src: Le ntetho ibonise indlela mayelana nokusebenza kwenkqubo karhulumente yokungena endimeni.
tgt: Le nkulumo ithula umgudu wamaqhinga wokuqalisa ukusebenza kohlelo lokusebenza lukahulumeni.

src: UMongameli umemelele urhulumente, abasebenzi namashishini ukuba basebenze ngokubambisana ukuze bafumane izisombululo eziza kunceda ekukhuliseni uqoqosho ngokuzingileyo.
tgt: UMongameli unxuse uhulumeni, abasebenzi kanye nabamabhizinisi ukuba basebenzisane ukuthola izixazululo zokukhula komnotho okusimeme.

src: IKhabhinethi iyawaxhasa amanyathelo okuthoba inkcitho, manyathelo lawo aza kwaziswa nguMphathiswa wezeMali ngomhla wama-24 kweyoMdumba.
tgt: IKhabinethi isekela izinyathelo zokunciphisa izindleko ezimenyezelwe nguMongameli, ezizochazwa kabanzi nguNgqongqoshe Wezezimali mhla zingama-24 kuNhlolanja.

src: INtetho yoHlahlo Lwabiwo-malii lowama-2016/17 iza kuphinda ibonise indlela yokwabiwa kwamancedo ngokweenkqubo ngeenkqubo zikarhulumente, ngokokugxinisisa kukaMongameli.
tgt: INkulumo Yesabelomali yonyaka wezi-2016/17 izophinda iveze ukwabiwa kwezinsizakusebenza kuzinhlelo zeminyango ezihlukahlukene njengoba kugcizelelwe nguMongameli.

src: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNgqungquthela yezeMigodi ebibanjelwe ngempumelelo eKapa ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-11 kweyoMdumba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele ukubanjwa ngempumelelo kweNgqungquthela Yezimayini, ebibanjelwe eDolobheni LaseKapa kusukela ziyi-8 kwaze kwaba mhla ziyi-11 kuNhlolanja.

src: Abameli abaphambili becandelo lezemigodi noorhululumente abaninzi base-Afrika babelana ngeembono zabo malunga nendlela eli candelo elingaluqhuba ngayo utyalo-mali lixhamle nakumathuba akhoyo e-Afrika.
tgt: Izikhulu eziqhamuka kumkhakha wezokuvukuza kanye nakohulumeni abaningana base-Afrika zabelane ngemibono yazo ukuthi lo mkhakha ungalunxenxa kanjani utshalomali uphinde usebenzise ngempumelelo amathuba akhona e-Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuqhwabele izandla ukuzinikela korhulumente waseJapan ekunyuseni utyalo-mali lwayo eMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuthokozele ukuzibophezela okwenziwe nguhulumeni wase-Japan kokwandisa utshalomali lwakhe eNingizimu Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi iphinde yaqinisekisa ukuzinikela kwayo kwicandelo lezemigodi elizinzileyo neliphumelelayo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqinisekisile ukuzibophezela kwayo kumkhakha wezokuvukuza ozinzile futhi okhulayo.

src: IsiCwangciso-sikhokelo sesiVumelwano seCandelo lezeMigodi eliZinzileyo sixhasa icandelo lezemigodi kule meko inzima igqubayo.
tgt: UMhlahlandlela Wesivumelwano Semboni Yezokuvukuza Ezinzile usekela imboni yezokuvukuza esimweni samanje esinzima.

src: IKhabhinethi isoloko inika ingcaciso kunye nesiqinisekiso ngemithetho elawula ezemigodi kwaye iza kuqinisekisa ukuqukunjelwa koMthetho osaYilwayo woPhuhliso lweziMbiwa nePetroliyam osePalamente kungoku nje.
tgt: Uhulumeni uyaqhubeka nokucacisa imithetho eza kusetyenziswa futhi uzoqinisekisa ukuthi uMthethosivivinywa Wokuthuthukiswa Kwezimbiwaphansi Nopethroli, osezithebeni zePhalamende, uyaphothulwa.

src: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi eziqavile.

src: IKhabhinethi iwuvumile uMgaqo-nkqubo wokugqibela weSizwe wokuNgcakaza ojongene nemingeni ethintela ukusebenza kakuhle koMthetho weSizwe wezokuNgcakaza, wowama-2004 (uMthetho uNombolo 7 wowama-2007).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphasise Inqubomgomo Kazwelonke Yezokugembula yokugcina, exazulula izinselele ezithiya ukusebenza ngempumelelo koMthetho Kazwelonke Wezokugembula, wezi-2004 (uMthetho we-7 wezi-2004).

src: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo sele kuboniswene ngawo noluntu.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo isidlulile ohlelweni lokudingidwa kwayo nomphakathi.

src: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uza nezilungiso kwimithetho elawula iibhodi zokungcakaza, kwaye iqinisa imiqathango yolawulo ukuze kuhle ukusetyenziswa kakubi kokungcakaza.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo iphakamisa izichibiyelo kumhlahlandlela wokulawula wezigungu zokugembula futhi iqinisa izindlela zokulawula ngenhloso yokunciphisa ukugembula budedengu.

src: Usebenza kwiikhasino, kwi-bingo, koomatshini bokungcakaza abangahlawuli kakhulu nasekubhejeni emidyharhweni yamahashe.
tgt: Ufaka amakhasino, amabhingo, imishini ekhona izamba ezithile, kanye nokubhejela amahhashi.

src: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uza kutshintsha iBhodi yeSizwe yezokuNgcakaza, ijike ibe nguMlawuli weSizwe wezokuNgcakaza oza kuba phantsi kweSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo izoqeda Isigungu Sikazwelonke Sokugembula kungene Umlawuli Kazwelonke Wezokugembula esikhundleni saso nozokuba ngaphansi koMnyango Wezokuhweba Nezezimboni.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume ukuba iNgxelo engokuPhononongwa kweYona miNyaka iVumelekileyo ukuba uBani angaBekwa iTyala loLwaphulo-mthetho ingeniswe ePalamente ngokommiselo woMthetho wezoBulungisa baBantwana, wowama-2008 (uMthetho uNombolo 75 wowama-2008).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele ukulethwa ePhalamende koMbiko Wokubuyekezwa Kweminyaka Ephansi Yokuphila Kwengqondo Ukuze Utholakale unecala lobelelesi, nokudingekayo ngokoMthetho Wezobulungiswa Bezingane, wezi-2008 (uMthetho wama-75 wezi-2008).

src: Le ngxelo ikhuthaza ukuba ilizwe eli lamkele izinyanzeliso zamazwe ngamazwe nezeengingqi malunga neyona minyaka mincinci ivumelekileyo yabantwana abanokuthi baphule ngayo umthetho.
tgt: Lo mbiko uphakamisa ukuthi izwe lisebenzise izibopho zomhlaba nesifunda mayelana neminyaka ephansi yokuphila kwengqondo ukuze utholakale unecala lobelelesi lezingane eziphula umthetho.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume ukupapashwa kwiphephandaba lombuso kweZiza zokuPhuhliswa kwaMandla aHlaziyekayo (i-REDZ).
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukumenyezelwa kweZindawo Zokuphehlwa Kwamandla Asebenziseka Kabusha (i-REDZ).

src: Ezi ziza ziza kucwangcisa iinkqubo zokumisela imithetho, zichonge iindawo apho ubuxhakaxhaka bobuchwepheshe bomoya nelanga be-photovoltaic bungakhuthazwa khona nalapho bungalawulwa khona.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoqondisa izinhlelo zokulawula, kuhlonze izindawo zebalazwe lapho ubuchwepheshe be-Photovoltaic obusebenzisa umonya nelanga kungasetshenziswa khona futhi lapho kungandiswa khona kakhulu ukuphehlwa kukagesi ongena ezintanjeni zikagesi zikazwelonke.

src: Ezi REDZ ziza kuqinisekisa ukutshintshela kuqoqosho olusebenzisa ikharbon ephantsi, zikhawulezise uphuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo, kwaye zibe negalelo kwimithetho evakalayo necacileyo eza kuphugula ubucukubhede obuhambelana nexabiso lokuthobela.. IKhabhinethi inikwe amagqabantshintshi ngeziphumo zowama-2014 zeNgxelo yoMzantsi Afrika yeziKhombisi zeNzululwazi, ubuChwephweshe nobuChule bokuYila yeBhunga leSizwe leeNgcebiso ngezokuYila.
tgt: Lawa ma-REDZ azoqinisekisa ukuguqukela kumnotho ongcolisa kancane, ukusheshiswa kokuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda, kanye nokufaka isandla kumhlahlandlela ocacile noqagulekayo onciphisa izithiyo ezihlobene nezindleko zokuthobela umthetho.

src: Le yingxelo yezinto ezenzekayo ekusebenzeni kweNkqubo yeSizwe yezokuYila (i-NSI).
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngemiphumela Yombiko Wezinkomba ZaseNingizimu Afrika Zesayensi, Ezobuchwepheshe Nokusungula zonyaka we-2014 woMkhandlu Kazwelonke Olulekayo Wezokusungula.

src: Ihlola ukwenza umsebenzi negalelo le-NSI kwizinto eziphambili ezingundoqo kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP).
tgt: Umbiko uhlinzeka lokho okuvamise ukwenzeka ekusebenzeni koHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwezokusungula.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume ukusetyenziswa kwamagosa karhulumente adla umhlalaphantsi nalowo asaqeshiweyo njengabahlohli kwisiKolo sikaZwelonke sikaRhulumente (i-NSG).I-NSG yaqala ukusebenza ngowama-2013, sithatha indawo yeZiko lokuQeqesha ubuNkokeli noLawulo (i-PALAMA), kwaye sigunyaziswe ukuba sikhuthaze ukuphuhla okuphucukileyo kwezinto ezingundoqo nemithetho-siseko elawula ulawulo lwamagosa karhulumente kwaye sibe semgangathweni, sibe nefuthe ekuphuhliseni izakhono zabasebenzi kumaziko.
tgt: Luhlola ukusebenza kanye nomthelela we-NSI emisebenzini kazwelonke eseqhulwini njengoba ivezwe kuHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kweze (i-NDP).

src: Eli linge liza kukhe livavanywe kuqala nokusebenza kweNKqubo esisiNyanzelo yoQhelaniso yabasebenzi bakarhulumente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukusetshenziswa kwabafundisi bezikhungo zemfundo ephakeme esebethathe umhlalaphansi kanye nabasebenzi bakahulumeni njengabafundisi baseSikoleni Sikahulumeni Sikazwelonke (i-NSG).I-NSG yathulwa ngokusemthethweni ngonyaka we-2013, esikhundleni seSikhungo Sikahulumeni Sokuphatha Nobuholi (i-PALAMA), futhi sinegunya lokukhuthaza ukufezwa kwemigomo ebusa ukulawula kuhulumeni kanye nokwenza ngcono izinga, ubukhulu kanye nomthelela wokuthuthukiswa kwamandla ezokuphathwa kwezabasebenzi ezikhungweni.

src: Le nkqubo yenza abasebenzi bakarhulumente babe lulutho kwinkonzo karhulumente.
tgt: Lesi sinyathelo sizohlolwa ngokuqaliswa kokusetshenziswa koHlelo Oluphoqelekile Lokwamukelwa Kwabasebenzi bakahulumeni.

src: Baza kwabelana ngamava abo, ubungcali, izakhono kunye nolwazi ukuze bacebise kwaye bancede abasebenzi bakarhulumente.
tgt: Le ndlela yenza ukuthi abasebenzi bakahulumeni bakwazi ukwengeza ukubaluleka emsebenzini kahulumeni.

src: Eli linge liza kuphinda liphucule kakuhle nangendlela eyonga inkcitho izinga leenkonzo esizinika uluntu.
tgt: Bazokhipha isipiliyoni, amakhono kanye nolwazi lwabo ukuqeqesha abasebenzi bakahulumeni.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume iNgxelo yoMzantsi Afrika yesiGaba sesi-3 sokuGqibela engokuPhunyezwa koMbutho weNtsebenziswano noPhuhliso loQoqosho (i-OECD) (iSivumelwano esiChasana nokuNyoba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivume Umbiko Wezwe LaseNingizimu Afrika Wesigaba Sokugcina sesi-3 omayelana nokuqala koKusebenza Kwenhlangano Yezentuthuko Nokubambisana Kwezomnotho (i-OECD) (Isivumelwano Sokulwa Nokufumbathisa).

src: Le ngxelo iza kungeniswa kwiQela eliSebenza ngokuNyoba.
tgt: Umbiko uzonikezwa Iqembu Elisebenza Ngokufumbathisa le-OECD.

src: Ingxelo le icacisa nenkqubela karhulumente ekungeneleleni kwakhe athintele ukunyotywa ngabamanye amazwe, ngokukubona, ukukuphanda nokubutshutshisa.
tgt: Lo mbiko uveza inqubekela phambili eyenziwe nguhulumeni ekungeneleleni kwakhe ukuqeda ukufumbathisa okwenziwa ngabantu abavela emazweni angaphandle ngokubona, ukuphenya kanye nokushushisa amacala amayelana nakho.

src: Ingxelo ikwagqamisa nelinge lokuvula abantu amehlo ngolu lwaphulo-mthetho.
tgt: Lo mbiko uphinda uveze izinyathelo ezithathiwe ukuqwashisa ngalobu bugebengu.7 IKhabhinethi ivume ukuthi uMnyango Wezasekhaya (i-DHA) ufakwe kabusha Eqoqwaneni Lezobulungiswa, Ukuvinjelwa Kobugebengu Nezokuphepha.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume ukuba iSebe lemiCimbi yezeKhaya (i-DHA) lihlelwe ngokutsha libe phantsi kweNtlanganisela yezoBulungisa, uThintelo lolwaPhulo-mthetho noKhuseleko.
tgt: Igunya loMnyango Wezasekhaya wukugcina irejista ephephile, enolwazi okuyilonalona lomazisi kanye nesimo sawo wonke umuntu ongaphakathi kwemigcele yethu, nekwenza kwenzeke yonke eminye imisebenzi yombuso.

src: I-DHA igunyaziswe ukuba ligcine irejista eluqilima, echanekileyo yokuba ngoobani, isithini imeko yabo, bonke abangaphakathi kwemida yeli lizwe, nto leyo encedisa kakhulu kweminye imisebenzi karhulumente.
tgt: Uphinde wanikezwa igunya lokusingatha uhlelo lokufuduka, olunomthelela ngqo ekuphepheni kwezwe, ukubumbana komphakathi kanye nokufezwa kwezinhloso zentuthuko.

src: Isebe likwagunyaziswe ukuba liphathe inkqubo yemfuduko, enefuthe ngqo kukhuseleko lwesizwe, ukunamathelana koluntu nokuphumeleliswa kweenjongo zophuhliso.
tgt: Ngaphambili i-DHA ibifakwe ngaphansi kweqoqwana likaHulumeni Nokulawulwa komsebenzi ojwayelekile wokusekela ukulawula.

src: Kwilixa elingaphambili, eli Sebe lalihlelwe njengelixhasa ngeenkonzo zolawulo linqumbene nezokuPhatha kunye nezoLawulo.
tgt: Imithethosivivinywa.1 IKhabhinethi ikuphasisile ukwethulwa ePhalamende koMthethosivivinywa Wokuvikela, Ukukhuthaza, Ukuthuthukiswa Nokusingathwa Kolwazi Lwendabuko.

src: Imithetho esaYilwayo.1 IKhabhinethi ivume ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho osaYilwayo wokuKhusela, ukuKhuthaza, ukuPhuhlisa nokuLawula uLwazi lweMveli.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa ukuvikela, ugqugquzele intuthuko nokulawula Kwezinhlelo Zolwazi lwendabuko.

src: Lo mthetho osayilwayo injongo yawo kukukhusela, ukukhuthaza ukuphuhliswa nokulawulwa kweenkqubo zoLwazi lweMveli.
tgt: Uhlinzeka ukusungulwa kanye nemisebenzi yehhovisi Likazwelonke Lezinhlelo Zolwazi Lwendabuko, ukuphathwa kwamalungelo abanikazi bolwazi lwendabuko, ukusungulwa kanye nemisebenzi yephaneli yokweLuleka ngezinhlelo zolwazi lwendabuko.

src: Ubonelela ngokusekwa nangemisebenzi yeofisi yeeNkqubo zeSizwe zoLwazi lweMveli, ulawulo lamalungelo abo banolwazi lwemveli, ukusekwa nemisebenzi yabantu aBacebisi malunga neenkqubo zolwazi lwemveli.
tgt: Uphinda uvumele ukufinyelela kanye nemibandela yokufinyelela olwazini lwemiphakathi yendabuko neyendawo, ukusungulwa kohlelo lokuqopha lwezinhlelo zolwazi lwendabuko, ukubhaliswa, ukugunyazwa kanye nokunikezwa izitifiketi kongoti bolwazi lwendabuko, ukulawulwa nokuqondiswa kokusungula okuncike olwazini lwendabuko.

src: Ukwavumela ukufikelela kunye nemiqathango yokufikelela kulwazi ngabahlali bomthonyama nabendawo, ukusekwa kwenkqubo yesizwe yokurekhoda iinkqubo zolwazi lwemveli, ukubhalisa, ukugunyazisa nokunikwa kweencwadi ezifaneleyo iincutshe zemveli, ukulungiselela nokulungelelanisa ulwazi lwemveli olungqiyame ngezinto ezintsha.
tgt: Lo mthethosivivinywa uzosekela Umthetho Oyisichibiyelo Wemithetho Yobunikazi Bolwazi, wezi-2013 (uMthetho wa-28 wezi-2013).IKhabhinethi ivume ukushicilelwa koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Iregistra Yamatayitela yonyaka wezi-2015 ukuthi umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Lo mthetho osayilwayo uza kufezekisa iSilungiso seMithetho yoLwazi olungoloMqambi walo kuphela we- 2013 (uMthetho wama-28 we- 2013).IKhabhinethi ivume ukupapashwa kweSilungiso soMthetho osaYilwayo wokuBhaliswa kweeNcwadi zeZiqinisekiso zeMihlaba zowe-2015 ukuze uluntu luphefumle ngaso.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Weregistra Yamatayitela, we-1937 (uMthetho wama-47 we-1937).

src: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo ulungisa uMthetho wokuBhaliswa kweeNcwadi zeZiqinisekiso zoMhlaba we-1937 (uMthetho wama- 47 we-1937) ukuze iofisi yezi ncwadi ibe yala maxesha asebenzisa ubuxhakaxhaka beinthanethi.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlose ukuchibiyela uMthetho Wamaregistra Amatayitela, we-1937 (uMthetho wa-47 we-1937) ukuze kufudukwe kusukwa ekusebenzeni ngephepha kuyiwe kulezo ezisebenza ngobuchwepheshe ehhovisi lamatayitela.

src: Loo nto ijonga imiba yokhuseleko ngokubonelela ngokubhaliswa kwabo bancutsheza ngokususa umhlaba komnye umntu uye komnye njengabagunyaziswe ukusebenzisa le nkqubo yokubhaliswa kwemihlaba ngobuxhakaxhaka beinthanethi.2 IKhabhinethi ivume ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho osaYilwayo weMpilo yeZityalo yowe-2015.
tgt: Uxazulula izindaba zezokuphepha ngokuhlinzeka ukubhalisa kwabadlulisi bezakhiwo njengabasebenzisi abasemthethweni bohlelo lwezobuchwepheshe lokubhaliswa kwamatayitela.2 IKhabhinethi ikuvuphasisile ukulethwa ePhalamende koMthethosivivinywa wezi-2015 Wempilo Yezihlahla.

src: Lo mthetho osayilwayo ulungelelanisa umthetho woMzantsi Afrika nezinyanzeliso kunye nemigangatho efaneleyo ukulungiselela urhwebo olukhuselekileyo nolungakhethi cala lamazwe ngamazwe ukuqinisa urhwebo lwasekhaya nolwamazwe ngamazwe lwezityalo neziveliso zezityalo.
tgt: Lo mthethosivivinywa wenza umthetho waseNingizimu Afrika uhambisane nezibopho kanye namazinga ukwenza lula futhi kube nobulungiswa ukuhweba komhlaba ukuphephisa ukuhweba komhlaba nokwaleli lizwe ngezihlahla kanye nemikhiqizo yezihlahla.

src: Wakuba uphunyeziwe lo mthetho osayilwayo, uMzantsi Afrika uza kukwazi ukuthintela ukungena kwezitshabalalisi zasemazweni ezivalelweyo ngenxa yezifo ezibulalayo kwanezifo ezinokusasaza izitshabalalisi ezinobungozi nezifo zezityalo elizweni.
tgt: Uma lo Mthethosivivinywa usuphasile, iNingizimu Afrika izokwazi ukuvimbela ukwethulwa kwezindlela zokuhlukanisa zangaphandle zezinambuzane nezifo ezingasabalalisa izinambuzane eziyingozi kanye nezifo zezitshalo kuleli lizwe.3 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukwethulwa ePhalamende koMthethosivivinywa wezi-2015 Ochibiyela Umthetho Wezinkantolo.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho osiSilungiso osaYilwayo weeNkundla zamaTyala we-2015.Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo ulungisa uMthetho weeNkundla zeeMantyi we-1944 (uMthetho wama-32 we-1944) noMthetho osiSilungiso weeNkundla eziPhakamileyo we-2013 (uMthetho we-10 we-2013).Ezi zilungiso zijonge ukwenza lula imeko yabakwelitayo abazifumana bengamaxhoba okuphathwa kakubi yinkqubo yokuqokelelwa kwamatyala kwiinkundla zemantyi.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wezinkantolo Zezimantshi, we-1944 (uMthetho wa-32 we-1944) noMthetho Wokuchibiyela Izinkantolo Eziphakeme, wezi-2013 (uMthetho we-10 wezi-2013).Izichibiyelo zihlose ukuphungula usizi lwabakweletayo abazithola behlukunyezwa ohlelweni lokuqoqa izikweletu ezinkantolo zezimantshi kanye nokufaka uhlelo loMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni lokususa ulwazi lwezikweletu zabathengi olungeluhle.

src: Zikwajonge nokulungiselela iprojekthi yeSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino yokuguzula iinkcukacha ezimbi zesikweliti somthengi.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlose ukuchibiyela izingxenye zoMthetho Wezinkantolo Zezimantshi, we-1994 (uMthetho wa-32 we-1994) (i-MCA), ukubhekana nokusetshenziswa budedengu koMyalelo Wokuchibiyela Izinkokhelo (i-EAO).Lo Mthethosivivinywa uhlose ukubhekana futhi uqede izahlulelo ezikhishwa ngokungemthetho, kakhulukazi ngonobhala bezinkantolo ngaphandle kokubheka umthetho, izikhathi eziningi ngenxa yokungazi noma ukuhlangana nabakweletwayo, nabameli babo noma nabaqoqi bezikweletu.

src: Lo Mthetho osaYilwayo ufuna ukulungisa amacandelo athile oMthetho weeNkundla zeeMantyi we-1994 (uMthetho wama-32 we-1994) ukuze ujongane nokuphathwa kakubi kwiziHlomelo zeMiyalelo yokuNyanzelisa ukuHlawulwa (i-EAO).
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uzoqinisekisa ukuthi abakweletwayo banikezwa izahlulelo ezihambisana nomyalelo wokukhokha ngamancozuncozu noma Umyalelo Wokuthathwa Kwezinkokhelo ohambisana nemali esemthethweni ebekelwe ukuthi ikhokhwe.

src: Imisitho ezayo.1 Impelaveki yokuqala yokubhaliswa kwabavoti bebhaliselwa uNyulo lowe-2016 loRhulumente waseKhaya iza kuba ngomhla we-5 ukuya kowe-6 kweyoKwindla kowe-2016.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.1 Impelaviki yokuqala yokubhalisa abavoti bebhalisela Ukhetho Lukahulumeni Wasekhaya lonyaka we-2016 kuzoqhutshwa mhla zi-5 zize zibe yi-6 Ndasa 2016.

src: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abahlali boMzantsi Afrika ukuba baluxhamle kwaye baluzimase olu lawulo lwentando yesininzi olufumaneke nzima ngokuthi baphume balisebenzise ilungelo labo lolawulo lwentando yesininzi babhalise kwaye bavote kolu nyulo luzayo.2 UMongameli Zuma uza kutyelela ngokwaseburhulumenteni e-Islamic Republic of Iran ukususela ngomhla wama- 28 ukuya kowama-29 kweyoMdumba ngowe- 2016.Olu tyelelo luza kuqinisa ukunxibelelana okusoloko kuqhubeka kwezopolitiko noqoqosho ne-Iran kwaye luvuselele nobudlelwane phakathi kwamazwe aseZantsi kunye naseNtla kwe-Ikhweyitha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi zisebenzise leli thuba futhi zihloniphe le ntando yeningi labantu eyatholakala kanzima ngokuthi ziye ukuyosebenzisa ilungelo lazo lentando yeningi labantu ngokubhalisa kanye nokuvota okhethweni oluzayo.2 UMongameli Zuma uzothatha Uhambo Olusemthethweni Lombuso Lokuvakashela i-Islamic Republic of Iran kusukela zi-28 zize zibe ngama-29 Nhlolanja 2016.Lokhu kuvakasha kuzoqinisa ukuxosisana kwethu okuqhubekayo ngezepolitiki nangezomnotho ne-Iran nokwenza ngcono ubudlelwano phakathi kwalawa mazwe.

src: NjengeNkumanda ePhezulu yoMbutho weSizwe wezoKhuselo woMzantsi Afrika (i-SAND), uMongameli Zuma uza kuphatha umcimbi woSuku lwecandelo loMkhosi lesihlanu.
tgt: NjengoMkhuzi Omkhulu Wombutho Wezokuvikela WaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SANDF), uMongameli Zuma uzophatha imibhiyozo Yosuku Lwamasosha yehlandla lesihlanu eBhayi, eMpumalanga Kapa, mhla zingama-21 Nhlolanja 2016.

src: Kuza bhiyozwa eBhayi,eMpuma Koloni ngomhla wama-21 kweyoMdumba kowe-2016.
tgt: Le mibhiyozo eyenziwa minyaka yonke ikhombisa ukusekela nokubonga amalungu esilisa nawesifazane e-SANDF.3 UMongameli Zuma uzokwethula inkulumo ekuvulweni Kwendlu Kazwelonke Yabaholi Bendabuko ePhalamende, eKapa mhla zingama-26 Nhlolanja 2016.

src: Lo mbhiyozo owenziwa unyaka nonyaka ubonisa inkxaso nombulelo kumadoda namabhinqa oMkhosi weSizwe woKhuselo woMzantsi Afrika.3 UMongameli Zuma uza kuthetha xa kuvulwa iNdlu yeSizwe yeeNkokheli zeMveli ePalamente eKapa ngomhla wama-26 kweyoMdumba kowe-2016.
tgt: Ubuhlobo phakathi kukahulumeni kanye nabaholi bendabuko busemqoka njengoba besebenzela ukwenza ngcono izimpilo zabantu.4 NgoMgqibelo, mhla zingama-20 Nhlolanja 2016, iPhini likaMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa uzohola ithimba loNgqongqoshe kuMbukiso Wokuthuthukiswa Kwentsha oqhutshwa nguMongameli e-Grace Bible Church ePimville, eSoweto.

src: Lo mboniso uxhaswa ngamasebe emiCimbi yaseKhaya, ezabaSebenzi, oPhuhliso loLuntu noKhuselo.
tgt: Lo mbukiso usekelwa nguMnyango Wezasekhaya, Umnyango Wezabasebenzi, Umnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi noMnyango Wezokuvikela.

src: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abantu abatsha baloo ndawo ukuba baye kulo mboniso oza kubonelela ngolwazi lokuqhubela phambili ezifundweni,ukuqala amashishini abo okanye ukuncedwa ngamalinge karhulumente enkxaso.
tgt: IKhabinethi inxusa intsha yakule ndawo ukuthi ithamele lo mbukiso, ozohlinzeka ulwazi mayelana nokuthi ingaziqhuba kanjani izifundo zayo, iqale amabhizinisi kanye nokuhlomula kuzinhlelo zokusekelwa nguhulumeni.5 IKhabhinethi ivume ukusingathwa koMhlangano Wase-Afrika omayelana noKuvikelwa Kwabantu kuncike Ekuzikhetheleni Ubulili, Ukuveza Ubulili kanye Nenkulumo, yiKhomishani Yamalungelo Esintu YaseNingizimu Afrika, kusukela mhla zi-3 zize zibe yi-5 Ndasa 2016.Lo mhlangano uzokwenza lula ukuxoxisana ukuze kube nokuqonda kwezimbangela eziyimisuka kanye nokuvela kwalezi zinselele ukuze kutholakale izisombululo ezisebenzayo ezikhona kuMbuso ukubhekana nalokhu kwephulwa komthetho.6 IKhabinethi ifisela impumelelo bonke abafundi ababhala ukuhlolwa kokuChibiyela Isitifiketi Sikamatikuletsheni.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume ukubanjwa kweNdibano ye-Afrika engokuKhuselwa kwaBantu ngokweNdlela abaziBona, Abazichaza nabaZazi ngayo iSini sabi yiKhomishoni yoMzantsi Afrika yamaLungelo oLuntu ukususela ngomhla we-3 ukuya kowe-6 kweyoKwindla kowe-2016.
tgt: Abafundi bayakhuthazwa ukuthi bamukele ngezandla zombili uhlelo lwethuba lesibili lokubhala umatikuletsheni olusanda kuthulwa ngokusemthethweni olutholakala kuzo zonke izifundazwe futhi olusiza abafundi ngezifundo zabo ngokusebenzisa izinsiza ezihlukahlukene.

src: Le semina iza kulungiselela uthethathethwano ukuze kubekho kuqondwe ngakumbi oyena nobangela ongundoqo wale mingeni nokuzibonakalisa kwayo ukuze kufumaneke izisombululo ezibonakalayo nezinto ezikhoyo okunokukhethwa kuzo nguRhulumente ukujongana nolu lwaphulo.6 IKhabhinethi inqwenelela impumelelo bonke abafundi ababhala iimviwo zabo zokuxabangela iBanga le-12.
tgt: Inhloso yoHlelo Lwethuba Lesibili Lokubhala Umatikuletsheni ukunikeza abantu abasha ithuba lokuphasa umatikuletsheni ngaleyo ndlela benze ngcono isimo sezimpilo zabo.

src: Abafundi bakhuthazwa ukuxhamla iNkqubo esandula ukusungulwa enika abafundi umnyinyiva wesibini wokubhala iimviwo zebanga le-12.
tgt: Ukuhlolwa kokuchibiyela kuyingxenye yoHlelo Lomnyango Lwethuba Lesibili Lokubhala Umatikuletshenzi kanye nokuhlinzeka abafundi abangakwazanga ukuhlangabezana nemibandela yokukhushulwa neyokunikezwa isitifiketi, kodwa abadinga ukuphasa izifundo ezimbili kuphela ukuze bathole i-NSC ithuba lokwenza njalo.

src: Ikho kuwo onke amaphondo kwaye inceda abafundi ezifundweni zabo ngezixhobo.
tgt: Inxusa bonke abantu abanentshisekelo Emfundweni Ephakeme ukuthi babambe iqhaza emsebenzini wekhomishani ukuze kutholakale ikhambi lesikhathi eside kuzinselele ezibhekene neMfundo Ephakeme.

src: Injongo yeli Thuba lesiBini lokuBhala iBanga le-12 kukunika abantu abatsha abangaliphumelelanga ibanga le-12 umnyinyiva wesibini wokupasa, ngaloo ndlela baphucule izinga lobomi babo.
tgt: Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni eziqavile kwezemvelo.1 UNgqongqoshe Wezezimbiwaphansi uMosebenzi Zwane, Ungqongqoshe Ehhovisini Likamongameli uSusan Shabangu kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Komphakathi uBathabile Dlamini – abaqokwe nguMongameli Zuma ukuthi basekele uhulumeni wesifundazwe, abaphathi bemayini nemindeni ethintekile kulandela isigameko sase-Lily Gold Mine eBarberton - bazise iKhabhinethi ngezakamumva.

src: Iimviwo zokuxabangela ziyinxalenye yeNkquba yokuNika iThuba lesiBini lokuBhala iiMviwo zeBanga le-12 yesebe kwaye inceda abo bangaphumelelanga nabangafumananga ziqinisekiso, kodwa befuna ubuncinane izifundo ezibini ukuze babe bapasile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi njengoMongameli icela isizwe ukuthi sigcine emithandazwe nasemicabangweni abavukuzi abathathu abasavaleleke emathunjini omhlaba kanye nemindeni yabo.2 IKhabhinethi isakhathazekile ngesomiso esisalokhu siqhubekile nokuhlasela izingxenye ezithile zezwe.

src: IKhabhinethi yamkela isibhengezo sikaMongameli samagama amalungu eKhomishoni yoPhando ngeMfundo ePhakamileyo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa ukubonga kubo bonke abananele ikwelo lokubika ukuvuza kwamazi ukusekela Umkhankaso Wokulwa Nokuvuza Kwamanzi oholwa Ungqongqoshe Wezamanzi Nokuthuthwa Kwendle uNomvula Mokonyane.

src: Imemelela bonke abanomdla nabachaphazelekayo kwiMfundo ePhakamileyo ukuba babe negalelo emsebenzini wekhomoshoni ukuze kufunyanwe isisombululo esiza kuhlala sihleli semingeni ejongene nayo iMfundo ePhakamileyo.1 Uluvo lweKhabhinethi malunga nemiba esematheniUMphathiswa weSebe lemiThombo yeziMbiwa uMosebenzi Zwane, ovela kwiSebe likaMongameli uSusan Shabangu noMphathiswa weSebe loPhuhliso loLuntu uBathabile Dlamini—abakhethwa nguMongameli Zuma ukubonelela ngenkxaso urhulumente wephondo, abasebenzi-mgodini neentsapho ezichaphazelekayo emva kwentlekele kuMgodi iLiily Gold Mine eBarberton – bachazele iKhabhinethi ngokutsha okwenzekayo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabonga ngomoya wobuntu okhonjiswe yisinyathelo esiholwa yi-Operation Hydrate owenze umehluko emiphakathini ekhahlamezekile.3 IKhabhinethi idingide yaphinda yabheka imiphumela ephelele yokuqala kokusebenza koMthetho Ochibiyela Imithetho Yentela, wezi-2014.

src: IKhabhinethi yazibandakanya noMongameli ekumemeleleni isizwe ukuba sicinge ngabasebenzi-mgodini abathathu abasabambeke phantsi komhlaba kwaye sibathandazele.
tgt: Ngokwalo Mthetho, ukushintshwa kwesikhwama seprovidenti imali yaso ikhokelwe ngamancozuncozu ngenyanga kuzoqala mhla lu-1 Ndasa 2016.

src: IKhabhinethi isoloko ixhalabile yimbalela esachaphazela iindawo ezithile zelizwe.
tgt: Lokho kusho ukuthi kusukela ngalolu suku imihlomulo yesikhwama seprovidenti kanye nemihlomulo yesikhwama sezimpesheni kuzolawulwa ngendlela efanayo ngokuthi uma amalungu esikhwama seprovidenti ethatha umhlalaphansi ayovunyelwa ukuthatha ingxenye yokukodwa kokuthathu njengemali eyisamba futhi ingxenye yokubili kokuthathu yemihlomulo yawo kuyomele ikhokhwe ngamancozuncozu nyangazonke.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa uvuyo lwayo kwabo basabele ikhwelo lokuxela ukuvuza kwamanzi ngolo hlobo bexhasa iPhulo loMphathiswa waManzi noCoceko uNomvula Mokonyanene.
tgt: Izinguquko kulo mthetho zithinta abantu abahola kakhulu kanye nabo bonke abantu abangaphansi kwezikhwama zeprovidenti.

src: IKhabhinethi ivuyela umoya wobuntu obubonakaliswe liphulo elikhokhelwa yiOperation Hydrate nelenze umahluko kubahlali ababandezelekileyo.2 IKhabhinethi ixoxile yaqwalesela iziphumo ngokupheleleyo zokuqalisa koMthetho osisiLungiso seMithetho yeRhafu we-2014.
tgt: Izinhlangano kanye nabantu abaningi bazwakalise ukukhathazeka mayelana nokuqaliswa kokusetshenziswa kwezinguquko ezintsha futhi benza izethulo kuhulumeni mayelana nokuqaliswa kokusetshenziswa kwalezi zinguquko.

src: Ngokwalo Mthetho, ukuhlawulwa kwemali esisigxina kwingxowamali egciniweyo kuza kuqalisa ngomhla wokuqala kweyoKwindla ngo-2016.
tgt: Kusobala ukuthi, phezu kwezinhlelo zokuxoxisana ezenziwa ngaphambi kokuphasiswa kwalo mthetho, kusekhona ukukhathazeka futhi lokho kukhathazeka kumele kuxazululwe ngokushesha ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ngesikhathi umthetho uqala, izinguquko kumihlomulo yesikhwama seprovidenti ziqale ngaphandle kwezihibe futhi ngempumelelo.

src: Loo nto ithetha ukuthi ukususela ngaloo mhla amancedo aloo ngxowa aza kufana nawomhlala-phantsi lo uqhelekileyo kuba amalungu aloo ngxowamali xa athatha umhlalaphantsi aza kuvunyelwa ukuba athathe isambukru esiziinkozo esisinye esithathwini kumancedo.
tgt: Ngalesi sizathu, iKhabhinethi inqume ukuthula umthetho wokuchibiyela uMthetho Ochibiyela Imithetho Yentela ngokushesha ukuhlehlisa ukuqala kosuku lokusebenza kwezinguquko lusuka mhla lu-1 Ndasa 2016 luye mhla lu-1 Ndasa 2018 ukuze kuqhutshekwe nokuxoxisana nabo bonke abathintekayo.

src: Imali esalayo kuza kufuneka amalungu ayisebenzise athenge imali enikwa umntu ngomnyaka ebomini bakhe bonke.
tgt: Lokho kuxoxisana kungaholela kokunye ukuchitshiyelwa kwemithetho.

src: Ezi nguqu emthethweni zichaphazela abo bamkela kakhulu nabanye abangamalungu engxowamali esisigxina.
tgt: Amazwi enduduzo.1 IKhabhinethi lithanda ukudlulisa amazwi enduduzo ngokudlula emhlabeni koNgcwele uBhishobhi Glayton Modise we-International Pentecostal Holiness Church.

src: Imibutho eminizi nabantu bavakalise inkxalabo ngokusebanza kwalo mthetho mtsha kwaye bathethe norhulumente ngawo.
tgt: UBhishobhi Modise uhole leli sonto elinamalungu angaphezu kwezigidi ezintathu kuyo yonke iningizimu ne-Afrika, emva kokushona kukababa wakhe futhi ongumsunguli wesonto, Ongcwele u-Comforter Frederick Modise ngonyaka we-19.2 IKhabhinethi lithanda ukudlulisa amazwi enduduzo ngokudlula emhlabeni kwaloyo owayenguNobhala-Jikelele Wenhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN) u-Boutros Boutros-Ghali.

src: Kuyacaca ukuba noxa kwathethathethwana kakhulu phambi kokuba lo mthetho uphunyezwe, kusekho inkxalabo kwaye kufuneka ijongwe ngokukhawuleza ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba xa uqala ukusebenza lo mthetho iinguqu kumancedo engxowamali esisigxina zisebenza ngokulula nakakuhle.
tgt: Waqala ukusebenza njenjoNobhala-Jikelele we-UN ngonyaka we-1992 ngesikhathi sokukhula kwamandla e-UN kulandela indima yayo empini yase-Gulf, esebenza ihlandla lokuphatha leminyaka emihlanu elilodwa.

src: Amazwi ovelwano.1 IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano ngokubhubha koHloniphekileyo uBhishophu Glayton Modise weInternational Pentecostal Holiness Church.
tgt: Kevin Govender weHhovisi elizinze eKapa le-Astronomy for Development and the International Astronomical Union ozoklonyeliswa nabanye ngeNdodo i-Edinburgh yonyaka we-2016 ngokusungula iHhovisi le-Astronomy for Development eDolobheni LaseKapa.

src: UBhishophu Modise ukhokhele ibandla elinamalungu angaphezu kweemiliyoni ezintathu kumazantsi eAfrika, emva kokubhubha kukayise nongumseki waloo cawe oHloniphekileyo uComforter Frederick Modise ngowe-19.2 IKhabhinethi ikwavakalisa uvelwano lwayo olunzulu ngokubhubha kutsha nje kwayesakuba nguNobhala-jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo, iNkosi Boutros Boutros-Ghali.
tgt: U-Govender yisakhamuzi sokuqala saseNingizimu Afrika ukuthola lo mklomelo ohloniphekile wempumelelo kwezesayensi nezobuchwepheshe okunomthelela ekuqondeni nakunhlalonhle yabantu.

src: Ungene kweso sikhundla ngowe-1992 xa ifuthe lo mbutho lo likhula emva kwemfazwe yeGulf, wasebenza iminyaka emihlanu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lihalalisela umdansi we-ballet oneminyaka eyi-16 ubudala u-Leroy Mokgatle owine i-Audience Favourite award nomfundaze e-Prix de Lausanne International Ballet Competition e-Switzerland.

src: Ubhubhe kwisibhedlele saseCairo eneminyaka engama- Uza kukhunjulwa ngegalelo lakhe kuxolo nolawulo lwentando yesininzi.
tgt: Uyisakhamuzi sokuqala saseNingizimu Afrika ukuwina lo mfundaze eminyakeni enga-28 futhi ungowesibili emlandweni waleli lizwe.

src: Imiyalezo yokuvuyisana.1 IKhabhinethi ivuyisana noMnu.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi lijoyina uMongameli Zuma ngokuhalalisela abawinde Izindondo zo-Ubuntu Zesibili ezibanjwa minyaka yonke.

src: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezisemqoka.

src: IKhabhinethi iyamkele iNtetho yoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali yowama-2016 ethe yenziwa nguMphathiswa wezeMali uPravin Gordhan ngomhla wama-24 kweyoMdumba yama-2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamukelile Inkulumo Yesabelomali Yonyaka we-2016 ethulwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezezimali uPravin Gordhan mhla zi-24 Nhlolanja 2016.

src: Olu hlahlo lwabiwo-mali lubonakalisa ukomelela, ukuzinikela nokuba nobuchule njengoko sichankcatha kwelona xesha lakhe lanzima kwezoqoqosho ezimbalini.
tgt: Lesi sabelomali sikhombisa ukubuyela esimweni, ukuzibophezela kanye nokukwazi ukubhekana nezinselele njengoba sibhekene nesimo somnotho esibi kakhulu emlandweni wamanje.

src: Olu hlahlo lwabiwo-mali luhlangabezana noko eli lizwe likudingayo kwaye lukwadala intembeko kwezoqoqosho ngokubeka eli lizwe kwindlela yohlumo lwezoqoqosho ethembakeleyo, ezinzileyo nedibene ngokuphilisayo.
tgt: Lesi sabelomali siphendula mayelana nalokho okudingwa yizwe futhi sibuyisa ukuzethemba emnothweni ngokubeka izwe emgudwini wokukhula komnotho ofaka uwonkewonke othembekile, ozinzile futhi okhulayo.

src: Kwakhona iKhabhinethi iyawamkela amanyathelo abalulekileyo okugcina iindleko ziphantsi kwemo elawulekayo kwaye ikwazibophelela ekusebenzisaneni nawo onke amacandelo ekwenzeni igalelo kwilinge elidibeneyo lesizwe ukuphumeza umlima-ndlela omiselwe luhlahlo lwabiwo-mali.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamukela futhi izinyathelo zokunciphisa izindleko futhi iyazibophezela ekusebenzisaneni nayo yonke imikhakha ekudlaleni indima emizamweni kazwelonke yawo wonke umuntu ukuqalisa ukusebenza umgudu ocatshwe yisabelomali.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukumiselwa kweQela looNondaba likaMongameli (i-PPC) nguMongameli uJacob Zuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukuthulwa ngokusemthethweni kweThimba Labezindaba Likamongameli (i-PPC) nguMongameli Jacob Zuma.

src: I-PPC izakuquka abahleli bezopolitiko, iintatheli zezopolitiko, oonondaba bezopolitiko neentatheli zezoqoqosho eziqinisekisiweyo ukuba zizo ezinegunya lokukhupha ingxelo nge-Ofisi kaMongameli ngokupheleleyo zihlale zisenza njalo rhoqo.
tgt: I-PPC izobunjwa ngabahleli bezindaba zombusazwe, ababhali bezindaba zombusazwe, ababika ngezindaba zombusazwe kanye nezintatheli zezindaba zomnotho ezinikezwe imvume yokubika ngeHhovisi Likamongameli ngokugcwele futhi ngokuqhubekayo.

src: Injongo ye-PPC kukubonelela amajelo eendaba ngokufikelela okuphuculiweyo kulwazi.
tgt: Inhloso ye-PPC ukuhlinzeka abemithombo yezindaba ukufinyelela okwenziwe ngcono olwazini.

src: Iza kuphucula ukufikelela kwamajelo eendaba kuMongameli ne-Ofisi kaMongameli, khona ukuze iqinisekise ukuba iintatheli nazo zifumana ulwazi neenkqubo ezizeleyo ukuze kuphucuke indlela ababhala kunye nabazikhupha ngayo iindaba.
tgt: Kuzophinda kwenze ngcono ukufinyela kwabezindaba kuMongameli kanye nakwiHhovisi Likamongameli, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi izintatheli zithola ulwazi oluyisisekelo kanye nezinhlelo ukwenza ngcono ukuqonda kanye nokubika kwazo.

src: Amalungu eliqelaloonondaba aza kuthatha inxaxheba kwiitlanganiso noSekela-Mongameli okanye nawuphi na uMphathiswa omenyiweyo nguMongameli ukuba babelane ngeenkqubo ezibalulekileyo kwisizwe.
tgt: Amalungu abalulekile ezindaba azophinda akhishelwe izindaba yiPhini Likamongameli kanye nanoma yimuphi uNgqongqoshe omenywa nguMongameli ukuthi azise ngezinhlelo ezibalulekile ezweni lethu.

src: IKhabhinethi ilincomile igalelo elenziwe nguMzantsi Afrika ekubuyiseleni uxolo eBurundi, ngokuhambelana nesibophelelo somgaqo-nkqubo wethu wezangaphandle ukuqinisekisa uxolo nozinzo kweli lizwekazi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakalise ukubonga ngomsebenzi owenziwe yiNingizimu Afrika ekubuyiseni uxolo e-Burundi, ngokuhambisana nokuzibophezela kwinqubomgomo yethu yazangaphandle ukuqinisekisa izwekazi elinokuthula futhi elizinzile.

src: Kwakhona izamkele iziphumo zoThethathethwano oluquka bonke abemi baseBurundi obelubanjwe ngethuba igqiza eliphezulu leeNtloko zemiBuso nooRhulumente leMbumba yase-Afrika (i-AU), ebelikhokelwa nguMongameli uZuma, belityelele eBujumbura eBurundi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yamukela imiphumela yeZingxoxo Zezakhamizi Zase-Burundi ezabanjwa ngesikhathi kuvakashe ithimba eliphezulu loMongameli leNhlangano Yamazwe Ase-Afrika (i-AU) e-Bujumbura e-Burundi, elaliholwa nguMongameli Zuma.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuchongwa kukaMongameli uZuma nguNobhala Jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) uBan Ki-moon, ukuba abe ngusihlalo wesibini kwiKhomishini ePhezulu yeNgqesho kwezeMpilo noHlumo lwezoQoqosho ebambisene noMongameli u-François Hollande weRhiphabliki yaseFrance.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukuqokwa kukaMongameli Zuma nguNobhala-Jikelele Wenhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN) u-Ban Ki-moon, ukuba abe ngomunye wosihlalo Bekhomishani Ephezulu Yezemisebenzi Kwezempilo Nokukhula Komnotho benoMongameli u-François Hollande weRiphabhuliki yase-France.

src: Asikuko okokuqala ukuba uMongameli uZuma achongwe ngumbutho wehlabathi ukuba enze umsebenzi kwimibutho yehlabathi.
tgt: Lokhu akukhona okokuqala ukuthi uMongameli Zuma aqokwe yinhlangano yomhlaba ukuthi enze umsebenzi ezingeni lomhlaba.

src: Le khomishini iza kuvuselela ukudalwa kwamathuba amatsha emisebenzi kwicandelo lezempilo kuwo onke amazwe jikelele, ingakumbi kulawo aphuhliswe kancinci.
tgt: Le khomishani izokhuthaza ukudalwa kwamathuba emisebenzi amasha emkhakheni wezempilo emazweni wonke, kakhulukazi lawo angathuthukile kahle.

src: Oku komeleza nokuphunyezwa kwe-Ajenda yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo yowama-2030, eza kunceda kakhulu ukuhlangabezana nemingeni entlantlu-ntathu yentswela-ngqesho, indlala nokungalingani.
tgt: Lokhu kuzophinda kugxilise ukuqaliswa koHlelo Lwentuthuko Ezinzile lwe-2030, oluzokwenza umsebenzi omkhulu ekuxazululeni izinkinga ezintathu okungukuswelakala kwemisebenzi, ububha nokungalingani.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukumiselwa koPhando lweSizwe loLuntu lowama-2016 eMamelodi ePitoli nguMphathiswa kwi-Ofisi kaMongameli uJeff Radebe noSonkcukhacha-manani Jikelele uPali Lehohla.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukuthulwa ngokusemthethweni kweNhlolovo Kazwelonke Yomphakathi yonyaka we-2016 eMamelodi, ePitoli nguNgqongqoshe eHhovisini LikaMongameli u-Jeff Radebe kanye noMqondisi-Jikelele Womnyango Wezezibalo uPali Lehohla.

src: Uhlolo lwalo nyaka lwenziwa phantsi komxholo othi: “UMzantsi Afrika endiwaziyo, ikhaya endiliqondayo” kwaye lujongiswe kwimizi engaphezu kwe-1,5 sezigidi – lilolona lukhulu ukuza kutsho ngoku xa luthelekiswa nolo lwalwenziwe kwiminyaka emihlanu edlulileyo elafikelela nje kwimizi engaphezulu kwama-300 000.
tgt: Inhlolovo yalo nyaka yenziwa ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi “iNingizimu Afrika engiyaziyo, ikhaya engiliqondayo” futhi ihlose imindeni engaphezulu kwesigidi esi-1,5 – nokuyinhlolovo enkulu njengamanje uma kuqhathaniswa neyayibanjwe eminyakeni emihlanu edlule eyenziwa emindenini eyi-300 000 kuphela.

src: Olu hlolo luza kwenziwe kwinyaga kaTshazimpuzi zize iziphumo zifumaneke ekupheleni kweyeSilimela yowama-2016.
tgt: Le nhlolovo izokwenziwa ngoMbaso kanti imiphumela yayo izotholakala emaphethelweni kaNhlangulana 2016.

src: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele ngenkxalabo ingxelo enikzelwe nguMbutho wezeMpilo weHlabathi kunye noMbutho weNtsebenziswano noPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho kuPhando lweCandelo llezeMpilo olukhokelwa yiJaji uSandile Ngcobo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaqaphela ngokukhathazeka umbiko othulwe yiNhlangano Yezempilo Yenhlangano Yezizwe kanye neNhlangano Yokubambisana Kwezomnotho Nentuthuko Ophenyweni Ngemakethe Yezempilo eholwa nguJaji Sandile Ngcobo.

src: Le ngxelo ibonisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ubonelela ngezona nkonzo zezonyango zibiza kakhulu xa uthelekiswa namanye amazwe.
tgt: Imibiko ikhomba ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ihlinzeka izinsizakalo zezokwelashwa ezimba eqolo kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa namanye amazwe.

src: IKhabhinethi iza kulinda kuqukunjelwe olu phando phambi kokuba iphefumle ngalo mba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izolinda ukuphothulwa kwalolu phenyo ngaphambi kokwenza isimemezelo mayelana nalolu daba.

src: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi eziqavile.

src: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukupapashwakweDrafti yesiCwangciso-qhinga sokuLwa iNgxaki yoNgcoliseko loMoya kwiiNdawo eziXineneyo Ezihlala Abantu abaMkela iMivuzo ePhantsi eMzantsi Afrika ukwenzela uluntu ukuba luhlomle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukushicilelwa kweQhinga Eliwuhlaka Lokubhekana Nokungcola Komoya Emiphakathini YaseNingizimu Afrika Enabantu Abaningi Abahola Kancane ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngalo.

src: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sigxile ekuboneleleni ngendlela egxile ekuzinikeleni ukusebenza ngezinga eliphezulu longcoliseko kolunye loluntu oluhlala kwiindawo ezixineneyo nolwamkela imivuzo ephantsi.
tgt: Leli qhinga lihlose ukuhlinzeka indlela egxile ekubhekaneni namazinga aphezulu okugcola emiphakathini enabantu abaningi abahola kancane.

src: Sibonelela ngendlela elungeleleneyo ekuphumezeni amalinge okunciphisa ukuvutha kwezibaso emakhayeni.
tgt: Lihlinzeka indlela ehlelekile ukuqalisa imizamo yokunciphisa intuthu edalwa ukusetshenziswa kwezinto ezifana namalahle negesi emakhaya.

src: Olu ngenelelo lelokuqinisekisa ukuba le mimandla iyathobelana neMimiselo yoMgangatho weziRhangqo yeSizwe.
tgt: Lokhu kungenelela kuhlose ukuqinisekisa ukuthi lezi zindawo zithobela Amazinga Kazwelonke Omoya Wendawo Ohlanzekile.

src: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sigxilileyo siza kuxhasa isicwangciso-qhinga sesizwe esikhoyo ukuhlangabezana nongcoliseko lomoya kweli lizwe.
tgt: Leli qhinga lizosekela iqhinga likazwelonke elisetshenziswa njengamanje ukubhekana nokugcoliseka komoya ezweni.

src: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuba urhulumente abe lelinye lamahlakani aza kusingatha iNgqungquthela yeZizwe-ngezizwe kaGawulayo yama-21 (i-AIDS 2016) ndawonye noNombutho eHlabathi kaGawulayo kwiZiko leNgqungquthela yeZizwe ngezizwe (i-ICC) eDurban ukususela ngomhla we-18 ukuya kowama-22 kweyeKhala yowama-2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukusingathwa ngokuhlanganyela kweNkomfa Yomhlaba Yengculazi Yama-21 (i-AIDS 2016) phakathi kukahulumeni neNhlangano Yomhlaba Ye-AIDS e-International Convention Centre (ICC) e-Durban kusukela mhla zi-18 zize zibe nga-22 Ntulikazi 2016.

src: Ukusingatha le ngqungquthela kuza kuqhubela phambili indlela ilizwe lethu elihlangabezana ngayo neeNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV) nesifo sephepha (i-TB) ngeli xesha kwangaxesha nye lisenza impembelelo komnye weyona mingeni iyeyona ibalulekileyo eMzantsi Afrika, kummandla welizwekazi nakwihlabathi.
tgt: Ukusingathwa kwale nkomfa kuzokwenza ngcono ukubhekana kwezwe ne-HIV nesifo sofuba ngesikhathi esifanayo kube nomthelela kwenye yezinselele ezibaluleke kakhulu eNingizimu Afrika, esifundeni kanye nasemhlabeni.

src: Le ngqungquthela iza kubonelela abaphandi abavela kwiinkalo zonke zehlabathi ngeqonga lokwabelana ngeenkqubo zobunzululwazi zala maxesha kweli candelo, ukufunda kubuchule bomnye nomnye nokuphuhlisa ubuchule bokuqhubela phambili onke amacala kumalinge wethu ahlangeneyo okunyanga nokuthintela i-HIUmthetho oYilwayo.
tgt: Ukusingathwa kwale nkomfa kuzohlinzeka inkudla kubacwaningi abavela emhlabeni jikelele ukuthi babelane ngenqubekela phambili yakamumva yezesayensi kulo mkhakha, ukufunda kumakhono abanye kanye nokuthuthukisa amaqhinga okuqhubezela phambili zonke izingxenye zemizamo yethu yokwelapha nokuvimbela igciwane lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV).

src: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukungeniswa koMthetho-siHlomelo wezoThutho zaseMhlabeni weSizwe wama-2015 ePalamente, ohlomela uMthetho wezoThutho zaseMhlabeni weSizwe, wama-2009 (uMthetho we-5 wama-2009).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuphasisile ukwethulwa ePhalamende Kwesichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Kazwelonke Wezithuthi Ezihamba Phansi sonyaka we-2015, esichibiyela uMthetho Kazwelonke Wezithuthi Ezihamba Phansi, wezi-2009 (uMthetho we-5 wezi-2009).

src: Ezi zilungisoo zoMthetho wezoThutho zaseMhlabeni wama-2009 ziza kuqhubela phambili inkqubo yokuguqula nokumisela ngokutsha inkqubo yezothutho zasemhlabeni yesizwe.
tgt: Izichibiyelo eMthethweni Kazwelonke Wezithuthi Ezihamba Phansi wezi-2009 zizoqhubeza izinhlelo zokuguqula kanye nokuhlela kabusha uhlelo lukazwelonke lwezithuthi ezihamba phansi.

src: Oku kuza kwenza igalelo kwinkonzo yezothutho kawonkewonke ekhuselekileyo, efikelelekayo, enobuchule nesebenzayo.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoba nomthelela kumisebenzi yezithuthi zomphakathi eziphephile, ezitholakala kalula, ezisebenza kahle nangempumelelo.

src: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ubonelela ngophuhliso olutsha kwicandelo lezothutho kawonkewonke.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uhlinzeka intuthuko entsha emkhakheni wezithuthi zomphakathi.

src: Ubonelela ngesikhokelo ekukho phakathi kwaso, izithuthi ezingezo moto iinkonzo zezothutho ezibizwa ngezixhobo zobuchwephetshe nokuphawulwa kwezithuthi zikawonkewonke ngokutsha ngokusebenza ngendlela ephucukileyo.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uhlinzeka umhlahlandlela, phakathi kokunye, ngezithuthi ezingenanjini, ngezithuthi ezikulanda emva kokuzibiza ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe kanye nokubhalwa kwezithuthi zomphakathi.

src: Ukwabonelela ngokucacisa ngengcaciso kwinkqubo yokudluliselwa kwamagunya nemimiselo ngokumayela nokukhutshwa kweelayisenisi zokuqhuba izithuthi zikawonkewonke.
tgt: Uphinda ucacise ngokulawula okuphathelene namandla abiwe kanye nemithethonkambiso emayelana nokukhishwa kwamalayisensi okuqhuba ibhizinisi lezithuthi zomphakathi.

src: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kubonelela ngokuqaliswa koThungelwano lwezoThutho lukaWonkewonke oluDibeneyo kwaye luyinxalenye yeProjekthi ye-7 yesiCwangciso seziSeko ezinguNdoqo seSizwe, sigxile ekusebenziseni uphuhliso olulungeleleyo ezidolophini nothungelwano lwezothutho oludibeneyo ukumisela izixeko njengonobangela wohlumo.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uzophinda uvumele ukuqaliswa Kwezithuthi Zomphakathi Ezididiyelwe futhi uyingxenye yoHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwengqalasizinda kanye nePhrojekthi Edidiyelwe Yamaqhinga ye-7, egxile ekusetshenzisweni kokuthuthukiswa okulawulwayo kwezithuthi zasedolobheni futhi ezididiyelwe ukwakha amadolobha njengezizinda zokukhula komnotho.

src: Imisitho ezayo.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.

src: UMongameli uZuma uza kuya luTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni kwiFederal Republic of Nigeria ukususela ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-9 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzothatha Uhambo Olusemthethweni Lokuvakashela e-Federala Republic of Nigeria kusukela mhla zi-8 zize zibe yi-9 Ndasa 2016.

src: Olu tyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni luza kuqinisa ubudlelwano obuphakathi kwalamazwe mabini nokuqhubela phambili urhwebo oluphakathi kwemimandla yala mazwe.
tgt: Lokhu kuVakasha Kombuso kuzokwenza gcono ubudlelwano obukhona njengamanje phakathi kwalawa mazwe amabili futhi kuphinde kwenze gcono ukuhweba phakathi kwezifunda.

src: INyanga yamaLungelo oLuntu kweyoKwindla yowama-2016 iza kubhiyozelwa phantsi komxholo othi: “UMzantsi Afrika umanyene ukulwa nobuhlanga.” ISebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko limisele inkqubo ebude buyinyanga equka iintlanganiso ezimalunga nokusebenzisana ukuze kwakhiwe isizwe esingenabuhlanga, esingacaluli ngokwesini, esilinganayo nesilawulwa ngentando yesininzi.
tgt: INyanga Yamalungelo Oluntu ngoNdasa 2016 izogujwa ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: "INingizimu Afrika ihlangene ekulweni nobandlululo."

src: IKhabhinethi icela abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bahlomle kwisiCwangciso sokuSebenza seSizwe sokulwa ubuHlanga, uCalucalulo ngokobuHlanga, iNtiyo yabaSuka kuMazwe angaPhandle kunye neminye imiKhuba yokungaNyamezelani (sowama-2016-2021) phambi komhla wama-30 kweyeSilimela yowama-2016.
tgt: UMnyango Wezobuciko Namasiko uhlanganise uhlelo oluzoqhubeka inyanga noluhlanganisa uchungechunge lwezingxoxo mayelana nokusebenza ngokubambisana ukwakha umphakathi ongacwasi ngokobuhlanga, ngokobulili, olinganayo futhi onentando yeningi.

src: Esi sicwangciso sibonelela ngesiseko somgaqo-nkqubo kawonkewonke wokulwa nocalucalulo ngokobuhlanga okuza kunceda ukunika impembelelo kwisibophelelo sethu samalungelo oluntu ezizwe-ngezizwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuba ziphawule ngoHlelo Lokusebenza Lukazwelonke Lokulwa Nobandlululo, Ukucwasa Ngokobuhlanga, Inzondo Yabantu Bokufika kanye noKungabekezelelani okuhlobene Nalokhu (lwezi-2016-2021) ngaphambi komhla zi-30 Nhlangulana 2016.

src: INgqungquthela ye-Russia ne-Afrika yokuLwa neziYobisi kwi-ICC yaseDurban ukususela ngomhla we-8 ukuya kowe-9 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016 lubonelela ngeqonga lokuqinisa isiCwangciso esiyiNtloko seziYobisi seSizwe (sowama-2013-2017).Umlo wokulwa iziyobisi ezingekho mthethweni uyahambelana neSicwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe kwaye le ngqungquthela iphantsi kwemiqondiso emihle ye-AU ukusebenzela isibophelelo ngokwemimiselo efanelekileyo ye-UN yeziVumelwano zoLwaphulo-mthetho oluHleliweyo Phakathi kwaMazwe amaBini neziYobisi, isiCwangciso soMsebenzi se-AU (2013-2017 nezindululo zamazwe e-BRICS (i-Brazil, Russia, India, China noMzantsi Afrika).
tgt: Lolu hlelo luhlinzeka isisekelo senqubomgomo yomphakathi yokulwisana nokucwasa ngokobuhlanga nokuzosiza ekuqaliseni ukusebenza kwezibopho zethu zomhlaba zamalungelo oluntu.

src: Le ngqungquthela ilandela iNgqungqthela ye-Russia ne-Afrika yokuLwa iziYobisi, eligxile ekubonakaliseni imo edibeneyo yokuba iinkokheli zehlabathi zizimisele kangakanani ukuqubisana neengxaki yeziyobisi phakathi kwezizwe ngezizwe.
tgt: Izingxoxo phakathi kwe-Russia-ne-Afrika Zokulwa Nezidakamizwa e-ICC e-Durban kusukela mhla zi-8 kuze kube mhla zi-9 Ndasa 2016 zinhlinzeka inkundla yokwenza ngcono Iqhinga Likazwelonke Lokulwa Nezidakamizwa (lwezi-2013-2017).Ukulwa nezidakamizwa ezingekho emthethweni kuhambisana noHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwentuthuko futhi lezi zingxoxo zingaphansi kwe-AU ekufezeni izibopho zayo ngokweZivumelwano Ze-UN Ezimayelana Nezidakamizwa Nobugebengu Obuhlelekile Obuxuba Amazwe, Uhlelo Lokusebenza Lwe-AU Lokulawula Izidakamizwa (lwezi-2013-2017) nezinqumo ze-BRICS (i-Brazil, i-Russia, i-India, i-China neNingizimu Afrika).Le nkomfa yisithangami sokulandelela seZingxoxo Phakathi Kwe-Russia-ne-Afrika, ihlose ukuthula indlela eyodwa yokuthi abaholi bomhlaba bazobhekana kanjani nenkinga yezidakamizwa ekhungethe umhlaba wonke.

src: Esi sicwangciso siza kuthiwe thaca kwiNdibano eNkulu eKhethekileyo ye-UN kwekaTshazimpunzi yowama-2016.
tgt: Lokhu kuzothulwa ezithebheni zoMhlangano Okethekile Wesigungu-Jikelele Se-UN ngoMbaso 2016.

src: Urhulumente – ngokusebenzisana ne-ofisi kaNobhala wamaZwe aye ngamaThanga, iDyunivesithi yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-UNISA) ne-Arhente yoPhuhliso loLutsha yeSizwe – uza kusingatha iNgqungquthela yesibini2 yamaZwe ayesakuba ngamaThanga ngoMsebenzi woLutsha kwikhampasi yase-UNISA ePitoli ukususela ngomhla- we-8 ukuya kowe-10 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016.
tgt: Uhulumeni – ngokubambisana nonoBhala Wamazwe e-Commonwealth, Inyuvesi yaseNingizimu Afrika ne-Ejensi Kazwelonke Yentuthuko Yentsha – bazosingatha Inkomfa Yesi-2 Yamazwe e-Commonwealth Emayelana Nomsebenzi Wentsha Ophikweni Lwe-Unisa ePitori kusukela zi-8 zize zibe yi-10 Mbaso 2016.

src: Le ngqungquthela iqhubeka phantsi komxholo othi: “Bandakanya uLutsha eKwakheni iSizwe: iNdima yabaSebenzi abaluLutsha” nokuphinda kuhlolwe indima yamagcisa alulutsha olusebenzayo nabahlohli bamaziko emfundo ephakamileyo ekubandakanyeni ulutsha kuphuhliso lwamazwe walo.
tgt: Le nkomfa izobanjwa ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: Ukusebenzisa Intsha Ekwakheni Isizwe: Indima Yabasebenzi Abayintsha” futhi izohlola kabusha indima yabasebenzi abayintsha kanye nezifundiswa ekusebenziseni intsha ekuthuthukiseni amazwe azo.

src: Uluvo lwekhabhinethi kwimiba engundoqo ngokusingqongileyo.
tgt: Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni ezisematheni.

src: IKhabhinethi izeka mzekweni kumyalezo kaMongameli uZuma ngokudingeka kokuhlonitshwa kwamaziko neenkqubo ezidalwe ngokwemimiselo yomgaqo-siseko weRhiphabliki yoMzantsi Afrika yowe-1996 nomthetho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igcizelela umyalezo kaMongameli Zuma omayelana nesidingo sokuhlonipha izikhungo kanye nezinhlelo ezisungulwe ngokoMthethosisekelo weRiphabhuliki YaseNingizimu Afrika we-1996 kanye nomthetho.

src: UMongameli uZuma uyasebenza ngemeko yoMkhomishinala weZiko loMzantsi Afrika leeNkonzo yezeRhafu yaseMzantsi Afrika noMphathiswa wezeMali ngokulandela iindlela ezifanelekileyo esebenzisa izikhokelo ezifanelekileyo zezomthetho.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uxazulula udaba lukaKhomishana Wenhlangano Yokuqoqwa Kwentela eNingizimu Afrika kanye noNgqongqoshe Wezezimali ngokusebenzisa imigudu efanele esebenzisa izimiso zomthetho ezifanele.

src: UMongameli umisele iinkqubo zokuhlangabezana nalo mba ngokufanelekileyo nangoxolo ukwenzela uncedo lwethu sonke.
tgt: UMongameli uthatha izinyathelo zokuxazulula lolu daba ngendlela efanele nenobungani ukuze kuhlomule wonke umuntu.

src: IKhabhinethi ibongoza onke amaqela achaphazelekayo ukuba azole azibambe, aze anikeze ithuba lokuba lo mba usonjululwe ngokusebenzisa iindlela ezifanelekileyo.
tgt: Ikhabhinethi inxusa bonke abanentshisekelo kulolu daba ukuthi bahlise umoya futhi bazilawule, futhi basidedele ithuba lokuthi kuxazululwe lezi zindaba kusetshenziswa imigudu efanele.

src: IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba babhalisele uNyulo looRhulumente baseKhaya lowama-2016 ngomhla we-5 nowe-6 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi linxusa zonke izakhamuzi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi zibhalisele ukuvota Okhethweni Lukahulumeni Wendawo lonyaka we-2016 mhla zi-5 nangomhla zi-6 Ndasa 2016.

src: Unyulo loorhumente basekhaya, alufani nolwesizwe kuba koloorhulumente basekhaya kufanele ubhalise kwiwadi ohlala kuyo.
tgt: Ukhetho lohulumeni bendawo ludinga ukuthi ubhalise esigcemeni ohlala kusona kanti ukhetho lukazwelonke aludingi ukuthi ubhalise esigcemeni ohlala kusona.

src: Kubalulekile ukuba ube neNcwadi yeSazisi (i-ID) – ziza kwamkeleka zombini i-ID eluhlaza enebhakhodi kunye neKhadi-Sazisi – nokukhangela isimo sokuba ubhalisile na, iinombolo yewadi kunye nokuba simi phi isikhululo sakho sokuvota.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuthi ube nomazisi (i-ID) – bamukelekile bobabili oluhlaza onamagabela kanye nalowo oyikhadi – ukubheka isimo sakho sokubhalisa, inombolo yesigceme kanye nendawo yesiteshi sokuvota.

src: Zonke ii-ofisi zeSebe lemiCimbi yezeKhaya ziza kuba zivuliwe ukususela ngentsimbi ye-08:00 ukuya kweye-17:00 ngomhla we-5 nowe-6 kweyoKwindla yowama-2016, oku kuhambelana kunye namaxesha okusebenza eKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo kwezi ntsuku zimbini.
tgt: Wonke amahhovisi oMnyango Wezasekhaya azobe evuliwe kusukela ngehora le-08:00 kuze kube yihora le-17:00 mhla zi-5 zize zibe yi-6 Ndasa 2016, nokuhambisana nahora okusebenza Ekhomishani Yokhetho Ezimele kulezi zinsuku ezimbili.

src: IKhabhinethi ibongoza lonke ulutsha kunye nabo baza kuqala ukuvota ukuba babhalisele ukuvota.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu abasha nalabo abazobe bevota okokuqala ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota.

src: Ngokuvota kwakho uthathe inyathelo elibhekisele ekubeni ilizwi lakho livakale ekuthathweni kwezigqibo ezikuchaphazelayo nendawo ohlala kuyo.
tgt: Ngokuvota, uthathe isinyathelo sokwenza izwi lakho lizwakale izinqumweni ezithinta wena nomphakathi ohlala kuwo.

src: Oorhulumente basekhaya baxhomekeke kuwe.
tgt: Ukuba nezwi kuzinqumo zikahumeni wendawo kusezandleni zakho!.

src: IKhabhinethi iyalugxeka uqhankqalazo olunobundlobongela lwabafundi, noluthe lwaphazamisa izifundo kwezinye iidyunivesithi laze lakhokelela ekutshatyalalisweni kwezakhiwo nempahla.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayigxeka imibhikisho yabafundi enodlame, ephazamise izifundo kwamanye amayunivesithi futhi yaholela nasekonakalisweni kwempahla.

src: Aba baqhankqalazi bathintela abafundi abanelungelo ilungelo lokuqhuba ngezifundo zabo kwaye oko kunempembelelo engekho ntle kwilungelo labo lokufumana imfundo ephakamileyo.
tgt: Le mibhikisho ivimvela abafundi abadinga ukufunda ithuba lokuqhubeza izifundo zabo futhi ithikameza ilungelo labo lokuthola imfundo yasemazingeni aphakeme.

src: Urhulumente uvulele bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo kwezemfundo ephakamileyo iinkqubo zonxibelelwano ukwenzela iingxoxo nothethathethwano.
tgt: Uhulumeni uvula imigudu yokuxhumana nabo bonke abathintekayo emfundweni ephakeme ukuze kuxoxwe futhi kuboniswane.

src: Oko kukhokelele ekubuyeleni kwisiqhelo nokukhuthazwa kwentalo-ntle kwiidyunivesithi zethu ezifuna ukufumana isisombululo kwimingeni yexesha eliphakathi ukuya kweyelide edibene nokudalwa kwenguqu kwelicandelo njengoko ichazwe kwizindululo zeMbizo yeNguqu kwezeMfundo ePhakamileyo yowama-2015.
tgt: Lokhu sekuholele ekutheni isimo sibuyele kwesijwayelekile nokukhuthazwa kobunye emayunivesithi ethu afuna ukuthola izisombululo zesikhathi esiphakathi nendawo kuya kweside kwizinselele ezihlobene nokuguqula lo mkhakha njengoba kuchaziwe kuzinqumo ezathathwa kuMhlangano Wokuguqula Ezemfundo Ephakeme we-2015.IKhabinethi isekela imizamo yabezomthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuthi isiko lokufunda liyabuyiswa, futhi impahla kanye namalungelo abantu kuyavikelwa.

src: IKhabhinethi iyawaxhasa amalinge awenziwe zi-arhente zogcino-mthetho ukuqinisekisa ukuba isithethe sokufunda sibuyiselwe, kunye nokukhuselwa kwempahla nesakhiwo namalungelo womntu ngamnye.
tgt: Umthetho ubalulekile futhi kumele ulandelwe ngazo zonke izikhathi.

src: Ukubuyela esiqhelweni nenzolo kwiidyunivesithi kuyafuneka ukuze iinkqubo zezemfundo zikwazi ukuqhubeka ngeli xesha imingeni yexesha eliphakathi nelide kusazanywana nayo.
tgt: Isimo esijwayelekile kanye nokuthula kumele kubuyele emayunivesithi ukuze izinhlelo zezemfundo ziqhubekele phambili ngesikhathi kusaxazululwa izinselele zesikhathi esiphakathi nendawo kuya kweside.

src: IKhabhinethi iyabancoma abafundi abathe bema kunye bemanyene ukulwa ubuhlanga kunye nokulwa abo bazidla ngokuba nobuhlanga ngokugqithisileyo bechasa abamhlophe, oku kube ngumzekelo wokuba singasebenzisana sisonke ukwakha kwinkqubela neenzuzo ezenzwe kwicandelo lezemfundo ephakamileyo ukulungiselela lo nyaka wemfundo sikuwo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibashayela ihlombe abafundi abakhulume ngazwi linye lokulwisana nokucwasa ngokwebala nokuchitha inkolelo yabamhlophe, nokuyinto eyisibonelo ukuthi sonke singasebenzisana ukwakhela kwinqubekela phambili kanye nemihlomulo eyenziwe emkhakheni wezemfundo ephakeme ukulungiselela lo nyaka wokufunda.

src: Kufuneka siyikhusele le nkqubela size sivumele ukubuya kocwangco nokululondoloza kuzo zonke iidyunivesithi zethu.
tgt: Kumele sivikele inqubekela phambili futhi sivumele ukuthula ukuthi kubuyiswe futhi kugcinwe emayunivesithi ethu.

src: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo ukuba basebenzisane ukuze iidyunivesithi zethu zibe ziinkokheli zomsebenzi oquka konke nenguqu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinda inxusa bonke abanentshisekelo ukuthi basebenzisane ukuze amayunivesithi ethu abe ngabaholi bokuxoxisana okufaka wonke umuntu kanye nezinguquko.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukucetywa kokudibanisa iinkampani ezintathu ezenza iibhotile ukwenzela iNkampani ye-Coca Cola eMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaphawula ngokuhlanganiswa okuhlongozwayo kwemisebenzi emithathu yamabhodlela enkampanini yakwa-Coca Cola eNingizimu Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukuba lo mba uza kuxoxwa kwiNkundla yoKhuphiswano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaphawula ukuthi lolu daba luzolalelwa Enkantolo Yezokuncintisana.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa ukuxhalaba kwayo ngokulahleka kwemisebenzi okucetywayo nokuncitshiswa komsebenzi kwiintengiselwano zokudityaniswa kwazo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakalisa ukukhathazeka kwayo ngokulahleka kwamathuba emisebenzi okuhlongozwayo kanye nokuncipha kwamathuba emisebenzi okuzodalwa yilokhu kuhlanganiswa.

src: Ngenxa yezinga eliphezulu lentswela-ngqesho, iKhabhinethi ibongoza ezi nkampani ukuba ziqiniseke ukuba akukho kulahleka kwemisebenzi kwaye kuze kugcinwe izinga eliphakathi lengqesho.
tgt: Njengoba amazing okuswelakala kwemisebenzi ephezulu, iKhabhinethi inxusa izinkampani ukuthi ziqinisekise ukuthi ayilahleki imisebenzi futhi amazinga aphakathi nendawo emisebenzi ayagcinwa.

src: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana noNozakuzaku waseMzantsi Afrika kuMbutho woRhwebo weHlabathi (i-WTO), uMnu Xavier Carim, othe wonyulwa ukuba abe ngusihlalo weBhodi yokuLamla iMbambano yeBhunga Jikelele le-WTIBhunga Jikelele yeyona bhodi iphezulu ye-WTO yokuthatha izigqibo phakathi kweNgqungquthela yobuPhathiswa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela Inxusa laseNingizimu Afrika Enhlanganweni Yomhlaba Yezohwebo (i-WTO) uMnu Xavier Carim, okhethelwe ukuba ngusihlalo weSigungu Esixazulula Izingxabano soMKhandlu-Jikele we-WTUMkhandlu-Jikelele yisigungu esiphezulu esithatha izinqumo se-WTO phakathi kweNkomfa yoNgqongqoshe.

src: Ukuchongwa kukaNozakuzaku uCarim uyinxalenye yobungqina bokubaluleka kwendima edlalwa nguMzantsi Afrika kwi-WTO kwaye iyinxalenye yobungqina beempawu zikaNozakuzaku uCarim.
tgt: Ukuqokwa kweNxusa uCarim kuyinto eyingxenye yokuqashelwa kwendima ebalulekile edlalwa yiNingizimu Afrika ku-WTO futhi kuyingxenye yobufakazi bekhono leNxusa uCarim.

src: IKhabhinethi isiqaphele isibhengezo seBarclays PLC sokuba nenjongo zokunciphisa ubunini-zabelo bayo zingama-62.3%i kwi-Barclays Africa Group Limited (i-BAGL) kule minyaka mibini ukuya kwemithathu ezayo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphawulile ngesimemezelo se-Barclays PLC senhloso yaso yokwehlisa amasheya aso angamaphesenti anga-62,3 enawo e-Barclays Africa Group Limited (e-BAGL) eminyakeni emibili kuya kwemithathu ezayo.

src: I-Baclays PLC, ngokukodwa iGosa eliyiNtloko yesiGqeba (i-CEO), lithetha kunye nabo bobabini uNdyebo weSizwe kunye ngeBhanka enguVimba kothethathethwano olungafihlekelanga, kwaye siyakkwamkela ukuzinikela kwale nkampani ukuba iphumeze isicwangciso-qhinga sayo esitsha ngendlela eza kunciphisa impembelelo kuqoqosho apho iBAGL isebenza khona.
tgt: I-Barclays PLC, ikakhulukazi u-CEO, uye waxoxisana noMnyango Wezezimali neBhange Lombuso leNingizimu Afrika ezigxoxweni ezivulelekile, futhi siyakwamukela ukuzibophezela kwenkampani ukuqalisa ukusebenzisa iqhinga elisha ngendlela ezonciphisa umthelela eminothweni yasemazweni lapho kusebenza khona i-BAGIBhangengodla lizosebenzisana neBarclays PLC ne-BAGL ukuqinisekisa ukuthi noma yibuphi ubungozi obungavela kulokhu kuncishiswa kwamasheya kuyavinjelwa futhi kuthathwa izinyathelo ezifanele ukuphatha ukufuduswa kwezimali ezivela kulokhu kuncishiswa kwamasheya.

src: IBhanka enguVimba iza kusebenza neBarclays PLC ne-BAGL ukuqinisekisa ukuba nayiphi na imingcipheko ekwintengiselwano iyathityazwa kuze kuthathwe amanyathelo afanelekileyo ukulawula ukungena nokuphuma kwemali kule ntengiselwano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela bonke abafike kumanqamu kanye nabawinile kuZindondo Zikazwelonke Zokufundisa ezabanjwa mhla zingama-27 Nhlolanja 2016.

src: IKhabhinethi ibothulela umnqwazi bonke abo bafikelele kumagqibela kankqoyi nabo bathe baphumelela iMbasa yokuFundisa yeSizwe.
tgt: Labo thisha abazinikele baqhubezela izwe lethu phambili ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi amagumbi abo akhiqiza abafundi abakhuthazekile abayobamba iqhaza ekuthuthukisweni kweNingizimu Afrika.

src: Umsitho wazo ububanjwe ngomhla wama-27 kweyoMdumba yowama-2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela iMarket Theatre yaseGoli ngokugubha unyaka wayo wama-40 ikhona.

src: Aba titshala bakhutheleyo baliqhubela phambili ilizwe lethu ngokuqinisekisa ukuba amagumbi wabo okufundela avelisa abafundi abakhuthazekileyo abazokwenza igalelo ekuphuhliseni uMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: Ngesikhathi sobandlululo leli shashalazi laba wuphawu loMzabalazo ngokulandisa ngezindaba eziyiqiniso zaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana neMarket Theatre eRhawutini ngokubhiyozela iminyaka engama-40 ikho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela uthisha womculo, uMnu.

src: Ngexesha lucalucalulo iMarket Theatre yaba luphawu lomzabalazo ngokubalisa ibali loMzantsi Afrika eliyinyaniso.
tgt: Chad Hendricks, wase-Retreat e-Cape Flats ngokuwina Umncintiswano Ohlonishayo Wababhidisi we-Len van Zyl eKapa.

src: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nootitshala womculo, uMnu Chad Hendricks, wase-Retreat kwi-Cape Flats ngokuphumelela uKhuphiswano lwabaCulisi oludumileyo i-Len van Zyl eKapa.
tgt: Umklomelo wakhe ufaka umfundaze waseMelika wezinyanga ezintathu lapho uMnu Hendricks ezobe efunda e-Orchestra Philadelphia futhi aqeqeshwe nguSolwazi odumile uVictor Yampolsky e-Chicago.

src: Ibhaso lakhe liquka imali yokufunda yeenyanga ezintathu e-United States apho aza kufunda khona kwiPhiladelphia Orchestra aze aqeqeshwe ngodumileyo uNjingalwazi uVictor Yampolsky eChicago.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela umdidiyeli wamafilimu, uMnu.

src: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nomvelisi wemidlalo-bhanyabhanya, uMnu Anant Singh, ngokufumana iwonga elikwindawo yesithathu ngomdlalo-bhanyabhanya i-uShepherds and Butchers kumsitho wokuWongwa ngabaBukeli wasePanorama woMdlalo Bhanyabhanya obuNtsomi kuMbiyozo woMdlalo Bhanyabhanya weSizwe-ngezizwe waseBerlin.
tgt: Anant Singh, ngokunikezwa indawo yesithathu ngefilimu ethi Shepherds and Butchers kwi-Panorama Audience Award for Fiction Film eMgubheni Womhlaba Wamafilimu waseBerlin.

src: Le yeyona mpumelelo inkulu njengoko lo mdlalo bhanyabhanya ubukhuphisana nemidlalo bhanyabhanya ingama-51 ebonisiweyo enobude bayo evela kumazwe angama-.
tgt: Lokhu kuyimpumelelo enkulu njengoba ifilimu ibincintisana namanye amafilimu anga-51 asemazweni anga-336.

src: IzikhundlaZonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.
tgt: AbaqashiweUkuqashwa kwabo bonke abalandelayo kuzokwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela uma sekuqinisekiswe ubufakazi beziqu zabo zemfundo futhi uma sebenikezwe izimvume ezifanelekile.

src: Ukwandiswa kwesivumelwano sengqesho sikaMnu Lionel October njengoMlawuli-Jikelele (u-DG) kwiSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino, isithuba sexesha leminyaka emihlanu.
tgt: Ukwelulwa kwenkontileka kaMnu.

src: Ukuqeshwa kukaGq Mantlhake Mboya njengoSekela-Mlawuli-Jikelele: Umgaqo-nkqubo weKharityhulam noHlolo kwiSebe leMfundo esiSiseko.
tgt: Lionel October njengoMqondisi Jikelele (u-DG) woMnyango Wezohwebo Nezezimboni, isikhathi esiyiminyaka emihlanu.

src: Ukuqeshwa kukaNksz Shamilla Chettiar njenge-DDG: KwiiNkonzo zoMgaqo-nkqubo noLwazi kwiSebe lezoKhenketho.
tgt: Mantlhake J Maboya njengePhini Likamqondisi Jikelele (i-DDG): Inqubomgomo Nokuqashelwa Kwekharikhulamu eMnyangweni Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo.

src: Ukuqeshwa kukaMnu Mbulelo Tshangana njengoMlawuli-Jikelele kwiSebe lwezokuHlaliswa koLuntu.
tgt: Ukuqashwa kukaNkz.

src: Ukuqeshwa kwakhona kukaMnu Kutoane Obed Kutoane njengeGosa eliyiNtloko lesiGqeba kwiQumrhu le-Inshorensi yamaTyala eMpahla eThunyelwa kuMazwe angaPhandle lwaseMzantsi Afrika .
tgt: Shamilla Chettiar njenge-DDG: Imisebenzi Yenqubomgomo Nezolwazi eMnyangweni Wezokuvakasha.

src: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi Eziqavile.

src: IKhabhinethi ihlole iiNgxelo zeNkqubela yeziPhumo zeKota yesiThathu ukususela kweyeDwarha kuye kweyoMnga ngowama-2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlole Imibiko Yesigamu Sesithathu Yemiphumela Yenqubekela Phambili yesikhathi sikaMfumfu kuze kushaye uZibandlela 2015.

src: Ezi ngxelo zibonakalisa inkqubela ethe vetshe ekusebenziseni iinkqubo zikarhulumente ezinefuthe elingqalileyo ekuphuculeni ubomi babemi boMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: Imibiko ibonisa inqubekela phambili ebonakalayo ekuqalisweni kokusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezinomthelela ngqo ekuthuthukisweni kwezimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ezi Ngxelo zibubungqina bokuba urhulumente kukho inkqubela ayenzileyo ekuphumeleliseni izinto emakufikelelwe kuzo ngokwesiCwangciso-sikhokelo esibubuChule sesiGaba esiPhakathi sowama-2014-2019.
tgt: Imibiko Yemiphumela Yenqubekela Phambili ihlinzeka ubufakazi bokuthi uhulumeni ube nenqubekela phambili ekufezeni imikhawulo ebekwe Ohlakeni Lwamaqhinga Lwesikhathi Esiphakathi Nendawo 2014-2019.

src: Zikwasisondeza ekufezekeni koMbono wama-2030, njengoko uthiwe thaca sisiCwangciso soPhuhliso lweSizwe, nonjongo wawo ikukuhlasela indlala, intswela-ngqesho nokungalingani.
tgt: Iphinda isisondeze ekufezeni Umbono we-2030, njengoba ubekiwe oHlelweni Lwentuthuko Lukazwelonke (i-NDP), oluhlose ukulwa nobubha, ukuntuleka kwamathuba emisebenzi kanye nokungalingani.

src: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele inkqubela ebonakalayo eyenziweyo ukuphumelelisa izinto ezingundoqo emakufikelelwe kuzo kwakunye neziqhamo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphelile inqubekela phambili eyamukelekile eyenziwe ukufeza imikhawulo kanye nemiphumela.

src: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele into yokuba noxa kukho inkqubela ebonakalayo eyenzekileyo malunga nenkoliso yezinto ezalatha oko, kusekho imiba efuna ukungenelela kukarhulumente ngokulungeleleneyo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yaqaphela ukuthi yize kube nenqubekela phambili ebonakalayo maqondana nezinkomba eziningi, zisekhona izindawo ezidinga ukungenelela okuhleliwe kukahulumeni.

src: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo ezingundoqo zikarhulumente.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezisemqoka.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalise umbulelo wayo kubo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika abalisabeleyo ikhwelo elenziwe yiKhomishini yoNyulo eZimeleyo (i-IEC) lokuba abantu babhalise, bajonge imeko yabo malunga nobhaliso kwaye bahlaziye iinkcukacha zabo ezikumqulu wabavoti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakalise ukubonga kubo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abananele ikhwelo leKhomishana Ezimele Yokhetho (i-IEC) lokuthi abantu babhalise, babheke isimo sabo sokubhalisa futhi babuyekeze imininingwane yabo esohlwini lwabavoti ngempelasonto yomhla zi-5 nangomhla zi-6 Ndasa 2016.

src: Abantu ababalelwa kwizigidi ezithathu baya kwiindawo ekubhaliselwa uvoto kuzo kulo lonke eli, kwaye abangama- 544 552 kwabo ibingabhalisa okokuqala (i-78.6%) kwaye beneminya yobudala engaphantsi kwengama-30.
tgt: Balinganiselwa kuzigidi ezintathu abantu abavakashele iziteshi zokuvota ezweni lonke kanti abantu aba-544 552 kwababhalise okokuqala ngqa (ama-78.6 %) ngabantu abaneminyaka engaphansi kwa-30 ubudala, nokubonisa ukuzimisela kwezakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika ekubambeni iqhaza ekwakheni umbuso wethu wentando yeningi.

src: Loo nto ibonisa ukuzimisela kwabemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuthatha inxaxheba ekwakheni ulawulo lwethu lwentando yesininzi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi basebenzise ilungelo labo lentando yeningi ngokubhalisela ukuvota futhi inxusa labo abaseke babhalisa ngaphambilini ukuthi baqinisekise imininingwane yabo yokubhalisela ukuvota njengoba ziningana izinto eziye zaholela ezinguqukweni ohlwini lwabavoti.

src: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba balixhamle ilungelo labo lomgaqo-siseko ngokuthi babhalise, kwaye icela abo ababhalisa kwixesha elidluleyo ukuba baqinisekise iinkcukacha zabo zobhaliso njengoko kubekho izinto ezininzi ezikhokhelele ekutshintsheni komqulu wabavoti.
tgt: Impelasonto yokubhalisa okokugcina izoba mhla zi-9 nangomhla zi-10 Mbaso 2016 lapho kuzophinda kuvulwe iziteshi zokuvota kusukela ngehora le-8:00 kuze kushaye ihora le-17:00.

src: Eli iza kuba lithuba lokugqibela lokuba abavoti babhalise kwaye bahlaziye inkcukacha zabo zobhaliso kwiindawo zabo zokuvota.
tgt: Leli kuyoba yithuba lokugcina lokuthi abavoti babhalise futhi babuyekeze imininingwane yabo yokubhalisa eziteshini zabo zokuvota.

src: Phofu, ubhaliso yinto esoloko iqhubeka kuzo zonke ii-ofisi ze-IEC ngamaxesha omsebenzi ukususela ngoMvulo kude kube ngoLwesihlanu, de umqulu wabavoti woNyulo looMasipala wama-2016 uvalwe mhla unyulo lwaziswayo ngokusemthethweni.
tgt: Kodwa ukubhalisa kuyaqhubeka emahhovisi e-IEC endawo ngezikhathi zomsebenzi kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuze kushaye uLwesihlanu, kuze kuvalwe uhlu lwabavoti loKhetho Lomasipala lonyaka we-2016 ngosuku okumenyezelwa ngalo usuku lokuvota.

src: IKhabhinethi iyalugxeka udushe kwiingingqi ezithile noluthe lagxobhagxobha impelaveki yobhaliso esandul’ukubakho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalugxeka udlame olube khona kwezinye izindawo ngempelasonto yokubhalisela ukuvota esanda kudlula futhi iyagcizelela ukuthi akukho muntu ongavimbela noma yisiphi isakhamizi saseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi sisebenzise ilungelo laso lentando yeningi lokubhalisela ukuvota.

src: Iyaphinda iyayithetha into yokuba akukho mntu omele ukuthintela nawuphi na ummi woMzantsi Afrika ukuba alixhamle ilungelo lakhe elibhalwe lacaca kuMgaqo-siseko lokubhalisela uvoto.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinda inxusa bonke labo abenza lokhu ukuthi bayeke le misebenzi yobugebengu futhi ukuthi labo abathintekile babike lezi zigilamikhuba kwabezomthetho.

src: IKhabhinethi ikwamemelela bonke abenza loo nto ukuba bahlukane nezenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho ezinjengezo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abaphethe ezomthetho ukuthi bathathele labo abaphula umthetho izinyathelo ezinqala.

src: UMongameli Jacob Zuma uza kutyelela eBhayi ngomhla we-8 kuTshazimpunzi kowama-2016.
tgt: UMongameli Jacob Zuma uzohambela e-Port Elizabeth mhla zi-8 Mbaso 2016 ukuyohlola inqubekela phambili ekwakhiweni kwengqalasizinda yezokuthutha yasolwandle njengengxenye yezinyathelo zoMnotho Wezwe Wasolwandle.

src: Uza kuhlola inkqubela eyenziweyo ekuphuhliseni iziseko zothutho zaselwandle njengenxalenye yelinge lesizwe mayelana noQoqosho lwaseLwandle.
tgt: UMnotho Wasolwandle ungenye yemigudu emithathu yoMKhankaso we-Operation Phakisa futhi usondeza izwe ekufezeni ukubaluleka kwezilwandle zaseNingizimu Afrika, nokungenzeka kufake izigidigidi ezi-177 zamarandi emkhiqizweni okhiqizwe ngaphakathi ezweni kanye nokudala amathuba emisebenzi emisha angaphezu kwesigidi.

src: Olu qoqosho lolunye lwamacandelo amathathu e-Operation Phakisa kwaye lusondeza ilizwe eli ekuboniseni amandla eelwandlekazi zoMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukuphethwa ngempumelelo koHambo Olusemthethweni lukaMongameli Zuma lokuvakashela eRiphabhuliki YaseNigeria kusukela mhla zi-8 zaze zaba yi-9 Ndasa 2016, nokwenze ngcono ubudlelwano bezepolitiki, bezomnotho kanye nobezenhlalo phakathi kwamazwe amabili.

src: Loo nto inganegalelo lemali engafikelela kwiibhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-177 kwimveliso yasekhaya iyonke, nto leyo enokudala imisebenzi emitsha engaphaya kwesigidi.
tgt: Okunye okufezwe yilokhu kuvakasha kube ukuphakanyiswa kweKhomishani Yamazwe Amabili yayiswa ezingeni leZinhloko Zombuso, nokuqhakambisa ukuthuthukiswa komnotho phakathi kwalawa mazwe amabili.

src: IKhabhinethi yamkela utyelelo olube yimpumelelo lwaseBurhulumenteni lukaMongameli Zuma kwiFederal Republic of Nigeria ukususela kumhla we-8 ukuya kowe- 9 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukuvulwa komnotho waseNigeria uvulelwa izinkampani zaseNingizimu Afrika emikhakheni ehlukahlukene efana nowezobunjiniyela, owezokuxhumana ngezigcingo, owezokwakha, owezezindiza, owezezindaba, owezokuphathwa kwezivakashi, owezamabhange, owezokuzijabulisa, owezakhiwo, owezokuthengisa, owezemisebenzi yokuthola upetroli negesi.

src: Elinye leziganeko ezibalulekileyo zolo tyelelo yaba kukunyuselwa kwesiVumelwano seNtsebenziswano saMazwe amaBini iye kwinqanaba leNtloko yoMbuso, nto leyo ebeka phambili ukuphuhliswa koqoqosho kula mazwe mabini.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikulangazelele ukwanda kwenani lotshalomali lwaseNigeria eNingizimu Afrika nokuzokhuthaza uhwebo oluhlomulisa amazwe womabili.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuvuleleka koqoqosho lwaseNigeria kwiinkampani zaseMzantsi Afrika kumacandelo anjengobunjineli, eleziseko ezingundo zonxibelelwano, elezokwakha, elobuchule bokuhamba ngeenqwelo-moya, amajelo eendaba, ukubuka nokutenda iindwendwe, imiba yebhanki, ulonwabo, imihlaba nezindlu, intengiso kunye neenkonzo zokuphonononga nokuzingela i-oli negesi.
tgt: Imiphumela yalokhu kuxoxisana phakathi kwezikhondlakhondla ezimbili zezomnotho ezwenikazi kuzodidiyela iminotho yezifunda, ngaleyo ndlela kwandise imakethe efanayo futhi kukhuphule izinhlelo ezikhona njengamanje zokukhula komnotho kanye namathuba emisebenzi e-Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi ijonge ukunyuka kwenani lotyalo-mali lweNigeria eMzantsi Afrika, nto leyo eza kukhuthaza urhwebo phakathi kwezi zizwe zimbini.
tgt: Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isalokhu iyindawo yotshalomali ekwazi ukuncintisana nezinye phezu kwesimo somnotho womhlaba esingesihle, futhi kuzoholela ekwakhiweni kwamathuba emisebenzi kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Iziphumo zoku kusebenzisana kwala mazwe mabini analona qoqosho lungamandla kweli lizwekazi ziza kudibanisa uqoqosho lwengingqi, ngaloo ndlela zinyuse izinga labathengi nabasebenzisi-zinkonzo abafanayo namalinge akhoyo okukhulisa uqoqosho nengqesho e-Afrika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iqaphelile ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika izobamba iqhaza eMhlanganweni wa-60 Wekhomishana Yenhlangano Yezizwe (i-UN) emayelana Nesimo Sabesifazane (i-CSW60) ezobanjelwa e-New York, e-USA kusukela zi-14 zize zibe nga-24 Ndasa 2016 ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: "Ukufukulwa Kwabesifazane kanye nokuxhumana kwakho nentuthuko ezinzile".

src: Oku kubonisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika yindawo ekunokukhutshiswana ngayo ngotyalo-mali, noxa imeko yezoqoqosho ehlabathini imaxongo.
tgt: Lo mhlangano ubajwa onyakeni obalulekile kuNingizimu Afrika njengoba kunemicimbi emintathu ebalulekile, okungukuGunjwa kweminyaka e-20 yoMthethosisekelo weRiphabhulikhi YaseNingizimu Afrika yonyaka we-1996, Umgubho weminyaka e-40 Yezibhelu Zentsha YaseSoweto kanye noMgubho wa-60 wemashi yabesifazane yonyaka we-1956.INingizimu Afrika ithule umbiko ku-UN CSW60 futhi lokhu kusinika ithuba lokulinganisa inqubekela phambili esesiyifezile kusukela ekuqaleni kwentando yeningi.

src: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele into yokuba uMzantsi Afrika uza kuthatha inxaxheba kwiSeshoni yama-60 yeKomishini yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) ngeMeko yabaseTyhini (i-CSW60) eNew York, eMelika, ukususela ngomhla we-14 ukuya kowama-24 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuxhotyiswa ngezakhono kwabasetyhini kunye nendlela okunxibelelana ngayo nophuhliso oluzinzileyo”.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuba siveze ukuthi kusukela ngesikhathi sombuso wentando yeningi eNingizimu Afrika, phakathi kwezinye izinto , sibambe iqhaza eMhlanganweni We-4 Womhlaba Wabantu Besifazane ngonyaka we-1995, futhi sasayina ne-Beijing Declaration ne-Platform for Action ngomnyaka ofanayo.

src: Le seshoni ibanjwa ngonyaka obalulekileyo eMzantsi Afrika kuba kukho iziganeko ezithathu ezibalulekleyo ezenzekayo ezizezi: iSikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-20 yokusekwa koMgaqo-siseko weRiphabliki yoMzantsi Afrika ngowe-1996, iSikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-40 sezidube-dube ezazikhokelwa luLutsha eSoweto ngowe-1976 kunye neSikhumbuzo seminyaka engama-60 somngcelele wamanina wangowe-1956.UMzantsi Afrika wenze ingxelo kwiUN CSW60 kwaye oku kusinika ithuba lokuthelekisa inkqubela esiyenzileyo oko kuthe kwabakho ulawulo lwentando yesininzi.
tgt: Ngokuhambisana nesinqumo E / Res / 2013 / 18 soMkhandlu Wenhlalakahle Nomnotho we-UN, iNingizimu Afrika izibophezele ekuqhubekeni nokuqalisa ukusebenza i-Beijing Declaration ne-Platform for Action nokuwuhlelo lokufukulwa nokuthuthukiswa kwabantu besifazane.

src: IMithetho esaYilwayo.
tgt: Imithethosivivinywa.

src: IKhabhinethi ivume ukungeniswa ePalamente koMthetho-sihlomelo osaYilwayo wamaCandelo kaMasipala: uRhulumente weMimandla wonyaka wama- 2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuphasisile ukwethulwa ePhalamende Kwesichibiyelo Somthethosivivinywa Wezinhlaka Zikamasipala: Uhulumeni Wendawo sonyaka we-2016.
