src: Izilungiso ziyenziwa kuMthetho wamaCandelo kaMasipala: uRhulumente weMimandla, wonyaka we-1998 (uMthetho uNombolo 117 wowe-1998), owaqalisa ukusebenza phambi konyulo lokuqala lorhulumente wemimandla kulawulo lwentando yesininzi olwalungomhla wesi-5 kweyoMnga ngowama-2000.Ezi zilungiso ziza kuphucula ulawulo lonyulo lukarhulumente wemimandla, kwaye phakathi kweenguqulelo ezikhoyo, ziza kwenza oku:a) ukulungisa imigaqo yoomasipala abakwiCandelo Ab) ukususa yonke into ebhekisa kwimimandla yolawulo lwezithilic) ukucacisa umhla wokuqalisa kokusebenza kocebad) ukumisela ukuba uMongameli abeke umhla wonyulo loomasipalae) ukuvumela ukuba lolulwe ixesha lokubhengeza iziphumo zonyulof) ukufuna ukuba umphathi kamasipala azise i-IEC ngezithuba ezikhoyo kwiiwadig) ukumisela ukuba iLungu leBhunga eliLawulayo limisele umhla wonyulo lwelungu olwenziwa phakathi kwexesha lolawulo lweBhungah) ukucacisa isininzi esifunekayo ukuze ibekho intlanganiso yebhungai) ukucacisa iimeko zokuvota koceba ochophele intlanganiso yebhungaj) ukunyusa ukutshintsha kwamanani abavoti kwiwadi nganye ngelixa lentlanganiso yebhungak) ukunyusa ukutshintsha kwamanani abavoti xa kucandwa ukuze kucaciswe ukunikwa koomasipala basekhaya izihlalo ezingaphaya.
tgt: Kwenziwa izichibiyelo kuMthetho Wezinhlaka Zikamasipala: Uhulumeni Wendawo we-1998 (uMthetho wa-117 we-1998), owaphasiswa ngaphambi kokubanjwa kokhetho lokuqala lwentando yeningi lohulumeni basekhaya olwabanjwa mhla zi-5 Zibandlela 2000.Ukuchibiyela kuzokwenza ngcono ukulawulwa kokhetho lohulumeni bendawo futhi phakathi kokunye, kuhlose:a) ukuchibiyela indlela yomasibala beSigaba Ab) ukuqeda konke ukukhuluma ngezindawo zokuphathwa kwezifundac) ukucacisa ngosuku lokuqala umsebenzi kwekhanselad) ukunquma ukuthi uMongameli kumele aqoke futhi amemezele usuku lokhetho lomasipalae) ukuvumela ukwelulwa kwesikhathi sokumenyezelwa kwemiphumela yokhethof) udinga ukuthi imenenja kamasipala yazise i-IEC ngezikhala zomsebenzi ezivulekile kuzigcemeg) ukunquma ukuthi Ilungu Lomkhandlu limemezela futhi liqoke usuku lokhetho lokuchibiyelah) ukucacisa isibalo esidingekayo sabantu abakhona ukuze kubanjwe umhlangano kamasipalai) ukucacisa izimo zokuvota zekhansela elingusihlalo ngesikhathi kubanjwe imihlangano yomkhandluj) ukukhulisa ukuguqulwa kwesibalo sabavoti kusigceme ngasinye ngesikhathi kubanjwe imihlangano yomkhandlu kanyek) nokukhulisa ukuguqulwa kwesibalo sabavoti kusigceme ngasinye ngesikhathi sokuklanywa kwendawo ukucacisa ukwabiwa kwezihlalo eziningi komasipala bendawo.

src: Imisitho ezayo.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.

src: UMongameli Zuma – njengobambisane isihlalo noMongameli waseFrance uFrançois Hollande, kwiKomishini ePhezulu kwezeNgqesho kwezeMpilo noHlulo loQoqosho – uza kuya ekuphehlelelweni ngokusesikweni kwale Komishini eLyon, eFrance ngoLwesithathu umhla wama-23 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma – njengomunye wosihlalo benoMongameli waseFrance u-François Hollande beKhomishani Ephezulu Yezemisebenzi Kwezempilo Nokukhula Komnotho – uzothamela ukuthulwa ngokusemthethweni kwayo e-Lyon, e-France ngoLwesithathu, zi-23 Ndasa 2016.

src: Ikhomishini le igxile kwisidingo seengcali zezempilo kumazwe anemivuzo ephakathi nephantsi.
tgt: Le khomishana igxile kusidingo sabasebenzi bezempilo abaqeqeshiwe emazweni azuza imali kancane naphakathi nendawo.

src: Eli linge le-UN kulindeleke ukuba linyuse ukhuseleko ngokwasempilweni elizweni liphela kwaye likhuthaze ukukhula koqoqosho okubandakanyayo, nto leyo enegalelo ekusebenzeni kweNkqubo yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo lowama-2030.
tgt: Lolu hlelo lwe-UN kulindeleke ukuthi lukhulise ezempilo emhlabeni wonke kanye nokukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho ofaka wonke umuntu, nokuyinto enomthelela ukuqalisweni koHlelo Lwentuthuko Oluzinzile lonyaka we-2030.

src: UMongameli Zuma uza kutyelela ngokwasebuRhulumenteni eSaudi Arabia ukususela ngomhla wama-27 ukuya kowama-28 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016, tyelelo olo oluza kuqinisa ubudlelwane obukhoyo phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzothatha Uhambo Olusemthethweni Lokuvakashela i-Kingdom of Saudi Arabia kusukela mhla zi-27 zize zibe mhla zi-28 Ndasa 2016, nokuzoqinisa ubudlelwano obukhona phakathi kwalawa mazwe amabili.

src: UMongameli uza kuya kwiNgqungquthela yesi- 4 engoKhuseleko lweNyukliya eWashington, eMelika, ukususela ngomhla wama-31 kweyoKwindla ukuya kumhla woku-1 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2016.
tgt: UMongameli uzothamela Umhlangano We-4 Wokuphepha Kwenuzi e-Washington, e-USA kusukela mhla zi-31 Ndasa kuze kube mhla lu-1 Mbaso 2016.

src: Ingqungquthela le iza kuxoxa ngomngcipheko okhulayo onokukhokelela kubunqolobi obunokuqhutywa kusetyenziswa izixhobo zenyukliya, kwaye iza kugqamisa amanyathelo anokuthathwa ngamazwe ngamazwe ukuthoba ukusetyenziswa kweyuraniyam enamandla amakhulu, ukugcinwa kwexhobo ezinobungozi, ukuchasa ukuthutyeleziswa kwenyukliya, ukuthintela, ukubona nokuphazamisa amalinge azama ukusebenzisa izixhobo zenyukliya kwizenzo zobunqolobi.
tgt: Lo mhlangano uzodingida ubungozi obukhulayo benuzi yobushokobezi futhi uveze izinyathelo ezingathathwa ngamazwe omhlaba ukunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwe-uraniyamu ecebe kakhulu, ukulondoloza impahla esengozini, ukuvimbela okushushunjiswa kwenuzi kanye nokuvimbela, ukuthola nokuphazamisa imizamo yobushokobezi benuzi.

src: UMongameli Zuma uza kukhokhela imibhiyozo yoSuku lwamaLungelo oLuntu kwiBala iMoses Mabhida kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal ngoMvulo, umhla wama-21 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “UMzantsi Afrika umanyene ekulweni ubuhlanga”.
tgt: UMongameli Zuma uzohola imigubho yoSuku Lwamalungelo Oluntu e-Moses Mabhida Stadium, esifundazweni saKwaZulu-Natal ngoMsombuluko, zi-21 Ndasa 2016 ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: "iNingizimu Afrika ibumbene ekulweni nokucwasana ngobuhlanga."

src: Njengoko kwakwazisiwe kwiNtetho engoBume beSizwe yowe-2016, olu Suku kulo nyaka luza kubeka isiseko senkqubo yexesha elide yokwakha isizwe esingacalulani ngobuhlanga.
tgt: Njengoba kwamenyezelwa eNkulumweni Yesimo Sezwe yonyaka we-2016, Usuku Lwamalungelo Oluntu lwalo nyaka luzokwakha isisekelo sohlelo lwesikhathi eside lokwakha umphakathi ongacwasi ngokobuhlanga.

src: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba babe banye ekulweni nasekuchaseni ubuhlanga – nokokuba busemakhayeni ethu, ekuhlaleni, kwimibutho yasekuhlaleni, emisebenzini okanye kunxibelelwano ngeselela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa zonke izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi zilwe futhi zingxeke ukucwasa ngokobuhlanga - kungaba semakhaya ethu, emiphakathini , emicimbini yokuzijabulisa, ezindaweni zokusebenza noma ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.

src: Kufuneka sisebenze kunye ukuze kufezeke ulawulo lwentando yesininzi oludibeneyo, olungacaluli ngabuhlanga nasini.
tgt: Kufanele sonke sisebenzisane ukufeza intando yeningi ebumbene, engacwasi ngokwebala nangokubulili.

src: IKhabhinethi iza kusebenzisana nabemi boMzantsi Afrika kulo lonke eli ngelixa leVeki yeSizwe yokuGxininisa kwiiMbizo phakathi komhla wesi- 4 nowe-10 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2016, phantsi komxholo othi: “Sisonke siqhubela uMzantsi Afrika phambili : Sikhulisa uMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: Amalungu Esigungu Esiphezulu azoxoxisana nezakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika ezweni lonke ngesikhathi seSonto Likazwelonke Eligxile Ezimbizweni phakathi komhla zi-4 kuze kube mhla zi-10 Mbaso 2016, ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: "Ngokubambisana singenza iNingizimu Afrika iqhubekele phambili: Khula Ningizimu Afrika."

src: Loo veki ingqamana neVeki yePalamente yeeNqila zoVoto nokukhumbula iNyanga yeNkululeko.
tgt: Leli viki lihambisana neViki LePhalamende Lokubuyela Emazikweni kanye nokugujwa kweNyanga Yenkululeko.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bathathe inxaxheba ngamandla kule misitho, kwaye bathethathethane neenkokeli zopolitiko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika uthi zibambe iqhaza ngendlela ebonakalayo kule micimbi futhi zixoxisane nezikhulu zezombusazwe.

src: Le Veki yokuGxininisa kwiiMbizo iza kugqamisa ukusebenza kwesiCwangciso esinaManqaku aliThoba enjongo yaso ikukomeleza ukukhula koqoqosho nokudala amathuba emisebenzi afuneka kangangoko.
tgt: Iviki Eligxile Ezimbizweni lizocacisa ngokuqala kokusetshenziswa koHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye oluhlose ukufukula ukukhula komnotho kanye nokuvula amathuba emisebenzi adingeka kakhulu.

src: Le veki yeeMbizo iza kuphinda itshile ngempumelelo yorhulumente wemimandla, kubandakanywa nempumelelo eze ngecebo lokuvuselela urhulumente wasekhaya- inkqubo yokuBuyela kuNdalashe.
tgt: Lizophinda liveze impumelelo kahulumeni wendawo, kubandakanya impumelelo efezwe ngokusebenzisa uhlelo lokuvuselela kabusha ukulumeni wendawo.

src: Le veki iza kuphinda ingqamane nempelaveki yokugqibela yobhaliso phambi koNyulo looMasipala lowe-2016, nto leyo eza kuphinda inike abaphetheyo ithuba lokuqoqa nokuhlanganisa abemi boMzantsi Afrika ngokubafundisa ngezovoto ukuba babhalise kwaye baqinisekise iinkcukacha zabo zovoto.
tgt: Leli viki lizophinda lihambisane nempelasonto yokugcina yokubhalisela Ukhetho Lomasipala lonyaka we-2016, futhi lihlinzeke abaphathi ngelinye ithuba lokukhuthaza nokuvukuza izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika ngokusebenzisa umkhankaso wokufundisa abavoti ukuthi babhalise futhi baqinisekise imininingwane yabo yokuvota.

src: USekela-Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uza kuvula iNgqungquthela yesiBini yokuPhuhliswa kwabaSebenzi eza kuba seGallagher Convention Centre eMidrand ngomhla wama-29 nowama- 30 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “Intsebenziswano yezakhono – Ikhwelo lokuba kuSetyenzwe”.
tgt: IPhini Likamongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa uzovula Ingqungquthela Ye-2 Yomkhandlu Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwabasebenzi ezobanjelwa eGallagher Convention Centre eMidrand mhla zi-29 nangomhla zi-30 Ndasa 2016 ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: "Ukusebenzisana kwezamakhono – Ikhwelo Lokuthi Kusetshenzwe".

src: Le ngqungquthela iza kudibanisa bonke abachaphazelekayo kwicandelo lemfundo ephakamileyo liphela ukuze incede ekuliphuhliseni nasekudibaneni ngentsebenzisano edala amaziko emfundo ephakamileyo alungele ukusebenza.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela ihlanganisa ababambiqhaza abavela kuwo wonke umkhakha wezemfundo ephakeme ukusiza ukukhula kwawo kanye nokwakha ubudlelwano obakha izikhungo zezemfundo ephakeme eziqotho eziyilungele imboni.

src: IVeki yeSizwe yezaManzi yowama-2016 iza kubakho ukususela ngomhla we-14 ukuya kowama-22 kweyoKwindla phantsi komxholo othi, “Amanzi abantu, amanzi ongiwa ngabantu”.
tgt: Iviki Likazwelonke Lamanzi lonyaka we-2016 lizoba kusukela mhla zi-14 kuze kube mhla zi-22 Ndasa ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: "Amanzi abantu, amanzi aphethwe ngabantu".

src: Le veki iza kutshila ngamanzi njengelungelo lomntu ngokuvusa abantu malunga nengxaki yabantu abangafikeleliyo emanzini acwengileyo aselwayo.
tgt: Leli viki lizoveza amanzi njengelungelo lomuntu ngokuqwashisa abantu ngosizi lwabantu abangenawo amanzi ahlanzekile okuphuza.

src: ISebe laManzi noGutyulo likwiphulo lokutshabalalisa inkqubo yamabhakethe elindle kwaye kungoku nje sele iphelise ukusetyenziswa kwamabhakethe kwiindawo ezingama--78.8% ezinezindlu ezihlala abantu eMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: UMnyango Wezamanzi Nokuthuthwa Kwendle usalokhu uqhubekile nohlelo lokuqeda uhlelo lwamabhakede futhi kuze kube yimanje usuqede ama-78,8% ohlelo lwamabhakede emijondolo eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Amaphondo asixhenxe aqhube kakuhle kakhulu ngokuphelisa iindawo ezingumyinge ongama-90% ezisasebenzisa amabhakethe.
tgt: Izifundazwe eziyisikhombisa zisebenze kahle ngokuqeda uhlelo lwamabhakede ngama-90%.

src: Amaphondo aziphelise zonke iindawo ezinezindlu ezisebenzisa amabhakethe ukuzithumba yiKwaZulu-Natal, uMntla Ntshona, iMpumalanga neGauteng.
tgt: Lezo zifundazwe ezikwazile ukuqeda nya uhlelo lwamabhakede emijondolo yi-KwaZulu-Natal, yiNyakatho Ntshonalanga, yiMpumalanga neGauteng.

src: INtshona Koloni sele iphelise iindawo ezingama-i-99.8%.
tgt: INtshonalanga Kapa ifinyelele kuma-99,8% okuqedwa kohlelo lwamabhakede.

src: Kwinani ebekujongwe kulo elingama-26 120 eMntla Koloni, eMpuma Koloni, eMntla Ntshona naseFreyistata, ukuza kuthi ga ngoku iindawo ezingama-11 650 ebezikade zisebenzisa amabhakethe ngoku azisawasebenzisi.
tgt: Kumkhawulo we-26 120 eNyakatho Kapa, eMpumalanga Kapa, eNyakatho Ntshonalanga naseFreyistata, kuze kube manje sekuqedwe izinhlelo azingaba yi-11 650.Nakuba imvula esanda kunetha ilethe ukukhululeka okuncane, umthelela wesomiso uyaqhubeka nokuzwakala kwezinye izingxenye zaleli lizwe.

src: Noxa iimvula ezithe zana kutsha nje ziye zanceda, imbalela isagquba kwezinye iindawo kweli lizwe.
tgt: Izakhamizi zaseNingizimu Afrika kumele ziqhubeke nokusebenzisa amanzi ngokuwonga futhi ziqalise imizamo yokonga amanzi.

src: URhulumente selebonelele ngemali eyibhiliyoni yeerandi ukuhlangabezana nale ngxaki yembalela.
tgt: Uhulumeni wabe isigidigidi esi-1 samarandi ukubhekana nenkinga yesomiso.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela inkqubela eyenziwe yinkqubo yeDabi lokuLwa ukuVuza kwaManzi yeminyaka emihlanu phantsi komxholo othi: “Ithontsi ngalinye libalulekile).
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamukela inqubekela phambili eyenziwa wuHlelo Lokulwa Nokuvuza Kwamanzi lweminyaka emihlanu ngaphansi kwengqikithi ethi: "Iconsi ngalinye libalulekile".

src: Injongo yayo le nkqubo kukufumana, ukuqeqesha nokusebenzisa abantu abatsha abali-15 000 abanesiqinisekiso semfundo ubuncinane seBanga le-12 okanye u-N3 ukuba babe ngabatywini, amagcisa nee-arhente zamanzi.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luhlose ukuqasha, luqeqeshe futhi lusabalalise abantu abasha aba-15 000 abaphase Ibanga le-12 noma u-N3 njengoplamba, abenzi bomsebenzi wezandla kanye nama-ejenti amanzi.

src: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba egqubayo ekuhlaleni.
tgt: Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni eziqavile kwezemvelo.

src: IKhabhinethi iyabacela abaqhankqalazi ukuba bazibambe kakhulu, kwaye izikhalazo zabo zilawulwe ngumthetho nanguMgaqo-siseko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa ababhikishi ukuthi benze konke okusemandleni ukuthi bazibambe futhi bazwakalise izikhalazo zabo ngendlela ehambisana nomthetho kanye noMthethosisekelo.

src: Ukonakalisa okuyinkohlakalo nokonakalisa impahla yinto yokutsiba ilitye likaphungela malunga nelungelo lokuqhankqalaza kwaye loo nto ngumsebenzi wabaphuli-mthetho abalahlekileyo.
tgt: Ukucekela phansi kanye nokonakalisa impahla kuyadlula emkhawulweni welungelo lokubhikisha futhi ngumsebenzi wabantu abanobugebengu.

src: Ii-arhente zogcino-mthetho aziza kuwugcina umthetho ngokubamba nokubeka ityala abo batshabalalisa impahla kwiidyunivesithi, kwanamanye amaziko emfundo ephakamileyo, ekuhlaleni nangexesha loqhankqalazo.. UMphathiswa wezeZimali wazise iKhabhinethi ngotyelelo asandula ukuba nalo eMelika naseNgilani apho athe wadibana nabachaphazelekayo, kuquka iinkokheli kwezoshishino.
tgt: Abathobelisi bomthetho bazolandela umthetho ngokubopha futhi babeke amacala labo bantu abonakalisa impahla emayunivesithi, kwezinye izikhungo zemfundo ephakeme, emiphakathini kanye nangezikhathi zokubhikisha.

src: IKhabhinethi izinikele ekuqinisekiseni okokuba izinga lethu kwezoqoqosho alithotywa..Olo tyelelo lunika urhulumente ithuba lokwabelana ngamalinge athile aliqela asetyenzisiweyo ukuhlangabezana nemingeni.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezezimali wazise iKhabhinethi mayelana nomkhankaso osanda kuba khona wokuya e-US nase-United Kingdom nabantu abahlukahlukene okusetshenziswana nabo, kuhlanganisa abaholi bezamabhizinisi.

src: Loo malinge aquka intsebenziswano ukuze ukukhula okubandakanyayo kukhawuleze, ukukhawulezisa amanyathelo okuqinisa imicimbi yemali kaRhulumente nokukhawulezisa ukusebenza kweNkqubo yoTyalo-mali kwiziSeko ezinguNdoqo exabisa iibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-R870 kwakunye nenkqubela eyenziweyo ekusombululeni imiqathango yezamandla, kuquka ukusebenzisa amandla ahlaziyekayo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi leli lizwe lisebenza ngokubambisana ukuqinisekisa ukuthi asihliselwa kwelinye izinga.

src: IKhabhinethi imemelela onke amacandelo ukuba athethe ngazo zonke iinkqubo ezakhayo nangokungenelela okwenziweyo ukukhusela uqoqosho lwethu.
tgt: Lokhu kuvakasha kunikeza uhulumeni ithuba lokwazisa ngemizamo eminingana esiqalisiwe ukubhekana nezinselele.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayiphinda into yokuba ukomelela koqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika kusekelwe phezu kwezinto eziqinileyo nezingundoqo zoqoqosho kwaneenkqubo ezisebenzayo.
tgt: Lokhu kuhlanganisa izinyathelo zokusebenzisana ukusheshisa ukukhula komnotho okufaka wonke umuntu, izinyathelo zokusheshisa ukuhlanganiswa kwezimali, ukusheshiswa kokuqaliswa koHlelo Lokutshala Imali Kungqalasizinda olubiza izigidigidi ezi-870 zamarandi kanye nenqubekela phambili esiyenziwe ekuxazululeni izingqinamba zezamandla, kuhlanganisa ukusebenzisa ezamandla ezisebenziseka kabusha.

src: IKhabhinethi isiqaphele isimangalo seQumrhu leMigodi sokuba uXwebhu lwezeMigodi kuthiwe alihambisani namgaqo-siseko kwaye alikho mthethweni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa yonke imikhakha ukuthi yazise ngazo zonke izinhlelo ezinhle kanye nokungenelela okwenziwe ukusiza umnotho wethu.

src: IKhabhinethi iphinda iyayithetha into yokuba imithetho-siseko yoXwebhu lwezeMigodi ijonge ekuguquleni ushishino lwemigodi ngenjongo yokulungisa ukungalingani kwezinto ngokwasembalini, nto leyo eyeza nenkqubo yocalucalulo.
tgt: Kubalulekile ukuthi yonke imikhakha iqinisekise ukuthi umnotho wezwe uyakwazi ukubhekana nezimo ezinzima.

src: Injongo kukuba ishishini eli lihambelane neenguqu zoMzantsi Afrika mayelana nezentlalo, ezopolitiko nezoqoqosho.
tgt: Mayelana nalokhu, iKhabhinethi ijube iKomiti Lotshalomali Elixube Ongqongqoshe ukuthi liqalise ngokushesha ukusebenzisa zonke izinqumo ezibalulekile ezimayelana nomnotho.

src: Ukuphuculwa kwabahlali ikwangumba ongundoqo ekugxilwe kuwo ukuqinisekisa ukuba uphuhliso lwemigodi alubabekeli ecaleni abahlali abafaneleyo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyagcizelela ukuthi umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika okwazi ukubhekana nezimo ezinzima wakhelwe phezu kwezisekelo zomnotho kanye nezinqubomgomo ezisebenzisekayo ezingezoqobo.

src: IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abasebenzisa iindlela, ngokukodwa abo baza kuba besendleleni kwezi holide zizayo, ukuba badlale indima yabo ngokuluthabathela kubo uxanduva lokhuseleko lwabo nolo lwabahamba ezindleleni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyaqaphela icala elivulwe yi-Chamber of Mines ukuthi kumenyezelwe Umqulu Wezezimayini njengophambene noMthethosisekelo futhi oyizeleze.

src: Ukuphelisa le nyhikityha yokubhubha kwabantu ezindleleni yinto ephambili esizweni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyagcizelela ukuthi imigomo yoMqulu Wezezimayini wukuguqula imboni yasezimayini ukulungisa ukungalingani kwaphambilini okwabangelwa wubandlululo ukuze imboni ihambisane nezinguquko jikelele zaseNingizimu Afrika zesimo somphakathi, sezombusazwe kanye nesezomnotho.

src: Abaqhubi kufuneka baqave, bathobele imithetho yendlela, bangaseli baze baqhube, basigcine isantya esimiselweyo kwaye baqinisekise ukuba iinqwelo zabo zikufanele ukuhamba endleleni.
tgt: Ukufukulwa komphakathi ngenye yezindawo ezibalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuthuthukiswa kwezimayini akushiyi ngaphandle imiphakathi efanele.

src: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana nabo bonke abaphumelele iiMbasa zeSizwe zamaLungelo abaKhubazekileyo, msitho lowo owawubanjwe ngomhla we-11 kweyoKwindla ngowama-2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abasebenzisi bomgwaqo, kakhulukazi labo abathatha uhambo ngamaholidi azayo, ukuthi badlale indima yabo ekuphepheni kwabo kanye nokwabanye abasebenzisi bomgwaqo.

src: Ezi mbasa zithulela umnqwazi abantu abakhubazekileyo kunye namatshantliziyo alwela amalungelo abantu abakhubazekileyo abagqwesileyo ngonyaka wama-2015.
tgt: Ukuqeda izingozi zomgwaqo kusalokhu kungumsebenzi oseqhulwini kuzwelonke.

src: IKhabhinethi ithulela umnqwazi abo baphumelele kwiiMbasa zesiThathu zeSizwe zoNyaka zokuGqwesa zabeNkonzo yesiPolisa yoMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS), eqhwabela izandla ukugqwesa kwamalungu e-SAPS, amapolisa ahleli ekhaya anokubizwa nanini na kwanamaqonga amapolisa abahlali.
tgt: Abashayeli kumele baqaphele, bathobele imithetho yomgwaqo, bangaphuzi bese beyashayela, bagcine umkhawulo wejubane futhi baqinisekise ukuthi izimoto zabo zisesimweni esifanele sokuba semgwaqeni.

src: IKhabhinethi incoma ababhali uMandla Dube noLeon Otto bePambili Media ngefilimu yabo ethi: Kalushi: The Story of Solomon Mahlangu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela bonke abawinile kuZindondo Zikazwelonke Zamalungelo Okukhubazeka ezazibanjwe mhla zi-11 Ndasa 2016.

src: Abemi boMzantsi Afrika bakhuthazwa ukuba bayibukele le filimu itsala umdla inomxholo otyebileyo wezopolitiko engokuguquka kwetyendyana eliminyaka ili-19 ubudala nelilelaseMamelodi, empuma Pitoli, libe ngumzekelo woMzabalazo.
tgt: Le miklomelo ihlonipha abantu abaphila nokukhubazeka kanye nezishoshovu zamalungelo okukhubazeka abenze umsebenzi oncomekayo ngonyaka we-2015.

src: IKhabhinethi iphinde yayithetha into yokuba, ngokusebenzisa isebe lezoRhwebo noShishino nelezobuGcisa neNkcubeko, iza kusoloko ikuxhasa ukukhula kweshishini lobugcisa elisikhumbuza lisixelela ibali loMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela bonke abanqobile ku-3rd South African Police Service (SAPS) Excellence Awards, abonga umsebenzi oncomekayo wamalungu e-SAPS, amarizevu kanye namalungu ezinkundla zamaphoyisa omphakathi.

src: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana netshantliziyo lobulungisa ekuhlaleni uFather Michael Lapsley ngokuwongwa nge-International 2016 Public Peace Prize kwinqanaba i- ‘Global Peace and Reconciliation – Internationally-Reputed Peacemaker’.
tgt: IKhabinethi ihalalisela abalobi abahlanganyele uMandla Dube no-Leon Otto we-Pambili Media ngefilimu ethi Kalushi: The Story of Solomon Mahlangu.

src: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezinhlelo zikahulumeni ezisemqoka.

src: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela izinto ezibe yimpumelelo ezithe zakhankanywa nguMongameli uJacob Zuma ngexesha lokutyelela iziko eliseBhayi eMpuma Koloni, ukuza kuhlola inkqubela esele yenziwe ekuphunyezweni kwephulo elibizwa i-Operation Phakisa: uQoqosho lwezaseLwandle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile osekuzuziwe okuqhakanjiswe nguMongameli u-Jacob Zuma ngenkathi ehambele mathupha Echwebeni laseBhayi eMpumalanga Kapa, ukuhlola inqubekelaphambili esiyenziwe maqondana nokuqaliswa ukusebenza kohlelo lomnotho wasolwandle olwaziwa ngokuthi yi-Operation Phakisa: Umnotho Waselwandle.

src: Urhulumente uvule utyalo-mali olufikelela kwimali emalunga neebhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-17 kuQoqosho lwezaseLwandle.
tgt: Uhulumeni usethukulule utshalomali olufinyelela cishe kwizigidigidi eziyi-17 zamarandi Emnothweni Wasolwandle.

src: Ukususela ekusungulweni kwayo, kudalwe imisebenzi engaphezulu kwama-4 500 kumacandelo aliqela.
tgt: Kusukela ekusengulweni kwalo lolu hlelo, sekusungulwe imisebenzi engaphezu kwezi-4 500 emikhakheni enhlobonhlobo.

src: Oodokolwana ababini kwabalithoba abakhiwa kuMzi weeNqanawa waseMazantsi e-Afrika, i-Southern African Shipyard, nesakhelwa uGunyaziwe waMazibuko eSizwe akwa-Transnet (i-TNPA) kwiZibuko laseDurban baza kuthunyelwa kwiZibuko laseBhayi.
tgt: Izingalawana ezimbili kweziyisishiyagalolunye ezakhiwa Izakhamkhumbi zaseNingizimu ne-Afrika zakwa-Transnet National Ports Authority (i-TNPA) Echwebeni lase-Durban zizohanjiswa Echwebeni laseBhayi.

src: UMongameli uZuma umisele ngokusesikweni udokolwana wokuqala eBhayi, obizwa uMvezo, nothiywe ngendawo awazalelwa kuyo owayesakuba nguMongameli uNelson Mandela.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma wethule ingalawana yokuqala eBhayi, ebizwa ngokuthi uMvezo, eqanjwe ngegama lendawo yokuzalwa kaMongameli waphambilini uNelson Mandela.

src: I-TNPA ibekele bucala imali engaphezulu kweebhiliyoni zeerandi ezisixhenxe yokuphucula amazibuko eli.
tgt: I-TNPA seyabe izigidigidi ezingaphezu kweziyi-7 zamarandi ukwenza ngcono amachweba ethu.

src: UMongameli ukubona oku kuhlaziywa nokwakhiwa ngokutsha kwesangwana neebhulorho zokungena ekumisa kuzo iinqanawa kwiZibuko laseBhayi neziza kukwazi ukungenisa iinqanawa ezongezelelweyo ezili-12 xa kuthelekiswa nezo zimbini zikhoyo ngoku.
tgt: UMongameli uzibhekile izindlela ezishibilikayo ezivuselelwe kabusha nezakhiwe kabusha kanye nemigudu eholela ezakhiweni zokukhuleka imikhumbi Echwebeni laseBhayi ezizokwazi ukuhlala imikhumbi eyi-12 ngaphezulu uma kuqhathaniswa nalena emibili ekhona njengamanje.

src: IKhabhinethi iyababulela abahlawuli berhafu abathe basebenzisana norhulumente kunyaka-mali wama-2015/16 ukwenza ukuba uqokelelo lwethu lwerhafu lufikelele okokuqala kwitriliyoni yeerandi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonge bonke abakhokhi bentela ababambisane nohulumeni onyakeni wezimali wezi-2015/16 ekuthatheni izimali zethu eziqoqwayo bazibeke kutriliyoni yamarandi okokuqala ngqa emlandweni.

src: Lo ngumzekelo ocacileyo wamandla oqoqosho lweli oluphumelela naphantsi kweemeko ezinzima.
tgt: Lesi yisibonakaliso esicacile samandla omnotho wethu ohlumayo ngisho ngaphansi kwezimo ezinzima.

src: Kungenxa yerhafu ehlawulwa ngabemi boMzantsi Afrika abathe bangenisa iingxelo zabo zerhafu ngethuba kunye nomsebenzi omhle wokuqokelela irhafu weZiko leeNkonzo zezeRhafu zaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SARS) okwenza ukuba urhulumente akwazi ukunikezela ngeenkonzo ezidingeka kakhulu nezidlala indima ekuphuculeni ubomi babemi baseMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: Kungenxa yezinkokhelo zentela ezivela kubantu baseNingizimu Afrika abathobela umthetho kanye nokuqoqwa kwezimali ngempumelelo yiSikhungo Sezinsizakalo Zokuqoqwa Kwezimali saseNingizimu Afrika (i-SARS) nakuba uhulumeni ukwazi kangcono ukuhlinzeka izinsizakalo ezibhekwe ngamehlo abovu ezinegalelo ekwenzeni ngcono izimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziwe nguMongameli uZuma sokuba umhla wesi-3 kweyeThupha yowama-2016 njengomhla woNyulo looRhulumente beeNgingqi lowama-2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isamukelile isimemezelo sikaMongameli uZuma somhla zi-3 Ncwaba 2016 njengosuku Lokhetho Lohulumeni Bezindawo Lwezi-2016.

src: Urhulumente uxolile kukuba iimpela-veki ezimbini ezingumhla we-5 ukuya kowe-6 kweyoKwindla nomhla we-9 ukuya kowe-10 kuTshazimpuzi zokubhalisela unyulo kubonakale inani elikhulu labo baselungelweni lokuvota, ingakumbi abo baza kuvota okokuqala kunye nolutsha.
tgt: Uhulumeni uyakujabulela ukuthi izimpelasonto ezimbili zokubhalisela ukuvota ngomhla zi-5–6 kuNdasa kanye nomhla ziyi-9–10 kuMbasa zibonise inqwaba yabantu abangavota behambela ezikhungweni zokuvota, ikakhulukazi labo abazobe bevota okokuqala kanye nentsha.

src: IKhabhinethi iyababulela bonke abo bathe basabela kwikhwelo lokuya kubhalisa nokuya kukhangela iinkcukhacha zabo kuluhlu lwabavoti.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonge bonke labo abasabelile ekhweleni lokubhalisela ukuvota kanye nokuyobheka imininingwane yabo ohlwini labavoti.

src: Kungenxa yokusebenza ngokubambisana okubangela ukuba ulawulo lwethu lwentando yesininzi luye lusomelela ngakumbi.
tgt: Kungenxa yokusebenza kwethu ndawonye lapho intando yeningi yethu izokwazi ukukhula izikhathi ngezikhathi.

src: IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abemi abangekabhalisi okanye abangekazikhangeli iinkcukhacha zabo ukuba batyelele ii-ofisi zeKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo koomasipala babo baze balungise iinkcukhacha zabo kumqulu woluhlu lwabavoti (banikezele ngeedilesi) baze babhalisele unyulo lomhla wesi-3 kweyeThupha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa zonke izakhamuzi ezingakabhaliseli ukuvota noma ezingakayibheki imininingwane yazo ukuba zihambele amahhovisi eKhomishana Yokhetho Ezimele komasipala bezindawo bazo bese zivuselela imininingwane yazo ohlwini labavoti (zihlinzeke ngamakheli) bese zibhalisela ukuvota okhethweni lomhla zi-3 kuNcwaba.

src: Abavoti basenokuthumela iinombolo zabo zeZazisi nge-SMS ku-3281.0 okanye baqhagamshelane neziko loqhagamshelwano ku-0800 11 8000 ukuqinisekisa ukuba buthini ubume babo.
tgt: Abavoti bangaphinda futhi bathumele nge-SMS inombolo yabo kamazisi ku-3281.0 noma baxhumane nesikhungo sezingcingo ku-0800 11 8000 ukuqinisekisa isimo sabo.

src: Ubhaliso luqinisekisa ukuba igama lakho likhona kumqulu woluhlu lwabavoti ukuze ukwazi ukuvota.
tgt: Ukubhalisa kuqinisekisa ukuthi igama lakho likhona ohlwini labavoti ukuze uzokwazi ukuvota.

src: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abemi ukuba basebenzise ilungelo labo lomgaqo-siseko lokuvota nesalufumana nzima ngokuthi bavote kuNyulo looRhulumente beeNgingqi lowama-2016 ngomhla wesi-3 kweyeThupha yowama-2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema izakhamizi ukuba zisebenzise ilungelo lethu lomthethosiseko esalithola kanzima lokuvota Okhethweni Lohulumeni Bezindawo Lwezi-2016 ngomhla zi-3 Ncwaba 2016.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukumiselwa ngokusesikweni kweProjekthi yokuLinga i-eChannel yeSebe leMicimbi yezeKhaya (i-DHA) nguMongameli uZuma.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukwethulwa ngokusemthethweni komklamo obizwa ngokuthi yi-eChannel Pilot Project woMnyango Wezasekhaya (i-DHA) nguMongameli uZuma.

src: Le nkqubo yala maxesha intsha ivumela ukuba abemi bafake izicelo zabo zamakhadi-sazisi, i-Smart ID, kwi-intanethi ukuze baphephe imigca emide.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luusha lesimanje manje luvumela izakhamuzi ukuba zikwazi ukufaka izicelo zazo zomazisi abangamakhadi, i-Smart ID, ku-inthanethi futhi zigweme imigqa emide.

src: Le yintsebenziswano kunye neebhanki zeli ezine ezinkulu – i-ABSA, i-FNB, i-Nedbank kunye ne-Standard Bank ukuvelisa iqonga lokufaka isicelo samakhadi-sazisi nepaspothi ngokusebenzisa i-intanethi kuza kuvumela abemi beli ukuba batyelele i-ofisana ze-DHA ukuya kunyathelisa iminwe nemifanekiso yabo emva kokwenza idinga baze bahlawula nge-intanethi.
tgt: Lokhu kusebenzisana namabhange amane amakhulu – okuyi-ABSA, i-FNB, i-Nedbank kanye ne-Standard Bank – ukwethula inkundla yokufaka izicelo kwi-inthanethi zomazisi abangamakhadi kanye namaphasiphothi kuzokwenza izakhamuzi zikwazi ukuhambela amakhosombe e-DHA ukuhambisa izinsalela zawo zeminwe kanye nezithombe emva kokuba esenze isivumelwano sokubonana futhi enza nezinkokhelo kwi-inthanethi.

src: I-eChannel iyinxalenye yesicwangciso-qhinga sokwenza eli sebe lihambelane nala maxesha xa lilonke ukutshintsha iinkonzo zisuke kwezokusetyenziswa kwamaphepha kusetyenziswa ubuchwepheshe bale mihla , inkqubo eza kuquka ukulungiswa kweziphene kuluhlu oluqulethe iinkcukacha zoluntu.
tgt: I-eChannel iyingxenye yeqhinga selilonke lomnyango lesimanjemanje lokususa izinsizakalo ephepheni ziye kubuxhakaxhaka bubochwepheshe, uhlelo oluzobandakanya ukulungiswa kwamaphutha kwirejista enemininingwane yabantu.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela iimpumelelo yokubanjwa kutsha nje kweVeki eGxile kwiiMbizo phantsi komxholo othi ‘Sisonke siqhubela uMzantsi Afrika phambili’, apho sibone khona amagosa karhulumente etyelela iindawo ezininzi zoluntu kweli jikelele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamukelile impumelelo yeViki Lokubamba Izimbizo esanda kubanjwa nje ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi ‘Sisonke siqhubekisela iNingizimu Afrika phambili’, ebonise izikhulu zikahulumeni zixoxisana nemiphakathi ezweni lonkana.

src: IKhabhinethi ibothulela umnqwazi abo bemi boMzantsi Afrika bathe bathatha inxaxheba kwiinkqubo ezingaphezulu kwama-36 kweli jikelele, nezithe zaqinisekisa ukuba urhulumente uyahlangabezana nezo mfuno zoluntu zichongiweyo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabancoma labo bantu baseNingizimu Afrika ababambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni ezingaphezu kwama-36 ezweni lonkana, abaqinisekisile ukuthi uhulumeni uyaphendula ezidingweni zomphakathi ezihlonziwe.

src: Le Veki iGxile kwiMbizo iye yaxhobisa uluntu ngolwazi lweenkqubo zikarhulumente.
tgt: IViki Lokubamba Izimbizo isimamise imiphakathi ngolwazi maqondana nezinhlelo zikahulumeni.

src: ISebe lezokuHlaliswa koLuntu lisingathe ingqungquthela yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) ebeyimpumelelo enkulu ebigxile kwimiba yeendawo ezingamatyotyombe, futhi igxininisa nakwisantya esiphezulu sokufudukela kwabantu ezidolophini nokukhula ngokukhawuleza kwemimandla yamatyotyombe.
tgt: UMnyango Wezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu usingathe ingqungquthela eyimpumelelo Yenhlangano Yezizwee (i-UN) ebibhekene nezindawo zokuhlala eziyimikhukhu, igcizelela izinga elimangalisayo lokufudukela kwabantu emadolobheni kanye nokukhula kwemikhukhu.

src: Ngoku ngabantu abayibhiliyoni ehlabathini jikelele abahlala kwimimandla yamatyotyombe.
tgt: Njengamanje abantu abayisigidigidi esisodwa emhlabeni bahlala emikhukhwini.

src: Ukususela ngowe-1994 uMzantsi Afrika wakhe izigidi zezindlu njengenxalenye yokuqinisekisa ngobomi obungcono kumntu wonke.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika kusukela ngowe-1994 seyakhe izigidi ngezigidi zezindlu njengengxenye yokuqinisekisa impilo engcono kubo bonke abantu.

src: IMithetho eYilwayoIKhabhinethi iphumeze le Mithetho iYilwayo ilandelayo:.
tgt: IMithethosivivinywaIKhabhinethi igunyaze lezinhlaka zeMithethosivivinywa elandelayo:.

src: UMthetho oYilwayo ongokuKhuselwa kweZiseko ezinguNdoqo eziBaluleke kaKhulu wama-2016 oza kushicilelwa kwiPhephandaba loMbuso ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle kuwo.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wokuvikelwa Kwengqalasizinda Esemqoka wezi-2016 uzoshicilelwa kuSomqulu Kahulumeni ukuze kutholakale imibono yomphakathi ngawo.

src: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uguzula uMthetho waMaziko weSizwe anguNdoqo, we-1980 (uMthetho onguNombolo 102 we-1980, kwaye ugxile ekulungelelaniseni inkqubo yokuchonga nokubhengeza iziseko ezingundoqo ezibaluleke kakhulu ngendlela eselubala necacisekayo.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchitha uMthetho Wezintuba Ezisemqoka Zikazwelonke, we-1980 (uMthetho we-102 we-1980), futhi ufuna ukuhambelanisa inqubo yokuhlonza kanye nokudalulwa kwengqalasizinda esemqoka ngendlela esobala nephendulayo.

src: Kwakhona uza kuqinisekisa ukuba zonke iziseko ezingundoqo ezibaluleke kakhulu ziyachongwa zize zikhuselwe ngokufanelekileyo ukwenzela ukhuseleko lwesizwe.
tgt: Uzophinda futhi uqinisekise ukuthi zonke izingqalasizinda zokuvikelela kuzwelonke kwezwe ziyakwazi ukuhlonzwa futhi ziyavikelwa ngokwanele.

src: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ukwabonelela ngokumiselwa kwenkqubo-sikhokelo yeziko ukwenzela ukuhlolwa nokwenziwa kokhuseleko lweziseko ezingundoqo ezibaluleke kakhulu.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uhlinzekela ukumiswa kohlaka lokusebenza lwesikhungo ukuqapha nokusebenzisa ukuvikelwa kwezingqalasizinda ezisemqoka.

src: Ukwacacisa imisebenzi kweziko eliza kucebisa uMphathiswa wezamaPolisa ekubhengezweni kweziseko ezingundoqo.
tgt: Uphinde uchaze imisebenzi yomgwamanqa ozokweluleka uNgqongqoshe Wezamaphoyisa ekudalulweni kwezingqalasizinda ezisemqoka.

src: UMthetho-siHlomelo ongeMibutho yabaNikazi Mhlaba wowama-2016 uza kupapashwa ukwenzela ukuba uluntu lukwazi ukuhlomla kuwo.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa Wokuchitshiyelwa Kwezinhlangano Zempahla Ehlanganyelwayo wezi-2016 uzoshicilelwa ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngawo.

src: Lo Mthetho uyilwayo uhlomela uMthetho okhoyo ongeMibutho yabaNikazi Mhlaba, we-1996 (uMthetho uNombolo 28 we-1996).Lo Mthetho uYilwayo womeleza inkqubo yolawulo olulolwentando yesininzi yeMibutho yabaNikazi Mhlaba abaLuluntu okanye amaqumrhu eTrasti akhoyo athi ongamele umhlaba onabanikazi abaluluntu.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho wamanje Wezinhlangano Zempahla Ehlanganyelwayo, we-1996 (uMthetho wama-28 we-1996).UMthethosivivinywa uzoqinisa uhlelo lokubusa ngentandoyeningi lweziNhlangano ezikhona njengamanje Zempahla Ehlanganyelwayo noma izikhungo ezikhona njengamanje Zesikhwama Sezimali Ezisisiwe ezengamela umhlaba osetshenziswa ngokuhlanganyela.

src: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlonyelweyo uvumela ukuba kumiselwe i-ofisi yoMgcini-ncwadi kwiSebe loPhuhliso lwamaPhandle noBuyekezo lweMihlaba, kwaye uyayicacisa imisebenzi yale ofisi.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa ochitshiyelwe uhlinzekela ukumiswa kwehhovisi likaNobhala eMnyangweni Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zasemakhaya kanye Nezinguquko Kwezomhlaba, futhi uchaze imisebenzi yaleli hhovisi.

src: Xa sele upasisiwe lo Mthetho uYilwayo waba ngumthetho, uza komeleza imimiselo yamaziko olawulo uze uqinise inkxaso kaRhulumente kuwo.
tgt: Uma lo Mthethosivivinywa usuphasisiwe waba umthetho, uzoqinisa ukulawulwa kwezikhungo zokubusa futhi uthuthukise ukwesekwa kwawo nguMbuso.

src: Uza kwenza ukuba uluntu lukwazi ukufumana, lubambe luze lulawule imihlaba ngokusebenzisa amaqumrhu olawulo asebenzayo nasekwe ngokomthetho naxhaswayo ngurhulumente.
tgt: Uzovumela imiphakathi ukuba ithole, ibambe futhi iphathe izimpahla ngokusebenzisa izikhungo zokwenziwa komsebenzi ezisungulwe ngokusemthethweni ngempumelelo zisekelwa nguhulumeni.

src: Ukuthiwa thaca koMthetho oYilwayo ongoLamlo weHlabathi wowama-2016 ePalamente.
tgt: Ukwethulwa koMthethosivivinywa Wokulamula Emhlabeni Wonke wezi-2016 ePhalamende.

src: Inkqubo yolamlo lwehlabathi sisixhobo esibalulekileyo sokwenza ushishino ngaphaya kwemida yeli lizwe.
tgt: Inqubo yokulamula emhlabeni wonke iyithuluzi elisemqoka lokwenza ibhizinisi ngaphesheya kwemingcele yezwe.

src: Uza kwenza ukuba kube lula kwiinkampani ezenza ushishino kumazwe angaphandle kweli nezamazwe angaphandle ezishishina eMzantsi Afrika ukuba zifikelele kwiinkonzo zezobulungisa.
tgt: Uzokwenza ngcono ukufinyeleleka kwezinsizakalo zobulungiswa ezinkampanini ezenza ibhizinisi ngaphandle kwaleli lizwe kanye nezinkampani zasemazweni angaphandle eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uguzula uMthetho wokwaMkelwa nokuSetyenziswa kokuNikezelwa koLamlo lwaMazwe angaPhandle, we-1977 (uMthetho uNombolo 40 we-1977) kwakunye nokuhlonyelwa koMthetho woKhuselo loShishino, we-1978 (uMthetho uNombolo 99 we-1978).Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhambelana noMthetho woMfuziselo ongoLamlo kuRhwebo lweHlabathi, owamkelwa yiKhomishini yeZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) kuMthetho woRhwebo lweHlabathi.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchitha uMthetho Wokwamukelwa kanye Nokuqiniswa Kwemiklomelo Yokulamula Emazweni Angaphandle, we-1977 (uMthetho wama-40 we-1977) uphinde futhi uchibiyele uMthetho wamanje Wokuvikelwa Kwebhizinisi, we-1978 (uMthetho wama-99 we-1978).

src: Ukupapashwa kwedrafti yoMthetho-siHlomelo weSiseko soPhando-nzulu seSizwe wowama-2016 kwiPhephandaba loMbuso ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle.
tgt: Umthethosivivinywa ohlongozwayo uhambelana Nomthetho Owuhlaka maqondana Nokulamula Kwezokuhwebelana Ezweni Lonke, owamukelwa yiKhomishana Yenhlangano Yezizwe maqondana Nomthetho Wezokuhwebelana Emhlabeni Wonke.

src: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlomela uMthetho weSiseko soPhando-nzulu weSizwe, we-1998 (uMthetho uNombolo 23 we-1998).Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kuphucula isakhono soMzantsi Afrika sokukwazi ukumelana nokhuphiswano kuphuhliso lwezophando-nzulu nokuvelisa okutsha ngolawullo olusebenzayo, olwaneleyo noluququzelelweyo lokubandakanywa koluntu kwezenzululwazi, nobonelelo lweziseko ezingundoqo zophando-nzulu eziphuculilweyo nofikeleleko.
tgt: Ukushicilelwa kohlaka loMthethosivivinywa Wokuchitshiyelwa Kwesisekelo Socwaningo Lukazwelonke wezi-2016 kuSomqulu Kahulumeni ukuze umphakathi uphawule.

src: Kwakhona uza kuphucula indlela uphuhliso loPhando-nzulu olusabela nolusebenza ngokuvakalayo kwalo nokubonelela ukuveliswa kokutsha, ukuphucula umgangatho wobomi babemi baseMzantsi Afrika ngokuhambelana okungcono nemiba ephambili nengundoqo karhulumente.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wesisekelo Socwaningo Lukazwelonke, we-1998 (uMthetho wama-23 we-1998).

src: Izigqibo ezingundoqo zeKhabhinethi.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi eziqavile.

src: IKhabhinethi ilamkele iPhepha leNgcaciso ngezobuPolisa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukele Umthetho Odingidwayo Omaqondana Nobuphoyisa.

src: Idrafti yeli Phepha leNgcaciso lapapashwa okokuqala kwinyanga yoKwindla yowama-2015 ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle.
tgt: Uhlaka Lomthetho Odingidwayo lwashicilelwa okokuqala ukuze kutholakale imibono yomphakathi ngoNdasa 2015.

src: Eli phepha libonelele ngenkonzo yezobupolisa ebacingela kakhulu abemi abasebenzayo ize ilandele neemeko ezikhoyo zezobupolisa.
tgt: Lo mthetho odingidwayo uhlinzekela imisebenzi yobuphoyisa echeme nezakhamuzi eziphilayo futhi ephendulayo esimweni samanje semisebenzi yobuphoyisa.

src: Ikwabonelela ngeNkonzo yezobuPolisa yaseMzantsi Afrika neyamapolisa kamasipala ekwaziyo ukuphendula icacise futhi nesebenza ngobuchule nondiliseko.
tgt: Uphinde uhlinzekele Umbutho Wamaphoyisa waseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) kanye namaphoyisa kamasipala akwaziyo ukuphendula futhi asebenza ngobungoti.

src: Eli Phepha leNgcaciso likwafuna ukuba kumiselwe iBhodi yezobuPolisa yeSizwe eza kuthi, phakathi kweminye yemisebenzi yayo, ijongane nokumiselwa kwemimiselo nemigaqo yokukhupha izithuba zemisebenzi, ukukhethwa nokuqeshwa kwamalungu amatsha kwiinkonzo zezobupolisa.
tgt: Umthetho Odingidwayo unxusa ukuba kusungulwe iBhodi Likazwelonke Lamaphoyisa, elizokuba, phakathi kweminye imisebenzi, nesibophezelo sokumisa imigomo yezinjongo zokuqashwa, ukuhlungwa kanye nokuqokwa kwabantu abasha emisebenzini yobuphoyisa.

src: IKhabhinethi ilamkele iPhepha leNgcaciso elingoKhuseleko noKhuselo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yamukele Umthetho Odingidwayo Omaqondana Nezokuphepha Nokuvikeleka.

src: Eli Phepha leNgcaciso, nebelikhutshwe kwinyanga yoMdumba yowama-2015 ukwenzela ukuba kufakwane imilomo noluntu malunga nalo, ligxile kwindlela edibeneyo neyophuhliso kukhuseleko ngaphaya kobupolisa.
tgt: Umthetho Odingidwayo, obuvele usukhishiwe ukuze kuxoxiswane nomphakathi ngawo ngoNhlolanja 2015, ugxile endleleni yokusebenza edidiyelwe nethuthukisayo maqondana nokuphepha okungale komsebenzi wobuphoyisa.

src: Linika isikhokelo kumanyathelo okhuseleko loluntu oluthintelayo.
tgt: Ufuna ukuba ngumkhombandlela mayelana nezinyathelo zokuvikela ezokuphepha zemiphakathi.

src: Eli Phepha leNgcaciso lichonge onke amasebe afanelekileyo nemibutho yasekuhlaleni yoLuntu enegalelo kukhuseleko loluntu.
tgt: Umthetho Odingidwayo uhlonza yonke iminyango efanelekile kanye nezinhlangano ezigxile emiphakathini ezinegalelo ekuphepheni kwemiphakathi.

src: IKhabhinethi iyamkele idrafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo woKwenziwa kweSiko loLwaluko eMzantsi Afrika yaza yakwamkela ukuba iSebe leMicimbi yeMveli maliqalise ukuyila umthetho wesizwe ongolwaluko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze uhlaka lweNqubomgomo emaqondana Nosiko Lokusoka eNingizimu Afrika futhi yagunyaza nokuthi uMnyango Wezendabuko uqale ukwenza uhlaka lomthetho kazwelonke omaqondana nokusoka.

src: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo sele udlule kwinkqubo ebanzi yofakwano-mlomo loluntu kunye nabo bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo.
tgt: Le nqubomgomo isivele isidlule ohlelweni olunzulu lokuxoxisana nomphakathi maqondana nayo kanye nababambiqhaza abafanelekile.

src: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ubonelela ngesikhokelo esiqinisekisa ngokhuseleko lwesiko lemveli lolwaluko lwamakhwenkwe lwaminyaka le kungakhange kubekwe emngciphekweni ukhuseleko lwawo.
tgt: Inqubomgomo ihlinzeka ngemihlahlandlela eqinisekisa ukuvikelwa kosiko lomdabu lokusokwa minyakayonke kwabafana abasebancane ngaphandle kokubeka ukuphepha kwabo engcupheni.

src: Le yinxalenye yamanyathelo athathwa ngurhulumente ukuqinisa ukwenziwa kweli siko ngendlela efanelekileyo neyamkelekileyo.
tgt: Lokhu kwenza ingxenye yezinyathelo uhulumeni azithathayo ukuqinisa amasiko afanelekile kanye navumelekile.

src: Ubuyisela izinga elamkelekileyo lokuphendula nokucacisa kwabo baphethe amabhoma nabazali abathumela abantwana babo kulo mabhoma.
tgt: Igcina izinga elivumelekile lokukwazi ukuziphendulela kulabo bantu abaphethe izikole zokusoka kanye nabazali abathumela izingane zabo kulezo zikole.

src: IKhabhinethi izamkele izindululo ezenziwe yiKomiti yoPhando lokuba kunokwenzeka na ukuba kwenziwe kurhwetywe ngeempondo zemikhombe njengenye yeendlela zokusindisa imikhombe yeli lizwe ingabi semngciphekweni wokutshabalala.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze izincomo ezenziwe yiKomidi Lophenyo olumaqondana nokufaneleka kokuhweba ngezimpondo zobhejane njengenye yezindlela zokulondoloza obhejane kuleli lizwe.

src: Ezi zindululo ziye zaxhaswa yiKomiti yabaCebisi bezobuChwephetshe yamaSebe aHlukeneyo kunye neKomiti yabaPhathiswa echongelwe ukuba yenze uphando lokuba kungenzeka na lwenziwe olusemthethweni ushishino lwehlabathi lorhwebo lweempondo zemikhombe.
tgt: Lezi zincomo zamukelwa yiKomidi Lokweluka Kwezobuchwepheshe Leminyango Ehlukene kanye neKomidi loNgqongqoshe Abahlukene aqokelwa ukuba aphenye ngamathuba okwenza kube semthethweni ukuhweba ngokuthengiselana ngezimpondo zobhejane emhlabeni wonke.

src: Ezi zindululo zomeleze indlela yolawulo lobuchule edibeneyo uMzantsi Afrika oyiqwalasele ngayo lo mba ukusombulula ukuzingelwa kwemikhombe ngokungekho mthethweni nokurhweba ngemikhombe okungekhomthethweni.
tgt: Izincomo zigunyaza indlela yokusebenza yaseNingizimu Afrika yokuphathwa ngobuqhinga obudidiyelwe kwesixazululo sokuzingelwa kobhejane kanye nokuhweba ngobhejane okungekho emthethweni.

src: Ikomiti icebisa ukuba le ndlela yangoku yokugcina izinga lomhlambi okhoyo ugcinwe unjalo kunokuba kushishinwe ngeempondo zemikhombe.
tgt: Ikomidi lincoma ukuthi indlela esetshenziswa manje ukugcina isibalo sobhejane baleli lizwe kumele igcinwe uma iqhathaniswa nokuhwebelana ngezimpondo zobhejane.

src: Indlela yobuchule eliyisebenzisayo eli lizwe iquka ukhuselo ukuxhotyiswa koluntu ulawulo lwezenzulu-lwazi ngezilwanyana imithetho esabela ngqo kulo mngeni nesetyenziswa futhi inyanzeliswe ngokubonakalayo nolawulo lwezinga lokufunwa kweemveliso zemikhombe.
tgt: Indlela yokusebenza ngobuqhinga yaleli lizwe iqukethe ukuvikeleka ukunikezwa komphakathi amandla ukuphathwa kwebhayoloji izimiso zemithetho ephendulayo eziqaliswa ukusebenza ngempumelelo futhi eziqiniswayo kanye nokuphathwa kokufunwa ngamandla kobhejane.

src: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukuyilwa kweenkozo zemali zesikhumbuzo sowama-2016:a) UThotho lweeNkozo zeMali ze-National Geographic – Iphulo leeKati eziNkulu: ‘INgwenkala’.b) Uthotho lweeNkozo zeMali zesiThsaba sePonti neTiki sesilivere ‘izinto eziqanjwe eMzantsi Afrika’ – ‘i-Dolosse’Uyilo lweenkozo zemali, kunye nezibhengezo zazo, ziza kupapshwa kwiPhephandaba loMbuso, ize emva koko ziveliswe ize zithengiswe ngokweendlela zesiqhelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze lawa madizayini alandelayo ezinhlamvu zemali azokuba yisikhumbuzo sowezi-2016:a) Uhlelo Lochungechunge Lwezinhlamvu Zemali ze-National Geographic –Amakati Amakhulu: ‘Ingulule’.b) Uchungechunge lwezinhlamvu zemali zepondo notiki ezinomqhele wesiliva ‘Okukhandwe eNingizimu Afrika–‘i-Dolosse’.Amadizayini ezinhlamvu zemali, kanye nokwaziswa kwawo, azophrintwa kuSomqulu Kahulumeni, bese emva kwalokho azobe esekhiqizwa bese edayiswa kusetshenziswa imigudu ejwayelekile.

src: Imisitho ezayo.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.

src: Phakathi komhla we-18 nowama-22 kuTshazimpuzi uMongameli uZuma uza kuthatha utyelelo lwaseburhulumenteni kumazwe angamalungu oMbutho waseMazantsi e-Afrika waMazwe angaHlawulisani Rhafu yoRhwebo (i-SACU) noluza kuquka iNamibia, iBotswana, iLesotho neSwaziland.
tgt: UMongameli uZuma uzokube phakathi komhla ziyi-18 nama-22 Mbasa 2016 enohambo olusemthethweni lokuvakashela amazwe angamalungu eNhlangano yaMazwe Angakhokisani Intela yoHwebo aseNingizimu neAfrika (i-SACU) ahlanganisa i-Namibia, iBotswana, iLesotho kanye ne-Swaziland.

src: Olu tyelelo luza kuqinisa indima ebalulekileyo edlalwa yi-SACU ekukhuthazeni ukudityaniswa kommandla nophuhliso lwezoqoqosho lwamazwe angamalungu wayo.
tgt: Lokhu kuhambela kuzothuthukisa indima ebalulekile i-SACU eyidlalayo ekukhuthazeni ukuhlanganiswa kwezifunda kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwezomnotho wawo wonke amalungu ayo.

src: Ngomhla wama-23 nowama-24 kuTshazimpuzi wowama-2016 uMongameli uza kuthatha uTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni oluya kwi-Islamic Republic of Iran ukomeleza unxibelelwano lwezopolitiko nolwezoqoqosho phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.
tgt: UMongameli uzothatha uhambo Lokuhambela Kombuso ezweni lase-Islamic Republic of Iran ngomhla zingama-23 nama-24 kuMbasa 2016 ukuyoqinisa izingxoxo zezombusazwe kanye nezomnotho phakathi kwalamazwe amabili.

src: UMongameli uza kukhokela imibhiyozo yoSuku lweSizwe lweNkululeko ngomhla wama-27 kuTshazimpuzi wowama-2016 eLimpopo, kumaBala eMidlalo aseGiyani phantsi komxholo othi: “Sisonke sakha uluntu olungcono – ooRhulumente beeNgingqi yingxaki yomntu wonke”.IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika namacandelo ukuba babonakalise ukuba ngabathandi-besizwe ngokuthatha inxaxheba kwimisitho emininzi yokubhiyozela iNyanga yeNkululeko.
tgt: UMongameli uzohola imigubho yoSuku Lwenkululeko Lukazwelonke ngomhla zingama-27 Mbasa 2016 eLimpopo, eGiyani Stadium ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi: “Sisonke sakha imiphakathi engcono – Uhulumeni Wezindawo uwumsebenzi wawo wonke umuntu”.IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanye nayo yonke imikhakha ukuba bakhombise ugqozi lwabo ngezwe labo ngokubamba iqhaza emicimbini enhlobonhlobo yokugubha iNyanga Yenkululeko.

src: Kwezi veki zizayo, iPalamente izakuba iqhuba iiNgxoxo-mpikiswano zeVoti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lwamasebe karhulumente.
tgt: Kulawa masonto ezayo, iPhalamende lizobe libambe Amavoti Eezabelomali zeminyango.

src: Amalungu eKhabhinethi amasebe awohlukahlukeneyo aza kucacisa izicwangciso zawo zokusebenza zonyaka-mali wowama-2016/17.
tgt: Iziphathimandla zeminyango ehlukahlukene zizothulula izinhlelo zazo zokusebenza zonyaka wezimali wezi-2016/17.

src: Amalungu oluntu aza kwaziswa malunga neenkqubo zonikezelo-nkonzo zikarhulumente.
tgt: Amalungu omphakathi azokwaziswa ngezinhlelo zokuhanjiswa kwezidingongqangi zikahulumeni.

src: Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba esematheni.
tgt: Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni ezisematheni.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela impendulo elandelwe kukucelwa koxolo nguMongameli uZuma kwisiGwebo seNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko ngokumalunga nokuthotyelwa kwamanyathelo okulungisa acaciswe kwingxelo yoMkhuseli woLuntu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamukele impendulo kanye nokuxolisa okulandele lapho okwenziwe nguMongameli uZuma maqondana nesinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo mayelana nokuthobela izinyathelo zokulungisa isimo ezavezwa embikweni woMvikeli Womphakathi.

src: IKhabhinethi isasiphonononga esi sigwebo ukuze iqonde ukuba akhona na amanye amanyathelo ekufuneka athathwe ukuqinisa indima kaRhulumente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isafunda isinqumo ukuze ithole ukuthi ngabe zikhona yini ezinye izinyathelo ezingathathwa ukuqinisa indima kaHulumeni.

src: Isigwebo seNkundla yoMgaqo-siseko someleza sikwaqinisekisa ngolawulo lwentando yesininzi lwaseMzantsi Afrika olusekelwe kumgaqo-siseko.
tgt: Isinqumo seNkantolo yoMthethosisekelo siqinisa siphinde sivumele intando yeningi labantu eyatholakala ngokomthethosisekelo waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi iwaqaphele amanyathelo eebhanki ezine ezithe zakhupha izaziso zokuvala ii-akhawunti zenkampani.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isiqaphelile isenzo esenziwe ngamabhange amane afake isaziso sokuvala i-akhawunti yasebhange yenkampani ethile.

src: Ngeli xesha iKhabhinethi iyiqonda imiselo nemiqathango yeebhanki, la manyathelo asenokugxotha abo bebesenokuba ngabatyali-mali kwixesha elizayo abasenokufuna ukwenza ushishino eMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: Yize iKhabhinethi iyiqonda kahle imigomo nemibandela yamabhange, lesi senzo singaphazamisa abatshalizimali bakusasa abangafisa ukwenza ibhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi ivumelene ukuba uMphathiswa wezeMali, owezabaSebenzi noweMithombo yeziMbiwa ukuba baqale iingxoxo zokubonisana nokucweya kunye nezi bhanki ukufumana isisombululo esiyakuhlala simile ngalo mba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ivumelene ngokuthi uNgqongqoshe Wezezimali, Wezabasebenzi kanye Nowezimbiwa Phansi kumele bavulele ingxoxo eyakhayo kanye namabhange ukuze kutholakale isisombululo sesikhathi eside kulolu daba.

src: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana noMphathiswa wezeMpilo, uGq Aaron Motsoaledi, nothe wafumana imbasa yehlabathi i-USAID-TB ngenxa yendlela akhokele ngayo iphulo lehlabathi jikelele lokulwa isifo sephepha (i-TB) kwakunye nokuba nguvulindlela kumaphulo oMzantsi Afrika nawommandla ekuhlolweni, unyango nokuthintelwa kwe-TB usuleleko lwe-TB nayiNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV) kunye ne-TB enganyangekiyo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele uNgqongqoshe Wezempilo, uDkt Aaron Motsoaledi, othole indondo yomhlaba wonke evela kwi-USAID-TB yokumhlonipha ngobuholi bakhe empini yomhlaba wonke yokulwisana nesifo sofuba (i-TB) kanjalo nokuhola phambili izinhlelo zaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nezezifunda ekuhlolelweni, ukwelapha kanye nokuvimbela i-TB amagciwane okutheleleka nge-TB kanye Negciwane Lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV) ngesikhathi esisodwa kanye ne-TB engazweli amakhambi.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuphakanyiswa kwegama loMzantsi Afrika njengelizwe eliza kuwongwa ngeMbasa yeeNkonzo Zozakuzo ezikuDidi oluPhezulu liBhunga leMicimbi yeHlabathi eWashington DNjengelizwe lokuqala lase-Afrika ukufumana le mbasa, ingqina ukuzinikela okungathethekiyo kweli lizwe kwezemfundo yehlabathi jikelele, kwimicimbi yehlabathi nonxibelelwano nehlabathi ukuqhubela phambili iimfuno zethu zesizwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele ukuqokwa kweNingizimu Afrika njengezwe elizokwamukela Indondo yowezi-2016 Yemisebenzi Enhlobonhlobo Yosomaqhinga nguMkhandlu Wezindaba Zomhlaba e-Washington, DNjengezwe lokuqala lase-Afrika ukuthola le ndondo, ihlonipha ukuzinikela okuvelele kwezwe ekufundiseni umhlaba wonke, izindaba zamazwe omhlaba kanye nokuxhumana emhlabeni wonke ukuze liqhubele phambili izimfuno zezwe.

src: IKhabhinethi imothulela umnqwazi uMphathiswa woBudlelwane bamaZwe ngamaZwe neNtsebenziswano, uNksz Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, ngegalelo lakhe kunxibelelwano loMzantsi Afrika namazwe ngamazwe, noluqhutywa ngumbono “welizwekazi le-Afrika elimanyeneyo nelinoxolo, elilawulwa ngentando yesininzi, olungenabuhlanga, olungenacalucalulo ngokwesini nelihlumayo, nelithi lenze igalelo kwihlabathi elilungileyo nekulinganwayo kulo.”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income uNgqongqoshe Wezobudlelwano Bamazwe Nokubambisana, uNkz Maite Nkoana-Mashabane, ngegalelo lakhe ezingxoxweni zeNingizimu Afrika namazwe omhlaba, ezigqugquzelwa ngumbono “wezwekazi lase-Afrika elibumbene elinoxolo, elibuswa ngentando yeningi labantu, elingacwasi ngokobuhlanga, elingacwasi ngokobulili futhi eliqhakazile, futhi elinegalelo emhlabeni onobulungiswa nonokulingana.”.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukuchongwa kuka-Advocate Jan Lekhoa Mothibi, njengentloko yeCandelo loPhando oluKhethekileyo (i-SIU) nguMongameli uZuma, kwaye imnqwenela okuhle kodwa kulo msebenzi wakhe umtsha wokulwa urhwaphilizo nolawulo olugwenxa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukele ukuqokwa nguMongameli uZuma ko-Advocate u-Jan Lekhoa Mothibi, njengeNhloko yoPhiko Olukhethekile Lezophenyo, futhi imfisela okuhle nokumhlophe emisebenzini yakhe emisha yokuqeda inkohlakalo kanye nokuphatha budlabha.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kusapho lakwaMakwetu kunye nombutho i-Pan Africanist Congress ngokusweleka kukaMnu Clarence Makwetu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi enduduzo nokudabuka okukhulu emndenini wakwaMakwetu nakwi-Pan Africanist Congress ngokwedlula emhlabeni kukaMnu Clarence Makwetu.

src: UMnu Makwetu uza kukhunjulwa ngegalelo lakhe elikhulukazi nokuzenza idini kumzabalazo wenkululeko nokusekwa koMzantsi Afrika omtsha wolawulo lwentando yesininzi.
tgt: UMnu Makwetu uzokhunjulwa ngegalelo lakhe elikhulukazi kanye nasekuzinikeleni kwakhe uqobo embuthweni wokulwela inkululeko kanye nasekusungulweni kweNingizimu Afrika entsha ebuswa ngokwentando yeningi labantu.

src: UMongameli ubhengeze iinkonzo yoMngcwabo oseSikweni oKhethekileyo wePhondo kweli qhawe lomzabalazo wenkululeko.
tgt: UMongameli umemezele ukuthi kube Nongcwabo Okhethekile Wesifundazwe Osemthethweni wale ngqalabutho yomzabalazo wenkululeko.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kusapho lakwaNaidoo ngokusweleka kukaMnu Kumaran Naidoo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi enduduzo nokudabuka okukhulu emndenini wakwa-Naidoo ngokwedlula emhlabeni kukaMnu Kumaran Naidoo.

src: UMnu Naidoo ebenguMlawuli-Jikelele oliBambela weSebe loPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho.
tgt: UMnu Naidoo ubeyiBamba likaMqondisi-Jikelele woMnyango Wezokuthuthukiswa Kwezomnotho.

src: Ngaphambili ebesebenza njengeGosa lezeZimali eliyiNtloko leSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino.
tgt: Ukhe wasebenza ngaphambilini njengoMphathi Omkhulu Wezezimali woMnyango Wezohwebo Nezezimboni.

src: UMnu Naidoo ube negalelo elikhulukazi kulawulo lwezezimali kwiNkonzo kaRhulumente.
tgt: UMnu Naidoo ube negalelo elikhulukazi ekuphathweni kwezezimali emkhakheni weMisebenzi Kahulumeni.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ombulelo kwigalelo elenziwe nguMnu William Smith, obesenza kwiQonga looNobhala leKhabhinethi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izwakaliswe ukubonga kwayo maqondana negalelo elifakwe nguMnu William Smith, obesebenza njengeHhovisi likaNobhala weKhabhinethi.

src: UMnu Smith uthathe umhlala-phantsi ekupheleni kweyoKwindla emva kokuphangelela iNkonzo kaRhulumente iminyaka engama-27.
tgt: UMnu Smith uthathe umhlalaphansi ekupheleni kukaNdasa emva kokusebenzela umkhakha weMisebenzi Kahulumeni iminyaka engama-27.

src: IKhabhinethi imnqwenelela okuhle kodwa kumhlala-phantsi wakhe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imfisela okuhle kodwa kumhlalaphansi wakhe.

src: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe malunga neNgxelo yeKhomishini yoPhando malunga neziTyholo zobuQhetseba, uRhwaphilizo, iMposiso okanye iziPhene kwiSivumelwano seNtengo yeziXhobo zoMkhosi zobuChule (iKhomishini yeNtengo yeziXhobo) ethe yakhutshwa nguMongameli kusasa nje.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilunywe indlebe mayelana noMbiko weKhomishana Yophenyo Maqondana Nezinsolo Zokukhwabanisa, Inkohlakalo, Ukungahloniphi noma Ukungahambisi Ngomthetho Ekuthengweni Kobuqhinga Kwempahla Yokuzivikela (iKhomishana Yokuthengwa Kwezikhali) okhishwe nguMongameli ekuseni namuhla.

src: Le Ngxelo ayifumanisanga bungqina bubonakalisa bugwenxa, kunyoba, buqhetseba okanye rhwaphilizo kwinkqubo yokuthengwa kwezixhobo.
tgt: Umbiko uthole ukuthi abukho ubufakazi bokwenza okungalungile, ukugwazela, ukukhwabanisa noma inkohlakalo enqubweni yokuthwengwa kwezikhali.

src: NjengoRhulumente siyazamkela iziphumo zeKhomishini.
tgt: NjengoHulumeni siyayemukela imiphumela yeKhomishana.

src: Liye lahlanjwa igama lethu njengokuba besisoloko sisitsho kwiminyaka emininzi edlulileyo ukuba akukho bugwenxa kwaye le nkqubo yokuthengwa ibimsulwa ingenamakhwiniba.
tgt: Sikhishwe phambili satholakala singenacala njengoba besilokhu sisho eminyakeni eminingi edlule ukuthi kwakungekho ukuphambana nomthetho okwenziwa nanokuthi ukuthengwa kwezikhali kwenziwa ngendlela efanelekile nesemthethweni.

src: Siyathemba ukuba ezi ziphumo ziza kuwuvala lo mba ubukade urhuqwa ixesha elide.
tgt: Siyethemba ukuthi imiphumela izoletha isiphetho kulolu daba oselube yinsakavukela umchilo wesidwaba isikhathi eside.

src: Nathi njengoMongameli uZuma sibulela uJaji Willie Seriti noJaji Thekiso Musi, onke amangqina, kuquka nowayesakuba nguMongameli uThabo Mbeki, abetshutshisi ababegoca-goca amangqina ngemibuzo, amagqwetha, abasebenzi nabo bathe benza igalelo ekwenzeni ukuba umsebenzi wale Khomishini ube yimpumelelo.
tgt: Sihlanganyela noMongameli uZuma ekubongeni iJaji u-Willie Seriti kanye neJaji uThekiso Musi, bonke ofakazi, kubandakanya noMongameli waphambilini uThabo Mbeki, abaholi bobufakazi, amathimba ezomthetho, abasebenzi kanye nalabo ababe negalelo ekwenzeni umsebenzi weKhomishana ube yimpumelelo.

src: IzikhundlaZonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.
tgt: AbaqashiweUkuqashwa kwabo bonke abalandelayo kuzokwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela uma sekuqinisekiswe ubufakazi beziqu zabo zemfundo futhi uma sebenikeziwe izimvume ezifanelekile.

src: UMnu Siyabonga Gama njengosa leGosa eliPhezulu lesiGqeba soLawulo noMnu Gary Pita njengeGosa lezeZimali eliyiNtloko lwakwa-Transnet.
tgt: Ukuqashwa kukaMnu Siyabonga Gama njengeSikhulu Esiphezulu Sezigungu Seziphathimandla kanye noMnu Garry Pita njengoMphathi Omkhulu Wezimali Zeqembu lakwa-Transnet.

src: UMnu Lufuno Leslie Nevhutalu njengelungu noSihlalo weBhodi yoPhuhliso lwaMashishini oKwakha.
tgt: Ukuqashwa kukaMnu Lufuno Leslie Nevhutalu njengelungu noSihlalo weBhodi Lokuthuthukiswa Kwemboni Yezokwakha.

src: UMnu Andile Nongogo njengeGosa eliyiNtloko yesiGqeba kaGunyaziwe weeNkonzo zeCandelo lezeMfundo noQeqesho.
tgt: Ukuqashwa kukaMnu Andile Nongogo njengoMphathi Oyisikhulu Esiphezulu Somkhakha Wamagunya Ezinsizakalo Zokufundisa Nokuqeqesha.

src: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza Kwezinhlelo Zikahulumeni Ezisemqoka.

src: IKhabhinethi iyalwamkela utyelelo lukaMongameli uJacob Zuma lwasebuRhulumenteni e-Islamic Republic of Iran, nolwandisa ubudlelwane bezoqoqosho norhwebo phakathi kwala mazwe omabini, ngokutyikitywa kwezivumelwano nezibhambathiso eziliqela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalwamukela uhambo lukaMongameli u-Jacob Zuma lokuHambela Kombuso ezweni lase-Islamic Republic of Iran, oludlondlobalisa ubudlelwano bezomnotho kanye nezokuhwebelana phakathi kwawo womabili lawa mazwe, ngokucikicwa kwezivumelwano ezihlukahlukene kanye nezibophezelo.

src: UMongameli uJacob Zuma noMongameli uHasan Rouhani bayiqinisile intsebenziswano kumacandelo ezorhwebo, ezemfundo nophuhliso lwezakhono inzululwazi nobuchwepheshe ezamandla kuquka nokuhlolwa kwe-oli kunye namandla okucolwa kwayo ezolimo imigodi nezokuxhamlisa kwezemigodi uphuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo kunye nezothutho ezezimali, ezebhanki neze-inshorensi nokhenketho.
tgt: UMongameli u-Jacob Zuma kanye noMongameli u-Hasan Rouhani bakuqinisile ukusebenza ngokubambisana emikhakheni yezokuhwebelana, ezemfundo kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono ezesayensi kanye nobuchwepheshe ezamandla, kubandakanya nokuhlolwa kwegesi yamakhemikhali kaphethiloli ongakahluzwa kanye namandla okukwazi ukuhluza ezolimo ezezimayini kanye nokuhlomula kwezezimbiwa phansi ezokuthuthukiswa kwengqalasizinda kanye nezokuthutha ezezimali, ezokubhanga kanye nezemishwalense kanye nezokuvakasha.

src: Xa zizonke zenza igalelo ekuphunyezweni kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP).Kwimiba yezehlabathi, ezi nkokheli zimbini zivumelene ukuba makuqiniswe isimemo sokuhlaziywa nokuziza iinguqu kuMbutho weZizwe eziManyeneyo (i-UN) ingakumbi iBhunga loKhuselo le-UN, ukuze lincede nezizwe ezinoqoqosho elisakhulayo.
tgt: Konke lokhu kunegalelo ekuqalisweni kokusebenza koHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP).Ngasohlangothini lwamazwe omhlaba, abaholi ababili bavumile ukuqinisa ikhwela elihlatshwayo lokuguqulwa kweNhlangano Yezizwe Ezihlangene (i-UN) ikakhulukazi Umkhandlu Wezokuvikeleka weNhlangano Yezizwe Ezihlangene, ngokubhekelela izimfuno zamazwe asathuthuka.

src: Ezi ziphumo zomeleza uTyelelo lukaMongameli oluyiNxalenye yomsebenzi kwi-United Arab Emirates (i-AEU) apho omabini la mazwe ahlaziye khona isivumelwano sawo ekudibaniseni nasekuphakamiseni ubudlelwane benkululeko, ingakumbi kwezorhwebo, kwimiba yotyalo-mali neyezoqoqosho kubudlelwane bobuchule obudibeneyo.
tgt: Le miphumela iqinise kabusha Uhambo Lokusebenza lukaMongameli oluya ezweni lase-United Arab Emirates (i-UAE) lapho yomibili le mibuso ivuselele isibophezelo sayo maqondana nokuhlanganiswa kanye nokukhushulwa kobudlelwano obumbaxambili, ikakhulukazi emikhakheni yezokuhwebelana, ezokutshalwa kwezimali kanye neyezomnotho ukuba bube ukubambisana okubanzi okunobuqhinga.

src: Oku kwakhela phezu koTyelelo lukaMongameli uJacob Zuma lwasebuRhulumenteni lwenyanga yeNkanga yowama-2011 nolwakhokelela ekusekweni kweKhomishini eDibeneyo yoMzantsi Afrika ne-Unite Arab Emirates olwathi lwakhawulezisa isantya esipheleleyo sorhwebo phakathi kwala mazwe mabini ukususela kwiibhiliyoni zeerandi ezili-13 ngowama-2011 ukuya kwiibhiliyoni zeerandin ezingama-27 ngowama-2015.UMzantsi Afrika ne-United Arab Emirates ukwavumelene ngokwandisa intsebenziswano yokusebenzisa ithuba elivela kuQoqosho laseLwandle, ukuthumela kumazwe angaphandle, iimveliso zezolimo zaseMzantsi Afrika, iimveliso ezenziweyo kwaye ngokukodwa ukuthengwa kwezixhobo zokhuselo nobudlelwane.
tgt: Lokhu kwakhelwe ohambweni lukaMongameli uJacob Zuma Lokuhambela Kombuso ngoLwezi wezi-2011 olwabonakalisa ukusungulwa kweKhomishana Ehlanganyelwe ye-SA-UAE eyadlondlobalisa umgqigqo ophelele wezokuhwebelana phakathi kwamazwe omabili kusukela ezigidini eziyi-13 zamarandi ngowezi-2011 kuya ezigidini ezingama-27 zamarandi ngowezi-2015.INingizimu Afrika kanye ne-UAE baphinde bavumelana ukuthi bazokwandisa ukusebenza ngokubambisana ukuze basebenzise amathub ngendlela efunwa yibona Kwezomnotho Wasolwandle, ukukhulisa ukuhanjiswa emazweni angaphandle kwemikhiqizo yezolimo yaseNingizimu Afrika, imikhiqizo ekhiqiziwe ikakhulukazi ukuthengwa kwezinto zezokuzivikela kanye namaxhama okubambisana.

src: Olu tyelelo lukwakhuthaza ukuxhotyiswa kolwakhiwo lweziseko ezingundoqo olugxile ekunikeni iinkampani zaseMzantsi Afrika amathuba kwi-EXPO 2020 eDubai, kwakunye nentsebenziswano kwicandelo lezoxolo, ukhuseleko nozinzo.
tgt: Lolu hambo luphinde lwakhulisa amandla iNingizimu Afrika enawo ukwakha ingqalasizinda esophe amathuba azotholwa yizinkampani zaseNingizimu Afrika embukisweni i-EXPO 2020 ozobe ubanjelwe eDubai, kanjalo nokusebenza ngokubambisana emkhakheni wezoxolo, ukuvikeleka kanye nozinzo.

src: IKhabhinethi iwamkele amanyathelo angqongqo athe amiselwa nguMphathiswa wezeMidlalo noLonwabo uFikile Mbalula ngokusebenzisa uXwebhu lweNguqu ukwakha ngokutsha imbonakalo yezemidlalo nolonwabo eqhekekileyo nenocalucalulo olunzulu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi izamukelile izinyathelo eziqinile ezibekwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezemidlalo Nokungcebeleka uFikile Mbalula ukubumba kabusha ukubukeka kwesimo sezemidlalo nokungcebeleka esiqhekekile nesibandlululayo ngendlela ejulile esebenzisa uMqulu waso Woguquko.

src: Oku kuza kukhawulezisa inguqu ebhekisele kwinkqubo yezemidlalo emanyeneyo exhaswa yimigomo yolawulo lwentando yesininzi, umakulingwane, ukwenza elubala, ukuqinisekisa ukuba wonke ubani uthatha inxaxheba, ukufikelela nokwanda kokuthathwa kwenxaxheba ngokweenjongo ze-NDIKhabhinethi iyazamkela iingxoxo-mpikiswano zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali ezenziwa ngamasebe ngamasebe nengxelo ezingena nzulu ekucaciseni inkqubela eseyenziwe ukuphucula ubomi babemi baseMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: Lokhu kuzodlondlobalisa uguquko maqondana nohlelo lwezemidlalo olubumbene olusekelwe ngaphansi kwemigomo yentando yeningi labantu, ukulingana, ukusebenzela obala, ukumeleleka kwabantu ngokwehlukahlukana kwabo, ukufinyeleleka kanye nokubamba iqhaza okukhuphukile ngokuhambelana nezinjongo zoHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe.

src: Oku kubonakalisa ukufezekiswa kweNkqubo-sikhokelo yesiCwangciso-qhinga sesiGaba esiPhakathi nesisisondeza ekufezekisweni koMbono wama-2030 wesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyazamukela izinkulumo zamavoti esabiwomali ezethulwa yiminyango eyehlukene ezihambisana nemibiko ebanzi eqhakambisa inqubekelaphambili esiyenziwe maqondana nokwenziwa ngcono kwezimpilo zabantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi imema bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba bamamele futhi bazibukele ezi ngxoxo-mpikiswano zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali kuwo onke amajelo eendaba ukuze bayiqonde ngcono iNkqubo yokuSebenza kaRhulumente.
tgt: Lokhu kubonisa ukuqaliswa ukusebenza koHlaka Lokusebenza Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi olusisondeza eduzane nokufezekiswa koMbono wezi-2030 woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe.

src: IKhabhinethi icela ukuzibophelela okuqhubekayo ukwenza inguqu enentsingiselo emisebenzini ngenxa yeziphumo ezivela kwiNgxelo yoNyaka yeKhomishini ye-16 kaMakulingwane eMisebenzini kubo bonke abaqeshi abachongiweyo neyathi yamiselwa phantsi komxholo othi “Iinguqu zibalulekile”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba balandelele izinkulumo zokwabiwa kwezimali ezinkundleni zabenzindaba ezinhlobonhlobo ukuze baqonde kangcono ngoHlelo Lokusebenza lukaHulumeni.

src: Le Ngxelo iyamnceda urhulumente ukuba abuqonde ubume bomakulingwane emisebenzini kweli lizwe nenkqubela yakhe ekwenziweni kwenguqu emisebenzini kunyaka wama-2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa ukuba kube khona ukuzibophezela okuqhubekayo ukuze kuvikelwe uguquko olunengqondo lwendawo yokusebenzela ngokubhekelela imiphumela evela Embikweni Wonyaka weKhomishana ye-16 Yokuqashwa Kwabantu Ngokulingana wabo bonke abaqashi abaqokiwe owethulwa ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi “Uguquko lubalulekile”.

src: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana neSebe lezokuHlaliswa koLuntu ngokunikezela ngezigidi eziyi-4,3 zezindlu namathuba ezezindlu ukususela mhla kwafika ulawulo lwentando yesininzi.
tgt: Umbiko usiza uhulumeni ukuba aqonde isimo sokuqashwa kwabantu ngokulingana ezweni kanye nenqubekelaphambili yaso ekuguqulweni kwendawo yokusebenzela onyakeni wezi-2015.

src: La mathuba aquka izindlu zenkxaso epheleleyo ezingama-2, 806 235 (izindlu ze-BNG), izindlu zezentlalo/zokurenta ezingama-121 784, izindlu zeNkqubo yeNkxaso-mali yoMntu ngaMnye ezingama-121 784 kunye neziza ezifumana iinkonzo ezingundoqo ezingama-986 608.Le mpumelelo iyimbali ibonelele ngezindlu abantu abangaphezulu kwezigidi ezingama-20 kwaye ukubhiyozela le mpumelelo isebe limisele iphulo lesizwe lokubonakalisa le mpumelelo yesizwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele uMnyango Wezokuhlaliswa Kwabantu ngokwakhiwa kwezindlu eziyizigidi eziwu-4, 3 kanye namathuba okwakhiwa kwenzindlu kusukela kwafika umbuso wentando yeningi labantu.

src: Oku kumiselwa kwesizwe kwenzeke e-COSMO City, neyenye yeeprojekthi eziphambili ezidibeneyo kwilizwe jikelele nekwabhiyozela iminyaka elishumi yabakho.
tgt: Lawa mathuba abandakanya izindlu ezixhaswe ngokuphelele eziyizi-2, 806 235 (izindlu ze-BNG), izindlu zomphakathi/eziqashisayo eziyizi-121 784, izi-6329 zoHlelo Lokuxhaswa Komuntu Ngamunye Oluxhunywe Kwezezimali kanye neziza zokwakha ezinezinsizakalo eziyizi-986 608.Leli banga eliyingqophamlando eselihanjiwe selihlinzeke umpheme kubantu abangaphezu kwezigidi ezingama-20 kanti-ke ukubhiyozela le mpumelelo umnyango sewethule umkhankaso kazwelonke wokudweba isithombe sempumelelo yezwe lakithi.

src: IKhabhinethi ibulela bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ngegalelo labo, lokuzinikela nokusebenza kwabo ngamandla ekuqinisekiseni ukuba isidima sabemi baseMzantsi Afrika abahlelelekileyo siyabuyiselwa ngezokuhlaliswa koluntu.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kukazwelonke kubanjelwe e-COSMO City, okungomunye wemiklamo yezindlu edidiyelwe eseqhulwini ezweni lonkana nawo ogubha iminyaka eyishumi ukhona.

src: IKhabhinethi iyamncoma uNobhala Jikelele weZizwe eziManyeneyo ngokuqhuba uMsitho wokuTyikitya okwiNqanaba eliPhezulu wesiVumelwano saseParis, nesithe samkelwa ngaMazwe angamaLungu ali-176 kweyoMnga yowama-2015.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ibonge bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ngegalelo labo, ukuzimisela kanye nokusebenza kanzima ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi isithunzi sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abaswele siyabuyiselwa ngezinhlelo zokuhlaliswa kwabantu.

src: Ukutyikitywa kwesiVumelwano saseParis kuphawula inyathelo lokuqala ekuphunyezweni kwaso nokuzakukhokela amalinge ehlabathi ekunciphiseni ukukhutshwa kweegesi ezingcolisa umoya nokukwazi ukulwa imingeni ehambelana nako ebangelwa kukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi income uNobhala-Jikelele weNhlangano Yezizwe Ezihlangane ngokuhlanganisa Umcimbi Osezingeni Eliphezulu Wokucikicwa Kwesivumelwano sase-Paris, esamukelwa ngamazwe ayi-176 ngoZibandlela wezi-2015.

src: IKhabhinethi ikulinde ngomdla ukuqukunjelwa kweenkqubo zokugunyaziswa zalapha ekhaya, ngawo onke, ukuvumela ukungena kwangexesha ukwenzela ukufezekiswa ngokupheleleyo kwesiVumelwano saseParis ngowama-2020.
tgt: Ukucikicwa Kwesivumelwano sase-Paris kuwuphawu lwesinyathelo sokuqala ekuqalisweni kokusebenza kwaso okuzohola imizamo yamazwe omhlaba ukunciphisa ukukhiqizwa kwezintuthu ezingcolisa umoya kanye nokuhlangabezana nazo zonke izinselele eziphonswe ukuguquguquka kwesimo sezulu.

src: IKhabhinethi ikwaqaphela ukuba iSebe lezeNdalo lizibandakanye neSebe lezoKhenketho ekuqaliseni iilebhu zokubonelela ezinesihloko esithi “iLebhu yeNzululwazi ngeZilwanyana neziTyalo: Ikhulisa igalelo loqoqosho lwemithombo yobunzululwazi ngezilwanyana nezityalo yaseMzantsi Afrika” ukususela ngomhla we-10 kuTshazimpuzi ukuya kowe-13 kwekaCanzibe yowama-2016.Injongo kukuphumeza amandla oqoqosho lobutyebi bezenzululwazi ngezilwanyana nezityalo zaseMzantsi Afrika achazwe kuyilo lwesiCwangciso-qhinga soQoqosho lweNzululwazi ngeziLwanyana neziTyalo seSizwe esiphunyezwe yiKhabhinethi kweyeKhala yowama-2015 ukwenzela ukuthatha inxaxheba koluntu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isilangazelele isiphetho sezinqubo zezigunyazo zalapha ezweni ngaphakathi ezihlukahlukene, yibo bonke abantu, ukuvumela ukuqaliswa ngesikhathi kokusebenza ngokuphelele Kwesivumelwano sase-Paris ngowezi-2020.

src: IKhabhinethi isamkele isiCwangciso soMgaqo-nkqubo wokuSebenza kwezoShishino (i-IPAP) sowama-2016/17 – 2018/19, nesiyintsika engundoqo yesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba sikaMongameli kwaye senza igalelo ekuphunyezweni kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphinde yaqaphela ukuthi uMnyango Wezemvelo usubambisene noMnyango Wezokuvakasha ekuhlanganiseni amalebhu okuhanjiswa kwezinsizakalo abizwa ngokuthi yi-“Biodiversity Lab: Ukukhulisa igalelo lezomnotho lemithombo yezemvelo yaseNingizimu Afrika” kusukela mhla ziyi-10 kuMbasa kuya mhla ziyi-13 kuNhlaba 2016.Inhloso ukufezekisa amandla ezomnotho emvelo enothile yaseNingizimu Afrika eyingxubevange aveziwe ohlakeni lokuqala lweQhinga Likazwelonke Lezomnotho Yezemvelo Eyingxubevange olwagunyazwa yiKhabhinethi ngoNtulikazi wezi-2015 ukuze umphakathi ukwazi ukubamba iqhaza kulona.

src: Oku kukuphindaphindwa kwaminyaka le kwesibhozo kwesicwangciso sikarhulumente semizi-mveliso esiyimpumelelo nesakhelwa kwiimpumelelo, amaqonga emigaqo-nkqubo neenkqubo zokuphindaphindwa kwangaphambili.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze Uhlelo Lokusebenza Lwenqubomgomo Yezimboni (i-IPAP) lowezi-2016/17 – 2018/19, oluyinsika eqavile yoHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye lukaMongameli futhi olunegalelo maqondana nokuqaliswa kokusebenza koHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe.

src: I-IPAP yowama-2016/17 iinjongo zayo kukwenza impembelelo enkulu kumgaqo-nkqubo wezoshishino phantsi kweemeko ezinzima zezoqoqosho.
tgt: Lesi yisibuyekezo sonyaka wesishiyagalombili sezinhlelo eziyimpumelelo zezimboni zikahulumeni esakhela ezinzuzweni, izithangami zezinqubomgomo kanye nezinhlelo zezibuyekezo ezidlulile.

src: Ekukho phakathi kwazo impembelelo eqhubekayo yokudodobala kwezoqoqosho kwihlabathi jikelele kuquka iimeko emaxongo kurhwebo lwezesinyithi kunye nezimbiwa kwakunye nembalela enkulu neminye imiqobo ebalulekileyo yalapha ekhaya.
tgt: I-IPAP yowezi-2016/17 ifuna ukuzuza inqubomgomo yezezimboni enomthelela ophezulu ezimweni ezinzima zezomnotho.

src: Imisebenzi eyimpumelelo yonyaka ophelileyo iquka ukusindiswa kwemisebenzi emalunga nama-67 000 nokudalwa kwemisebenzi emitsha endilisekileyo ethelekelelwa kuma-7 000 kwicandelo leMpahla nelezeziKhumba neZihlangu.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya imithelela eqhubekayo yokuwohloka kwamandla omnotho emhlabeni wonke kubandakanya nesimo esimazonzo embonini yezensimbi nezimbiwaphansi kanjalo nesomiso esibi kakhulu kanye nezinye izingqinamba ezinkulu ezikhona ezweni lakithi ngaphakathi.

src: Icandelwana elisebenza phantsi kokucolwa nokulungiswa kweemveliso zezolimo lelinye lamacandelo okuvelisa amakhulu apha ekhaya ngokwengqesho, abonelela ngemisebenzi ethelekelelwa kuma-216 090 ngowama-2015 xa kuthelekiswa nama-208 822 ngowama-2014.
tgt: Izimpumelelo zangonyaka odlule zibandakanya ukuphephiswa kwemisebenzi ebalelwa ezi-67 000 kanye nokusungulwa kwemisebenzi eqotho emisha sha eyizi-7 000 emkhakheni Wezendwangu, Izimpahla Zesikhumba kanye Nezicathulo.

src: Lutyalo-mali olungaphezulu kwezigidi ezingama-600 zeerandi athe atsalwe ngowama-2015/16, elusisiseko sokomeleza uphuhliso lwamashishini amancinci olugxile kuluntu lwasemaphandleni.
tgt: Umkhakhana ongaphansi kwezokukhiqizwa kwemikhiqizo yezolimo ungomunye wemikhakha emikhulukazi lapha ezweni yezokukhiqiza ngokuqasha abantu, ngokuhlinzeka ngemisebenzi elinganiselwa ezi-216 090 ngowezi-2015 uma kuqhathaniswa nezi-208 822 ngowezi-2014.

src: Khabhinethi iyamkele iNkqubo-sikhokelo yokuGqibela yoPhuhliso lweeDolophu oluDibeneyo nesiCwangciso sokuPhumeza sowama-2016/19.
tgt: Izigidi ezingaphezu kwama-600 zamarandi zotshalomali ezihehekile ngowezi-2015/16, ezindlale isisekelo sokuqinisa ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi ngokugxila kakhulu emiphakathini yasezindaweni ezisemakhaya.

src: Iziphumo ezipheleleyo zeNkqubo –sikhokelo yoPhuhliso lweDolophu oludibeneyo yinguqu ngokwabala omhlaba.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze Uhlaka Lokusebenza Lokugcina Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Ezisemadolobheni Ezididiyelwe kanye Nohlelo Lokuqaliswa Ukusebenza lowezi-2016/19.

src: Oku kuza notshintsho olutsha kwizixeko needolophu zaseMzantsi Afrika, nokuza kuqhubela uhlumo lwasezidolophini kwindlela eluqilima yohlumo oluzinzileyo, iqhagamshelanise ize iququzelele izixeko needolophu, neziyindawo ekhuselekileyo, ezinemithombo esebenzayo futhi neziyindawo elungileyo ukuba umntu angasebenza ahlale kuzo.
tgt: Umphumela ophelele woHlaka Lokusebenza Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Ezisemadolobheni Ezididiyelwe ukuguqulwa kokuklaywa kwemingcele yedolobha.

src: Oku kusabela kumyalelo wesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso wokuqulunqa umgaqo-nkqubo wophuhliso lwedolophu oza kuqinisekisa ngokucwangcisa okufanelekileyo, utyalo-mali kwiziseko ezingundoqo nolawulo lokuxhasa uhlumo nokuvulela amandla ezoqoqosho lwezixeko needolophu.
tgt: Lokhu kuwuphawu lesivumelwano esisha samadolobha kanye namadolobhana amancane aseNingizimu Afrika, esizoqhubezela phambili ukukhula kwezindawo ezisemadolobheni siziqhubekisele ohlakeni lokukhula okuqinile kwamadolobha namadolobhana amancane ahlangene, axhumene futhi adidiyelwe, aphephile, anezinsiza ezanele futhi ayizindawo ezinhle zokusebenza kanye nokuhlala kuzo.

src: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukupapashwa kweDrafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe weeNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwamaKhondo – uKwakhela uMzantsi Afrika iNkqubo esebenzayo neDibeneyo yeeNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwamaKhondo, kwiPhephandaba loMbuso ukwenzela ukuba uluntu luhlomle.
tgt: Lokhu kuphendula emyalelweni woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe wokuthi kusungulwe inqubomgomo yokuthuthukiswa kwezindawo ezisemadolobheni ezoqinisekisa ukuhlela okufanelekile, utshalomali lwezingqalasizinda kanye nokuphathwa kwalo ukuze kwesekwe ukukhula kanye nokuthukulula amandla ezomnotho amadolobha kanye namadolobhana amancane ethu.

src: Le drafti yoMgaqo-nkqubo xa sele iphunyeziwe iza kubonelela ngendlela edibeneyo yeenkonzo zophuhliso lwamakhondo asemgangathweni kubo bonke abemi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukushicilelwa koHlaka lweNqubomgomo Yezinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi Kazwelonke – Ukwakha Uhlelo Lwezinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi Oluyimpumelelo Noludidiyelwe lwaseNingizimu Afrika, eMqulwini Kahulumeni ukuze kutholwe imibono yomphakathi.

src: Oku kuza kubenza bakwazi ukuthatha izigqibo zokukhetha amakhondo afanelekileyo ukuze bakwazi ukufumana imisebenzi, benze igalelo kuluntu nasekwakheni uqoqosho lwaseMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: Uhlaka lweNqubomgomo uma seluqalisiwe ukusebenza luzohlinzeka ngendlela yokusebenza ehlanganisiwe yezinsizakalo zokuthuthukiswa kwemikhakha yemisebenzi eziseqophelweni eliphezulu zazo zonke izakhamuzi.

src: IiNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwamaKhondo zidlala indima engundoqo ekuncedeni umsebenzi wokubonelela ngemisebenzi nenkqubo yezemfundo ukuba zifikelele kwiinjongo zazo ezijongise kuzo.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokwenza izakhamuzi zikwazi ukukhetha imikhakha yemisebenzi ngomqondo ophusile ukuze zikwazi ukuqashwa, zibe negalelo emphakathini futhi zakhe umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Oku kwenza igalelo ekuphumezeni izindululo zesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso sokukhuthaza uhlumo lwezoqoqosho nemisebenzi, ukuthelekisa abasebenzi abaphangelayo nemisebenzi nokwandiswa kophuhliso lwezakhono kunye noninzi lwabo banezidanga zasedyunivesiti.
tgt: Izinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi zidlala indima esemqoka ekusizeni umsebenzi wezimakethe zabasebenzi kanye nezinhlelo zezemfundo zikwazi ukuhlangabezana nezinjongo zazo.

src: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngokuphunyezwa kweNkqubo yoVavanyo yeSizwe yaza yamkela iNgxelo yonyaka wama-2014/15 kunye nesiCwangciso soVavanyo seSizwe sesihlanu seminyaka yowama-2016/17 ukuya kowama-2018/19, njengenxalenye yendlela yokuphucula unikezela lweenkonzo.
tgt: Lokhu kunegalelo maqondana nokufezekiswa kwezincomo zoHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe zokugqugquzela ukukhula komnotho kanye nokuqashwa kwabantu, ukuqondaniswa kwabasebenzi abaqashiwe nemisebenzi yabo kanye nokwandisa ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kanye nesibalo sabantu abaneziqu zemfundo yasenyuvesi.
