src: INkqubo yoVavanyo yeSizwe ivela kwiNkqubo-sikhokelo yoMgaqo-nkqubo woVavanyo weSizwe oqinisekisa ukuba ubungqina bovavanyo obuthembakeleyo nobungakhethe-cala buyafakwa kwiinkqubo zokucwangcisa, ukwenza uhlahlo lwabiwo-mali, ukuphuculwa kweziko, uhlaziyo lomgaqo-nkqubo, kwakunye nolawulo lwenkqubo oluqhubekayo nolawulo lweprojekthi ukuze kuphuculwe indlela ekusetyenzwa ngayo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi lithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nokuqaliswa kokusebenza Kohlelo Lokulinganisa Lukazwelonke futhi lagunyaza umbiko Wonyaka wezi-2014/15 kanye Nohlelo Lokulinganisa Lukazwelonke lesihlanu lowezi-2016/17 kuya kowezi-2018/19, njengengxenye yombhidlango wokwenza ukuhanjiswa kwezidingo-ngqangi.

src: Luvavanyo olungama-47 eselugqityiwe okanye olusaqhutywayo, lubandakanya imali ezibhiliyoni ezingama-75 zeerandi enkcitho karhulumente.
tgt: Uhlelo Lokulinganisa Lukazwelonke lususelwa oHlakeni Lokusebenza leNqubomgomo Yokulinganisa Kazwelonke oluqinisekisa ukuthi ubufakazi obuqotho nobunenjongo obuvela ekulinganisweni buyafakwa ezinhlelweni zokuhlela, ukwabiwa kwezimali, ukwenziwa ngcono kwezinhlangano, ukubuyekezwa kwezinqubomgomo, kanjalo nasezinhlelweni eziqhubekayo kanye nokuphathwa kwemiklamo ukuze kwenziwe ngcono ukusebenza.

src: Zingxelo zovavanyo ezili-15 esezamkelwe ize ibe zezi-12 ezithiwe theca phambi kweKhabhinethi ukuza kutsho ngoku.
tgt: Izilinganiso ezingama-47 seziphothuliwe noma zisaqhutshwa, ezikhava izigidigidi ezingama-75 zamarandi ezindleko zikahulumeni.

src: Izicwangciso zokuphucula ezili-14 ziyaphunyezwa kwaye inkqubela kuzo ibonakalisa iinguqu ezinkulu, ukuvula umsantsa wempembelelo.
tgt: Imibiko yokulinganisa eyi-15 yagunyazwa kwathi eyi-12 yabekwa ezithebeni zeKhabhinethi kuze kube manje.

src: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo zovavanyo nezindululo ezamkelweyo ngenjongo yokwandisa impembelelo yokuphunyezwa kweCandelo lezeNtlalo leNkqubo yeMisebenzi yoLuntu eNatyisiweyo (i-EPWP-SS).
tgt: Izinhlelo zokwenza ngcono eziyi-14 ziyaqaliswa ukusebenza kanti futhi inqubekelaphambili maqondana nazo ikhombisa izinguquko ezinkulu kakhulu, ukukhulisa umthelela wazo.

src: Le Nkqubo idlala indima ebalulekileyo kukhuseleko lwezentlalo lwabantu abadala abakwaziyo ukusebenza abangaphangeliyo, ngokubatsalela kumsebenzi onenkqubela baze bafumene ukuvuzwa kwenyanga okungumyinge we-R 1 517.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nemiphumela yokulinganisa kanye nezincomo ezigunyaziwe ngenhloso yokwandisa umthelela osukela ekuqalisweni ukusebenza Kohlelo Lemisebenzi Yomphakathi Eyandisiwe Yomkhakha Wezenhlalo (i-EPWP-SS).Lolu Hlelo ludlala indima esemqoka yokuvikelwa kwesimo senhlalo yabantu abantu abangakhubazeke ndawo abangasebenzi, kokubadonsela emsebenzini onomkhiqizo bese bethola umthobanhlizinyo njalo ngenyanga olinganiselwa esambeni se-R1 517.

src: Uninzi lweenkqubo zecandelo lezentlalo zibonelela ngeenkonzo ezikhethekileyo kuluntu oluhlelelekileyo noluhluphekayo.
tgt: Iningi lezinhlelo zomkhakha wezenhlalo lihlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezikhethekile emiphakathini entekenteke nehluphekayo.

src: I-EPWP-SS ikhule ngokuphindaphindeneyo phakathi kwesigaba sokuqala nesigaba sesibini, ukususela kwiinkqubo ezintlanu ukuya kwezi ngama-22 nezikhokelele ekubeni eli candelo lifikelele kumathuba emisebenzi engama-175 769 kwisigaba sokuqala namathuba emisebenzi engama-866 246 kwisigaba sesibini, ngaphezulu kakhulu kuma-750 000 ebesizimisele kuwo.
tgt: I-EPWP-SS ikhule ngesivinini esikhulu phakathi kwesigaba sokuqala nesigaba sesibili, kusukela ezinhlelweni ezi-5 kuya ezinhlelweni ezingama-22 okuholele kulo mkhakha ukuba ufezekise amathuba emisebenzi ayizi-175 769 esigabeni sokuqala kanye namathuba emisebenzi ayizi-866 246 esigabeni sesibili, nokungaphezulu kakhulu kobekusophiwe okungamathuba emisebenzi ayizi-750 000.Izincomo zigxile ekwenzeni ngcono ukuqaliswa kokusebenza ukuze kuncishiswe ukungasebenzi ngendlela egculisayo ekuthathweni kwezinqumo, ukuqaliswa ukusebenza (izinkokhelo zemithobanhliziyo) kanye nokuhlinzekwa ngokuqeqesha, kanjalo nokuxhumanisa.

src: Ezi zindululo zigxile ekuphuculeni ukuphunyezwa ukuze kunciphe ukungathathwa kakuhle kwezigqibo, ukuphunyezwa (iintlawulo nokuvuzwa) nokubonelelwa koqeqesho, kwakunye nokuququzelela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nemiphumela kanye nezincomo ezigunyaziwe zedizayini kanye nokuqaliswa ukusebenza kokulinganiswa Kwesabelo Sokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zokuhlala Ezisemadolobheni kanye Nohlelo Lokwenziwa Ngcono kwaso.

src: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo yaza yazivuma izindululo zokuyilwa nokuphunyezwa kovavanyo lweSibonelelo soPhuhliso lezokuHlaliswa eziDolophini neSicwangciso sokuPhuculwa kwaso.
tgt: Imiphumela yeseka ukugcinwa kweSabelo Sokuthuthukiswa Kwezindawo Zokuhlala Ezisemadolobheni njengesabelo sokunezezela esikhokhela umqondo ovulekile wokuhlaliswa kwabantu okuqhubekayo nokulinganayo ukuze kuhlomule abantu abahluphekayo kanye namakhaya anemali engenayo engenkulu kakhulu.

src: Ezi ziphumo zixhasa ukugcinwa kweSibonelelo soPhuhliso lezokuHlaliswa eziDolophini njegesibonelelo soxabangelo nesiyinkxaso-mali yombono obanzi wezokuhlaliswa koluntu ozinzileyo nolinganayo ukwenzela ukuba kuxhamle abahluphekileyo namakhaya amkela imivuzo ephakathi.
tgt: Lokhu kuwusizo kakhulu ekufezekiseni izinjongo zoHlaka Lokusebenza Lwesikhathi Esimaphakathi ukuhlinzekwa kwamathuba okwakhiwa kwezindlu eziyisigidi esi-1 495 ezindaweni zokuhlala eziseqophelweni eliphezulu ngowezi-2019.

src: Oku kuyanceda ekufikeleleni kummiselo ovela lwiNkqubo-sikhokelo yesiCwangciso-qhinga sesiGaba esiphakathi ukubonelela ngamathuba ezindlu azizigidi ezi-1 495 kwimeko yezokusingqongileyo yokuhlala okusemgangathweni ngowama-2019.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze umbiko maqondana Nokuqaliswa Ukusebenza kanye Nokulinganiswa Komthelela Wezobuchwepheshe kanye Nezindaba Zabasebenzi zoHlelo Lwezezimboni, impendulo yabaphathi embikweni kanye nohlelo lokwenza ngcono oluthunyelwe nguMnyango Wezokuhwebelana kanye Nezezimboni.

src: IKhabhinethi iyamkele ingxelo engokuphunyezwa nokuVavanywa kweMpembelelo yezobuChwepheshe nemiCimbi yezaBasebenzi yeNkqubo yezoShishino, indlela abalawuli abayihlangabeza ngayo le ngxelo nesiCwangciso sokuphucula esifakwe liSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino.
tgt: Lolu Hlelo lwethulwa nguMnyango Wezohwebo kanye Nezezimboni ngowe-1992 ukuze kuqiniswe ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kwezesayensi, ezobunjiniyela kanye nezobuchwepheshe.

src: Le Nkqubo yaveliswa liSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino ngowe-1992 ukomeleza uphuhliso lwezakhono kwezenzulu-lwazi, ezobunjineli nobuchwepheshe.
tgt: Lunegalelo ekusungulweni kwamathuba emisebenzi ngokukhiqiza inqwaba yabacwaningi abanamakhono aphezulu kanye nabaphathi bezobuchwepheshe embonini kanye nokwenza ngcono ubuqhudelwano bezinhlangano zamabhizinisi ezibambe iqhaza.

src: Yenza igalelo ekudalweni kwemisebenzi ngokuvelisa igquba labaphandi-nzulu abanezakhono ezikudidi oluphezulu nabalawuli bezobuchwepheshe boshishino nangokuphucula ukukhuphisana kwemibutho yamashishini athatha inxaxheba.
tgt: Uhlelo luyingxenye esemthethweni, esemqoka futhi egculisayo yokweseka okuqanjwe kabusha okunikezela ngalokho okuyifanele ngempela imali yakho kukhona kokubili ukuthuthukiswa kwezobuchwepheshe kanye nokuthuthukisa ukuphathwa kwezindaba zabasebenzi kanye namakhono ahlobene nezezimboni.

src: Le Nkqubo iyasebenza, ibalulekile kwaye iluphawu olusebenzayo kwinkxaso yokuvelisa izinto ezintsha ebonelela ngexabiso elivakalayo ngemali ngokophuhliso lwezobuchwepheshe nophuhliso lwemicimbi yezabasebenzi nezakhono ezihambelana noshishino.
tgt: Luphinde futhi luqhathaniseke ngokuvumelanayo nezinye izinhlelo zasemazweni aphesheya.

src: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo zeNgxelo yeQela loMphathiswa eliphanda ngezityholo ‘zokuthengiswa kwezithuba zootitshala’ ezibandakanya abantu abathile, imibutho yootitshala namagosa wamaSebe ezeMfundo kuMaphondo athile.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nemiphumela yoMbiko Wethimba loNgqongqoshe Lokwenziwa Komsebenzi wokuphenya ngezinsolo ‘zokuthengiswa kwezikhala zemisebenzi yothisha’ ezibandakanya abantu abathile, izinyunyana zothisha kanye nezikhulu zeMinyango ethile Yezemfundo Yezifundazwe.

src: IKhabhinethi iziphehlelele izindululo zokusebenza ngokulandela inkqubo ethile nangokwendlela ekuchazwe ngayo kwiziphumo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze izincomo zokubhekana ngendlela enohlelo neqondiswe ngqo emiphumeleni.

src: KwiNgxelo yalo yokugqibela iQela loMphathiswa lihlabe amadlala kwindima edlalwa ngabo bonke abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo kwinkqubo yokukhetha nokuqeshwa ootitshala.
tgt: Embikweni walo wokugcina Ithimba loNgqongqoshe Lokwenziwa Komsebenzi lihlinzeke ngohlaziyo lwendima edlalwe yibo bonke ababambiqhaza ohlelweni lokukhethwa kanye nokuqashwa kothisha.

src: Ikwaphawule iingxaki ezibalulekileyo kwinkqubo yangoku yokuqesha kwisithuba esikhoyo kwicandelo lezemfundo esisiseko yaza yabonelela ngezindululo zokunceda iSebe lezeMfundo esiSiseko necandelo lezemfundo esisiseko ngokubanzi ukuba lingayisombulula njani le mingeni ichaziweyo.
tgt: Uphinde uqaphele izinkinga ezinkulu ezisohlelweni lwamanje lokuqokelwa ezikhaleni zomsebenzi emkhakheni wezemfundo yamabanga aphansi futhi uphinde uhlinzeke ngezincomo ukusiza uMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo kanye nomkhakha wezemfundo yamabanga aphansi jikelele ukwazi ukubhekana nezingqinamba ezihlonziwe.

src: Imithetho eYilwayo.
tgt: IMithethosivivinywa.

src: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukungeniswa koMthetho siHlomelo wezamaHlathi weSizwe ePalamente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igunyaze ukuhanjiswa koMthethosivivinywa Wokuchibiyela Ezamahlathi Kazwelonke ePhalamende.

src: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uhlomela uMthetho wezamaHlathi weSizwe, we-1998 (uMthetho onguNombolo 84 we-1998).Ukuphunyezwa kwezi zihlomelo kuza kuphucula ulawulo lwezamahlathi oluzinzileyo kukhuthaze nokuthatha inxaxheba kwabahlelelekileyo, abaxhomekeke kwezamahlathi ukuze baphila, bathathe inxaxheba kwiBhunga leeNgcebiso lezamaHlathi leSizwe.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa uchibiyela uMthetho Wezamahlathi Kazwelonke, we-1998 (uMthetho onguNombolo 84 we-1998).Ukuqaliswa ukusebenza kwezichibiyelo kuzokwenza ngcono ukuphathwa kwezamahlathi okuqinile futhi kuphinde kugqugquzele ukubamba iqhaza kwamaqempu abantu abantekenteke, abathembele emahlathini ukuze bakwazi ukuphila, eMkhandlwini Wezokululeka Ngezamahlathi Kazwelonke.

src: Imisitho ezayo.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.

src: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kuzimasa umsitho wokubekwa esihlalweni nokufungiswa kukaMongameli uYoweri Museveni wase-Uganda eKampala ngomhla we-12 kuCanzibe wama-2016.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uzohambela umcimbi wokugcotshwa kanye nokufungiswa kukaMongameli wase-Uganda u-Yoweri Museveni eKampala ngomhla ziyi-12 Nhlaba 2016.

src: Olu tyelelo luphumayo luza kuqhubeka ukomeleza ubudlelwane bala mazwe mabini, uMzantsi Afrika ne-Uganda.
tgt: Lolu hambo oluphumayo luzophinde luqinise ubudlelwano obumbaxambili phakathi kweNingizimu Afrika ne-Uganda.

src: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kukhokela uSuku loMthandazo leSizwe eliza kubanjelwa kumaBala ase-ABSA eDurban ngomhla wama-29 kuTshazimpuzi wama-2016.
tgt: UMongameli u-Jacob Zuma uzokwengamela Usuku Lukazwelonke Lomkhuleko ozobanjelwa Ezinkundleni Zemidlalo i-ABSA e-Durban mhla zingama-29 Mbasa 2016.

src: Iinkokheli zakwaLizwi kunye neenkokheli zemibutho yoluntu ziza kuzibandakanya norhulumente ekuthandazeleni ukuqhubeka komanyano lwentando yesininzi, umanyano lwesizwe, intlalo- ntle kwakunye noNyulo looRhulumente beeNgingqi lowama-2016 oluza kuba noxolo futhi lube yimpumelelo.
tgt: Abaholi bezenkolo kanye nabaholi bezinhlangano zomphakathi bazohlanganyela nohulumeni ekukhulekeleni okunye ukuqiniswa kombuso wentando yeningi labantu, ubumbano lukazwelonke, ukubumbana komphakathi kanjalo Nokhetho Lohulumeni Bezindawo lowezi-2016 oluyimpumelelo nolunokuthula.

src: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngezicwangciso zeSebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko zokusingatha iNyanga ye-Afrika kuCanzibe yowama-2016 phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukwakha i-Afrika eNgcono neHlabathi eliNgcono” njengenxalenye yemibhiyozo yelizwekazi yokusekwa koMbutho weManyano ye-Afrika (i-OAU), ngoku ebizwa ngokuba yiMbumba yaMazwe ase-Afrika (i-AU) kunye nemisebenzi eyenzileyo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nezinhlelo zoMnyango Wezobuciko Namasiko zokusingatha Inyanga ye-Afrika ngoNhlaba 2016 ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi: “Ukwakha i-Afrika Engcono kanye Nomhlaba Ongcono” njengengxenye yemigubho yezwekazi yokusungulwa kweNhlangano Yobumbano lwase-Afrika (i-OAU), manje esiyaziwa ngokuthi Ubumbano lwaseAfrika (i-African Union) kanye nomsebenzi esiwenzile.

src: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kumphehlelela iNyanga ye-Afrika ngoSuku loMthandazo leSizwe ngomhla wama-29 kuTshazimpuzi yowama-2016.Ngowama-2016 iNyanga ye-Afrika iza kugxila kumalinge wophuhliso lwabantu basetyhini nolutsha, ngeli xesha siza kube sibhiyozela unyaka wama-60 woMngcelele wooMama nonyaka wama-40 woVukelo loLutsha eSoweto.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uzokwethula Inyanga yeAfrika ngoSuku Lukazwelonke Lomkhuleko ngomhla zingama-29 kuMbasa 2016.Ngowezi-2016 Inyanga ye-Afrika izogxila ezinhlelweni eziqanjwe kabusha zokuthuthukiswa kwabantu besifazane kanye nentsha, ngenkathi sigubha iminyaka engama-60 yeMashi Yabantu Besifazane kanye neminyaka engama-40 Yemibhikiso Yentsha eSoweto.

src: Abemi baseMzantsi Afrika bayabongozwa ukuba bathathe inxaxheba kule nkqubo iqulathe iindidi ngeendidi zemisitho nemibhiyozo equka eyobugcisa obubonwayo, izifundo ngedrama, umculo, izifundo neentetho eziqhelekileyo kwakunye ngesikhumbuzo seminyaka eli-10 yeNgxowa-mali yamaFa eHlabathi ase-Afrika.
tgt: Abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayanxuswa ukuba babambe iqhaza ohlelweni oluzobe luhlanganise iminxa ehlukahlukene olubandakanya imisebenzi enhlobonhlobo efaka phakathi imisebenzi yobuciko obubukwayo, imidlalo yeshashalazi, umculo, izifundo kanye nezingqungquthela kanjalo nokubungazwa kweminyaka eyi-10 yeSikhwama Samasiko Omhlaba Wase-Afrika.

src: Le Nyanga ye-Afrika isebenza njengeqonga lokuqhagamshelanisa ngokutsha nokuzibophelela kwethu ngokutsha kuko konke okusenza sibe ngama-Afrika neBuyambo yase-Afrika ngokudibanisa abantu belizwekazi basondelelane.
tgt: Inyanga yase-Afrika isebenza njengenkundla yokuzixhumana kabusha kanye nokuzibophezela kabusha Obumbanweni lwama-Afrika kanye Nasekuvuselelweni kwe-Afrika ekuhlanganiseni abantu bezwekazi lase-Afrika ndawonye.

src: Ngomhla wama-20 kuCanzibe wama-2016 urhulumente uza kukhokela umbhiyozo wesizwe wokugqiba kweDyunivesithi iFort Hare iminyaka elikhulu yabakho kwiziko layo eliseDikeni eMpuma Koloni.
tgt: Ngomhla zingama-20 Nhlaba 2016 uhulumeni uzohola umgubho kazwelonke weminyaka eyikhulu yeNyuvesi i-Fort Hare ophikweni oluse-Alice eMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Ukulungiselela umsitho omkhulu wokubhiyoza, uMongameli uJacob Zuma umisele iKomiti yabaPhathiswa (i-IMC) ukuba yenze izicwangciso ize iququzelele lo mbhiyozo wenkulungwane uyimbali.
tgt: Ukulungiselela umgubho omkhulu, uMongameli u-Jacob Zuma usesungule iKomidi loNgqongqoshe Abahlukahlukene (i-IMC) ukuba lihlele liphinde lididiyele le ngqophamlando yomgubho weminyaka eyikhulu.

src: Eli ziko lemfundo liyimbali belisebenza njengenqaba yethemba ngexesha lomzabalazo wethu wenkululeko kwaye laziwa “njengeziko lokupheka iinkokeli ze-Afrika” libe liyidyunivesithi ekwakufundwa kuyo ziinkokheli ezazikumzabalazo wokulwa ucalucalulo ezifana neengqanga oo-ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukhwe, Oliver Tambo noGovan Mbeki.
tgt: Lesi sikhungo sokufunda esiyingqophamlando sasebenza njengesikhonkwane ngesikhathi sethu sokuzabalazela inkululeko futhi siphinde saziwe njenge “mbiza yobuholi base-Afrika” ngenxa yokuthi iyona nyuvesi eyafunda izingqalabutho zomzabalazo wokulwisana nobandlululo ezinjengo-ZK Matthews, Nelson Mandela, Robert Sobukwe, Oliver Tambo no-Govan Mbeki.

src: Kuphela kwedyunivesithi yaseMazantsi e-Afrika evelise iintloko zoorhulumente ezintlanu: uNelson Mandela waseMzantsi Afrika, uYusuf Lule wase-Uganda, uRobert Mugabe waseZimbabwe, uNtsu Mokhehle waseLesotho no-Sir Seretse Khama waseBotswana.
tgt: Iyona kuphela inyuvesi eseNingizimu ne-Afrika eyake yakhiqiza izinhloko zombuso ezinhlanu: u-Nelson Mandela waseNingizimu Afrika, u-Yusuf Lule wase-Uganda, u-Robert Mugabe waseZimbabwe, uNtsu Mokhehle waseLesotho kanye no-Sir Seretse Khama waseBotswana.

src: Njengenxalenye yemibhiyozo yenkulungwane iDyunivesithi iFort Hare iKhabhinethi imema bonke abantu ababefunda kule dyunivesithi noluntu jikelele ukuba babalisane ngeenkumbulo zabo ngedyunivesithi iFort Hare nephulo likaBalisa iBali Lakho ngokusebenzisa i- #MyFortHare.
tgt: Njengengxenye yemigubho yeminyaka eyikhulu yeNyuvesi i-Fort Hare iKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abafundi bangaphambilini bale nyuvesi kanye namalungu omphakathi ukuba abelane ngezinkumbulo anazo nge-Fort Hare emkhankasweni Wokuxoxa Indaba Yakho esebenzisa isibambo esithi #MyFortHare.

src: USekela-Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uza kukhokela igqiza loMzantsi Afrika ukuya kwingqungquthela yama-26 yeQonga lezoQoqosho leHlabathi (i-WEF) e-Afrika e-Rwanda phakathi komhla we-11 nowe-13 kuCanzibe yowama-2016.
tgt: IPhini likaMongameli uCyril Ramaphosa uzohola ithimba lezinthunywa zaseNingizimu Afrika eliya Esithangamini Sezomnotho Womhlaba Wonke (i-WEF) sama-26 e-Afrika esizobe sibanjelwe eRwanda phakathi komhla ziyi-11 kanye ne-13 Nhlaba 2016.

src: Eli qonga lisingathwe phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuqhagamshelanisa iMithombo ye-Afrika ngeNguqu yezebuChwepheshe”.Urhulumente uqhubela phambili inguqu kwezobuchwepheshe yeli lizwe ngesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba.
tgt: Isithangami sisingathwe ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi: “Ukuxhumanisa Izinsiza zase-Africa ngokusebenzisa Ukuguquka Kwezobuxhakaxhaka Bukagesi”.Uhulumeni esebenzisa Uhlelo lwakhe Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye uqhubezela phambili ukuguquka kwezwe kwezobuxhakaxhaka bukagesi.

src: Uza kusungula isigaba sokuqala sephulo lakhe lamaza osasazo aza kufaka uqhagamshelwano kumaziko karhulumente angaphezulu kwama-5 000 kwizithili zoomasipala ezisibhozo kwixesha leminyaka emithathu.
tgt: Useqalile ukukhipha isigaba sokuqala sohlelo lwakhe oluqanjwe kabusha lwezinxakanxaka zokuxhumana oluzoxhuma izikhungo zikahulumeni ezingaphezu kwezi-5 000 komasipala bezifunda abayisishiyagalombili esikhathini esiyiminyaka emithathu.

src: Sele kubekelwe bucala imali ezizigidi ezingama-740 zeerandi yokuxhasa oku kusungulwa.
tgt: Uxhaso lwemali ebalelwa ezigidini ezingama-740 zamarandi selwabiwe ukweseka lokhu kukhishwa kwalesi sigaba.

src: INDABA YOWAMA-2016 ebanjelwe kwiZiko leNgqungquthela Inkosi Albert Luthuli eDurban ukususela kumhla we-7 ukuya kowe-9 kuCanzibe yowama-2016, liqonga lokuzingca ngako konke okusenza sibe ngama-Afrika eliza kukhuthaza iimveliso zokhenketho kubathengi behlabathi.
tgt: INDABA 2016 eNkosi Albert Luthuli Convention Centre e-Durban kusukela mhla ziyi-7 kuya mhla ziyi-9 Nhlaba 2016, iyisithangami Sobumbano lwama-Afrika esizokhuthaza imikhiqizo yethu yezokuvakasha kubathengi basemazweni aphesheya.

src: Ukhenketho, njengenye yeentsika ezintandathu zohlumo lwezoqoqosho kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso, lenze igalelo eliyimali ezibhiliyoni ezingama-357 kwiSambuku seMveliso yeSizwe (i-GDP) ngowama-2014 laza laxhasa i-9% kwingqesho epheleleyo yaseMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: Ezokuvakasha, njengenye yezinsika eziyisithupha zokukhula komnotho woHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe, zibe negalelo lezigidigidi ezingama-357 zamarandi kwiSamba Somkhiqizo Wezwe (i-GDP) ngowezi-2014 futhi zixhase nge-9% esambeni esiphelele sabantu abaqashiwe eNingizimu Afrika.

src: IBhunga lezoHambo eHlabathini noKhenketho lithelekelela ukuba ukhenketho lenze igalelo elizibhiliyoni zeerandi ezingama-560 kwi-GDP yethu ngowama-2015 kwaye luza kuxhasa imisebenzi engaphezulu kwezigidi ezibini.
tgt: Umkhandlu Wezokuhamba Nokuvakasha Womhlaba Wonke ulinganisa ngokuthi ezokuvakasha zizoba negalelo lezigidigidi ezingama-560 zamarandi kwi-GDP yethu ngowezi-2025 kanti futhi ziyoxhasa ngemisebenzi engaphezu kwezigidi ezimbili.

src: Ukukhulisa impembelelo yezoKhenketho kuQoqosho lwaseLwandle yintsika ebaluleke kakhulu kwisiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba, ngokubangelwa ngamandla akhoyo kumalwandle wethu, nanokuba negalelo kuhlumo loqoqosho.
tgt: Ukukhulisa umthelela Wezokuvakasha Emnothweni Wasolwandle kuyinsika esemqoka yoHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye, okususelwe emandleni angakathintwa muntu ezilwandle zethu, angaba negalelo ekukhuleni komnotho.

src: Uqoqosho lwaselwandle nokhenketho lubonelela ngamathuba angumangaliso ohlumo lwezoqoqosho nokudala imisebenzi.
tgt: Umnotho wasolwandle kanye nezokuvakasha zihlinzeka ngamathuba amangalisayo okukhula komnotho kanye nokusungulwa kwamathuba emisebenzi.

src: Kwisikhumbuzo soSuku lwabaSebenzi ngomhla woku-1 kuCanzibe wowama-2016, iKhabhinethi iyakuphinda ukuzibophelela kwayo ekukhuseleni amalungelo wabasebenzi ngemithetho yezabasebenzi enenkqubela.
tgt: Ekugujweni koSuku Lwabasebenzi mhla lu-1 Nhlaba 2016, iKhabhinethi igcizelela ukuzibophezela kwezwe ukuvikela amalungelo abasebenzi ngokusebenzisa imithetho yethu yabasebenzi enenqubekelaphambili.

src: Ukususela ngowe-1994 urhulumente uwaqhubele phambili amalungelo wabasebenzi ngemithetho efana noMthetho woBudlelwane bezaBasebenzi, uMthetho weeMeko zoMsebenzi ezisiSiseko, uMthetho womakuLingwane eMsebenzini nezeMpilo noKhuseleko eMsebenzini.
tgt: Kusukela ngowe-1994 uhulumeni esebenzisa imithetho enjengoMthetho Wezobudlelwano Nabasebenzi, uMthetho Wezimo Zokusebenza Eziyisisekelo, uMthetho Wokuqashwa Kwabantu Ngokulingana kanye noMthetho Wezempilo Emsebenzini kanye Nokuphepha useqhubezele phambili amalungelo abasebenzi.

src: IKhabhinethi ibongoza abafundi beBanga le-12 ukuba baqalise ukuprinta iifomu zokufaka izicelo okanye bafake izicelo kwi-intanethi kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo njengenxalenye yephulo lika-Apply Now/Khetha Career Guidance Campaign.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abafundi beBanga le-12 ukuba baqale ukuthwebula amafomu okufaka izicelo noma bafake izicelo nge-inthanethi ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme njengengxenye yoMkhankaso othi Apply Now/Khetha Career Guidance.

src: Eli phulo liqhutywa rhoqo ngonyaka liSebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho, liza kuqhutya esizweni jikelele kude kube yinyanga yoMsintsi yowama-2016 kwaye linceda abafundi ekukhetheni ngokufanelekileyo xa befaka izicelo kumaziko emfundo ephakamileyo.
tgt: Umkhankaso obanjwa njalo minyaka yonke nguMnyango Wezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha, uzobanjwa kuzwelonke kuze kube nguMandulo 2016 futhi uzosiza abafundi ukuba bakhethe ngomqondo ophusile lapho befaka izicelo ezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme.

src: Abafundi bayakhuthazwa ukuba baqhagamshelane neZiko leNkonzo zoPhuhliso lwaMakhondo ngokuthumela i-SMS okanye u-“please call me” kua-072 204 5056 okanye 086 999 0123, i-imeyili: EMAILTOKEN, kwikhasi lika-Facebook kwa: WEBTOKEN okanye basebenzise i-Twitter kwa: WEBTOKEN Uluvo lweKhabhinethi kwimiba esematheni.
tgt: Abafundi bayagqugquzelwa ukuba baxhumane neSikhungo Sezinsizakalo Zokuthuthukiswa Kwemikhakha Yemisebenzi ngokuthumela i-SMS noma u-“please call me” ku-072 204 5056 noma ku-086 999 0123, nge-imeyili kuleli kheli: EMAILTOKEN, ku-Facebook kuleli kheli: WEBTOKEN noma ku-Twitter kuleli kheli: WEBTOKEN Isimo seKhabhinethi ezindabeni ezisematheni.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza abadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo abachaphazelekayo ukuba bahlomle kwidrafti ehlaziyiweyo yoXwebhu lwamaLungelo ngokuXhotyiswa kwabaNtsundu kwezoQoqosho ngokuBanzi (i-BBBEE) kuShishino lwezeMigodi neziMbiwa zaseMzantsi Afrika, lowama-2016 nolwapapashwa kwiPhephandaba loMbuso.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igqugquzela ababambiqhaza abafanelekile ukuba baphawule ohlakeni olubuyekeziwe loMqulu Wokuthuthukiswa Kwabamnyama Kwezomnotho Wezezimboni zaseNingizimu Afrika Zezezimayini kanye Nezimbiwa Phansi, lowezi-2016 olwashicilelwa kuSomqulu Kahulumeni.

src: Le draftio ihlaziyiweyo yoXwebhu lwezeMigodi ibandakanya imigaqo-nkqubo yenguqu karhulumente nemithetho ngakumbi.
tgt: Uhlaka olubuyekeziwe loMqulu Wezezimayini luphinde luhlanganise izinqubomgomo zenguquko zikahulumeni kanye nomthetho wokuthuthukisa ukwenziwa lula kwebhizinisi, ukusungula incanciselo yezokulawula, ukuqagulwa kanye nokuqiniseka.

src: Ikwahambelana namasolotya oMthetho wokuXhotyiswa kwabaNtsundu kwezoQoqosho ngokuBanzi, wama-2003 (uMthetho onguNombo 53 wama-2003) kunye neKhowudi yokuSebenza kaKuhle (iiKhowudi zakwa-DTI).
tgt: Luphinde lwahanjelaniswa nezimiso zoMthetho Wokuthuthukiswa Kwabamanyama Kwezomnotho, wezi-2003 (uMthetho onguNombolo 53 wezi-2003) kanye Namakhodi Enkambiso Enhle (Amakhodi e-DTI).

src: IKhabhinethi iqaphela ukuba ukugunyaziswa kokuthengwa kweSAB Miller ngu-AB InBev kusaqwalaselwa ngamaqumrhu ezokhuphiswano.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphelile ukuthi ukugunyazwa kokuthengwa okuhlongozwayo kwe-SAB Miller yi-AB InBev kusengaphansi kokucutshungulwa ngabasebagunyeni ezemiqhudelwano.

src: IKhabhinethi iyayamkela indlela ekuvunyelwene ukuba mawuphathwe ngayo lo mba nguMphathiswa woPhuhliso lwezoQoqosho ne-AB InBev umaqumrhu okhuphiswano kuluhlu lwemiba ehambelana neemfuno zoluntu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyayamukela indlela yokusebenza okuvunyelwene ngayo ethathwa nguNgqongqoshe Wezokuthuthukiswa Komnotho kanye ne-AB InBev kwabasemagunyeni ezemiqhudelwano maqondana nezindaba ezinhlobonhlobo ezithinta umphakathi.

src: Isivumelwano esenziwe yile nkampani siza kusebenza njengesikhokelo, kwimiba ebalulekileyo kuluntu, nakwezinye iinkampani ezithenga okanye ezizimanya nezinye phantsi kweemeko ezikwafanayo.
tgt: Ukuzibophezela kwenkampani kusebenza njengomkhombandlela, ezindabeni ezithinta umphakathi, kwezinye izinkampani ezihlangene kanye nasekuthengweni okunezimo ezifanayo.

src: Oku kuquka isibhambathiso ekuvunyelwene ngaso yile nkampani sokuchitha imali eyibhiliyoni yeerandi kule minyaka mihlanu izayo ukukhuthaza amafama afuyela ukuziphilisa efuya ngomyinge omncinci nophuhliso lababoneleli-zinkonzo balapha ekhaya, amashishini amatsha asakhulayo, ezamandla nobuchwepheshe bokusebenzisa kakuhle amanzi nophuhliso lolutsha.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya isibophezelo okuvunyelwene ngaso yinkampani sokuchitha isigidigidi samarandi eminyakeni eyisihlanu ezayo ukukhuthaza ukufuya nokulima kwabalimi abancane kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabaphakeli bempahla balapha ezweni ngaphakathi, amabhizinisi amasha, ubuchwepheshe bamandla kanye namanzi anele kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwentsha.

src: Isibophelelo ngokwemisebenzi siquka ukuthintela ukudendwa ngenkani kwabasebenzi ngenxa yendibanisela yeenkampani nokugcina izinga lengqesho kule nkampani kule minyaka mihlanu ilandelayo, oko yinxalenye yesivumelwano sokuhlahla indlela phakathi kwale nkampani norhulumente ukuxhasa ukwanda kwemizi-mveliso, uphuhliso lwamashishini amancinci nokudala imisebenzi.
tgt: Ukuzibophezela ngemisebenzi kubandakanya nesithembiso sokugwema ukudilizwa kwabasebenzi bengazikhethelanga bona njengomphumela wokuhlangana kwezinkampani kanye nokugcina amazinga okuqashwa enkampanini iminyaka emihlanu ezayo, kuyingxenye yesivumelwano esiyingqophamlando esingakaze sibonakale phakathi kwenkampani nohulumeni ukweseka ezezimboni, ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi amancane kanye nokusungulwa kwamathuba emisebenzi.

src: Komnye omba, iKhabhinethi iqaphela ukuba ukuqalisa ukusebenza kwamasolotya oMthetho-siHlomelo woKhuphiswano owenza ukuba kungabikho mthethweni ukuba abalawuli nabaphathi basebenzisane ukwenze iyelenqe lokunyusa amaxabiso, kwiziniki-maxabiso okanye kurhwebo.
tgt: Ngakolunye uhlangothi oluseceleni, iKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezimiso zoMthetho Wokuchibiyela Imincintiswano ezikwenza kube icala lobugebengu ukuthi abaqondisi kanye nabaphathi bavumelane ngasese ekuphekeni kwamanani, amathenda noma izimakethe.

src: La masolotya ayinxalenye yamanyathelo okunyusa izinga lokulwa amaqela enza amayelenqe enzakalisa uqoqosho ngokuthi abize abathengi amaxabiso aphezulu.
tgt: Lezi zimiso ziyingxenye yezinyathelo zokukhuphula ukulwisana nombimbi olucekela phansi umnotho futhi lubeke amanani aphezulu kubathengi.

src: Sicela onke amashishini aseMzantsi Afrika ukuba mawakhuphisane ngamaxabiso aphantsi, ngokuba nobuchule obuthe chatha, ukuphucuka komgangatho wezinto abonelela ngazo okanye ukunika abathengi inkonzo ekwizinga eliphezulu kunokwenza amayelenqe.
tgt: Sinxusa amabhizinisi eNingizimu Afrika ukuba ancintisane ngokugxila emananini aphansi, ukuqamba kabusha okuthe xaxa, ikhwalithi eyenziwe ngcono yezimpahla ezinikezelwayo noma insizakalo ephezulu kubathengi kunokuba kuvunyelwane ngasese.

src: IKhabhinethi iqaphele ukuba icandelo leebhanki lilawulwa ngokwezinga eliphezulu eMzantsi Afrika – nasehlabathini jikelele, kunye nemfuneko yokuba uMzantsi Afrika uhambelane nemigangatho yehlabathi efana ne-Basel III nemithetho yeQela lezemiSebenzi yezeZimali (i-FATF) yokulwa ukuthutyeleziswa kwemali, neyayamkelwe ngaphambili yiKhabhinethi, yaxhaswa yimithetho engundoqo eyayamkelwe ngurhulumente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphelile indlela ephezulu umkhakha wezokubhanga olawulwa ngayo la eNingizimu Afrika – kanye nasemhlabeni jikelele, kanye nesidingo sokuba iNingizimu Afrika ithobele amazinga omhlaba wonke njenge-Basel III kanye nemithetho ephikisana nokushintshisana ngemali Yombutho Wethimba Lokusebenza Lezezimali (i-FATF), ebivele kakade isigunyaziwe yiKhabhinethi, futhi yasekelwa yimitheshwana engaphansi eyagunyazwa nguHulumeni.

src: Inkqubo yokuGunyaziwe Ababini nayo iza kulawula indlela oluziphatha ngayo urhwebo kwicandelo leebhanki necandelo lezezimali ngokubanzi.”.
tgt: Uhlelo lama-Twin Peaks nalo luzolawula ukuziphatha kwezimakethe emkhakheni wezokubhanga kanye nakwezezimali ngobubanzi.".

src: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziphumo zeNgxowa-mali yeMali yeHlabathi yowama-2016 neNdibano yaseNtlakohlaza yamaQela eeBhanki zeHlabathi eqhubeke phantsi komxholo othi “IMingeni yeHlabathi, iziSombululo zeHlabathi”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyamukele imiphumela evela eMhlanganweni Wasentwasahlobo wezi-2016 Wesikhwama Sezezimali Somhlaba Wonke kanye Namaqembu Ebhange Lomhlaba owabanjwa ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi “Izinselele Zomhlaba Wonke, Izixazululo Zomhlaba Wonke”.

src: Kuphakanyiswe indlela embaxa yokuvuselelwa kohlumo kwinqanaba lehlabathi, kukhuthazwa amazwe ukuba asebenzise onke amandla okunyusa akwimigaqo-nkqubo yawo ukukhuthaza uhlumo, oko kuthetha olungokwemali, olungokwemali kaRhulumente nokulungiswa kwezakhiwo.
tgt: Indlela yokusebenza embaxantathu yokokhwezela ukukhula ezingeni lomhlaba wonke yahlongozwa, egqugquzela amazwe ukuba asebenzise izilinganiso zenqubomgomo ukuqhubezela ukukhula, okuwokuphathelene nezezimali, isikhwama sezimali zikahulumeni kanye nezinguquko zokwakhiwa kwazo.

src: Amazwe anesithuba ngokwemali nangokwemali kaRhulumente akhuthazwa ukuba enze ngakumbi ukuphucula imfuneko noxa kunjalo, ukuphunyezwa kokulungiswa kwezakhiwo kubaluleke kakhulu kunako konke okunye.
tgt: Amazwe anendawo yezezimali kanye nesikhwama sezimali zikahulumeni agqugquzelwa ukuba enze okuthe xaxa ukusimamisa izimfuneko nakuba kunjalo, ukuqaliswa ukusebenza kwezinguquko zokwakheka kwazo kwakusemqoka kubo bonke.

src: Kuninzi oku kuquka utyalo-mali kwiziseko ezingundoqo, ubuchule bokuvelisa izinto ezintsha nokuphucula ukusebenza kolawulo, phakathi kokunye.
tgt: Kwabaningi lokhu kubandakanya utshalomali engqalasizindeni, ukuqamba kabusha kanye nokwenza ngcono indawo yokulawula, phakathi kokunye.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuza bonke abo bangabavoti abaselungelweni abangekabhalisi baqinisekise nangeenkcukhacha zabo ukuba bangakwenza oko ngokutyelela ii-Ofisi zeKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo (i-IEC) ezikufutshane kubo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhumbuza bonke labo abafanelekayo ukuba ngabavoti abangakabhalisi futhi baqinisekise imininingwane yabo ukuthi basangakwenza lokho ngokuhambela iHhovisi labo eliseduze nabo leKhomishana Yokhetho Ezimele (i-IEC).

src: Oku kuyadingeka ukuqinisekisa ngokubakho kwegama lakho kuluhlu lwabavoti okuza kwenza ukuba abavoti abaselungelweni bakwazi ukusebenzisa ilungelo labo lomgaqo-siseko ngomhla we-3 kweyeThupha yowama-2016.IKhabhinethi ibongoza bonke abavoti abaselungelweni ukuba baqinisekise ukuba banazo zonke izinto ezifunekayo zokunikezela ngeedilesi zabo kwi-ofisi yeKhomishini yoNyulo eziMeleyo (i-IEC).
tgt: Lokhu kuyadingeka ukuze uqinisekise igama lakho ohlwini labavoti oluzovumela abavoti abafanelekile ukuba basebenzise ilungelo labo lentandoyeningi mhla zi-3 Ncwaba 2016.IKhabhinethi inxusa abavoti abafanelekileyo ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi bayahlangabezana nesidingo sokuhlinzeka ngekheli ehhovisi eliseduzane nabo leKhomishana Yokhetho Ezimele.

src: Imibuzo ngonyulo ingabhekiswa kwiziko loqhagamshelwano le-IEC kwa-0800 11 8000, elivula ngoMvulo ukuya kuLwesihlanu, ukusukela ngentsimbi yesi-7 kusasa ukuya kweye-9 ngokuhlwa.
tgt: Imibuzo mayelana nokhetho ingaqondiswa esikhungweni sezokuxhumana se-IEC ku-0800 11 8000, esivulwa kusukela ngoMsombuluko kuya kuLwesihlanu, kusukela ngehora lesi-7 ekuseni kuya ehoreni lesi-9 kusihlwa.

src: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nabakwa-Transnet, iGunyabantu lezoTshutshiso, iZiko lezoSasazo loMzantsi Afrika (i-SABC) neSebe lezeMfundo ePhakamileyo noQeqesho, iSebe lezoBudlelwane baMazwe ngamazwe neNtsebenziswano, kunye neSebe lezobuLungisa noPhuhliso loMgaqo-siseko ngokuthi anikwe iwonga lokuba kudidi lokuba “Ngabona baQeshi banoMtsalane” eMzantsi Afrika yinkampani esebenza ngamagama abaqeshi, i-UNIVERSUIKhabhinethi yothulela umnqwazi uMphathiswa wezeNzululwazi nobuChwepheshe, uNaledi Pandor, othe wafumana imbasa i-Order of Merit kwiFederation Republic of Germany ngegalelo lakhe kuphuhliso lwezenzululwazi ehlabathini jikelele.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele uTransnet, Uphiko Lwezokushushisa Lukazwelonke, Inhlangano Yezokusakaza yaseNingizimu Afrika (i-SABC) kanye neMinyango Yezemfundo Ephakeme Nokuqeqesha, Wezobudlelwano Namazwe Omhlaba kanye Nokubambisana kanye Nowezokuthuthukiswa Kwezomthethosisekelo ngokukleliswa njengaba “Qashi Abahehayo Kakhulu” eNingizimu Afrika yinkampani eqopha abaqashi, i-UNIVERSUIKhabhinethi income uNgqongqoshe Wezesayensi Nobuchwepheshe, uNaledi Pandor, othole Umklomelo Wokusebenza Ngobungqaphambili ovela kwi-Federal Republic of Germany ngegalelo lakhe ekuthuthukisweni kwesayensi emhlabeni wonke jikelele.

src: Eli wonga belinikezelwa kubantu behlabathi jikelele ngeempumelelo zabo kwinqanaba lezepolitiki, lezentlalo okanye kwelobungqondi.
tgt: Umklomelo wokutuswa usunikezwe abantu emhlabeni wonke jikelele ngezimpumelelo zabo kwezepolitiki, kwezenhlalo noma ezigabeni zobuhlakani babo.

src: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana noMlawuli-Jikelele weSebe lezeNdalo uNosipho Ngcaba ngokufumana imbasa ebizwa i-Lifetime Achievement Eco-Logic Award evela kwimagazini yezendalo, i-The Enviropeadia.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele uMqondisi-Jikelele Wezemvelo uNosipho Ngcaba ngokuthola Indodo Yokuhlonishwa Impilo Yakhe Yonke yowezi-2015/16 Yokunakekela Ezemvelo eyinikwa yimagazini yezemvelo, i-The Enviropaedia.

src: IKhabhinethi iqhwabela izandla igcisa uKemang Wa Lehulere ngokuba “Ligcisa loNyaka” lowama-2017 elixhaswa yi-Deutsche Bank.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ishayele ihlombe iciko uKemang Wa Lehulere ngokuba "Iciko Lonyaka" lowezi-2017 elixhaswe yi-Deutsche Bank.

src: UWa Lehulere, ophonononga imisebenzi yobugcisa emva koCalucalulo eMzantsi Afrika, uza kwenza umboniso wakhe wokuqala eyedwa eGermanu kwiholo eDeutsche Bank KunstHalle eBerlin kulo nyaka uzayo.
tgt: UWa Lehulere, ohlola ukufaneleka kwesimo sobuciko eNingizimu Afrika yangemuva kobandlululo, uzokwethula umbukiso wakhe ehamba yedwa e-Germany e-Deutsche Bank Kunst Halle e-Berlin ngonyaka ozayo.

src: IKhabhinethi ivuyisana neSebe lezoKhenketho ngokuphumelela ibhaso lokuba Yelona Nkonzo kaRhulumente inoMgaqo-nkqubo/Nkxaso eNgcono kwiMbasa yoKhenketho oluFanelekileyo e-Afrika lowama-2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele uMnyango Wezokuvakasha ngokuwina umklomelo weNqubomgomo Engungqaphambili Yomphakathi/Yokweseka emncintiswaneni Wezindondo wezi-2016 Wezokuvakasha Ezinobuhlakani wase-Afrika.

src: Eli wonga linikezelwa kwisebe lecandelo laseburhulumenteni, ugunyaziwe okanye iqumrhu elithe labonakalisa ukuzinikela okucacileyo negalelo lokuqhubela phambili ukhenketho.
tgt: Le ndondo inikezelwa emnyangweni womkhakha kahulumeni, isiphathimandla noma isikhungo esenze isibophezelo esicacile kanye negalelo ekuthuthukiseni ezokuvakasha ezinobuhlakani.

src: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nomdlali wegalufa uBranden Grace ngokuphumelela imbasa yakhe yokuqala,i-PGA Tour e-RBC Heritage e-Hilton Head, e-U IKhabhinethi ilusizi ngokushiywa kwethu nguBertie Lubner nothe wenza igalelo elincomekayo kuphuhliso loMzantsi Afrika njengenkokeli kwezoshishino, umthandi wabantu nowawongelwa ukuba abe ngusihlalo ubomi bakhe bonke we-SA Jewish Board of Deputies.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisele umdlali wegalofu u-Branden Grace ngokuwina umqudelwano wakhe wokuqala we-PGA Tour e-RBC Heritage eHilton Head, eMelika.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa uvelwano olunzulu kubahlobo nosapho lwamaxhoba alishumi (uTiisetso Tselo, uSesi Mtshali, uSana Sibeko, uMphikeleli Malindi, uGugulethu Sithole, uVusi Nkabinde, uDaphney Linda, uSicelo Kheswa, uSphamandla Gedle noSimphiwe Nhlapo) engozi yebhasi emasikizi eyenzeke ngethuba ebebuya kwiNgqungquthela yoMqulu weziThembiso ye-ANC eBhayi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iphatheke kabi ngokudlula emhlabeni kuka-Bertie Lubner owaba namagalelo amangalisayo ekuthuthukisweni kweNingizimu Afrika njengomholi wezamabhizinisi, umuntu ophanayo kanye nosihlalo kanomphela wokuhlonishwa weNhlangano yamaJuda aseNingizimu Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano olunzulu kusapho nezihlobo zikaGqirha u-Herman Nditsheni Netshidzivhani, nongowokuqala oNtsundu eMzantsi Afrika ukuba yingcali kwezokuchumisa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi enduduzo nokudabuka okukhulu kubangani kanye nemindeni yezisulu eziyishumi (uTiisetso Tselo, Sesi Mtshali, Sana Sibeko, Mphikeleli Malindi, Gugulethu Sithole, Vusi Nkabinde, Daphney Linda, Sicelo Kheswa, Sphamandla Gedle noSimphiwe Nhlapo) zengozi ebuhlungu yebhasi eyehla ngenkathi bebuya eMbuthanweni Wokuthwelwa Komqulu Wezethembiso Zokhetho we-ANC eBhayi.

src: Njengomseki wekliniki yokuchumisa kwiSibhedlele i-Park Lane eRhawutini, uNetshidzivhani uncede abemi baseMzantsi Afrika abaninzi ukuba baqalise iintsapho zabo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini kanye nakubangani bakaDkt Herman Nditsheni Netshidzivhani, ungoti wokuqala wenzalo omnyama waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalisa amazwi ovelwano kusapho nezihlobo zikaDene Smuts, owayesakuba liLungu lePalamente lombutho iDemocratic Alliance.
tgt: Njengomsunguli womtholampilo wezenzalo eSibhedlela i-Park Lane eGoli, uNetshidzivhani wasiza abantu abaningi baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bakwazi ukuqala imindeni yabo.

src: IKhabhinethi ilothulela umnqwazi igalelo lakhe elikhulu kuphuhliso lolawulo lwethu lwentando yesininzi olumilisele kumgaqo-siseko.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulise amazwi enduduzo emndenini kanye nakubangani baka-Dene Smuts, iLungu Laphambilini le-Democratic Alliance ePhalamende.

src: IKhabhinethi njengoMongameli uJacob Zuma, inqwenelela uMama uWinnie Madikizela-Mandela ukuba achache ngokukhawuleza ikwacela ukuba usapho lunikwe intlonipho yalo ngeli xesha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imthulele isigqoko ngegalelo lakhe elihle kakhulu ekuthuthukisweni kwentando yeningi labantu yethu esekelwe ngumthethosisekelo.

src: UWinnie Mandela uhlonitshwe jikelele ngendima ayidlalileyo kumzabalazo wethu wenkululeko ebenegalelo ekupheliseni imigaqo-nkqubo yengcinezelo nasekuziseni ulawulo lwentando yesininzi eMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela kanye noMongameli u-Jacob Zuma ekufiseleni uMama u-Winnie Madikizela-Mandela ukululama okusheshayo futhi iyacela ukuba kuhlonishwe umndeni nempilo yawo yangasese ngalesi sikhathi.

src: IzikhundlaZonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.
tgt: U-Winnie Mandela uhlonishwa ezweni lonke ngegalelo lakhe emzabalazweni wethu wokulwela inkululeko owaba negalelo ekuqedweni kwezinqubomgomo zengcindezelo kanye nokulethwa kwentandoyeningi eNingizimu Afrika.

src: UPaul Steenkamp kwiBhunga leSizwe lokuCebisa kwezoYilo.
tgt: Ukuqashwa kuka-Paul Steenkamp eMkhandlwini Wezokweluleka Kazwelonke maqondana Nokuqamba Kabusha.

src: UClarinda Elizabeth Simpson njengeGosa eliyiNtloko kwezeZimali lakwa-SENTECULumko Caesario Mtimde njengeGosa eliyiNtloko yesiGqeba leeNkonzo eziDibeneyo ne-Arhente yokuFikelela yaseMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: Ukuqashwa kuka-Clarinda Elizabeth Simpson njengeSikhulu Esiphezulu Sezezimali se-SENTECUkuqashwa kukaLumko Caesario Mtimde njengoMphathi Omkhulu weSikhungo Sezinsizakalo Zomhlaba Wonke kanye Nokufinyeleleka saseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ukuqeshwa ngokutsha kuka-Adv.
tgt: Ukuqokwa kabusha kuka-Adv Rory Wayne Voller njengePhini likaKhomishana weKhomishana Wezinkampani Nemisebenzi Yobuciko.

src: Rory Wayne Voller njengoSekela-Mkhomishinala weKhomishini yeeNkampani nemiSebenzi yobuGcisa.
tgt: Ukunwetshwa kwenkontileka kaLungisa Fuzile njengoMqondisi Jikelele kuMnyango Wezezimali Kuzwelonke.

src: Ukwandiswa kwesivumelwano sengqesho sikaLungisa Fuzile njengoMlawuli-Jikelele kaNondyebo weSizwe.
tgt: Ukunwetshwa kwenkontileka kaNosipho Ngcaba njengoMqondisi Jikelele woMnyango Wezemvelo.

src: Ukuphunyezwa kweenkqubo zikarhulumente ezingundoqo.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza Kwezinhlelo Zikahulumeni Ezisemqoka.

src: IKhabhinethi iyiqaphele ingxelo eyenziwe nguMphathiswa wezeMali kuMongameli, ngenkqubela yokufakana imilomo kukarhulumente naboshishino lecandelo labucala kunye nemibutho yabasebenzi ngoqoqosho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwuqaphelile umbiko wokubuyisa impendulo owenziwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezezimali kuMongameli, maqondana nenqubekelaphambili yezingxoxo zikaHulumeni nabomkhakha ozimele kanye nabasebenzi kwezomnotho.

src: UMongameli ebegunyazise uMphathiswa ukuba akhokele ezi ndibano zokufakana imilomo nala mahlakani ezentlalo ukuba kuboniswane ngesicwangciso-qhinga kunye nokuveza amalinge okukhulisa uqoqosho nokugcina indawo ilizwe elibekwa kuyo ngokwezoqoqosho.
tgt: UMongameli ugunyaze uNgqongqoshe ukuba ahole izingxoxo nalaba balingani bezokuhlalisana ukuze kuhlahlwe iqhinga futhi kuqhanyukwe nezinyathelo zokukhulisa umnotho kanye nokulondoloza ukukleliswa kwezwe kwezezikweletu.

src: IKhabhinethi inovuyo lokuba lo msebenzi uphele ekuveliseni amanyathelo okuqala aluqilima aza kuphucula amathemba kumbono wezoqoqosho weli lizwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ijabulile ukuthi lo msebenzi uphethwe ngokutholakala kwezinhlelo eziqanjwe kabusha ezibambekayo ezizokwenza ngcono amathuba ezwe ezomnotho.

src: NgoMvulo uMongameli ubhengeze amaphulo aphambili aliqela, aquka: (1) ingxowa-mali edibeneyo yabezoshishino labucala norhulumente yeNkxaso yamaShishini amaNcinane, (2) ukuhlangabezana neengxaki eziphazamisa utyalo-mali olwandayo khona ukuze kukhawuleziswe uhlumo oluquka wonke umntu, (3) utyalo-mali oludibeneyo lukarhulumente nabezoshishino labucala kwiziseko ezingundoqo kusetyenziswa umzekelo weNkqubo yabaVelisi baMandla oMbane abaZimeleyo ebe yimpumelelo kunye (4) nokomeleza amaShishini kaRhulumente ukuqinisekisa uzinzo lwawo lwezezimali nokomeleza indima yawo ekuqhubemi uphuhliso.
tgt: UMongameli umemezele izinhlelo eziqanjwe kabusha ezimbalwa eziseqhulwini ngoMsombuluko, ezibandakanya: (1) isikhwama esihlanganyelwe somkhakha ozimele kanye nokahulumeni Sokuxhasa Amabhizinisi Amancane, (2) ukubhekana nemigoqo evimbela ukukhushulwa kotshalomali ukuze kusheshiswe ngesivinini ukukhula okufaka konke okuphelele, (3) ukutshala izimali ngokuhlanganyela kukahulumeni nomkhakha ozimele engqalasizindeni ngokubukela kwisibonelo sempumelelo yoHlelo Labakhiqizi Abazimele Bakages kanye (4) nokuqinisa Amabhizinisi Kahulumeni ukuqinisekisa ukuqina nokuzinza kwezezimali zawo kanye nokuqinisa indima yawo ekugqugquzeleni intuthuko.

src: Ezi zibhengezo zibubungqina bokuba yintoni enokwenziwa leli lizwe xa onke amahlakani ezentlalo edibene esebenzisana kwaye ejongise kwinjongo enye.2 IKhabhinethi ihleli iqinisekile ukuba uhlengahlengiso olumandla lwezoqoqosho, ukuqokelela kweNkonzo yezeRhafu yaseMzantsi Afrika (i-SARS) imali efikele kwitriliyoni yeerandi okokuqala ezimbalini kwakunye nokubhengezwa kwakutsha nje kwamanyathelo okungenelela amahlanu exesha elifutshane, zonke nje zongeza kwisicwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba ngeenjongo zokuqinisekisa ngokwenzeka kwenguqu kuqoqosho lweli lizwe.
tgt: Lezi zimemezelo ziwubufakazi balokho leli lizwe elingakwazi ukukuzuza uma bonke abalingani bezokuhlalisana behlangana ndawonye ukuze basebenzele injongo efanayo.2 IKhabhinethi isalokhu inethemba lokuthi ukuhlanganiswa okunesankahlu kwezimali zezwe nguhulumeni, ingqophamlando yokuqoqwa kwemali eyitriliyoni yamarandi yiSikhungo Sokuqoqwa Kwezimali saseNingizimu Afrika (i-SARS) kanye nemingenelelo yesikhathi esifushane eyisihlanu esanda kumenyezelwa, konke kugcwalisa Uhlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuguquka kwezinto engcebweni yethu yezomnotho.

src: Ukwanda kwerhafu eqokelelweyo ngabakwa-SARS kuza kongeza ukwenza ukuba uRhulumente anikezele iinkonzo eziza kuphucula umgangatho wobomi babo bonke abemi beli.
tgt: Ukuqoqwa kwezimali okukhuphukile ngu-SARS kuzophinda kwenze uHulumeni akwazi ukuhambisa izinsizakalo ezizokwenza ngcono izinga lezimpilo zazo zonke izakhamuzi zakhe.3 IKhabhinethi iyasamukela isimemezelo sesikhungo sezokuklelisa, esibizwa ngokuthi yi-Moody’s Investor Services, esiqinisekise kabusha esontweni eledlule ukukleliswa kwezwe kwezezikweletu ngamaphuzu amabili ngaphezu kwezinga lotshalomali olungaphansi.

src: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isibhengezo esenziwe yi-arhente yokuhlela, iMoody’s Investor Services, ethe kwezi veki zimbini zidlulileyo yaphinda yaliqinisekisa inqanaba eli lizwe elibekwa kulo kwezoqoqosho engamanqanaba amabini ngaphezulu kwenqanaba elilelona liphantsi nelamnkelekileyo kubatyali-zimali.
tgt: Ngokuqinisekisa lokhu kukleliswa, i-Moody’s ikuqaphelile ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isifinyelela ekuguquleni izinto emva kweminyaka eminingi yokukhula okuntekenteke kwezomnotho kanti-ke nezinyathelo zokuhlanganiswa ezinesankahlu kwisabelomali sowezi-2016 zizozinzisa isikweletu sikahulumeni Kwisamba Somkhiqizo Wezwe (i-GDP) onyakeni esikuwona.

src: Ekungqineni eli nqanaba, abakwaMoody’s baphawule okokuba uMzantsi Afrika uya uyiguqula imeko emva kweminyaka yohlumo olubuthathaka kwaye amanyathelo okuhlengahlengisa nokomeleza uqoqosho owama-2016 aza komeleza ityala likarhulumente kwiSambuku seMveliso yeLizwe (i-GDP) kulo nyaka.
tgt: Zonke izinhlangothi ziyavumelana ukuthi imizamo ehlanganyelwe kudingeka iqiniswe ukufaka ugqozi ekusimameni komnotho.

src: Sikwaqaphela ukuba umsebenzi woMphathiswa wezeMali kunye namahlakani ezentlalo ukwaquka umsebenzi oluthotho wohlolo lwemali ilizwe elinayo oza kuchonga uhlaziyo olunokwenziwa nongenelelo lokugcina urhwebo olomeleleyo lwemali eyinkunzi yaseMzantsi Afrika nomlinganiselo wohlolo lwemali yotyalo-mali.4 UMongameli uyazibulela iiVoti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali ezenziwa ngabaPhathiswa ngokwahlukeneyo nezithi zihlangabezane neemfuno zabo bonke abemi baseMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: Siyaqaphela futhi ukuthi umsebenzi kaNgqongqoshe Wezezimali kanye nabalingani bezokuhlalisana ubandakanya ithimba labasebenzi bezokukleliswa kwezezikweletu elizohlonza izinguquko ezinokwenzeka kanye nezinyathelo zokugenelela ukuze kulondolozwe izimakethe zezimali eziqinile kanye nokukleliswa kwezezikweletu kwezinga lotshalomali.4 UMongameli uyazincoma Izinkulumo Zevoti Zezabiwomali ezenziwe ngoNgqongqoshe abahlukene ezibhekana nezidingo zabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Iingxelo zenkqubela nezicwangciso eziphuma kwezi Voti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali zamaSebe zibonakalisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika usisizwe esisebenzayo, apho urhulumente akhokelayo khona, ekwakheni ubomi obungcono kumntu wonke.
tgt: Imibiko yenqubekelaphambili kanye nezinhlelo ezisuselwa Ezinkulumweni Zevoti Zezabiwomali Zeminyango kubonisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyisizwe esiphezu komsebenzi, nalapho uhulumeni ezihola phambili, ekwakheni impilo engcono yawo wonke umuntu.

src: Kumiselwe amanyathelo aluqilima ukunciphisa impembelelo embi yokudodobala koqoqosho ehlabathini jikelele kuqoqosho lweli lizwe, nokulungiselela uhlumo lwezoqoqoqsho oludlamkileyo xa uqoqosho seluguquke lwathembisa.
tgt: Izinyathelo ezibambekayo sezenziwe ukunciphisa umthelela ongemuhle wokuwohloka kwamandla emali emhlabeni wonke kwezomnotho wethu, kanye nokulungiselela ukukhula ngomfutho lapho umjikelezo wezomnotho usushintsha uba muhle.

src: Sikwasebenza ngamandla ukususa imiqobo yalapha ekhaya kwezohlumo.
tgt: Sisebenza kanzima futhi ukususa izithiyo zokukhula ezikhona lapha ngaphakathi ezweni.

src: Ezi voti zohlahlo lwabiwo-mali zikwabonakalisa ukuba urhulumente, imibutho yabasebenzi nabezoshishino basebenzisana, kakhulu kunangaphambili, ukufumanisa ngeendlela zokuvuselela uhlumo nokwakha ubomi obungcono kumntu wonke.
tgt: Izinkulumo zevoti zezabiwomali ziphinde zibonise ukuthi uhulumeni, abasebenzi kanye nabamabhizinisi basebenza ndawonye, ukudlula zonke ezinye izikhathi, ukuthola izindlela zokuphemba kabusha ukukhula kanye nokwakha impilo engcono yawo wonke umuntu.

src: Oku kuquka ukufezekiswa ngamandla kwesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba, esathi sabhengezwa nguMongameli uJacob Zuma kwiNtetho engoBume beSizwe yowama-2015 kwakunye nephulo i-Operation Phakisa, elamiselwa ukukhawulezisa ukufezekiswa kwezisombululo kwimimandla apho uphuhliso ludingeka ngamandla khona.
tgt: Lokhu kubandakanya ukuqaliswa ukusebenza okunomdlandla koHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye, olwamenyezelwa nguMongameli u-Jacob Zuma Enkulumweni Echaza Isimo Sezwe yowezi-2015 kanjalo ne-Operation Phakisa, eyasungulelwa ukusheshisa ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwezisombululo ezindaweni ezibucayi zentuthuko.

src: Ezi nkqubo zihlangabezana nemiba ebaluleke kakhulu kwisiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP), efana nokuncitshiswa kwendlala nentswela-ngqesho.5 IKhabhinethi iqinisekisa kwakhona abemi baseMzantsi Afrika ukuba iimeko yentswela-ngqesho kweli lizwe kuhlangatyezwana nayo ngokufezekiswa kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP) seli lizwe, ngongenelelo lwezoqoqosho lwesiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba esenzelwe ukuvuselela uhlumo size sikhulise imisebenzi kumacandelo angundoqoqo kuqoqosho lwethu.
tgt: Lezi zinhlelo zibhekana nezinkinga ezibucayi ezivela oHlelweni Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP), ezinjengokunciphisa ubuphofu kanye nokusweleka kwamathuba omsebenzi.5 IKhabhinethi iqinisekisa abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuthi isimo sezwe sokusweleka kwamathuba emisebenzi kuyabhekanwa naso ngokuqaliswa ukusebenza kwe-NDP ngokusebenzisa ukungenelela kwezomnotho koHlelo Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye okufuna ukuphemba kabusha ukukhula kanye nokuthuthukisa imisebenzi emikhakheni esemqoka yezomnotho wethu.

src: Intsebenziswano yecandelo lezoshishino labucala ibaluleke kakhulu ukuze kufumaneke iziphumo ezihle.
tgt: Ukusebenzisana komkhakha ozimele kusemqoka ukuze kutholakale umphumela onempumelelo.

src: Urhulumente usebenzisa onke amaphulo akhoyo kuquka nesiCwangciso sokuSebenza koMgaqo-nkqubo wezoShishino (i-IPAP) ukudala iimveliso eziza kuthatha abasebenzi abongezelelekileyo namacandelo eenkonzo ukuhlangabezana nentswela-ngqesho ethe yaphinda yongezwa bubunzima beemeko zezoqoqosho zehlabathi jikelele nezalapha ekhaya.
tgt: Uhulumeni usebenzisa zonke izinhlelo eziqanjwe kabusha ezikhona kubandakanya noHlelo lwakhe Lokusebenzisa Inqubomgomo Yezezimboni (i-IPAP) ukusungula imikhiqizo eminingi eqasha abasebenzi ngokugcwele futhi esebenzela imikhakha ukuze ibhekane nokusweleka kwamathuba emisebenzi okubuye kwathelelwa kabi izimo ezinzima zezomnotho zalapha ekhaya nezomhlaba wonke.

src: UMphathiswa wezoRhwebo noShishino uRob Davies umisele owesibhozo umfuziselo wonyaka we-IPAP2016/17 ukuya kowama-2018-19 ngomhla we-9 kuCanzibe wowama-2016 kwinkampani yokunyibilikisa isinyithi negilasi enabanikazi abaNtsundu ngokupheleleyo eGauteng.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezohwebo Nezezimboni, u-Rob Davies wethule isibuyekezo sesishiyagalombili sonyaka se-IPAP yowezi-2016/17 kuya kowezi-2018-19 ngomhla ziyi-9 Nhlaba 2016 ngo-100% wemikhiqizo ephethwe ngabantu abamnyama kanye nendawo yokubunjwa kwensimbi eGauteng.

src: Urhulumente ugxininisa ukubaluleka kokwakhiwa kwentsebenziswano emandla neenkampani zezoshishino zalapha ekhaya ezigqwesileyo nezisebenzisa ubuchule bale mihla ezingabandakanyeki nje kuphuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo, ezothutho nezolungiselelo kodwa zibandakanyeke kuthotho lwezinto zobuchwepheshe ezinzima, ezilungele ukuthunyelwa kumazwe angaphandle necandelo elifuna kakhulu abasebenzi loqoqosho laseMzantsi Afrika liphela.
tgt: Uhulumeni ugcizelela ukubaluleka kokusungula ukusebenzisana ndawonye kanye nezinkampani zezezimboni zangaphakathi ezweni ezinobuchule ezingabandakanyiwe kuphela nje ekuthuthukisweni kwengqalasizinda, kwezokuthutha kanye nokuhanjiswa kwezimpahla, kodwa ezibandakanywe emikhakheni enhlobonhlobo yezobuchwepheshe obuphucukile, yezimpahla ezilungele ukuthengiswa emazweni angaphandle kanye negxile kubasebenzi yezomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika ngobubanzi.

src: Ngeli xesha uPhando olungabaSebenzi lweKota ebelwenziwe kwikota yokuqala yowama-2016 lubonakalise ukwanda kwintswela-ngqesho okufikelela kuma-26.7% ngokwekota nekota, ngowama-2016 izinga lemisebenzi linyuke ngama-204 000 ekuqesheni abantu xa lithelekiswa nekota yokuqala yowama-20.6 IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukunikezelwa kweZiko loLutsha laseBhobhofolo eNtshona Koloni nguMongameli uJacob Zuma, elibonelela ulutsha ngoncedo lobuchule, apho lunokuzixhobisa.
tgt: Nakuba Ucwaningo Lwekota Lezabasebenzi lwekota yokuqala yowezi-2016 luqophe ukukhuphuka emathubeni omsebenzi kuya kuma.7% ekota ngekota, amazinga amathuba emisebenzi ezi-2016 aphezulu ngezi-204 000 zabantu abaqashiwe uma eqhathaniswa nekota yokuqala yowezi-20.6 IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukunikezelwa Kwesilulu Sentsha sase-Beaufort West, eNtshonalanga Kapa nguMongameli uJacob Zuma, esihlinzeka ngesikhungo entsheni, lapho ingakwazi khona ukuzisimamisa.

src: Eli Ziko lineendidi ngeendidi zoncedo lobuchule olubonelela ngophuhliso olugabalala lwabantu abatsha noluntu ngokubanzi.
tgt: Isilulu sinengxube yezikhungo ezihlinzeka ngokuthuthukiswa okuphelele kwabantu abasha kanye nomphakathi ngobubanzi.

src: Olu ncedo lobuchule lukhoyo kweli ziko lolutsha luza kubonelela abantu abatsha abasuka kuluntu oluhluphekileyo ngamathuba okuthatha ngcono inxaxheba nokwenza igalelo elihle kuluntu lwalo nakwilizwe.
tgt: Izikhungo ezitholakalayo kulesi silulu sentsha zizohlinzeka abantu abasha abavela emiphakathini ehluphekayo ngamathuba okuthi babambe iqhaza kangcono futhi babe negalelo elihle emiphakathini yabo kanye nasezweni.

src: IZiko lezaKhono elixhotyiswe ngokupheleleyo neliqhutywa yiKholeji yaseMzantsi Koloni iza kubonelela ngoqeqesho kulawulo lwezoshishino, ukusebenzisa ikhompyutha nophuhliso lwabantwana abazintsana ukuya kutsho kubathathi-nxaxheba abangama-200 beQela leNkonzo yoManyano lwamaShishini oLutsha lwaseMaphandleni leSizwe (i-NARYSEC) ngonyaka.
tgt: Isikhungo Samakhono esinazo zonke izinsiza esisetshenziswa yi-South Cape College sizohlinzeka ngokuqeqeshwa ekuphathweni kwamabhizinisi, ukusebenzisa ikhompuyutha kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwabantwana kusenesikhathi kubabambiqhaza abangama-200 boMbutho Kazwelonke Wemisebenzi Yentsha Yasemakhaya (i-NARYSEC) ngonyaka ngamunye.

src: I-NARYSEC yinkqubo yexesha elide apho igxile, ikwagaya ulutsha lwasemaphandleni kuphela nenesivumelwano sexesha leminyaka emibini.
tgt: I-NARYSEC iwuhlelo lwesikhathi eside lapho kuhloswe khona intsha yasemakhaya kuphela, iqashwa khona bese inikwa inkontileka yeminyaka emibili.

src: Kugaywa ulutsha oluminyaka iphakathi kwe-18 nama-25 ubudala luze lubhaliselwe uqeqesho kwizakhono ezahlukahlukeneyo eziza kuluxhobisa ngokufanayo kulwazi ngeengcingane nangokuphathwayo ukudala imisebenzi okanye bona ngokwabo nabanye abantu badale imisebenzi kuluntu lwabo.
tgt: Intsha eneminyaka yobudala ephakathi kweyi-18 nama-25 iyaqokwa bese ibhaliselwa ukuqeqeshelwa amakhono anhlobonhlobo azoyihlomisa, ngolwazi olucatshangwayo kanye noluphathekayo, ukuze izisungulele yona amathuba emisebenzi kanye nabanye abantu emiphakathini yabo.

src: Eli Ziko loLutsha luyiprojekthi esaLingwayo kwaye iyeyokuqala elolu hlobo kwaye liza kudluliselwa kwamanye amaphondo.7 Khabhinethi iyayamkela iNtlanganiso yoMmandla we-Afrika yoBudlelwane bobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo yowama-2016 ebibanjwe phantsi komxholo othi “UbuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo boPhuhliso obuZinzileyo e-Afrika” ukususela ngomhla we-5 ukuya kowe-6 kuCanzibe wowama-2016.Le ndibano iza emva kweenyanga ezisixhenxe uMzantsi Afrika wathi waba nguSihlalo oKhokelayo woBudlelwane bobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo.
tgt: Lesi Silulu Sentsha siwumklamo Wokuzwa Amanzi Ngobhoko futhi ongowokuqala walolu hlobo, futhi uzosatshalaliswa kwezinye izifundazwe.7 IKhabhinethi iyawamukela Umhlangano Wesifunda sase-Afrika Wokubambisana Kohulumeni Okuvulekile (i-OGP) wezi-2016 owawusingethwe yiNingizimu Afrika kusukela mhla ziyi-5 kuya ziyi-6 Nhlaba 2016 ngaphansi kwendikimba ethi "Uhulumeni Ovulekile Wentuthuko Eqinile Neqhubekayo e-Afrika".Lo mbuthano uza emva kwezinyanga eziyisikhombisa emva kokuba iNingizimu Afrika yaba nguSihlalo Oholayo Wokubambisana Kohulumeni Okuvulekile.

src: Imigomo yoburhulumente obuvulelekileyo ibaluleke kakhulu ekuphumezeni uludwe olubanzi lweenjongo eziphambili zophuhliso oluzinzileyo, ukuqhagamshelanisa okuvulekileyo kulawulo loorhulumente ukwenzela ukuphuculwa kwabahlelelekileyo nabahluphekileyo ehlabathini jikelele.
tgt: Imigomo kahulumeni ovulekile isemqoka ekufezekiseni izinjongo zentuthuko eqinile ezibanzi nezihlukehlukene, nezixhumanisa ukuvuleleka ekubuseni ukuze kwenziwe ngcono labo abantekenteke nabahlwempu emhlabeni wonke.

src: UBudlelwane bobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo nobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo bukwangundoqo ekuncedeni uluntu lwehlabathi ukuba lukwazi ukuphumeza i-Ajenda yowama-2030 yoPhuhliso oluZinzileyo.
tgt: Ukubambisana Kohulumeni Okuvulekile kanye Nohulumeni Ovulekile kuphinde kube isivumeli esisemqoka esizosiza umphakathi wasemhlabeni jikelele ukuba ufezekise i-Ajenda yowezi-2030 Yentuthuko Eqinile Neqhubekayo.

src: Le Ngqungquthela yoMmandla ibe yeyona inkulu kwiingqungquthela zoMmandla zoBudlelwane bobuRhulumente obuVulelekileyo (i-OGP) kwezakhe zaququzelelwa yi-OGP eneziphumo ezincomeka kakhulu kwisigaba ngasinye yade yayokuphela le ngqungquthela.
tgt: Lo Mhlangano Wezifunda ube ngumhlangano Wezifunda omkhulu kunayo yonke Wokubambisana Kohulumeni Okuvulekile (i-OGP) owake wahlelwa yi-OGP obe nemiphumela ebambekayo ebivela kwisiqubu ngasinye somhlangano kwaze kwaba inkomfa iyophela.

src: Ukugcina isibophelelo sikarhulumente kubudlelwane nolawulo lukarhulumente olungcono, le ngqungquthela ibe nomtsalane kubathathi-nxaxheba abavela kwiMibutho yoLuntu (i-CSO) evela ehlabathini jikelele emilisele kuluntu olukumacandelo awohlukahlukeneyo olungaphandle kwe-CSO yesiqhelo esoloko iyinxalenye yobu budlelwane.
tgt: Ngokuhambisana nesibophezelo sohulumeni sokubambisana kanye nokuphatha okuhle, lo mhlangano uhehe ababambiqhaza abavela Ezinhlanganweni Zemiphakathi (ama-CSO) ezihlukahlukene emhlabeni wonke ezigxile nezizinze emiphakathini kuyo yonke imikhakha enhlobonhlobo engaphandle kwama-CSO ajwayelekile abehlala njalo eyingxenye yokubambisana.8 IKhabhinethi iyakuqaphela ukugunyazwa kokuhlangana kwezinkampani ezintathu zeziphuzo ezisemabhodleleni ukwakha inkampani yeziphuzo zamabhodlela enkulukazi ezwenikazi, i-Coca-Cola Beverages Africa.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukwamkelwa kwesivumelwano sokudibanisa amaziko amathathu kutha ebhotileni ukwenza elona ziko lokutha ebhotileni lakwaCoca- Cola Beverages Africa lakhe lasikhulu kweli lizwekazi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyasamukela isivumelwano maqondana nezimo zezimfuno zomphakathi mayelana nokuhlangana phakathi kukahulumeni kanye ne-Coca-Cola Beverages Afrika okuwuhlangana kwezinhlangothi ezinkulu okungeseka imizamo yethu yokuba nezimboni ezinkulu emnothweni waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isivumelwano kwiimeko zeemfuno zoluntu kule ndibanisela phakathi kukarhulumente kunye noCoca-Cola Beverages Africa amaqela endibanisela anokuxhasa amalinge wethu wokuvulwa kwemizi-mveliso okukhulu kuqoqosho lwaseMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: Isivumelwano sivikela amazinga okuqashwa ngokugcwele enkampanini isikhathi esiyiminyaka emithathu, sivikela abasebenzi abasophikweni lwezingxoxo zamaholo ekudilizweni emsebenzini ngezizathu ezihlobene nokuhlangana kwezinkampani, siseka uchungechunge lokuphakelwa kwempahla lwalapha ngaphakathi ezweni futhi siyazibophezela ukuthuthukisa abalimi ababekhishwe inyumbazane ngaphambilini kanye nabaphakeli bempahla enkampanini.

src: Esi sivumelwano sisikhuselo sabo bakwinqanaba lengqesho ekumyinge ophakathi kule nkampani ixesha elingangeminyaka emithathu sikhusela abasebenzi abakwinqanaba elisezantsi ukuba bangabi ngamaxhoba okudendwa okuhambelana nendibanisela, sixhasa ukusetyenziswa kwezinto zasekhaya kwinkqubo yokuthenga nokuthengisa nokuzibophelela ekuphuhliseni amafama aye sakuhleleleka nababoneleli-zinkonzo kule nkampani.
tgt: Ngaphezu kwalokho, izigidi ezingama-400 zamarandi seziboshezelwe ukuxhasa ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi asochungechungeni lokuphakelwa kwempahla yezolimo kanti ezinye izigidi ezingama-400 zamarandi zikhuphule utshalomali ukuze kuthuthukiswe ukusatshalaliswa kwempahla iya emazingeni aphansi kanye namandla amabhizinisi ahlobene nokuthuthukiswa kwamakhono kanye nokuqeqesha.

src: Imveliso ye-Appletiser esele isaziwa kakhulu iseza kuqhubeka iveliswa eMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: Umkhiqizo oyingqayizivele we-Appletiser uzoqhubeka nokukhiqizwa eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Esi sivumelwano sivulela indawo kwizikhenkcezi zakwaCoca-Cola kwiivenkile ezincinci: indawo eyi-10% ingasetyenziselwa ukufaka iimveliso ezikwafanayo ezivela kwivenkile ethengisa ngemiyinge emincinci kweli candelo leevenkile apho kukho khona izikhenkcezi zakwaCoca-Cola.
tgt: Isivumelwano sivulela isikhala sokufaka efrijini eziqandisini eziphethwe noma eziphakelwe ngu-Coca-Cola emabhizinisini amancane: i-10% yesikhala sokufaka efrijini sizotholakala ukufaka imikhiqizo eyizimbangi evela kubakhiqizi abancane ezitolo ezinkulu lapho kuneziqandisi eziphakelwe ngu-Coca-Cola kuphela ezitholakalayo.

src: Oku kuvulela urhwebo kwinkampani ezintsha kunye neenkampani ezincinci zokutha ezibhotileni, ukuncedisa ukuphepha imimiselo yezoshishino enemiqathango ethintelayo nethi igcine amashishini amancinci naphakathi engaphandle korhweboUkongeza apho, utyalo-mali lwexesha elide lale nkampani kuphuhliso lwezoqosho nolwezentlalo kweli lizwe liza kuxhotyiswa ngokumiselwa kondlunkulu wequmrhu lendibaniselwano eMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: Lokhu kuvulela imakethe kubhizinisi amasha kanye nabakhiqizi abancane beziphuzo ezisemabhodleleni, okusiza ukugwema imisebenzi yebhizinisi enemikhawulo egcina amabhizinisi amancane naphakathi nendawo evaleleke ngaphandle kwemakethe.

src: Esi sivumelwano silandela isivumelwano sakutsha nje esikwafanayo ekungenwe kuso nabakwa-Annhauser Beush In Bevrelating sokuthenga i-SAB Miller.
tgt: Ngaphezu kwalokho, utshalomali lwesikhathi eside lwenkampani ekuthuthukisweni kwezomnotho kanye nenhlalakahle yezwe luzothuthukiswa ngokusungulwa kwamahhovisi akomkhulu enkampani ehlanganisiwe eNingizimu Afrika.

src: Ingakumbi, ekugxininiseni kwaso ingqesho, ukuthandwa kwezinto zalapha ekhaya nophuhliso lwamashishini amancinci, ezi zivumelwano zibalula ukubaluleka kokulinganiswa kweendibaniselwano zezoshishino kunye nemiba yokubaluleka kweemfuno zoluntu kunye noluhlu lwemigangatho yeenkampani ezisaceba ukwenza okanye ukufumana iindibaniselwano ezikumila kunje.
tgt: Isivumelwano silandela esinye isivumelwano sakamuva esifana naso okungenwe kuso kanye ne-Annhauser Beush InBev esihlobene nokuthengwa kwe-SAB Miller.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukumiselwa kweziko elixabise izigidi ezingama-350 zeerandi sokutha ebhotileni ngabakwa--Mpact Polymers besebenzisana nabakwaCoca-Cola.
tgt: Ngokukhethekile, ekugcizeleleni kwabo maqondana namathuba omsebenzi, ukuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi alapha ngaphakathi ezweni kanye nokuthuthukiswa kwamabhizinisi amancane, lezi zivumelwano zikhomba ukubaluleka kokubhalansisa ukuhlangana kwamabhizinisi kanye nezinkinga zezimfuno zomphakathi bese zibeka izinga okumele ligcinwe yizinkampani ezicabanga ukwenza ukuhlangana okufanayo noma ukuthenga ezinye izinkampani.9 IKhabhinethi ikuqaphelile ukwethulwa kwenkampani yamabhodlela ebiza izigidi ezingama-350 zamarandi yi-Mpact Polymers ngokubambisana no-Coca-Cola.

src: Eli phulo liyimpendulo kwinkqubo-sikhokelo kaRhulumente esemthethweni lisebenza ngenjongo ephambili yesiCwangciso-qhinga soLawulo lweNkunkuma lweMicimbi yezokusiNgqongileyo yeSizwe ukukhuthaza amashishini amancinane ukuba asebenzise kwakhona imveliso esele isetyenzisiwe ukuze isetyenziswe kwakhona.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luphendula ohlakeni lokusebenza lezomthetho lukaHulumeni olusebenzisa injongo yeQhinga Lokuphathwa Kwemfucuza Kazwelonke Yomnyango Wezemvelo yokukhuthaza amabhizinisi okusebenzisa kabusha izinto esezisetshenzisiwe.

src: Esi sikhululo sesokuqala ezilolu hlobo kwilizwekazi le-Afrika lijike ama-29 000 eetoni (i-polthylene terephthalate) iibhotile ezophukileyo ze-PET nokonga okuthelekelelwa kwi-186 000 zeetyhubhiki-mitha zesithuba ezigcwalise umhlaba kwaye siza kuba negalelo ekunciphiseni ukukhutshwa komoya ongcolileyo (i-CO2) omalunga nama-53 000 eetoni ngonyaka.
tgt: Le nkampani ingeyokuqala ngqa yalolu hlobo ezwenikazi lase-Afrika eguqula amathani ayizi-29 000 (e-polyethylene terephthalate) amabhodlela asesetshenzisiwe e-PET okunesilinganiso esiqaguliwe sokonga amamitha aphindwe kathathu ayizi-186 000 endawo yokulahla udoti futhi kuzoba negalelo ekuncishisweni kwezintuthu zomoya ongcolile (i-CO2) ngamathani abalelwa ezi-53 000 ngonyaka ngamunye.

src: IQumrhu loPhuhliso lwamaShishini (i-IDC) ibonelele ngoncedo lwemali-mboleko ezizigidi ezingama-210 zeerandi kwakunye nezigidi ezingama-30 zeerandi ukwenzela izabelo zenzala yayo engama-21% laza iSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino labonelela ngembuyekezo yerhafu yeCandelo le-12(1).
tgt: Inhlangano Yokuthuthukiswa Kwezimboni (i-IDC) ihlinzeke ngemalimboleko yezigidi ezingama-210 zamarandi kanjalo nezigidi ezingama-30 zamarandi ngo-21% wayo wezokulingana kanti futhi noMnyango Wezohwebo Nezezimboni unikezele ngesigaba 12(I) somthobanhliziyo wentela.

src: Isikhululo sokusebenzisa kwakhona imveliso esele isetyenzisiwe ukuze isetyenziswe kwakhona sibonelela ngemisebenzi kubasebenzi abangama-80 kunye nemisebenzi eli-1000 kubaqokeleli benkunkuma.
tgt: Inkampani esebenzisa kabusha osekulahliwe ihlinzeka ngemisebenzi kubasebenzi abangama-80 kanye nemisebenzi eyi-1 000 kubantu abaqoqa imfucuza.

src: Ubudlelwane obufana nobu yinjini ebalulekileyo kuhlumo lwezoqoqosho, ukudala amawaka-waka emisebenzi kuqoqosho lokusebenzisa kwakhona imveliso esele isetyenzisiwe ukuze isetyenziswe kwakhona exabisa malunga nama-R50 eebhiliyoni.
tgt: Ukubambisana okufana nalokhu kuyinjini esemqoka yokukhula komnotho, kusungula izinkulungwane zemisebenzi emnothweni wokusebenzisa kabusha osekulahliwe onengcebo ebalelwa ezigidigidini ezingama-50 zamarandi.

src: Sithetha nje, ukuveliswa ngokutsha kweplastiki eseyisebenzile kubonelela abaqokeleli bayo ngamathuba engeniso angaphezulu kwama-60 000.
tgt: Njengamanje, ukusetshenziswa kabusha koplastiki asebelahliwe kukodwa nje kuhlinzeka ngamathuba emali engenayo kubantu ababutha imfucuza abangaphezu kwama-60 000.

src: Isikhululo sokuvelisa ngokutsha imveliso eseyisebenzile sakwa-Mpact Polymer esikumgangatho wehlabathi, sihambelana nemigaqo yokhuselo lokutya yeManyano yaMazwe ase-Yurobhu (i-EU) kwaye ngumzi-mveliso wokuqala ololu hlobo e-Afrika kwaye ukwafikelela kwemimiselo yokuqinisekiswa yakwaCoca-Cola yeebhotile ze-PET.10 IKhabhinethi iyayamkela ingxelo yesiCwangciso-qhinga esiDibeneyo soLawulo lweMikhombe esiubonakalise ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ukulwa ngempumelelo ukuzingelwa kwemikhombe ngokungekho mthethweni.
tgt: I-Mpact Polymers, inkampani esebenzisa kabusha osekulahliwe esezingeni lomhlaba iyahambelana nemibandela yezokuphepha kokudla ye-EU njengoba iyifektri yokuqala yalolu hlobo e-Afrika futhi iphinde ihlangabezane nomgomo wokugunyazwa ngokugcwele we-Coca-Cola wamabhodlela e-PET.10 IKhabhinethi iyawamukela umbiko wokuphendula maqondana Nokuphathwa Ngobuqhinga Obudidiyelwe Kobhejane osekukhombisile ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isinqobile ekugcineni maqondana nokuzingelwa kobhejane ngokungemthetho.

src: Ukususela ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka kuphela kubanjwe abatyholwa ngokuzingela imikhombe ngokungekhomthethweni abangama-206.Indlela yokuHlangabezana nesiCwangciso-qhinga soLawulo oluDibeneyo yamkelwa yiKhabhinethi kwinyanga yeThupha yowama-2014 nokwakhokelela ekubeni iNtlanganisela yoKhuselo iphumeze amanyathelo okungenelela azindidi ezahlukeneyo, nolwamacandelo ahlukeneyo ukukhusela imikhombe eMzantsi Afrika.11 IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana neli lizwe ngokusingatha ngokuyimpumelelo iNgqungquthela yezoKhenketho yowama-2016 eDurban kwiphondo laKwaZulu-Natal, nethe yaqukunjelwa ngoMvulo umhla we-9 kuCanzibe wowama-2016 neqela lokubandakanyeka olube yimpumelelo phakathi kwababonisi abali-1 047 abavela kumazwe ase-Afrika ali-18 kunye nabathengi abali-1 856 abavela ehlabathini jikelele.
tgt: Kusukela kuqale lo nyaka nje kuphela abantu abazingela obhejane ngokungemthetho abangama-206 sebeboshiwe.

src: Kulo nyaka, Ie Ngqungquthela ibambe iintlanganiso ezingama-3 000 ngaphezulu kunakulonyaka uphelileyo.
tgt: Indlela Yokusebenza Yokuphathwa Ngobuqhinga Obudidiyelwe yamukelwa yiKhabhinethi ngoNcwaba wezi-2014 neyabonisa Umkhakha Wezokuvikela uqalisa ukusebenza ukungenelela okumfundiso-ningi nokumkhakha-ningi ukuvikela obhejane eNingizimu Afrika.11 IKhabhinethi ihalalisele izwe ngokusingatha ngempumelelo i-Tourism Indaba yowezi-2016 e-Durban KwaZulu-Natali, ephethwe ngoMsombuluko, mhla ziyi-9 Nhlaba 2016 ebe nezingxoxo ezimbalwa eziyimpumelelo phakathi kwababukisi abayi-1 047 abavela emazweni ase-Afrika ayi-18 kanye nabathengi abayi-1 856 abavela emhlabeni wonke.

src: Ziintlanganiso zezoshishino ezingama-14 000 ezithe zahlala zizonke kwezi ntsuku zintathu zale Ngqungquthela, zinikeza ithemba lokuxhamla kuqoqosho oluncomekayo.
tgt: Kulo nyaka, INDABA isingathe imihlangano eyizi-3 000 ngaphezu konyaka odlule.

src: Lo msitho ubukwazinyaswe nazintatheli zesizwe nezehlabathi ezingama-575.Le Ngqungquthela igxile kumashishini amancinci aphakathi nakhulayo (ii-SMME) ebonisa ngeemveliso neenkonzo zamashishini ehambo amancinci athembisayo.
tgt: Sekukonke imihlangano yamabhizinisi eyizi-14 000 ebanjiwe ezinsukwini ezintathu ze-INDABA, eveze ithuba eliyingqayizivele lomhlomulo wezomnotho.

src: ngamashishini amancinci angama-70 axhamle kwiintlanganiso zocweyo zokuba angafikelela njani kurhwebo lentengiso ukuze akhule.
tgt: Lo mcimbi ubuhanjelwe yizintatheli ezingama-575 zalapha ekhaya kanye nezangaphandle.

src: Ii-SMME zinamandla okuba ngamashishini amakhulu.
tgt: INDABA ibigxile ekutheni osomabhizinisi bemboni abancane, abaphakathi nendawo nabakhulu (ama-SMME) babukise ngemikhiqizo yabo kanye nezinsizakalo kosomabhizinisi abancane bezokuvakasha abathembisayo.

src: Le Ngqungquthela iyomelezile indima edlalwa zi-SMME kuphuhliso loqoqosho lamazwe aphuhlileyo nasaphuhlayo, ekukhuliseni icandelo lezokhenketho.
tgt: Amabhizinisi angama-70 ahlomulile emihlanganweni yokucobelelana ngolwazi maqondana nokuthi ungayifinyelela kanjani imakethe – bese uyakhula.

src: Ukuveza amandla ee-SMME yenye yeendlela ezibaluleke kakhulu ekuveliseni imisebenzi kwisiCwangciso esimaNqaku aliThoba eza kukhulisa ize iguqule uqoqosho idale nemisebenzi.
tgt: Ama-SMME anamathuba okuba ngamabhizinisi amakhulu.

src: IKhabhinethi ixoxe ngokufezekiswa kwezindululo zeKhomishini yeNyani noXolelwaniso (i-TRC) nezinye iindlela ezicetyisiweyo zokufezekiswa kweeProjekthi zokuBuyiselwa koLuntu kwiMo yesiQhelo.
tgt: INDABA iqinise indima ama-SMME ayidlalayo ekuthuthukisweni komnotho wamazwe asethuthukile kanye nasathuthuka, ekukhuliseni umkhakha wezokuvakasha.

src: UkuQondwa kweeProjekthi zokuBuyiselwa koLuntu kwiMo yesiQhelo zilungisa intswela-bulungisa yangaphambili ngokubuyiselwa kwemo yesiqhelo kwiindawo zoluntu ezili-128 ezazingamaxhoba ezenzo zobundlobongela nokutshatyalaliswa ngexesha longquzulwano (ukususela kumhla woku-1 kweyoKwindla yowe-1960 ukuya kowe-10 kuCanzibe wowe-1994).ISebe lezobuLungisa noPhuhliso loMgaqo-siseko liza kucela amagalelo avela kubadlali-ndima ababalulekileyo abachaphezelekayo (kurhulumente nakwabezoshishino labucala) khona ukuze kufumaneke imithombo eyaneleyo yokuzisa ungenelelo olupheleleyo kwezi ndawo zoluntu zili-128, nezathi zachazwa yi-TRC ngokwetyala ngalinye elinokwahluka ngokwexabiso kodwa ukuya kutsho kwelona xabiso liphezulu liyimali engama-30 ezigidi zeerandi.
tgt: Ukuthukulula amathuba ama-SMME kungomunye wemibhidlango esemqoka yemisebenzi oHlelweni Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye oluzokhulisa futhi luguqule umnotho bese lusungula amathuba emisebenzi.

src: Oku kuza kuqinisekisa ukuba iiProjekthi zinokwenzeka kwaye zizinzile khona ukuze kufezekiswe iminqweno yoluntuOku kunegalelo ekufezekisweni kwesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso (i-NDP) ngokwandisa intlalo-ntle nomanyano, ukulungisa ukungalingani kwangaphambili nokufezekiswa kombuso ophuhlayo, onakho nonenkathalo ophatha abemi ngesidima.2 IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziphumo zeNgqungquthela yonxibelelwano lukanomathotholo yeHlabathi (i-WRC-15) ebibanjwe ukususela ngomhla wesi-2 ukuya kowama-27 kweyeNkanga yowama-2015 eGeneva, eSwitzerland.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idingide ukuqaliswa ukusebenza kwezincomo zeKhomishana Yamaqiniso Nokubuyisana (i-TRC) futhi yahlongoza nezindlela zokuqaliswa ukusebenza Kwemiklamo Yokuhlunyeleliswa Komphakathi.

src: UMzantsi Afrika ubukhokela iQela lase-Afrika kuthethathethwano olukhokelele ekubeni lo mmandla ufumane ububanzi obongezelelweyo bamaza othungelwano lweminxeba ephathwayo kwaye i-Afrika ikwazile ukukhusela ububanzi baseMzantsi be-UHF boomabonakude bedijithali behlabathi jikelele.
tgt: Ukufezekiswa Kwemiklamo Yokuhlunyeleliswa Komphakathi kuzolungisa ukungalingani kwasemandulo ngokuhlunyeleliswa kwemiphakathi eyi-128 eyayivuleleke ezenzweni zodlame kanye nokubhidlizwa ngesikhathi sokungqubuzana (1 Ndasa 1960 -10 Nhlaba 1994).UMnyango Wezobulungiswa kanye Nokuthuthukiswa koMthethosisekelo uzocela izinkokhelo kubabambiqhaza abafanelekile (abakuhulumeni nabazimele) ukuze uzothola izinsiza ezanele zokuza nemingenelelo ephelele kule miphakathi eyi-128, ehlonzwe yi-TRC ngamunye ngamunye nokungenzeka izimo zayo zihluke ngokwenani kodwa lifinyelele enanini eliyizigidi ezingama-30 zamarandi isilinganiso esiphezulu.

src: Kunikezelwe ngobubanzi obongezelweyo ukwenzela amaza asemanzini, inqwelo-moya neenqanawa kunye neenkonzo zasesibhakabhakeni ezingena nto.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi Imiklamo iyenzeka futhi iqinile ukuze kufezekiswe amaphupho omphakathi.

src: IsiCwangciso saMaza e-Frequency eRediyo eSizwe (i-NRFP) siza kulungiswa ukuze sivelise izigqibo ze-WRC-15, neziqala ukusebenza ngomhla wo-1 kweyoMqungu yowama-2017.
tgt: Lokhu kunegalelo ekufezekisweni koHlelo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe ngokukhulisa ubumbano lomphakathi kanye nobunye, kulungise ukungalingani kwasemandulo kanye nokufezekiswa kombuso othuthukisayo, onamandla futhi onenkambiso enhle ophatha izakhamuzi zawo ngesithunzi nobuqotho.2 IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana nemiphumela yeNgqungquthela Yokuxhumana Ngomsakazo Emhlabeni (i-WRC-15) eyayibanjwe kusukela mhla zi-2 kuya mhla zingama-27 kuLwezi 2015 e-Geneva, e-Switzerland.

src: Ukwabelwa ngobubanzi ngaphakathi kwi-NRFP kuza kuququzelela izicwangciso zomsebenzi weenkonzo ezahlukeneyo ezibaluleke kakhulu ekuphumeleleni koqoqosho, ukuxhamla ngokwenkcubeko nezentlalo ngokusebenzisa ububanzi njengomthombo wendalo.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika yahola izingxoxo zeQembu lase-Afrika ezaholela ekutheni isifunda sithole umunxa owengeziwe wemisebe yezokuxhumana kamakhelekhukhwini kanti futhi i-Afrika yakwazi ukuvikela umunxa ophansi we-UHF kamabonakude osebenza ngobuxhakaxhaka bukagesi.

src: Ekuxhaseni iinjongo eziphambili zesiCwangciso seSizwe soPhuhliso, ububanzi buzakusetyenziselwa ukufezekiswa kwamaza omoya wesizwe, umabonakude wedijithali wehlabathi jikelele, unxibelelwano lwesiphekepheke esijikeleze ihlabathi (isathelaythi) nokhuseleko loluntu nomnyenyevu wentlekele, kwakunye nezinye iinkonzo.3 IKhabhinethi yazisiwe ngeziGqibo ezithathwe ngooMongameli beSizwe beNdibano yeMbumba yaMazwe ase-Afrika (i-AU) noRhulumente eRhawutini kweyeSilimela yowama-2015 ukuze ihlaziye uhlolo lwamagalelo onyaka lwaMazwe angamalungu ukususela kowama-2016, khona ukuze kuxhotyiswe amandla okuthwala iinkqubo zayo.
tgt: Uhlelo Lokuphindaphindwa Komsakazo Lukazwelonke (i-NRFP) luzovuselelwa ukukhombisa izinqumo ze-WRC-15, oluzoqala ukusebenza mhla lulu-1 Masingana 2017.

src: IKhabhinethi ikwamkele ukufezekiswa kwegalelo elitsha loMzantsi Afrika kwi-AU lokuhlola ngokuhambelana neSigqibo seNdibano yoHlolo loMlinganiselo omtsha.
tgt: Ukwabiwa komunxa ngaphakathi kwi-NRFP kuzogqugquzela izinhlelo zokujutshwa kwemisebenzi yezinsizakalo ezihlukene ezisemqoka ekuzuzeni imihlomulo yezomnotho, yamasiko kanye nezenhlalo ngokusebenzisa umunxa njengensiza yezemvelo.

src: Oku kumiliselwe kwimigomo yembumba yamanyama, intlawulo kamakulingwane kwakunye namandla okuhlawula, ngendlela eqinisekisa ukuba akukho lizwe linesabelo esingalinganiyo kuhlahlo lwabiwo-mali.
tgt: Ngokweseka izinjongo ze-NDP, umunxa uzosetshenziselwa ukusatshalaliswa kwemisebe yokuxhumana kazwelonke, umabonakude osebenza ngobuxhakaxhaka bukagesi, ukuxhumana ngesiqoqelilwazimkhathi kanye nokuvikelwa komphakathi kanye nokutakulwa ezinhlekeleleni, kanjalo nezinye izinsizakalo.3 IKhabhinethi ithiwe fahla fahla maqondana Nezinqumo ezathathwa nguMkhandlu Wezinhloko Zemibuso Yenhlangano Yobumbano lwase-Afrika (i-AU) kanye noHulumeni eGoli ngoNhlangulana wezi-2015 ukubuyekeza izinkokhelo ezihloliwe zonyaka ezenziwe yiMibuso Engamalungu kusukela ngowezi-2016, ukuze uqinise amandla awo okuqhubeka nezinhlelo zawo.

src: Imisitho ezayo.
tgt: Imicimbi ezayo.

src: Ngomhla we-19 kuCanzibe wama-2016 uMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kuqhuba uTyelelo lwasebuRhulumenteni eDoha, e-Qatar ukuyokomeleza ubudlelwane bezopolitiko nobezoqoqosho phakathi kwala mazwe mabini.
tgt: UMongameli u-Jacob Zuma uzothatha Uhambo Lokuhambela Kombuso e-Doha, e-Qatar ngomhla ziyi-19 Nhlaba 2016 ukuqinisa ubudlelwano bezepolitiki nezomnotho phakathi kwalamazwe womabili.

src: Ngomhla we-16 kuCanzibe wama-2016, uSekela Mongameli uCyril Ramaphosa, njengoMthunywa oKhethekileyo kaMongameli uJacob Zuma eSouth Sudan), uza kutyelela e-Juba.
tgt: IPhini likaMongameli u-Cyril Ramaphosa, njengeNxusa Elikhethekile likaMongameli u-Jacob Zuma e-South Sudan, lizohambela e-Juba mhla ziyi-16 Nhlaba 2016.

src: Olu suku lubaluleke kakhulu kubemi baseSouth Sudan kuba baza kube bekhumbula uSuku loMkhosi weNkululeko waBantu baseSudan, iSudan Liberation Army Day.
tgt: Lolu suku lubaluleke kakhulu kubantu base-South Sudan njengoba lusho uSuku Lombutho Wenkululeko Wabantu base-Sudan.

src: Ngexesha lolu tyelelo uSekela Mongameli uza kuhlola ukufezekiswa kwesivumelwano soxolo.
tgt: Ngesikhathi sokuhambela kwakhe iPhini likaMongameli lizoqapha ukuqaliswa ukusebenza kwesivumelwano soxolo.

src: ISouth Sudan yenze impumelelo eyimbali ekupheleni kwekaTshazimpunzi yowama-2016 ngokufungiswa kukarhulumente wethutyana wobumbano wesizwe.
tgt: Izwe lase-South Sudan lifinyelele impumelelo enkulu ekupheleni kukaMbasa wezi-2016 ngokufungiswa kukahulumeni wesikhashana wobumbano lukazwelonke.

src: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kukhokela umbhiyozo wesizwe nowoMbutho woPhuhliso wamaZwe eseMazantsi e-Afrika (i-SADC) wesiKhumbuzo seMinyaka eliKhulu yeDyunivesithi iFort Hare ngomhla wama-20 kuCanzibe wowama-2016.
tgt: UMongameli uJacob Zuma uzohola umgubho kazwelonke kanye Nowenhlangano Ethuthukisa Amazwe aseNingizimu ne-Afrika (i-SADC) Weminyaka Eyikhulu yeNyuvesi yase-Fort Hare ngomhla zingama-20 Nhlaba 2016.
