tgt: Eminye imikhakha okuzophuculwa kuyona ubambiswano ibandakanya: ezamasiko ezokuxhumana ezempilo ezesayensi nezobuchwepheshe ezemidlalo ezokuvakasha kanye nomkhakha wezindaba zabesifazane netsha.

src: IKhabhinethi idlulisa amazwi ovelwano kwiintsapho nabahlobo babantu abangama-235 abathe baphulukana nobomi babo ngenxa yeengozi zeendlela ngexesha leeholide zePasika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa amazwi enduduzo emindenini nabangani babantu abangama-235 abashone ezingozini zomgwaqo ngamaholide ePhasika.

src: Iinkcukacha-manani zeli xesha zibonakalisa ukuba ama-50% kwabo baswelekileyo ibingabahambi-ngeenyawo, kulandela abakhweli abangama-24% ize abaqhubi ibe li-19%.
tgt: Izibalo zalesi sikhathi samaholide ePhasika zibonisa ukuthi abantu abashonile abangama-50% bekungabantu abahamba ngezinyawo, kulandele abagibeli ngama-24% kanye nabashayeli ngama-19%.

src: IKhabhinethi nayo njengoMongameli uJacob Zuma ivakalisa udandatheko nomothuko omkhulu ngokusweleka kwabantwana besikolo abali-18, nabantu ababini abadala ngexesha kusenzeka ingozi eyoyikekayo yeteksi eBronkhorstpruit, ngaphandle nje kwePitoli.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela noMongameli Zuma ekuzwakaliseni ukudabuka kwayo kanye nokwethuka okukhulu ngokudlula emhlabeni kwezingane zesikole eziyi-18 nabantu abadala ababili engozini yetekisi enyantisayo eyenzeke e-Bronkhorstspruit, ngaphandle kwasePitoli.

src: Soleka umsundulu kwisimemezo esenziwe nguMongameli uZuma sokuba abezomthetho mabaphande ngokukhawuleza unobangela wale ngozi.
tgt: Sithanda ukugcizelela kwikhwelo likaMongameli Zuma lokuthi kumele izikhungo zokuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho ziphenye imbangela yale ngozi ngokushesha okukhulu.

src: IKhabhinethi ibulela onke amasebe karhulumente, imibutho engekho phantsi korhulumente (ii-NGO), amagcisa nabezoshishino abaxhasa iintsapho ezichaphazelekayo kwakunye nabafundi nabasebenzi besikolo seMfundo ePhakamileyo saseMahlenga neSikolo sePrayimari iRefano ngeli xesha linzima kangaka.
tgt: IKhabhinethi idlulisa amazwi okubonga kuyo yonke iminyango kahulumeni, izinhlangano ezingekho ngaphansi kukahulumeni (ama-NGO), ochwepheshe kanye nabamabhizinisi abahlinzeke ngosizo emindenini ethintekile kanye nakubafundi nothisha besikole iMahlenga High kanye nabesikole sase-Refano Primary ngalesi sikhathi esinzima.

src: Inyhikitya yokufa ezindleleni, ngokukodwa ngexesha leeholide eMzantsi Afrika, ihleli iyinkxalabo yesizwe.
tgt: Ukushona kwabantu abaningi ezingozini zomgwaqo, ikakhulukazi ngesikhathi samaholide eNingizimu Afrika, kuyinto ekhathazayo kakhulu kuleli.

src: Kwiimeko ezininzi oku kusweleka bekunokuthintelwa ngokuziphatha ngendlela enenkathalo nokusetyenziswa kweendlela zeli lizwe ngokunenkathalo.
tgt: Izingozi eziningi kulezi, yizingozi ebezingagwemeka ngokuthi abasebenzisi bomgwaqo baziphathe kahle ngenkathi besemgwaqeni futhi bacophelele kakhulu.

src: Ukuqhuba ngokungakhathaleli ngozi konke-konke nangokungenankathalo akwamkeleki kwaye bonke abantu baseMzantsi Afrika bayabongozwa ukuba baluthathele kubo uxanduva lokhuseleko lwabo ezindleleni zeli.
tgt: Kuyisenzo esingamukelekile neze ukushayela budedengu, ngaphandle kwenkathalo futhi abantu baseNingizimu Afrika bayanxuswa ukuba bakwenze kube yinto engumsebenzi wabo osemqoka kakhulu ukuphepha kwabo emigwaqeni yethu.

src: IKhabhinethi ibothulela umnqwazi abecandelo lezothutho leebhasi ngokubuyela emsebenzini emva kuqhankqalazo olungabanga naziganeko zabundlobongela, libonisa indlela yokuqhankqalaza yabasebenzi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwushayela ihlombe umkhakha wezokuthutha abantu ngamabhasi ngokubuyela emsebenzini emva kwesiteleka ebesingenalo udlame, okuyinto eyisibonelo esihle ekubanjweni kweziteleka zabasebenzi.

src: Indima edlalwe nguMphathiswa wezeMisebenzi kufuneka inconyiwe ngokuququzelela isiphelo soluqhankqalazo kweli candelo libaluleke kakhulu kuqoqosho lwethu.
tgt: Iphawulekile indima edlalwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezabasebenzi ekuqedeni isiteleka kulo mkhakha obaluleke kangaka emnothweni wethu.

src: IKhabhinethi ixhalabile kukuqhambuka kwakutsha nje kobundlobongela eVuwani emva kwesigqibo seBhodi yoCando-mida yooMasipala sokuyifakela phantsi komasipala omtsha.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhathazekile ngokuqubuka kabusha kodlame endaweni yase-Vuwani kulandela esinqumweni seBhodi Lokuklanywa Kwemingcele Yomasipala sokufaka le ndawo ngaphansi kukamasipala omusha.

src: IKhabhinethi ikugxeka kakhulu ukusetyenziswa kwabantwana bethu njengesixhobo sothethathethwano, ukuvalwa kwezikolo iiveki ngeeveki kulenza mfiliba ikamva laba abantwana nabathi bathwaliswe umthwalo ongaphezulu kwabo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugxeka kakhulu ukusetshenziswa kwezingane zethu njengethuluzi lokufezekisa izimfuno ezithile futhi ukuvalwa kwezikole amaviki ngamaviki kuphazamisa ingomuso lalezi zingane esezizithola zingaphansi kwengcindezi yomphefumulo eyengeziwe.

src: Ubundlobongela, izoyikiso, ukutshatyalaliswa, okanye amanyathelo athi akhokelele ekutshatyalalisweni kwezikolo okanye abafundi bavinjwe ithuba lokuya eskolweni akunandawo tu kweli lizwe lethu lilawulwa ngokwentando yesininzi.
tgt: Udlame, ukwesatshiswa, ukucekelwa phansi kwempahla noma izenzo eziholela ekucekelweni phansi kwezikole noma ezincisha abafundi ithuba lokuya esikoleni azinayo nakancane indawo ezweni lethu elibuswa ngokwentando yeningi labantu.

src: IKhabhinethi iyawubulela umsebenzi owenzwe yi-IMC, ikhokelwa nguMphathiswa woLawulo lweNtsebenziswano neMicimbi yezeMveli uMnu Des Van Rooyen nokutyelelwa nguMphathiswa wezamaPolisa, uFikile Mbalula, kwaye uyaluxhasa uluvo lokuba izenzo zolwaphulo-mthetho kuquka nokonakaliswa nokutshatyalaliswa kwempahla nezakhiwo akuzikunyanyezelwa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwushayela ihlombe umsebenzi owenziwe yi-IMC, ebiholwa nguNgqongqoshe Wokwengamela Ngokubambisana kanye Nezindaba Zendabuko uMnu Des Van Rooyen, kanye nokuvakashela kuleya ndawo kukaNgqongqoshe Wezamapholisa, uFikile Mbalula, futhi iyaweseka umbono wokuthi izenzo zobugebengu, kubandakanya ukulinyazwa nokucekelwa phansi kwempahla kuyinto engeke ibekezelelwe nakancane.

src: UMongameli uJacob Zuma kulindeleke ukuba adibane neKumkani yaMaVenda uKumkani Toni Mphephu Ramabulana kunye neenkokeli zomthonyama zesithili saseVhembe ngelinge lokuzisa uzinzo.
tgt: Kulindeleke ukuba uMongameli Jacob Zuma abambe umhlangano neNgonyama yamaVenda u-Toni Mphephu Ramabulana kanye nabaholi bendabuko abavela esifundeni sase-Vhembe njengomzamo wokuletha uzinzo kuleya ndawo.

src: IKhabhinethi iyagxininisa ukuba imali nezixhobo zoncedo ezichithwe ekulungiseni izikolo ezonakalisiweyo yimali ebiza kusetyenziswa kwezinye iinkqubo zikarhulumente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyagcizelela ukuthi imali kanye nezinsiza ezisetshenziwe ukwakha kabusha izikole ezicekelwe phansi yimali obekuhloswe ukuba isetshenziswe kwezinye izinhlelo zikahulumeni.

src: IKhabhinethi ikwacela inzolo nozinzo emva koqhankqalazo obelunobundlobongela kwidolophu yase-Lichtenburg nakwilokishi yase-Blydeville, kuMasipala wasekuHlaleni waseDitsobotla, eMntla Ntshona.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxuse futhi nokuthi abantu behlise imimoya futhi kubuyiswe nozinzo kulandela imibhikisho ehambisana nodlame edolobheni lase-Lichtenburg kanye naselokishini lase-Blydeville, ngaphansi kukaMasipala Wendawo yase-Ditsobotla, esifundazweni saseNyakatho Ntshonalanga.

src: Ukuya esikolweni kuye kwaphazanyiswa, iivenkile zatyhuthulwa zaza iimoto kunye nezindlu eziliqela zatshiswa.
tgt: Ukufunda kuphazamisekile, kwaphangwa nempahla ezitolo futhi kwashiswa izimoto nezindlu eziningana.

src: INkulumbuso yaseMntla Ntshona, u-Supra Mahumapelo, uchonge iqela labaPhathiswa kwiPhondo (ii-MEC) abahlanu noosodolophu ababini ukuba baphande baze balungise imingeni yonikezelo-nkonzo kulo mmandla.
tgt: UNdunankulu waseNyakatho Ntshonalanga, u-Supra Mahumapelo, useqoke ithimba elihlanganisa oNgqongqoshe Besifundazwe (abo-MEC) abahlanu kanye nezimeya ezimbili elizophenya futhi lixazulule izinselelo eziphathelene ngohlinzekwa kwezidingo-ngqangi kuleya ndawo.

src: IKhabhinethi iyalucela uluntu lwase-Coligny, eMntla Ntshona ukuba libuyeke ubundlobongela lize livumele uMbutho wamaPolisa aseMzantsi Afrika (i-SAPS) e-Coligny ukuba ugqibezele uphando lwaqwo ngokusweleka komntwana, ukuqinisekisa ukuba buyenziwa ubulungisa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawunxusa umphakathi wase-Coligny, esifundazweni saseNyakatho Ntshonalanga ukuba uyeke ukubamba imibhikisho ehambisana nodlame futhi unikeze uMbutho Wamaphoyisa aseNingizimu Afrika (i-SAPS) endaweni yase-Coligny ithuba lokuphothula uphenyo lwawo mayelana nengane eshonile, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ubulungiswa buqhutshwa ngendlela efanelekile.

src: Abemi beli bayabongozwa ukuba bavakalise iinkxalabo zabo ngokusebenzisa amaziko akhoyo asemthethweni kwaye bakwenze oko ngokulandela umthetho.
tgt: Izakhamuzi ziyanxuswa ukuba zisebenzise izinhlaka ezikhona njengamanje uma zifuna ukuzwakalisa izinkinga zazo futhi zithobele umthetho ngenkathi zizwakalisa ukukhathazeka kwazo.

src: Urhulumente uwothulela umnqwazi amaziko ogcino-mthetho ngomsebenzi oncomekayo wokubamba abenzi bobundlobongela kwabasetyhini nakubantwana.
tgt: Uhulumeni uzishayela ihlombe izikhungo zokuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa komthetho ngendlela ezisukumela ngayo phezulu ukuze kuboshwe izigilamkhuba ezihlukumeza abesifazane nezingane.

src: Kulo meko, iKhabhinethi iyawamkela amanyathelo akhawulezileyo athe athathwa liCandelo lokuLwa ukuRhweba ngaBantu looKhetshe kunye neQela lokuSabela ngobuChule le-SAPS nelithe labambaumfundisi ozinze eDurban ngesimangalo sokurhweba ngabantu eBhayi.
tgt: Mayelana nalokhu-ke, iKhabhinethi izishayela ihlombe izinyathelo ezisheshayo ezithathwe wuPhiko Loklebe Olulwisana Nokushushumbiswa Kwabantu kanye neThimba Elijutshwe Ukubhekana Namacala Abucayi Kakhulu njengoba bebophe umfundisi ozinze eThekwini obekwe icala lokushushumbiswa kwabantu e-Port Elizabeth.

src: Kungumsebenzi noxanduva labo bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba basebenzisane nabasemagunyeni ukukhusela abantu beli basetyhini nabantwana kubabulali kwaye siqinisekise ukuba siyayenza eyethu indima ukwenza iindawo ezihlala abantu beli zikhuselekile.
tgt: Kungumsebenzi wabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika futhi kuyisibopho sabo ukuba basebenzisane neziphathimandla ukuvikela abesifazane nezingane zethu kubahlukumezi futhi kumele siqinisekise ukuthi sidlala indima yethu ekwenzeni imiphakathi yethu ibe ngephephile kakhulu.

src: Imiyalezo.
tgt: Imiyalezo.

src: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana noZolani Tete ngokuphumelela intshinga yodidi lwebhantamu yoMbutho wezamaNqindi weHlabathi (i-WBO).
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela uZolani Tete ngokunqoba kwakhe isicoco sesisindo samabhantamu ngaphansi kweNhlangano Yezesibhakela Emhlabeni (i-WBO).

src: Oku kumbeka kwindawo elungele ukudibanisa iintshinga zehlabathi – oku kuthetha ukuba ngoku angakwazi ukucela umngeni kwiintshinga zehlabathi kwimibutho yomine emikhulu yezamanqindi yehlabathi: iBhunga lezaManqindi leHlabathi (i-WBC), uMbutho wezaManqindi weHlabathi (i-WBA) kunye neManyano yezaManqindi yeHlabathi (i-IBF).
tgt: Lokhu kumbeka ethubeni lokulwa empini yokuhlanganisa izicoco zomhlaba – okusho ukuthi manje usengafaka inselelo yokulwela izicoco zomhlaba ngaphansi kwezinhlangano zesibhakela ezithathwa njengezinkulu emhlabeni jikelele: okuwuMkhandlu Wezesibhakela Emhlabeni (i-WBC), iNhlangano Yomhlaba Yezesibhakela (i-WBA) kanye neNhlangano Yezesibhakela Yamazwe Ngamazwe (i-IBF).

src: IKhabhinethi nayo njengoMongameli uJacob Zuma ithumela amazwi ovelwano kusapho nabahlobo bomcebisi oligqala ekwanguye nomqeqeshi, uNick Durandt, nobesaziwa ngesakhono sakhe sokuvelisa iimbethi-manqindi ezizintshatsheli kwakunye nokuthatha amakhwenkwe asemancinane awasuse ezitalatweni aze awenze abe zintshatsheli.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihlanganyela noMongameli Jacob Zuma ekudluliseni amazwi enduduzo aqondiswe emndenini nabangani bomqeqeshi wesibhakela obedume kakhulu, uNick Durandt, obaziwa kakhulu ngekhono lakhe lokukhiqiza abashayisibhakela abayizingqwele futhi obethatha abafana abancane abebewuvanzi emgwaqeni abenze izingqwele.

src: IzikhundlaZonke izikhundla zixhomekeke ekuqinisekisweni kwamabakala ezemfundo kunye nokuqinisekiswa okufanelekileyo kwezokhuselo.
tgt: AbaqashiweUkuqashwa kwabo bonke abalandelayo kuzokwamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kuphela uma sekuqinisekiswe ubufakazi beziqu zabo zemfundo futhi uma sebenikeziwe izimvume ezifanelekile.

src: Amalungu achongwe nguMongameli weNkundla yeSizwe yamaTyala wabaThengi, aqalisa ukusebenza ngomhla wesiVumelwano sokuQondana sikaMongameli esifanelekileyo:a) Njing.
tgt: Abaqokwe nguMongameli njengamalungu eNkantolo Yezabathengi Kazwelonke, futhi abazongena ezikhundleni zabo ngosuku olushiwo kwiMemorandamu KaMongameli efanelekile:Slz Joseph Mandal Maseko (uSihlalo Omkhulu)Nkz Laura Best (iPhini LikaSihlalo)Mnu Lulama Andisa Potwana (ilungu elizosebenza ngokugcwele)Nkz Penelope Anne Beck (ilungu lesikhashana)Adv Hope Fiona Neo Sephoti (ilungu lesikhashana)Nkz Diane Reinette Terblanche (ilungu lesikhashana)Nkz Nomfundo Maseti (ilungu lesikhashana)Nkz Maleho Margaret Daisy Nkomo (ilungu lesikhashana)Slz Bonke Clayton Dumisa (ilungu lesikhashana)Slz Tanya Ann Woker (ilungu lesikhashana)Slz Kasturi Moodaliyar ilungu lesikhashana)Dkt Maria Claudina du Toit (ilungu lesikhashana)Mnu Xolela Christopher May (ilungu lesikhashana)Mnu Fungai Khumbulani Sibanda (ilungu lesikhashana)Mnu Lehlohonolo Lucky Rabotapi (ilungu lesikhashana)Mnu Trevor Albert Bailey (ilungu lesikhashana) kanye noAdv Frans Kgolela Manamela (ilungu lesikhashana).

src: IKhabhinethi ibidibene ngoLwesithathu, umhla we-10 kuCanzibe wama-2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabamba umhlangano wayo ngoLwesithathu mhla ziyi-10 kuNhlaba 2017, e-Tuynhuys, eKapa.

src: IQonga lezoQoqosho lweHlabathi (i-WEF) e-Afrika.
tgt: Isithangamu Sezomnotho Emhlabeni (i-WEF) esiqondene ne-Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukusingathwa ngempumelelo kwentlanganiso yama-27 yeQonga leHlabathi lezoQoqosho (i-WEF) e-Afrika apho uMongameli uJacob Zuma ebekhokela iQhiza loMzantsi Afrika, iiNtloko zemiBuso nooRhulumente zelizwekazi lase-Afrika, iinkokeli zezorhwebo noshishino eziphuma mbombo zone zehlabathi kunye neenkokeli zemibutho yoluntu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikushayela ihlombe ukusingathwa ngempumelelo kweSithangamu Sezomnotho Emhlabeni sama-27 esiqondene ne-Afrika lapho uMongameli ebehola khona iThimba LaseNingizimu Afrika, iziNhloko Zemibuso kanye Nohulumeni abavela kwiZwekazi lase-Afrika, izinhloko zezimboni emhlabeni nabaholi bezomnotho kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi wonkana.

src: Le nkomfa ibibanjelwe phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukuphumeza uHlumo oluXhanyulwa Nguye Wonke: Iinkokeli eziPhendulayo nezineNkathalo”.
tgt: Le ngqungquthela yabanjwa ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Ukufezekisa Ukukhula Komnotho Okubandakanya Abantu Bonke: Abaholi Abasabelayo futhi Abaphusile”.

src: Le seshoni yama-27 ye-WEF e-Afrika iqinisekise ihlabathi ukuba uMzantsi Afrika uselelinye lamazwe anomtsalane kubatyali-zimali kweli lizwekazi le-Afrika.
tgt: Lesi sigcawu sama-27 se-WEF eqondene ne-Afrika sibonise ngokucacile phambi kwamehlo omhlaba ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika isalokhu iyizwe elikwizwekazi lase-Afrika elikulungele ukutshalwa kwezimali.

src: Abaququzeleli bale ndibano baqinisekisile ukuba abathunywa abangaphezulu kwi-1 000 bebezimase lo msitho, inani elo ekungazange kufikelelwe kulo kwi-WEF e-Afrika ngaphambili.
tgt: Abagqugquzeli bale ngqungquthela bakuqinisekisile ukuthi beyithanyelwe yizithunywa ezingaphezu kwe-1000, okuyisibalo esiyingqophamlando uma kuqhathaniswa nesibalo sengqungquthela ye-WEF eyabanjwa phambilini.

src: Umoya omhle wentsebenziswano phakathi kukarhulumente nabezoshishino ngethuba le-WEF e-Afrika uncomeka kakhulu.
tgt: Umoya wobumbano oqinile phakathi kukahulumeni kanye nabamabhizinisi obonakale ngenkathi kubanjwe i-WEF bewumuhle kakhulu.

src: Ezi ngxoxo bezityebile kwaye zishushu zinike uMzantsi Afrika ithuba lokubonisa inkqubela oyenzileyo ukufikelela kuhlumo loqoqosho oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke nokubonisa ukuba amasango oMzantsi Afrika avuliwe ukuba abatyali-zimali beze kutyala imali.
tgt: Izingxoxo ezinohlonze zihlinzeke izwe laseNingizimu Afrika ngethuba lokubonisa inqubekelaphambili eliyenzayo emshikashikeni wokufezekisa ukukhula komnotho okubandakanya abantu bonke kanye nokukhombisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika ikulungele noma nini ukwenza ibhizinisi.

src: UMzantsi Afrika usesekhondweni lokuzalisekisa isiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe (i-NDP) ukuze kuliwe intlupheko, ukungalinani nentswela-ngqesho.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika isalokhu izibophezele ekuqhubekeni emgudwini wayo ophokophele ekuqalisweni nokusetshenziswa koHlelo lwayo Lokuthuthukiswa Kwezwe (i-NDP) ukuze kuncishiswe ububha, ukungalingani kanye nokuntuleka kwamathuba omsebenzi.

src: Ezothutho.1 Ukuphehlelelwa koololiwe abatsha bakwa-PRASA (i-Arhente yoMzantsi Afrika yooLoliwe Abakhwelwa ngaBantu) kunye nenkonzo yololiwe, nguMongameli uJacob Zuma ngomhla we-9 kuCanzibe ngowama-2017 eSitishini sasePitoli kuyinxalenye yephulo likarhulumente eliqhubekayo lokuqinisekisa ukuba kukho izithuthi zikawonke-wonke ezifikelelekayo nezithembakeleyo, ngolo hlobo kuphuculwe iziseko zeli lizwe ezingundoqo zezoqoqosho.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kwezitimela ezintsha kanye nezinsizakalo zezitimela zoPhiko Lwezitimela Ezithwala Abagibeli LwaseNingizimu Afrika (i-PRASA), nguMongameli Jacob Zuma mhla ziyisi-9 kuNhlaba 2017 eSiteshini Sezitimela sasePitoli kuyingxenye yokuzibophezela kukahulumeni okuqhubekayo okuhloswe ngakho ukuqinisekisa ukuhlinzekwa kwezinto zokuthutha umphakathi ezingambi eqolo futhi ezithembakele, kanye nokukhuthaza nokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda yezwe yezomnotho.

src: Aba loliwe bakwa-Metrorail batsha bayinxalenye yoololiwe abatsha abaza kuthengwa ngurhulumente kule minyaka izayo ili-10 ukuya kweli-15 njengenxalenye yeNkqubo ka-PRASA yokuPhucula ooLoliwe.
tgt: Izitimela ezintsha ze-Metrorail (ezaziwa futhi ngokuthi yiZitimela Zabantu) ziyingxenye yohlobo lwezitimela uhulumeni azizofaka emzileni kule minyaka eyi-10 kuya kweyi-15 ezayo njengengxenye yoHlelo lwe-PRASA Lokuhlinzeka Ngezitimela Zesimanjemanje.

src: Eli phulo liza kudala amawaka emisebenzi esigxina nezithuba zemisebenzi, umzi-mveliso wokwenziwa koololiwe abatsha uyakhiwa eNigel e-Ekurhuleni.
tgt: Lo mklamo uzodala izinkulungwane ngezinkulungwane zamathuba omsebenzi asimeme kanye namathuba etoho, njengoba uqhubeka umsebenzi wokwakha isikhungo okuzokhiqizwa kusona izitimela e-Nigel, Ekurhuleni.

src: Oku kukuqala kokusebenza kwesiVumelwano esityikitywe nelizwe lase-France nelaseBrazil phakathi ko-PRASA no-Alstom.3 Aba loliwe batsha bale mihla bakwa-Metrorail (baBantu) abekho abafana nabo ngokuhamba kamnandi nangokubamba ixesha, futhi abakhweli bazo baza kukonwabela kakhulu ukuhamba ngazo.
tgt: Lesi yisiqalo sokuqaliswa kokusebenza kweSivumelwano esenziwe yileli ne-France ne-Brazil esisayindwe yi-PRASA nabakwa-Alstom.

src: Eli phulo liyinxalenye yophuhliso lwezoqoqosho oluqhutywa ngurhulumente ngokusebenzisa iphulo elikhulu lophuhliso lweziseko ezingundoqo kwaye aba loliwe balungiselelwe nokuba bakwazi ukukhwelisa abantu abakhubazekileyo.4 IKhabhinethi imemelela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bazingce ngalo msebenzi mngaka futhi babakhusele aba loliwe batsha ukuba bangonakaliswa.
tgt: Izitimela ze-Metrorail zikanokusho ezintsha (iZitimela Zabantu) zihlinzeka abagibeli ngamazinga aphezulu kakhulu ezinsizakalo zesitimela kanye nokunethezeka, futhi zizoyiguqula indlela abagibeli abaphatheka ngayo uma behamba ngesitimela.

src: UMongameli uye wadibana neThole leSilo, lisiSilo Ngokwalo, uKumkani uToni Mphephu Ramabulana weSizwe samaVenda, kwakunye namanye amahlakani amele uluntu ngelinge lokuzama ukuba kukhangelwe isisombululo esiza kwanelisa wonke umntu kwimiba ibiphakanyisiwe.2 Kule ntlanganiso siye samkelwa isiphakamiso soMntwan’egazi sokuba uMasipala wesiThili saseVhembe kufuneka ibe nguye obonelela abantu baseVuwani ngeenkonzo ngeli thuba ingxaki yomba wokucandwa kwemida isaxoxwayo.
tgt: Lezi zitimela ziyingxenye yomsebenzi owenziwa nguhulumeni ukuthuthukisa umnotho ngokuqalisa imiklamo emikhulukazi yokuthuthukisa ingqalasizinda futhi zikulungele nokusetshenziswa ngabantu abanokukhubazeka.

src: Esi siphakamiso sihambelana nemithetho elandelwayo xa kulawulwa oomasipala.3 Kuye kwagqitywa nokuba amasebe afanelekileyo kazwelonke nawamaphondo kufuneka anike inkxaso kulo masipala wesithili ukuze akwazi ukwenza lo msebenzi wongezelelweyo mtsha.
tgt: IKhabinethi inxuse bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba baziqhenye ngalezi zitimela ezintsha futhi bazivikele ekucekelweni phansi.

src: IKhabhinethi iyawabulela amahlakani ngokunyanzelisa ukuba izivumelwano ebeziphakanyiswe yiKumkani zifezekiswe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikushayela ihlombe ukungenelela ngempumelelo kukaMongameli Zuma e-Vuwani, eLimpopo.

src: UMongameli uzimisele ukuphinda abuyele kubantu baseVuwani aye kubonisana nabo.
tgt: UMongameli ubambe umhlangano neNgonyama yesizwe samaVenda u-Toni Mphephu Ramabulana, kanye nababambiqhaza bomphakathi ngenhloso yokuthola izisombululo zokuxazulula, ngomoya omuhle nangoxolo, izinkinga ezivezwe ngumphakathi.

src: Umhla aza kubuyela ngawo kuza kuboniswana ngawo noMhlekazi oBekekileyo uKumkani uToni Mphephu Ramabulana kunye nawo onke amahlakani achaphazelekayo akulaa mmandla.5 IKhabhinethi icela abazali noluntu ukuba bawaxhase amalinge esebe okungenelela ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba bonke abafundi babuyela esikolweni bafunde iincwadi zabo nokuzama ukuleqa umsebenzi abasemva kuwo bencediswa ngamanyathelo okungenelela aqhutywayo kuzo zonke izikolo.
tgt: Umhlangano wasamukela isiphakamiso seNgonyama sokuba uMasipala Wesifunda saseVhembe kube yiwona ohlinzeka ngezinsizakalo kubantu baseVuwani ngenkathi kusathungathwa ikhambi lesikhathi eside lokusombulula impicabadala yodaba lokuklanywa kwemingcele yomasipala.

src: Uqhankqalazo olunobundlobongela.1 IKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba lwahlukane nobundlobongela, ukugrogrisa nokutyhuthula iivenkile xa bevakalisa izikhalazo zabo.
tgt: Lesi sombululo esiphakanyisiwe siyahambisana nemithetho efanelekile elawula omasipala.

src: Ubundlobongela nokutyhuthula iivenkile kunye nokutshabalalisa izakhiwo neempahla zamashishini okwenzeke kutsha nje eColigny, e-Eldorado Park nase-Ennerdale kugxekwa kabukhali yiKhabhinethi.2 IKhabhinethi icela bonke abantu ukuba bavaklise izikhalazo zabo ngendlela eyakhayo, akunyanzelekanga ukuba bade bonakalisa iimpahla zoluntu okanye banyhashe amalungelo abanye abantu.3 UMongameli wenza isimemezelo ngethuba leNtetho engoBume beSizwe (i-SoNA) yowama-2015 sokuba iNtlanganiselo yezobuLungisa, uThintelo loLwaphulo-mthetho kunye noKhuseleko (i-JCPS) izilwe kangangoko izaganeko zoqhankqalazo ezinobundlobongela nezonakalisa iimpahla zoluntu.
tgt: Kuphinde futhi kwathathwa nesinqumo sokuthi kumele iminyango kazwelonke neyezifundazwe efanelekile ilekelele umasipala wesifunda ukuze ukwazi ukwenza lo msebenzi omusha othweswe wona.

src: Umthetho-sihlomelo oyilwayo weziko lolwaphulo-mthetho kwezezimali (i-FICA)5.1 IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukutyikitywa koMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weZiko loLwaphulo-mthetho kwezeziMali (i-FICA) nguMongameli Zuma ukuba ube ngumthetho.
tgt: Kepha-ke, umhlangano ukugcizelelile ukuthi ukuthathwa kwalesi sinqumo akusho ukupheliswa kukamasipala omusha osunguliwe (i-LIM 345).

src: UMzantsi Afrika njengelizwe eliyinxalenye yamazwe alwa unaniselwano ngemali olungekho mthethweni, nawo uza kuzayamanisa namanyathelo ehlabathi okungenelela afuna ukulwa ukuthutyeleziswa kwemali kunye nokuncediswa ngemali kwamaphulo obunqolobi.2 Lo Mthetho uYilwayo uza kuba negalelo ekwenzeni inkqubo yezezimali eMzantsi afrika ukuba ihlonitshwe futhi yenze izinto elubala, futhi oko kuza kwenza ukuba kube nzima kwabo baphula umthetho bayinxalenye yabo bangahlawuli zirhafu, bathubelezisa imali futhi bananiselana ngemali ngokungekho mthethweni ngeenjongo zokufihla imali kusetyenziswa ubuxhaka-xhaka neenkqubo zezimali zoMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: Lesi sinqumo siyingxenye yokuzibophezela kukahulumeni ekutholeni isixazululo esibandakanya abantu bonke.

src: Lo Mthetho uYilwayo ungomnye weminye imithetho esinayo njengelizwe lokulwa ulwaphulo-mthetho oluqhutywa zizifundiswa kurhulumente nakumashishini abucala.3 IKhabhinethi ixelelwe nguMphathiswa wezeMali ukuba iintlanganiso zokubonisana ziyaqhuba kwaye ziza kuqukunjelwa kungekudala ukuze kuqinisekiswe ngenkqubo yokubhengezwa kwemithetho nemigaqo eza kuchaphazela uMthetho we-FICIzigqibo zekhabhinethi.1 UMphathiswa wezeMali unike iKhabhinethi amagqabantshintshi ngeentlanganiso zeNtwasahlobo zeNgxowa-mali yeHlabathi yeziMali (i-IMF) neBhanki yeHlabathi, namaPhulo okuTsala abaTyali-mali kunye neentlanganiso ze-WEFUye wanika neenkcukacha ngesiVumelwano se-G20 neziphakamiso ze-Afrika kunye neenkxalabo zabatyali-zimali kunye nee-arhente ezihlela amazwe ngokwesakhono sawo sokubhatala izikweliti.
tgt: Ukufakana imilomo nokubonisana phakathi kukaMongameli nabo bonke ababambiqhaza sekuholele ekutheni kubuyele esimweni esijwayelekile ukusebenza kwezikole namabhizinisi.

src: Kubekho iingxoxo ezinzulu ngemeko yoqoqosho lwehlabathi nolwengingqi nokuba kufuneka senze ntoni ukulungisa le ngxaki yokubekwa kwelona zinga lisezantsi ngokwesakhono sokukwazi ukuhlawula izikweliti.2 IKhabhinethi iphinde yakubethelela ukuba isazimisele nokuqhubeleka nemigaqo-nkqubo yezezimali eyayicaciswe kwiNtetho yoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali lowama-2017, ukuqaliswa kwenguqu ukuze kuphuculwe ulawulo kumashishini karhulumente ukugcina umyinge wemali ebekelwe inkcitho nokuqinisekisa ukuba amatyala karhulumente awanyuki.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabancoma impela ababambiqhaza ngokuqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa kwezivumelwano ezenziwe ngaphansi kwezingxoxo ebeziholwa yiNgonyama.

src: Inkqubo karhulumente yokukhawulezisa ukuqaliswa kweenguqu kwiindlela uqoqosho olumi ngayo ukuze lukhule njengoko kutshiwo kwisiCwangciso esiManqaku aliThoba iseyiyo enokusetyenziswa ukusabela kweminye yemiba ephakanyiswe ngabatyali-mali.3 IKhabhinethi iyayamkela ingxelo ebesanda ukukhutshwa yinkampani i-EY Consultancy emalunga noTyalo-mali lwangaPhandle oluza Ngqo e-Afrika.
tgt: UMongameli uzibophezele ekutheni uzophindela emphakathini waseVuwani lapho ezohlangana nomphakathi ngosuku olusazonqunywa emva kokubonisana nokuvumelana neNgonyama u-Toni Mphephu Ramabulana kanye nabo bonke ababambiqhaza abafanelekile bakuleya ndawo.

src: Le ngxelo iwuchaza uMzantsi Afrika njengelinye lamazwe anoqoqosho olukhulu kwaye ubekwa kwindawo yesibini kuLuhlu lowama-2017 lwase-Afrika lokuba Nomtsalane.4 IKhabhinethi iye yaxelelwa nangohambo lwee-Arhente zokuHlela iSakhono sokuBhatala iziKweliti oluzayo oluza kweli ukuze zingqubanise iintloko nemibutho emininzi kunye nezikhulu zikarhulumente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa abazali kanye nomphakathi ukuba basekele izinhlelo zokungenelela zomnyango ukuqinisekisa ukuthi abafundi babuyela emagunjini okufundela futhi bakhathule nomsebenzi osalele emuva ngokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokungenelela ezihlinzekwayo njengamanje kuzo zonke izikole.

src: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga sisabela kanye kwimiba ephambili koomasipala bezithili zasemaphandleni nakumaphondo anemimandla emininzi engamaphandle ngokusombulula umba wokungabikho kweziSeko ezinguNdoqo neeNkonzo ezifanelekileyo zezoThutho emaPhandleni into leyo ephazamisa uphuhliso lezoqoqosho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa imiphakathi ukuba iyeke ukuzibandakanya ezenzweni ezinodlame, nokwesabisa kanye nokuphangwa kwempahla ezitolo namabhizinisi ngenkathi izwakalisa ukukhathazeka kwayo.

src: Ukuqaliswa kwesi sicwangciso-qhinga kuza kuncedisa ekukhuliseni uqoqosho loomasipala nolwamaphondo ngokwenza izithuthi zikawonke-wonke zifikeleleke.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilugxeka kakhulu udlame kanye nezenzo zokuphangwa nokucekelwa phansi kwamabhizinisi okwenzeke esikhathini esifushane esedlule e-Coligny, Eldorado Park kanye nase-Ennerdale.

src: Oku kuza kwenza ukuba kube lula ebantwini ukusuka emaphandleni baye ezidolophini, ngeenjongo zokunceda imimandla yasemaphandleni ukuba ikwazi ukuthatha inxaxheba kuqoqosho lwelizwe ngobubanzi.6 IKhabhinethi iwuvile uMgaqo-nkqubo oBanzi wezoThutho zaseManzini.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa imiphakathi ukuba izwakalise ukukhathazeka kwayo ngendlela ehlose ukuthola izisombululo, ngaphandle ngokucekela phansi impahla nezakhiwo zomphakathi noma ukuphazamisa nokucindezela amalungelo amanye amalungu omphakathi.

src: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ubonakalisa ukuzimisela kukarhulumente kuhlumo, uphuhliso kunye nokutshintsha icandelo lezothutho lwasemanzini loMzantsi Afrika, ukuze luxhase uphuhliso lwezoqoqosho nolwezentlalo ngeli thuba lifaka igalelo kurhwebo lwehlabathi.
tgt: UMongameli wahlaba ikhwelo eNkulumweni Echaza Isimo Sezwe (i-SoNA) yowezi-2015, enxusa iQoqwana Lezobulungiswa Nokuvinjelwa Kobugebengu kanye Nokuvikeleka (i-JCPS) ukuba lithathe izinyathelo ezinqala zokubhekana nodlame kanye nemibhikisho edala umonakalo omkhulu.

src: Oku kuhambelana nemiba ekhokeliswa phambili ngurhulumente ngokumayelana ne-Operation Phakisa ngokukhuliswa koQoqosho lwaseLwandle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyagcizelela kuleli khwelo lokuthi labo abaphula umthetho kumele babhekane namandla aphelele engalo yomthetho.

src: Futhi kukwahambelana neenjongo ezibanzi zokusebenzela ukukhulisa uqoqosho kunye nokuncedisa kumaphulo okudala imisebenzi, njengoko kucacisiwe kwisiCwangciso soPhuhliso seSizwe (i-NDP) kunye nesiCwangciso seSizwe seziSeko ezinguNdoqo.7 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa kweDrafti yesiCwangciso-qhinga seziThuthi Ezingenzi Monakalo kwiNdalo ukuze uluntu luhlomle kuyo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa bonke ababambiqhaza ukuba baxoxisane futhi babonisane ngenhloso yokusombulula imibango yase-Ennerdale, Eldorado Park nase-Coligny ngokushesha.

src: Icandelo lezothutho liyintsika yoqoqosho nentlalo eMzantsi Afrika kuba linceda abantu batsho bakwazi ukuya kwiindawo abafuna ukuya kuzo neempahla zithuthwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyakwamukela ukucikicwa kweSichibiyelo SoMthethosivivinywa Wesikhungo Sobunhloli Bezimali nguMongameli Zuma ukuze sibe ngumthetho.

src: Nangona kunjalo, imisi ekhutshwa zizithuthi inegalelo elikhulu kwiigesi ezichaphazela iqondo lobushushu bomhlaba (i-GHG), zona izithuthi ezihamba ezindleleni zikhupha umsi omninzi.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika, njengoba iyingxenye yamazwe womhlaba alwisana nezenzo ezingekho emthethweni eziphathelene nezezimali, nayo izohambisana nezinhlelo zokungenelela zamazwe ngamazwe okuhloswe ngazo ukulwisana nokushushumbiswa nokushintshisana ngezimali ngendlela efihlakele futhi engekho emthethweni kanye nokuxhaswa kwezenzo zobushokobezi ngezimali.

src: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga siphakamisa amanyathelo okungenelela aza kunciphisa iigesi ezenza i-GHG ngokwemimiselo yophuhliso oluzinzileyo.8 IKhabhinethi ivumile ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ube lilungu loMfelandawonye wezobuChwepheshe wase-Afrika.
tgt: Lo Mthethosivivinywa uyalekelela futhi nasekuqiniseni ukusebenza ngokusobala kanye nobuqotho bohlelo lwezimali lwaseNingizimu Afrika futhi uzokwenza kube nzima kakhulu ezigebengwini ezibandakanyeka ezenzweni zokugwema ukukhokha intela kanye nokushushumbiswa nokushintshisana ngezimali ngendlela efihlakele futhi engekho emthethweni ukuba zizifihle ngokusebenzisa uhlelo lwezimali lwaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: Eli liphulo lokusebenzisana elikhokelwa ngamazwe ase-Afrika futhi ligxile ekuqambeni izisombululo ezifanelekileyo nokwabelana ngezixhobo zokusebenza ukuze kuliwe imingeni yezophuhliso eli lizwekazi elijamelene nayo.
tgt: UMthethosivivinywa ungenye yamathuluzi ahlukahlukene esinawo kuleli okulwisana nobugebengu obuphathelene nezimali obenziwa yizikhulu zikahulumeni kanye nabantu abasezikhundleni eziphakeme abasebenza emkhakheni ozimele.

src: Eli liphulo likhokelisa phambiil iintlobo zokuxhakaxhaba bobuchwepheshe bolwazi nonxibelelwano kwi-Ajenda yezoPhuhliso yowama-2063 yamazwe ase-Afrika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe nguNgqongqoshe Wezezimali ukuthi izingxoxo zokubonisana nokufakana imilomo ziyaqhubeka futhi zizophothulwa khona maduze nje ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuqaliswa kwenqubo yokushaywa kwemithethonqubo ezoqalisa ukusebenza koMthetho we-FICIzinqumo Zekhabhinethi.

src: Ngokulungelelanisa icandelo lezobuchwepheshe loMzantsi Afrika kunye nobunganga balo neenkqubo zophuhliso zoMfelandawonye wezobuChwepheshe wase-Afrika, uMzantsi Afrika uz a kuncedisa kuhlumo lwamashishini eli lizwekazi.9 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukuphunyezwa koMgaqo-nkqubo weSizwe weSebe leMfundo esisiSeko weNtsholongwane kaGawulayo (i-HIV), iziFo ezoSulela ngokuLalana (ii-STI) kunye neSifo sePhepha (i-TB).Umgaqo-nkqubo wowe-1999 wawugxininisa kuzo zonke iindlela zokulumkela kunye neendlela zokuzikhusela ezisekelwe kunyango, ungawuseli so kakhulu umba wezinto zeendlela ubomi bethu esibuphila ngayo, iimeko zezentlalo kwakunye neendlela esiziphethe ngazo njengezinto ezibalulekileyo ezibangelala i-HIV.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezezimali wethulele iKhabhinethi umbiko mayelana nemihlangano abeyihambele esikhathini esifushane esedlule, ebandakanya imihlangano yaSentwasahlobo Yenhlangano Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yezezimali (i-IMF) NeBhange Lomhlaba, neZigcawu Zokuheha Abatshalimali kanye neNgqungquthela ye-WEF eqondene ne-Afrika.

src: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo ucebisa ukuba masiyitshintshe yonke indlela esiyibona ngayo i-HIV siyibone njengesifo ekufuneka silawulwe kusetyenziswa indlela esetyenziswa ukulawula iinkonzo zezempilo zoluntu, kunye nokukhokeliswa phambili kwengxaki ye-TB ezikolweni, phakathi kwezinye izinto.
tgt: Ngaphezu kwalokhu uhlinzeke iKhabhinethi ngolwazi mayelana neziphakamiso zeSivumelwano esiphakathi kwe-G20 ne-Afrika kanye nezinto ezikhathaza abatshalimali neziNhlangano Ezenza Izilinganiso Zeminotho Yamazwe Omhlaba.

src: Lo mgaqo-nkqubo uza kusetyenziswa uquke abantu abaninzi uquke abafundi, ootitshala kunye namagosa kwizikolo zikarhulumente ngokunjalo nakwezizimeleyo.
tgt: Kubanjwe ingxoxo ebanzi mayelana nesimo somnotho emhlabeni kanye nesomnotho wesifunda futhi kwaxoxiswana ngokuthi yini okumele siyenze ukuze siguqule lesi simo esingaphansi kwaso njengamanje sokwehliswa kwesilinganiso somnotho wezwe, njengoba usufakwe ngaphansi kwezinga leminotho efadalalayo.

src: Imithetho Eyilwayo.1 IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukungeniswa ePalammente koMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weeNkampani yeziKhululo zeeNqwelo-moya wowama-2017, kunye noMthetho-sihlomelo oYilwayo weeNkonzo zezoLawulo lweeNqwelo-moya eMoyeni nobuChwepheshe bokuLawula iiNqwelo-moya eMoyeni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi igcizelelile ukuthi isalokhu izibophezele ekulandeleni umgudu wenqubomgomo yezezimali obalulwe kwiNkulumo Yesabelomali sowezi-2017, nokuqaliswa kwezinguquko zokwenza ngcono indlela okuphethwe ngayo izinkampani zombuso nokuqinisekisa ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezimali akubi ngaphezu komkhawulo obekiwe wokusetshenziswa kwemali kanye nokuqinisekisa uzinzo ezikweletini zikahulumeni ukuze zingabi ngaphezu kwamandla.

src: Izilungiso kule Mithetho-sihlomelo zilungiselelwe ukunika umthetho osisigxina.
tgt: Uhlelo lukahulumeni lokusheshisa ukuqaliswa kwezinguquko okuhloswe ngazo ukukhuthaza ukukhula komnotho, njengoba lokhu kuqukethwe oHlelweni Olunamaphuzu Ayisishiyagalolunye, lusalokhu lusemqoka kakhulu ekusombululeni ezinye zezinto ezikhathaza abatshalimali.

src: Imisitho ezayo.1 UMongameli uJacob Zuma uza kwenza intetho yokuvula i-Indaba yezoKhenketho yowama-2017 eza kube ibanjelwe kwiziko i-Inkosi Albert Luthuli International Convention Centre eDurban phakathi komhla we-16 nowe-18 kuCanzibe wowama-2017.Le yingqungquthela yehlabathi eza kubonisa ngeemveliso zoMzantsi Afrika zecandelo lezokhenketho nelokuntenda.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyawemukela umbiko okhishwe yifemu i-EY Consultancy ophathelene noTshalomali Olungena Ngqo e-Afrika luvela Emazweni Angaphandle.

src: Le Indaba iza kukhuthaza futhi ixhase amaphulo aqhubayo okuzisa iinguqu kunye nophuhliso kwicandelo lezokhenketho loMzantsi Afrika ingakumbi ngokwendima edlalwa ngoosomashishini abasakhasayo kunye nabanikazi bamashishini amancinci.
tgt: Lo mbiko ubala iNingizimu Afrika njengelinye lamazwe ayizizinda zomnotho ezinkulukazi futhi ikleliswe endaweni yesibili kwiNkomba yowezi-2017 Yamazwe Akhangayo Kubatshalimali Bangaphandle.

src: Ngabakhenkethi abavela kumazwe angaphandle abangaphezulu kwizigidi ezili-10 abangena eMzantsi Afrika ngowama-2016, into leyo ithetha ukuba bangaphezulu nge-13% kwabo bowama-2015.Eli zinga lingaphezulu kakhulu kumyinge oyi-3% ongumyinge wehlabathi wokunyuka kwamanani wabakhenkethi ngeli xesha linye.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yazisiwe futhi nangodaba lokuvakashela kuleli kweziNhlangano Ezenza Izilinganiso Zeminotho Yamazwe Omhlaba okuzokwenzeka esikhathini esifushane esizayo lapho lezi zinhlangano zizofakana khona imilomo nezinhlangano ezahlukahlukene kuleli kanye nezikhulu eziphezulu zikahulumeni.

src: IKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba luzifunde luzicokise ezi Voti zoHlahlo Lwabiwo-mali njengoko ziza kube zinikezelwa epalamente ngokweenkqubo zepalamente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilugunyazile uHlaka Olubuyekeziwe Lohlelo Lwezokuthutha Lwezindawo Zasemakhaya.

src: ISebe lezaManzi noGutyulo liza kusingatha iVeki yezoGutyulo phakathi komhla we-16 nowama-22 kuCanzibe ngowama-2017 phantsi komxholo othi: UGutyulo luSetyenziselwa iMpilo neSidima Sabantu”.
tgt: Lolu hlelo kuhloswe ngalo ukubhekana nezinto ezibekwe eqhulwini komasipala bezifunda kanye nasezifundazweni, ngokuthi kulungiswe inkinga yokugqoza nokungahlinzekwa kahle kweNgqalasizinda Nezinsizakalo Zokuthutha Ezindaweni Zasemakhaya, okuyinto evimbela ukuthuthukiswa kwenhlalo-mnotho kulezi zindawo.

src: Urhulumente uzimisele ukubuyisela abemi boMzantsi Afrika isidima sabo ngokubabonelela ngeenkonzo zogutyulo.
tgt: Ukuqaliswa kokusebenza kwalolu hlelo kuzolekelela ekuthuthukisweni komnotho wendawo kanye nowesifundazwe ngokwenza ngcono ukutholakala kwezinto zokuthutha umphakathi.

src: Ngale veki kuza kugxininiswa kakhulu ekukhokeliseni phambili iNkqubo yokuPhelisa Amabhakethi.
tgt: Lokhu kuzokhulisa ukuxhumana kwezindawo zasemadolobheni kanye nezindawo zasemakhaya, ngenhloso yokuqiniseka ukuthi izindawo zasemakhaya ziyabandakanywa emnothweni wezwe ukuze nazo zihlomule futhi zifake isandla esibonakalayo.

src: Ngethuba lale veki kuza kunikezelwa izindlu zangasese ezigungxulwayo kubantu abakuMasipala weNgiqi waseNketoane, eFreyistatha kunye noMasipala weNgingqi iDavid Kruiper eMntla Koloni njengenxalenye yokukhawulezisa iinkonzo zogutyulo ukuze kupheliswe inkqubo yokusebenzisa amabhakethi njengezindlu zangasese.5 UMzantsi Afrika ubhiyozela iNyanga ye-Afrika phantsi komxholo othi: Ukwakha i-Afrika eNgcono neHlabathi eliNgcono.
tgt: Lokhu kubonisa ngokucacile ukuzibophezela kukaHulumeni ekukhuliseni umkhakha wezinto zokuthutha zasolwandle, nokuwuthuthukisa lo mkhakha futhi kulethwe noguquko, ukuze kusekelwe ukuthuthukiswa kwenhlalo-mnotho yabantu futhi kusenjalo kufakwe isandla kwezokuhwebelana phakathi kwamazwe ngamazwe.

src: ISebe lezobuGcisa neNkcubeko liza kukhokela imisitho emininzi eza kugxininisa kubumbano lwe-Afrika.
tgt: Lokhu kuyahambisana nezinto ezibekwe eqhulwini nguhulumeni eziphathelene nomkhankaso we-Operation Phakisa okuhloswe ngawo ukukhulisa uMnotho Wasolwandle.

src: Le misitho iza kufikela kuvuthondaba ngomhla wama-25 kuCanzibe kowama-2017 apho uMongameli eza kusingatha umsitho osisidlo esisesikweni eSefako Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse.
tgt: Kuyahambelana futhi nezinjongo ezibanzi zokugqugquzela ukukhula komnotho kanye nokukhuthaza ukuvulwa kwamathuba omsebenzi, njengoba lokhu kubekwe ngokucacile kwi-NDP kanye Nohlelo Lwengqalasizinda Lukazwelonke.

src: Abantu abamenyiweyo kwesi sidlo zinkokeli zemibutho yabantu abaphuma kumazwe angaphandle abahlala apha eMzantsi Afrika uMongameli ebekhe wadibana nabo ngowe-20.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukushicilelwa koHlaka Lohlelo Lokuqinisekisa Ukubhekelelwa Kwemvelo Kwezokuthutha ukuze umphakathi uphawule ngalo.

src: Ukutyalwa komkhosi wezokhuselo wesizwe womzantsi afrika (I-SANDF)9.1 IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isigqibo sikaMongameli uJacob Zuma sokwandisa ixesha elibekelwe amajoni e-SANDF atyalwe eDemocratic Republic of Congo (e-DRC).Ukwenza oku kukuncedisa kumalinge okudala uxolo nozinzo kweli lizwekazi le-Afrika ingakumbi kulo mmandla ngokuhambelana noxanduva lwethu njengelizwe eliyinxalenye yamazwe ehlabathi kunye nomgaqo-nkqubo weli wezangaphandle wokuncedisa kumaphulo okudala i-Afrika kunye nehlabathi elingcono.2 Ngamajoni e-SANDF angama-1 371 atyalwe e-DRC ukuya kuncedisa kwiPhulo lokuZisa uZinzo loMbutho weZizwe eziManyeneyo.
tgt: Ezokuthutha zidlala indima esemqoka ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi ukuhwebelana namazwe omhlaba kwenzeka ngendlela ebhekelela ukusimama komnotho, nenhlalo yabantu kanye nemvelo.

src: Ixesha aza kulichitha e-DRC la majoni landisiwe lisuka kumhla woku-1 kuTshazimpunzi ngowama-2017 laya kutsho kumhla wama-31 kweyoKwindla ngowama-20.3 Ukutyala kwethu amajoni kweli lizwekazi kulilinge lokuxhasa amaphulo alo mmandla naweli lizwekazi okuzama ukulwa izixholo-xholo, ukukhuthaza uxolo nokhuseleko, ukomeleza ubudlelwane phakathi kwemimandla yeli lizwekazi, ukunyusa izinga lokurhwebelana phakathi kwamazwe ase-Afrika kunye nokulwela uphuhliso oluzinzileyo e-Afrika.
tgt: Izinhlelo zokuthutha zingumgogodla wemisebenzi yansukuzonke ephathelene nenhlalo-mnotho eNingizimu Afrika ngoba zenza kube lula ukuthuthwa kwabantu nempahla.

src: Iimbasa zesizwe.1 IKhabhinethi ibaqhwabela izandla bonke abathe bawongwa ngeeMbasa zeSizwe ngo-ngowama-2017.
tgt: Kodwa-ke, intuthu engcolile ekhiqizwa wumkhakha wezokuthutha inomthelela kumthamo ophelele wentuthu engcolile nesikhutha (ama-GHG) kuleli, futhi umkhakha wezokuthutha ngomgwaqo yiwona ohamba phambili kulokhu.

src: Kulo nyaka ka-OR Tambo, basibonisile ukubaluleka kokusebenzela uMzantsi Afrika ongcono nesizwe esingcono.
tgt: Lolu hlelo luhlose ukwenza iziphakamiso zokungenelela ezizonciphisa intuthu engcolile nesikhutha ngaphansi kwemigomo yentuthuko esimeme.

src: Sifunda kwimisebenzi yabo emihle, ukuzinikela kwabo, ukuthanda nokubonakalisa umdla ongazenzisiyo wokulwela uluntu nobuntu.
tgt: Lolu wubambiswano oluholwa ngamazwe ase-Afrika olugxile ekuthuthukiseni izixazululo ezifanelekile kanye nokwabelana ngezinsiza ukuze kusonjululwe izinselelo ezibhekene naleli zwekazi.

src: I-Order of Ikhamanga yeGolide (mnye), i-Order of Ikhamanga yeSilivere (basixhenxe), i-Order of Ikhamanga yeBronzi (mnye), i-Order of the Baobab yeGolide (mnye), i-Order of the Baobab yeSilivere (babini), i-Order of the Baobab yeBronzi (babini), i-Order of Luthuli yeSilivere (bangama-29), i-Order of Luthuli yeBronzi (mnye), i-Order of Mapungubwe yeSilivere (babini), i-Order of the Companions of OR Tambo yeGolide (mnye).2 Ukukhutshwa kweNgxelo ye-17 yeKhomishini yoLungelelwaniso lwezeNgqesho nguMphathiswa wezabaSebenzi uNksz Mildred Oliphant kubonakalisa indlela esihamba kancinci ngayo isantya sokuzisa iinguqu kwimisebenzi emininzi apha eMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: Lokhu kwenza uLwazi Lwezobuchwepheshe Kwezokuxhumana lube ngumgogodla we-ajenda yentuthuko yowezi-2063 yamazwe ase-Afrika.

src: Le ngxelo ibonakalisa ukuba sisekude kakhulu ekufikeleleni kwisizwe apho abasebenzi bebonakalisa iintlanga ezahlukeneyo zoMzantsi Afrika ngokulinganayo.
tgt: INingizimu Afrika izohlomula kukhona kokubili ezomnotho nezepolitiki ngokubamba kwayo iqhaza ku-Smart Africa.

src: Abantu abaNtsundu, abantu basetyhini kunye nabantu abakhubazekileyo ngabona bantu bavinjwa amathuba kuwo onke amabakala oLungelelwaniso kwezeNgqesho.3 Le ngxelo ibonisa ukuba abantu abamhlophe ngabo abakwizikhundla eziphezulu ezingama-68% zeli lizwe kurhulumente nakumashishini abucala, inani elo lilinani eliphindwe kathandathu labantu abamhlophe asele bekwinqanaba lokusebenza.
tgt: Ngokwenza imboni yaseNingizimu Afrika kanye nolwazi nobuchwepheshe bayo obunzulu kube ngumongo we-ajenda yentuthuko ye-Smart Africa, iNingizimu Afrika izofaka isandla ekukhuliseni amabhizinisi akuleli esifundeni.

src: Abantu abantsundu bona bakwizikhundla eziphezulu ezili-14.4% kuphela.4 Njengoko umba wokuzisa iinguqu nowohlumo oluza kuxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke ingxamiseke kakhulu xa kungoku, la manani eenkcukacha zengqesho kwizikhundla eziphezulu awamkelekanga kwaphela.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukuphasiswa kweNqubomgomo Kazwelonke YoMnyango Wezemfundo Eyisisekelo ephathelene neGciwane Lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV), iZifo Ezithathwelana Ngokocansi (ama-STI) kanye neSifo Sofuba (i-TB).Ngowe-1999 inqubomgomo yayigxile ezinyathelweni ezisetshenziswa emhlabeni wonke jikelele zokuvimbela ukusuleleka ngegciwane, futhi ingazibhekisisi ngokwanele izimo zenhlalo nokuziphatha kwabantu ezibhebhezela i-HILe nqubomgomo iphakamisa ukuthi kube noguquko olunohlonze kwindlela okusetshenzwa ngayo, ngokuthi i-HIV ibhekwe ngasohlangothini lodaba lokuphatha olungumongo ngokusebenzisa indlela egxile empilweni yomphakathi futhi kusenjalo kubandakanywe ne-TB kulokho okuzogxilwa kukhona ezikoleni, phakathi kokunye.

src: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso ngoLwesithathu, umhla wama-24 kuCanzibe kowama-2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabamba umhlangano wayo ngoLwesithathu mhla zingama-24 kuNhlaba 2017, e-Tuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Imiba engundaba-mlonyeni.
tgt: Izindaba ezisematheni.

src: IKhabhinethi ixhalabile ziziganeko ezifuna ukuthatha unyawo zoxhatshazo kunye nobundlobongela obujoliswe kwabasetyhini kweli lizwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhathazekile ngokudlondlobala kwezigameko zokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane kanye nodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane ezweni lakithi.

src: Iziganeko zakutsha nje ziquka ubundlobongela obenziwa zizinqanda-mathe ezithe zakhokelela ekubeni abantu basetyhini abaninzi babonakalise isibindi nokungoyiki ngokuthi bathethe phandle bekhalimela ukunyhashwa kwamalungelo abo.
tgt: Izigameko zakamuva ezibandakanya udlame olubhebhezelwa ngamasoka abo seziholele ekutheni abesifazane abaningi abanesibindi baphumele obala bazwakalise ukukhathazeka kwabo mayelana nalokhu kwephulwa nokunyathelwa kwamalungelo abo.

src: IKhabhinethi iyavuma ukuba njengelizwe siyaqhubeleka nokuba sisizwe esilawulwa ngogonyamelo labantu abangamadoda kangangokuba iyakubethelela ukuba kuninzi ekufuneka kwenziwe ukulwa umkhuba wokubulawa ngolunya kwabantu basetyhini kunye nokurhweba ngabantu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyavuma ukuthi njengezwe sisalokhu siyizwe elilawulwa ngamadoda futhi elibeka amadoda phambili, ngokunjalo-ke inxusa ukuba kwenziwe imizamo ethe xaxa ukulwisana nesihlava sokubulawa nokushushumbiswa kwabesifazane.

src: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kuwo onke amacandelo kweli lizwe ukuba abambisane kuliwe nalo mkhwa mbi kangaka, azikhabe zonke iintlobo zobundlobongela ezenziwa kwabasetyhini nabantwana, nokuba asebenzisane namapolisa kunye necandelo leenkundla ukuze bonke abenzi bobubi badityaniswa nomthetho.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa yonke imikhakha yomphakathi ukuba ibambisane ekunqobeni lesi sihlava, ilwisane nanoma yiluphi uhlobo lodlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane, futhi isebenzisane namaphoyisa kanye nohlelo lwezobulungiswa ukuze kuboshwe futhi kugwetshwe abenzi bobubi.

src: UMongameli uJacob Zuma umemelele ukuba mawuphele lo mkhuba uqhubekekayo wokuxhatshazwa kwabantu basetyhini nabantwana.
tgt: UMongameli Jacob Zuma usenxuse ukuba kuphele ukuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane okulokhu kuqhubekile njalo.

src: IKhabhinethi iyalele iNtlanganisela yoKhuseleko ekuHlaleni, uPhuhliso loLuntu naBantu ukuba imisele inkqubo yokusebenza eza kuba sisikhokelo esiza kunceda isizwe kwidabi lokulwa ukuxhatshazwa kwabasetyhini nabantwana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyalele iQoqwana Lezokuvikelwa Komphakathi Nokuthuthukiswa Kwabantu ukuba liqalise uhlelo lokusebenza oluzohola izwe empini yokuqeda udlame olubhekiswe kwabesifazane nezingane.

src: IKhabhinethi iyazamkela iziphumo zoPhando loMzantsi Afrika lowama-2016 leNani laBantu nezeMpilo liziko lezeNkcukacha-mani loMzantsi Afrika (i-Stats SA), eliphonononga imeko yempilo yabemi boMzantsi Afrika, kunye nomgangatho kunye nenani labantu abaxhamlayo kwiinkqubo zezempilo.
tgt: IKhabinethi iyayithokozela imiphumela yoCwaningo lowezi-2016 Lwesimo Sempilo Nenhlalo Yabantu Abahlukahlukene BaseNingizimu Afrika olwenziwe wuPhiko Lwezezibalo eNingizimu Afrika (i-Stats SA), olucubungula futhi luhlole isimo sempilo sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika, nezinga lokufinyelela kwezinhlelo zezempilo kubona kanye nekhwalithi yalezo zinhlelo.

src: Olu phando, phakathi kwezinye izinto, lunike ingxelo ezichaza ukuba inani labantwana abaswelekayo lihle ngama-20% nokuba elabantu basetyhini namadoda abatshaya icuba lona lihle nge-11%.Ezi ziphumo zibonakalisa ukuba imigaqo-nkqubo emiselwe ngulo mbuso uphantsi kukaMongameli Zuma iza neziphumo ezincumisayo.
tgt: Umbiko wocwaningo ubonisa ukuthi, phakathi kokunye, sehle ngama-20% isibalo sokushona kwezingane futhi lehle nge-11% inani labesifazane kanye nabesilisa ababhema ugwayi.

src: Noko kunjalo, iKhabhinethi ixhalabile linani labemi beli ababelana ngesondo namaqabane amaninzi ahlukeneyo bengasebenzisi zikhuseli.
tgt: Kepha-ke, iKhabhinethi ikhathazekile ngesibalo sabantu baseNingizimu Afrika abasalokhu beqhubeka nokuya ocansini olungaphephile nabalingani abaningi.

src: Abantu basetyhini abangama-32% kunye nabangamadoda abangama-42% bathe zange baye kuhlolela iNtsholongwana kaGawulayo (i-HIV) nangoku sele kukho amaphulo amaninzi karhulumente okufundisa abantu malunga nokubaluleka kokuvavanyelwa i-HIV.
tgt: Abesifazane abangama-32% kanye nabesilisa abangama-42% batshele abenzi bocwaningo ukuthi bona abakaze bahlolelwe igciwane lesandulelangculazi (i-HIV) nakuba uhulumeni enza imizamo yokuqwashisa ngokubaluleka kokuhlolelwa i-HIV.

src: IKhabhinethi ihlaba ikhwelo kubemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bayazi into yokuba impilo yabo kunye nobomi babo busezandleni zabo, nokuba mabasebenzise izikhuseli xa besabelana ngesondo futhi bazihlole i-HIV kunye nazo zonke ezinye izifo ezosulelayo nezingosuleliyo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba baqikelele impilo nenhlalakahle yabo, bazivikele uma beya ocansini futhi njalo baye kohlolelwa i-HIV kanye nazo zonke izifo ezithathelwanayo nezingathathelwana.

src: IKhabhinethi icela abazali nabagcini-bantwana ukuba baqinisekise ukuba abantwana babo bazigonyelwe izifo zabantwana.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa abazali kanye nabalondolozi bezingane ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi izingane zabo zigonyelwa izifo ezihlasela izingane.

src: IKhabhinethi isazimisele ukuqinisekisa ukuba bayagonywa ukuze kuliwe izifo ezosulelayo eziyingozi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isalokhu izibophezele ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi izingane ziyagonywa ngenhloso yokuqeda izifo ezithathelwanayo eziyingozi kakhulu empilweni yezingane.

src: IKhabhinethi iqinisekisa abazali kunye nabagcini-bantwana ukuba amayeza akhutshwa liSebe lezeMpilo awanabungozi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ithanda ukuqinisekisa abazali nabalondolozi ukuthi iphephile imithi esetshenziswa nguMnyango Wezempilo ukugoma izingane zabo.

src: IKhabhinethi iyasamkela isigaba sokuqala sokuhlaziywa kweMizi-mveliso yaseVulindlela Heights eMthatha eMpuma Koloni.
tgt: IKhabinethi isamukelile isigaba sokuqala sesizinda sezimboni esivuselelwe kabusha i-Vulindlela Heights Industrial esiseMthatha, eMpumalanga Kapa.

src: Oku kuyinxalenye yeNkqubo yesizwe yokuHlaziya imiMandla yeMizi-mveliso.
tgt: Lokhu kuyingxenye yoHlelo Lokuvuselelwa Kabusha Kwamapaki Ezimboni.

src: Lo msebenzi ngowesibini eMpuma Koloni futhi lo mmandla wemizi-mveliso ngomnye wemithandathu evuselelwayo kweli lizwe.
tgt: Leli paki lezimboni liyisizinda sesibili salolu hlobo eMpumalanga Kapa futhi lingelinye lamapaki ezimboni ayisithupha avuselelwa kabusha njengamanje ezweni lonkana.

src: Urhulumente uhlaziya imimandla yemizi-mveliso ukuze kudaleke imisebenzi futhi kubekho nohlumo oluxhanyulwa ngumntu wonke.
tgt: Uhulumeni uvuselela amapaki ezimboni ngenhloso yokukhuthaza ukuvulwa kwamathuba omsebenzi kanye nokuqinisekisa ukukhula komnotho okubandakanya abantu bonke.

src: Ukususwa kwemizi-mveliso norhwebo ezidolophini nako kuyinxalenye yamalinge karhulumente okuzisa iinguqo zezoqoqosho.
tgt: Ukufuduswa kwemisebenzi yezomnotho isuka ezizindeni ezisemadolobheni nakho kuyingxenye yemizamo kahulumeni yokuletha uguquko lwezomnotho olunohlonze.

src: Iinkcukacha malunga nokuba ubani angawasebenzisa njani amathuba akhoyo kule mimandla yemizi-mveliso, ukufumana inkxaso karhulumente kunye neenkqubo zezibonelelo zikarhulumente, kunye namathuba otyalo-malo kumacandelo ahlukeneyo ziyafumaneka kule webhusayithi: WEBTOKEN okanye ngokutsalela umnxeba kwiZiko lemiBuzo leSebe lezoRhwebo noShishino (i-dti) kule nombolo: 0861 843 384.
tgt: Ulwazi mayelana nokuthi abantu bangawasebenzisa kanjani amathuba akhona emapaki ezimboni akuleli futhi bafinyelele nasezinhlelweni zosizo nemihlomulo-nkuthazo ehlinzekwa nguhulumeni kanye namathuba okutshalwa kwezimali emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, luyatholakala WEBTOKEN noma eSikhungweni Sokuxhumana Namakhasimende soMnyango Wezohwebo Nezimboni (i-dti) ngokufonela le nombolo: 0861 843 384.

src: IKhabhinethi ivile futhi idanisiwe sisigqibo sika-General Motors South Africa (GMSA) (Pty) Ltd sokuyeka ukwenza kunye nokuthengisa iimoto zakwa-Chevrolet kweli lizwe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi isiphawule ngokudabuka nokukhathazeka isinqumo senkampani yezimoto i-General Motors South Africa (i-GMSA) (Pty) Ltd sokuvala umsebenzi wayo wokukhiqiza nokuthengisa izimoto zohlobo lwe-Chevrolet kuleli.

src: Oku kuzindaba ezimbi ngenene kuqoqosho lweli kwakunye nabo baza kuphulukana nemisebenzi.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoba nomthelela omubi kakhulu kulabo abazophelelwa yimisebenzi yabo kanye nasemnothweni wezwe lakithi.

src: Urhulumente nangoku usazimisele ukuxhasa icandelo lezeemoto, elilicandelo elibaluleke kakhulu kuqoqosho lweli kunye nakumalinge okudala imisebenzi.
tgt: Uhulumeni usalokhu ezibophezele ekusekeleni umkhakha wezimoto, okuwumkhakha obaluleke kakhulu emnothweni wezwe nasekuvulweni kwamathuba omsebenzi.

src: I-dti iyaqhubeleka nokusebenzisana nawo onke amahlakani ukuba enze iinzame zokuphungula umonkalo oza kwenziwa koku.
tgt: I-dti iyaqhubeka nokusebenzisana nabo bonke abathintekayo ukunciphisa umthelela walokhu.

src: Ukunyusa izinga lokuvelisa, ukudala imisebenzi nokunyusa umthamo wempahla zorhwebo ezithunyelwa kumazwe angaphandle, siphehlelele isigaba sesithoba sesiCwangciso sokuSebenza soMgaqo-nkqubo wezoShishino (i-IPAP) ukuze sibe sisikhokelo sethu.
tgt: Ngenhloso yokukhulisa umsebenzi wokukhiqiza, ukuvulwa kwamathuba omsebenzi kanye nokuqinisa ukuthunyelwa kwempahla emazweni angaphandle, esikhathini esifushane esedlule sethule isigaba sesishiyagalolunye soHlelo Lokusebenza Lwenqubomgomo Yezimboni (i-IPAP) ukuze ihole izinyathelo zethu.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuqaphele ukuba inkampani yakwa-Isuzu, ebikade isebenzisana no-GMSA iminyaka emininzi eMzantsi Afrika, yiyo ngoku eza kungena endaweni ka-GMSIKhabhinethi iwuqaphela umba wembalela ethathe unyawo eNtshona Koloni naseMpuma Koloni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuphawulile ukuthi inkampani yakwa-Isuzu, ebilokhu ibambisene nabakwa-GMSA eNingizimu Afrika kule minyaka edlule, izothatha izintambo iqhube umsebenzi obewenziwa ngabakwa-GMSIKhabhinethi isiphawulile isimo esibi kakhulu esidalwe yisomiso eNtsonalanga Kapa kanye naseMpumalanga Kapa.

src: IKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba nalo luncedise kwiinkqubo eziqaliswe ngala maphondo zokunciphisa indlela amanzi ankinkishwa ngayo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa imiphakathi ukuba isekele imikhawulo ebekwe yizifundazwe yokusetshenziswa nokongiwa kwamanzi.

src: Iqela elakhiwe ngamagosa aphuma kwiSebe lezaManzi noGutyulo, kunye neKomiti yeSizwe yoLawulo lweeNtlekele lisebenzisana namaphondo kunye noomasipala, lifakana imilomo ngeenjongo zokuqinisekisa ukuba izisombululo ezikhawulezileyo nezexesha elide ziyakhawuleziswa ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba kukho amanzi aneleyo kula maphondo aza kusetyenziswa ixesha elide.
tgt: Ithimba elihlanganisa izikhulu ezivela eMnyangweni Wezamanzi Nokuthuthwa Kwendle, neKomidi Likazwelonke Lokuphathwa Nokulawulwa Kwezinhlekelele, ngokusebenzisana nohulumeni bezifundazwe nabezindawo, basebenza ngokuzikhandla okukhulu ukuqinisekisa ukusheshiswa kwezixazululo zesikhathi esifushane kuya esikhathini esimaphakathi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukutholakala kwamanzi anele ezifundazweni esikhathini eside esizayo.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika kuquka nabantu emakhaya, kwicandelo lezoshishino, elezemigodi, elezamandla kunye nelezolimo ukuba basebenzisane futhi basebenzise amanzi ngononophelo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika kubandakanya nabasebenzisi bamanzi basemakhaya, amabhizinisi, umkhakha wezimayini, owezamandla kanye nowezolimo ukuba basebenze ngokubambisana futhi basebenzise amanzi ngokucophelela, futhi bawonge.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakwamkela ukukhutshwa koxwebhu ekuza kuxoxwa phezu kwalo lesiCwangciso-qhinga sokuLwa noRhwaphilizo, eliza kusetyenziswa njengesikhokelo sesiCwangciso-qhinga seSizwe sokuLwa noRhwaphilizo.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikwamukelile ukukhishwa kombhalo wokuxoxisana weSu Lokulwisana Nenkohlakalo, ozoholela ekusungulweni kweSu Likazwelonke Lokulwisana Nenkohlakalo.

src: IKhabhinethi icela uluntu ukuba luhlomle luvakalise izimvo zalo ngolu xwebhu ngokuthumela ezo zimvo kwiwebhusayithi yeSebe lezokuCwangcisa, ukuHlola nokuVavanya ethi: www.
tgt: IKhabhinethi imema umphakathi ukuba uthumele iziphakamiso nemibono yawo ebhalwe phansi, ngokusebenzisa i-webhusayithi yoMnyango Wezokuhlela, Ukuqapha Nokuhlola ku: www.

src: Idabi lokulwa urhwaphilizo lusengumba ophambili kurhulumente.
tgt: Impi yokulwisana nenkohlakalo isalokhu ingenye yezinto ezibekwe eqhulwini nguhulumeni.

src: Urhwaphilizo nokungathenjwa kwabasemagunyeni kurhulumente nakwicandelo lamashishini kuneziphumo ezibi kuphuhliso lwelizwe.
tgt: Inkohlakalo kanye nokungasebenzi ngobuqotho emikhakheni yomibili, okungumkhakha ozimele kanye nomkhakha kahulumeni, kunomthelela omubi kakhulu ekuthuthukisweni kwezwe lethu.

src: IKhabhinethi ivakalise ukuxhalaba sisenzo sakutshanje sobukrelemqa kweze-intanethi kwihlabathi, esichazwe njengesona senzo sobukrelemqa kweze-intanethi esakhe sasikhulu ezimbalini.
tgt: IKhabinethi izwakalise ukukhathazeka ngesigameko sakamuva sokuhlaselwa kohlelo-xhumano lwe-inthanethi emhlabeni jikelele, okubikwe njengesigameko esikhulu kunazo zonke kuze kube manje sokuhlaselwa kohlelo-xhumano lwe-inthanethi.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba balumke kangangoko xa besebenzisa ubuxhaka-xhaka beteknoloji xa benxibelelana okanye bethumela, bekhupha okanye befakelwa imali.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba bathathe izinyathelo ezidingekile ukuqinisekisa ukuphepha kwemininingwane yabo ngenkathi bexhumana noma benza ibhizinisi ngohlelo-xhumano lwe-inthanethi.

src: Abantu bayakhuthazwa ukuba basebenzise iinkqubo zekhompyutha ezinesakhono esihlaziywa rhoqo sokulwa nezinye iinkqubo zekhompyutha ezinjongo yazo ikukuba nokutshabalalisa ulwazi olukwikhompyutha.
tgt: Kunconywa futhi nokuthi abasebenzisi bohlelo-xhumano lwe-inthanethi basebenzise uhlelo-kusebenza lwekhompyutha lwakamuva olulwisana ngokuqhubekayo namavayirasi ahlasela izinhlelo-kusebenza zamakhompyutha.

src: IKhabhinethi ixhalatyisiwe zizinto ezenzeka kwa-Eskom.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhathazekile ngezigameko zakamuva ezenzeke kwa-Eskom.

src: IKhabhinethi iyakuqonda ukuba umba wokuqeshwa kwakhona kukaMnu Brian Molefe njengeGosa eliPhezulu lesiGqeba (i-CEO) usezinkundleni zamatyala nasePalamente ke ngoko ayizikuphazamisana neenkqubo zala macandelo karhulumente.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikuqonda ngokuphelele ukuthi udaba oluphathelene nokuqashwa kabusha kukaMnu Brian Molefe njengoMphathi Omkhulu (i-CEO) wakwa-Eskom njengamanje luphambi kwezinkantolo kanye nePhalamende, ngakho-ke izozihlonipha lezo zinqubo zize ziphothulwe ngokufanelekile.

src: Noko kunjalo, uMongameli umisele iKomiti yaBaphathiswa (i-IMC) eyakhiwe nguMphathiswa wamaShishini kaRhulumente, owezaMandla, owezeMali kunye nowezobuLungisa neeNkonzo zoLuleko.
tgt: Kepha-ke, uMongameli usesungule iKomidi LoNgqongqoshe Beminyango Ehlukahlukene (i-IMC) elihlanganisa uNgqongqoshe Wezamabhizinisi Kahulumeni, Owezamandla, Owezezimali kanye Nowezobulungiswa Nokuhlunyeleliswa Kwezimilo.

src: Le IMC inikwe umsebenzi wokuqokelela iinkcukacha eziza kunceda iKhabhinethi ukuba ikwazi ukusombulula nokuphendula imiba efana nale kwixa elizayo.
tgt: Leli Komidi lijutshwe ukuba lenze umsebenzi wokuqoqa ulwazi namaqiniso azonikeza iKhabhinethi umhlahlandlela wokuthi kumele ibhekane kanjani nezindaba ezinjengalezi esikhathini esizayo.

src: Umququzeleli wale IMC nguMphathiswa wezobuLungisa neeNkonzo zoLuleko uMichael Masutha.
tgt: Umhlanganisi waleli komidi nguNgqongqoshe Wezobulungiswa Nokuhlunyeleliswa Kwezimilo, uMnu Michael Masutha.

src: Izigqibo zekhabhinethi.
tgt: Izinqumo zeKhabhinethi.

src: IKhabhinethi ikuvumile ukupapashwa ngowama-2017 koMqulu oHlaziyiweyo wezoPhuhliso oluBanzi lwabaMnyama kwezoQoqosho wecandelo lezeMigodi neziMbiwa loMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikugunyazile ukushicilelwa kukaSomqulu Obuyekeziwe wezi-2017 Wokufukulwa Nokuhlonyiswa Kwabantu Abamnyama Kwezomnotho oqondiswe embonini yeZimayini Nezimbiwa yaseNingizimu Afrika.

src: UMphathiswa wemiThombo yeziMbiwa uza kunika amagqabantshintshi wakuba lo mqulu upapashiwe kwigazethi.
tgt: UNgqongqoshe Wezimbiwa u-Mosebenzi Zwane uzohlinzeka ngolwazi olufanelekile uma lo somqulu usushicilelwe kusomqulu kahulumeni.

src: IKhabhinethi isivumile isiCwangciso seSizwe saMaz’omoya ezoNxibelelwano sowama-2017 esamkelwe liSebe leziSeko zoNxibelelwano neeNkonzo zePosi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ilugunyazile uHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwezokusakaza Ngomoya lowezi-2017 oluvunywe yiHhovisi LikaNgqongqoshe Wezengqalasizinda Yezokuxhumana Nezinsizakalo Zeposi.

src: Lo mthamo wamaza omoya eli lizwe liwabelwe kwiNkomfa yeHlabathi yezoNxibelelwano ngaMaz’omoya uza kudlala indima enkulu kuhlumo loqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: Umthamo wokusakaza ngomoya owabelwe leli lizwe eNgqungqutheleni Yomhlaba Yezokhuxhumana Ngamagagasi Omoya unomthelela omkhulu ekukhulisweni komnotho waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: IsiCwangciso seSizwe saMaz’omoya ezoNxibelelwano sowama-2017 sisikhokelo esityebileyo esicacisa indlela amaza omoya abiwe ngayo esabelwa iinkonzo ezahlukeneyo ezisebenzisa amaza omoya kwezonxibelwano.
tgt: UHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwezokusakaza Ngomoya lowezi-2017 luwumthombo obanzi futhi ophelele wokwabelwa kwezinsizakalo zokuxhumana ngamagagasi omoya umthamo wokusakaza ngomoya.

src: IsiCwangciso seSizwe saMaz’omoya ezoNxibelelwano sowama-2017 siza kuqinisekisa ukuba uMzantsi Afrika uthobela iMithetho yeHlabathi yezaMaz’omoya eyamkelwa kwinkomfa yowama-2015 yoMfelandawonye weHlabathi weziSeko zoNxibelelwano.
tgt: UHlelo Lukazwelonke Lwezokusakaza Ngomoya olubuyekeziwe lowezi-2017 luyaqinisekisa ukuthi iNingizimu Afrika iyahambisana neMithethonqubo egunyaziwe Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yezokusakaza Ngomoya eyamukelwa ngokusemthethweni kwiNgqungquthela yowezi-2015 yeNhlangano Yamazwe Ngamazwe Yezokuxhumana Ngezingcingo.

src: IKhabhinethi isamkele isiCwangciso-qhinga soKhuseleko kwiMijelokazi neMilambo Emikhulu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iligunyazile iSu Lokuphepha Kwemifula Emaphakathi Nezwe.

src: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga, ngokusebenzisa iQumrhu loMzantsi Afrika lezoKhuseleko eManzini, simisela imigangatho kwaye siphucula iinkqubo zokunika amaphepha-mvume kunye neelayisenisi kumaphenyane asebenza kule milambo mikhulu nemijelokazo.
tgt: Lelisu, ngokusebenzisa uPhiko Lwezokuphepha Olwandle LwaseNingizimu Afrika, lubeka amazinga okumele athotshelwe futhi luphucula izinqubo zokuhlinzekwa ngezimvume namalayisense kwezikebhe ezisebenza emifuleni emaphakathi nezwe.

src: Oku kuza kuqinisekisa ukuba la maphenyana asebenza kule milambo mikhulu nemijelokazi akhuselekile.
tgt: Lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuphepha kwezikebhe ezincane emifuleni yaseNingizimu Afrika emaphakathi nezwe.

src: IKhabhinethi isivumile isiCwangciso-qhinga sokuHambisa imiThwalo eziNdleleni.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iligunyazile iSu Lokuthunyelwa Kwempahla Ngezinto Zokuthutha Ezihamba Emgwaqeni.

src: Esi sicwangciso-qhinga silungiselelwe ukubhala imithetho ehlanginisiweyo kunye nesicwangciso sokusebenza, into leyo eza kubangela ukuba uMzantsi Afrika ukwazi ukufikelela kumgangatho wehlabathi ophezulu kwezokuhanjiswa kwemithwalo ezindleleni.
tgt: Lelisu kuhloswe ngalo ukwakha uhlaka lokulawula nokusebenza oludidiyelwe, oluzokwenza ukuba iNingizimu Afrika ikwazi ukufinyelela emazingeni aphuma phambili emhlabeni jikelele aphathelene nomsebenzi wokuthunyelwa kwempahla ngezinto zokuthutha ezihamba emgwaqeni.

src: Iziphakamiso ezi kwesi sicwangciso-qhinga ziza kuphucula indlela imithetho enyanzeliswa ngayo, zikhuthaze ukhuseleko ezindleni, zikhokelise phambili ukukhuselwa kweziseko ezingundoqo, kuphungulwe umonakalo kwindalo, zidale isicwangciso esihlangeneyo sokhuphiswano olusekelwe kwiimveliso neenkonzo ezisemgangathweni icandelo lezohanjiso lweempahla ezindleleni eliza kulusebenzisa ukuze lizalisekise izidingo zoqoqosho loMzantsi Afrika.
tgt: Izincomo zalelisu zizoqinisekisa ukuthotshelwa kangcono kwamazinga abekiwe, zigqugquzele ukuphepha emgwaqeni, zenze ngcono ukuvikelwa kwengqalasizinda, zinciphise umthelela ongemuhle ongakhahlameza imvelo futhi zakhe uhlaka oludidiyelwe lokuncintisana okulawulwa ngokwekhwalithi yomsebenzi oluzovumela ukuba umkhakha wokuthunyelwa kwempahla ngezinto zokuthutha ezihamba emgwaqeni ukwazi ukuqhubeka nomsebenzi wokubhekelela nokuhlinzekela izidingo zomnotho waseNingizimu Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi ilwamkele uhlobo lwengqekembe olwenziwe yi-South African Mint Company lweengqekembe zowama-2017 nowama-2018 ezisisikhumbuzo neziza kusetyenziswa luluntu.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iwagunyazile amadizayini eNkampani Ekhiqiza Izinhlamvu Zemali yaseNingizimu Afrika, owezi-2017 nowezi-2018 ezinhlamvu zemali ezizoba yisikhumbuzo kanye nalezo ezizosetshenziswa emphakathini nsukuzonke.

src: Ngokusebenzisana neKhabhinethi, olu hlobo lutsha lweengqekembe lwenzelwe ukuphawula inkcubeko, inkululeko nolawulo lwentando yesininzi phantsi komxholo othi: “Ukubhiyozela uMzantsi Afrika”.
tgt: Ngokubambisana neKhabhinethi, sekwakhiwe olunye uchungechunge lwezinhlamvu zemali eziwuphawu olumele amasiko, inkululeko kanye nombuso wentando yeningi labantu ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sibungaza iNingizimu Afrika”.

src: Isikhumbuzo seminyaka elikhulu sokuzalwa kweGqala loMzabalazo u-Oliver Reginald Tambo sakhethwa njengomba ekuza kusekelwa phezu kwawo xa kuzotywa ezi ngqekembe.
tgt: Umbungazo weminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa ingqalabutho yomzabalazo u-Oliver Reginald Tambo uqokwe njengomfanekiso wokuqala ozoboniswa kulezi zinhlamvu zemali.

src: Ukuqaliswa kwengqekembe ye-R50 entsha (i-1oz, nesilivere ye-sterling), ingqekembe ye-R500 (i-1oz, negolide eneekharathi ezingama-24) kunye nengqekembe ye-R50 (eyenziwe ngesinyithi) zokubhiyozela iminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kuka-OR Tambo.
tgt: Ukwethulwa kohlamvu olusha olungama-R50 (oluyisiliva soqobo olusinesisindo esilingana ne-awunsi elilodwa), uhlamvu olungama-R500 (olwakhiwe ngamakharethi egolide angama-24, olusinesisindo esilingana ne-awunsi elilodwa) kanye nohlamvu olungama-R50 (olwakhiwe nge-sterling silver), okuyizinhlamvu okuhloswe ngazo ukugubha iminyaka eyi-100 kwazalwa u-OR Tambo.

src: Zenziwe iintlobo zengqekembe zezi ngqekembe zesikhumbuzo zilandelayo zowama-2017 nowama-2018:a. Iingqekembe zowama-2017: Umbhiyozo wemiNyaka eliKhulu ka-Oliver Reginald Tambob.
tgt: Sekwakhiwe izinhlamvu zesikhumbuzo ezilandelayo zowezi-2017 nowezi-2018:a. Uchungechunge lwezinhlamvu zowezi-2017: Umgubho Yeminyaka Eyikhulu ka-Oliver Reginald Tambob.

src: Iingqekembe zowama-2017 eziza kusetyenziswa: ingqekembe ye-R5 ebonisa imbasa i-Order of the Companions of OR Tamboc.
tgt: Uchungechunge lohlamvu olungu-R5 lowezi-2017 oluzosetshenziswa nsukuzonke emphakathini: uhlamvu olungu-R5 olubonisa i-Order of the Companions of OR Tamboc.

src: Iingqekembe ze-Protea zowama-2017: Ubomi beSithwalandwe – uNelson Mandelad.
tgt: Uchungechunge lohlamvu lwe-Protea lowezi-2017: Impilo Yengqalabutho – u-Nelson Mandelad.

src: Iingqekembe ze-R1 zowama-2017: Izirhubuluzi zoMzantsi Afrika - Irhambae.
tgt: Uchungechunge lohlamvu olungu-R1 lowezi-2017: Izilwane Ezihuquzela Ngesisu zaseNingizimu Afrika – iBululue.

src: Iingqekembe zowama-2018 zaBantu neBhayosfiye zoMbutho we-UN wezeMfundo, ezeNzululwazi nezeNkcubeko: UMyezo weBhayosfiye waseWaterbergf.
tgt: Uchungechunge lohlamvu lowezi-2018 lweNhlangano Yezemfundo, Ezesayensi Nezamasiko engaphansi kweNhlangano Yezizwe (i-UNESCO) Umuntu Nemvelo Aphila Kuyo: Isiqiwu Semvelo sase-Waterbergf.

src: Iingqekembe zowama-2018: i-National Geographic Society ‘iPhulo leziLwanyana eziziKati zaseNdle eziNkulu - Ingonyamag.
tgt: Uchungechunge lwezinhlamvu zowezi-2018: Inhlangano Kazwelonke Yezejiyografi ‘Umklamo Wamakati Amakhulu Asendle’ – IBhubesig.

src: Ingqekembe yowama-2018: i-2018 FIFA World Cup RussiaTImisitho ezayo.
tgt: Uhlamvu lowezi-2018: Umqhudelwano wezi-2018 Wendebe Yomhlaba ye-FIFA Ozosingathelwa kwelase-Russia, i-2018 FIFA World Cup RussiaTImicimbi ezayo.

src: IKhabhinethi icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bayixhase iVeki yokuKhuselwa kwaBantwana eza kuqala ngomhla wama-28 kuCanzibe iphele ngomhla wesi-4 kweyeSilimela phantsi komxholo othi: “Sonke masikhusele abantwana ukuze siqhubele uMzantsi Afrika phambili”.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabanxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba basekele iViki Lokuvikelwa Kwezingane kusukela mhla zingama-28 kuNhlaba kuze kube ngumhla zizi-4 kuNhlangulana, ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Sonke masivikele izingane ukuze siqhubekisele iNingizimu Afrika phambili”.

src: Umba wokukhuselwa kwabantwana ngumsebenzi noxanduva lwabemi boMzantsi Afrika, abazali, abagcini-bantwana, abantu kunye noluntu.
tgt: Ukuvikelwa kwezingane zethu kungumthwalo wabo bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika abazali, abalondolozi, umuntu ngamunye kanye nemiphakathi.

src: Njengesizwe sinoxanduva lokwenza konke esinakho ukwenza ukuze siqinisekise ukuba abantu abasemngciphekweni wokuba ngamaxhoba okuxhatshazwa kwesi sizwe abaxhatshazwa baphathwe kakubi.
tgt: Njengezwe, sinomthwalo wokwenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuqinisekisa ukuthi mabangahlukunyezwa nakancane labo abangakwazi ukuzivikela ngokwabo emphakathini wethu.

src: Kusezandleni zethu ukuba siphelise umkhuba oxakileyo wokungakhathalelwa, ukuxhatshazwa, ubundlobongela nokuphathwa kakubi kwabantwana.
tgt: Kusezandleni zethu ukuqeda isihlava sokunganakwa, ukuhlukunyezwa, udlame kanye nokuxhashazwa kwezingane.

src: IKhabhinethi icela ukuba bonke abantu kweli lizwe badale iimeko ezikhuselekileyo nezifanelekileyo zokunceda abantwana bakhule, bantingele ezinkwenkwezini.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza yonke imikhakha yomphakathi ukuba isebenzisane ukwakha imiphakathi ephephile futhi engumqemane ukuze zikhule kahle izingane zethu.

src: Kule mibhiyozo yeminyaka elikhulu yokuzalwa kuka-OR Tambo, uMzantsi Afrika uza kubhiyozela iNyanga yoLutsha ngeyeSilimela yowama-2017 phantsi komxholo othi: “UNyaka ka-OR Tambo: Ukuqhubela Phambili Indima Edlalwa Lulutsha kuQoqosho.”Ngale nyanga, urhulumente uza kubamba iindibano eziliqela, eziquka imiboniso engezolutsha, iindibano zokubonisana kunye neengqungquthela ezingendima yolutsha kwezoshishino ukuze kucaciswe ngamathuba akhoyo okunceda abantu abatsha, futhi nokubakhuthaza ukuba bafunde iimpawu zobunkokeli ezibonakalisa nezixabise imfundo, izakhono ezo u-OR Tambo naye awayesimelele ngazo.
tgt: Ngenhloso yokugubha iminyaka eyikhulu kwazalwa u-OR Tambo, iNingizimu Afrika izoqopha iNyanga Yentsha ngoNhlangulana wezi-2017 ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Lona Ngunyaka ka-OR Tambo: Siqhubekisela Phambili Ukubandakanywa Kwentsha Kwezomnotho.”Ngokuqhubeka kwenyanga kaNhlangulana uhulumeni uzosingatha imicimbi ehlukahlukene kubandakanya imibukiso eyenzelwe intsha, izinkulumo-mpikiswano kanye nezizinda zamabhizinisi entsha ngenhloso yokubonisa amathuba akhona enzelwe abantu abasha kanye nokubafaka ugqozi lokuba bamukele futhi bagxile kumagugu-mgomo ka-OR Tambo obuholi nemfundo.

src: IKhabhinethi ikhuthaza bonke abantu abatsha ukuba bazisebenzise iinkqubo zoncedo nezemfundo eziqulunqwe ngurhulumente ukulungisela bona ukuze kuphuculwe izakhono zabo ukuze amathuba abo okuthatha inxaxheba evakalayo kuqoqosho abe mahle.
tgt: IKhabhinethi iyabakhuthaza bonke abantu abasha ukuba baqinisekise ukuthi bayafinyelela ezinhlelweni zosizo nezemfundo ezahlukahlukene ezihlinzekwa nguhulumeni ukuze baphucule futhi baqhubekisele phambili amathuba abo okubamba iqhaza emnothweni.

src: IKhabinethi icela bonke abaqeshi ukuba bafake isandla kwiphulo elibizwa i-Take a girl child to work ngomhla wama-25 nowama-26 kuCanzibe.
tgt: IKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abaqashi ukuba nabo balekelele emkhankasweni obizwa nge-Take a girl child to work mhla zingama-25 kuNhlaba kuya kumhla zingama-26 kuNhlaba.

src: Injongo yeli phulo kukunika abantwana abangamantombazana abafunda kwiBanga le-10 nele-12 ithuba lokuba bazibonele ngokwabo iintlobo zamakhondo ezahlukeneyo.
tgt: Inhloso yalo mkhankaso wukuhlinzeka amantombazane afunda iBanga le-10 kuya kwele-12 ngethuba lokuzibonela ngamehlo awo imisebenzi ehlukahlukene angayifundela uma esephothule isikole.

src: UMongameli Zuma ngoLwesine, umhla wama-25 kuCanzibe wowama-2017, uza kubamba umsitho wokubhiyozela uSuku lwesizwe lwe-Afrika eSefako Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse ePitoli.
tgt: NgoLwesine mhla zingama-25 kuNhlaba 2017 uMongameli Zuma uzosingatha umgubho kazwelonke woSuku lwe-Afrika wezi-2017 endlini yezivakashi zikaMongameli i-Sefako Makgatho Presidential Guesthouse ePitoli.

src: Lo msitho uza kube uluvuthondaba lwemibhiyozo neenkqubo eziphawula iNyanga ye-Afrika phantsi komxholo othi: “UNyaka ka-OR Tambo: Ukwakha i-Afrika eNgcono kunye neHlabathi eliNgcono”.
tgt: Lo mgubho wuvuthondaba lwemicimbi nezinhlelo okuqoshwe ngazo iNyanga ye-Afrika ngaphansi kwesiqubulo esithi: “Lona Ngunyaka ka-OR Tambo: Sakha i-Afrika Engcono Kanye Nomhlaba Ongcono”.

src: Lo mbhiyozo woSuku lwe-Afrika ubanjwa rhoqo ngonyaka uphawula ukusungulwa koMbutho weMbumba ye-Afrika (i-OAU) ngowe-1963.Xa siqukumbela le Nyanga ye-Afrika, iKhabhinethi icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba babambisane namanye ama-Afrika ahlala apha eMzantsi Afrika nabo bakwamanye amazwe kweli lizwekwazi ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuba lo mmandla wethu kunye ne-Afrika iphela inekamva eliqaqambileyo nelizele amathamsanqa.
tgt: Umgubho waminyaka yonke woSuku lwe-Afrika uqopha ukusungulwa kweNhlangano Yobumbano Lwamazwe ase-Afrika (i-OAU) ngowe-1963.Njengoba sesiphothula iNyanga ye-Afrika, iKhabhinethi inxusa bonke abantu baseNingizimu Afrika ukuba babambisane nabantu abavela kwamanye amazwe ase-Afrika abahlala eNingizimu Afrika kanye nalabo abahlala kwezinye izingxenye zaleli zwekazi ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuchuma nokuphumelela kwesifunda sethu kanye ne-Afrika yonkana.

src: Kubalulekile nokuba bonke abo bahlala ngaphakathi kwemida yeli, oko kukuthi abemi boMzantsi Afrika kunye nabanye abantu bamazwe angaphadle abakweli, bayihloniphe futhi bayithobele imithetho yeli lizwe.
tgt: Futhi kungumthwalo osemahlombe abo bonke abantu abahlala kuleli, okungabantu baseNingizimu Afrika kanjalo nabantu abavela emazweni angaphandle, ukuba bathobele imithetho yezwe.

src: Sisonke masilwe isihelegu sokurhweba ngabantu, ukuthinjwa kunye nokuxhatshazwa kwabasetyhini nabantwana.
tgt: Ngokubambisana kumele sonke silwisane nesihlava sokushushumbiswa nokuthunjwa nokuhlukunyezwa kwabesifazane nezingane.

src: Amazwi okuvuyisana.
tgt: Imiyalezo yakuhalalisa.

src: IKhabhinethi ilothulela umnqwazi iqela leengcungela zoogqirha leDyunivesiti yaseStellebosch kunye ne-Tygerberg Academic Hospital eliquka uNjing Andre van der Merwe, uGq Alexander Zuhlke, uNjing Rafique Moosa, uGq Amir Zarrabi kunye noGq Zamira Keyser.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela ithimba lezokwelapha leNyuvesi yase-Stellenbosch kanye nesibhedlela sase-Tygerberg elihlanganisa uSlz Andre van der Merwe, uDkt Alexander Zuhlke, uSlz Rafique Moosa, uDkt Amir Zarrabi kanye noDkt Zamira Keyser.

src: Basandula ukwenza utyando nofakelo lwelungu lobudoda lwesibini, into leyo eyenze esi yasisibhedlela sokuqala ehlabathini ukwenza olu qhaqho-tyando ngempumelelo izihlandlo ezibini.
tgt: Esikhathini esifushane esedlule leli thimba lenze ukuhlinzwa okungokwesibili kuleli kokufakela owesilisa isitho sangasese, futhi ngalokho liqophe umlando ngokuba yisikhungo sezokwelapha sokuqala emhlabeni jikelele esenze ukuhlinzwa kwesibili okunjengalokhu.

src: Ukwenza lo msebenzi ungaka ngempumelelo usenziwa zingcali zoqhaqho-tyando zeli kububungqina bokuba ngenene icandelo lezempilo loMzantsi Afrika kumaziko karhulumente lineengcaphephe ezingoompondo-zihlanjiwe ezikumgangatho wehlabathi.
tgt: Impumelelo yalokhu kuhlinzwa kwesiguli ezandleni zethimba lakuleli lokufakela izitho zomzimba iwubufakazi bekhono nobuchwepheshe obusezingeni eliphezulu obukhona eNingizimu Afrika emkhakheni wezokwelapha kahulumeni.

src: IKhabhinethi ithumele amazwi okuvuyisana kwi-iSimangaliso Wetland Park ngokufumana iMbasa yokuGqwesa kwezoPhicotho-zincwadi kumsitho we-South African Institute of Chartered Accountants (i-SAICA) weeMbasa zokuGqwesa kuRhulumente ekuqaleni kule nyanga.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela iSimangaliso Wetland Park ngokuklonyeliswa kwayo ngeNdodo Yombiko Wocwaningo-mabhuku Omuhle Kakhulu emcimbini we-South African Institute of Chartered Accountants (i-SAICA) wokuKlonyeliswa Ngezindondo Kwezikhungo Ezivelele Emkhakheni Kahulumeni obanjwe ngasekuqaleni kwale nyanga.

src: Le mbasa bawongwe ngayo ngokuba befumene iziphumo zophicotho-ncwadi ezingenachaphaza nezingabonisi nasikhwasilimo iminyaka emihlanu ilandelelana.
tgt: Le ndondo iwumklomelo wokuhalalisela lesi siKhungo ngokuthola kwaso imibiko yocwaningo-mabhuku engenasici iminyaka emihlanu ilandelana.

src: Umyezo iSimangaliso Wetland Park wabhengezwa njengeSiza esiliLifa seHlabathi sokuqala soMzantsi Afrika ngeyoMnga ngowama-1999.
tgt: NgoZibandlela we-1999, iSimangaliso Wetland Park samenyezelwa njengeSizinda Esiyigugu Emhlabeni sokuqala saseNingizimu Afrika.

src: IKhabhinethi iyavuyisana nenkqubo yokuSebenza ngoMlilo ngokufumana imbasa kuRhulumente wePhondo lase-Alberta eCanada ngoncedo lwayo kumsebenzi omkhulu wocimo-mlilo kweliya Phondo ngowama-2016.
tgt: IKhabhinethi ihalalisela uhlelo lokulwisana nomlilo i-Working on Fire ngokuzitholela kwalo indondo yokubonga evela kuhulumeni wesifundazwe sase-Alberta e-Canada ewuphawu lokubonga usizo olwahlinzekwa yilolu hlelo ekulawuleni imililo yequbula esiFundazweni sase-Alberta ngowezi-2016.

src: Inkqubo yokuSebenza ngoMlilo yinxalenye yeNkqubo eNatyisiweyo yeMisebenzi kaRhulumente (i-EPWP) enjongo zayo ikukunika amathuba emisebenzi kubantu abatsha basetyhini nabangamadoda.
tgt: I-Working on Fire iwuhlelo olungaphansi koHlelo Olunwetshiwe Lwemisebenzi Yomphakathi (i-EPWP) okuhloswe ngalo ukuhlinzeka ngamathuba etoho kubantu abasha besilisa nabesifazane.

src: Amazwi ovelwano.
tgt: Amazwi enduduzo.

src: IKhabhinethi nayo njengoMongameli Zuma kunye nehlabathi jikelele ilugxeka kabukhali uhlaselo lobunqolobi olwenziwe eManchester Arena eManchester e-England, elikhokelele kwintlungu yokusweleka nokonzakala kwabantu abatsha nabantwana abaninzi.
tgt: IKhabhinethi nayo njengoMongameli Zuma kanye nomhlaba jikelele isigxeka kakhulu isenzo sobushokobezi bokuhlaselwa kwe-Manchester Arena e-Manchester kwelase-England, esiholele ekutheni kushone futhi kulimale izingane eziningi kanye nentsha.

src: IKhabhinethi ibibambe intlanganiso yayo ngoLwesithathu, umhla wesi-7 kweyeSilimela kowama-2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.
tgt: IKhabhinethi yabamba umhlangano wayo ngoLwesithathu, mhla ziyi-7 kuNhlangulana 2017, eTuynhuys, eKapa.

src: Imiba engundaba-mlonyeni.
tgt: Izindaba ezisematheni.

src: IKhabhinethi iyalibethelela ikhwelo ebelihlatywe nguMongameli Jacob Zuma lokuba abemi boMzantsi Afrika babambisane balwe ubundlobongela noxhatshazo olwenziwa kwabasetyhini nabantwana, kwaye icela bonke abemi boMzantsi Afrika ukuba bathathe amanyathelo akhawulezileyo okusiphula neengcambu lo mkhuba mbi kangaka kwisizwe sethu.
